{"step_index":173,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T13:57:04Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-10T19:27:04+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-10T19:27:05+05:30\nShowing lines 1-324 of 324\n1: \"\"\"\n2: backend/utils/pdf_parser.py â€” Low-level PDF text extraction for DPM-101 Chatbot\n3: \n4: Responsibilities:\n5:   - Open PDF files using pdfplumber and extract per-page text.\n6:   - Clean whitespace and formatting artifacts without altering meaning.\n7:   - Detect Doc04 section boundaries to separate official exam rules\n8:     from unmoderated student forum comments.\n9:   - Return structured data only â€” no business logic, no chunking here.\n10: \n11: This module must NOT:\n12:   - Import or call the Gemini API.\n13:   - Perform TF-IDF indexing or retrieval.\n14:   - Access the SQLite database.\n15:   - Fabricate or assume document content not present in the PDF.\n16: \"\"\"\n17: \n18: from __future__ import annotations\n19: \n20: import re\n21: import logging\n22: from dataclasses import dataclass, field\n23: from pathlib import Path\n24: from typing import Optional\n25: \n26: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n27: \n28: \n29: # â”€â”€ Data classes â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n30: \n31: @dataclass\n32: class PageData:\n33:     \"\"\"\n34:     Represents one extracted page from a PDF.\n35: \n36:     page_number is 1-indexed (matches the visible page number in the PDF viewer).\n37:     is_empty is True when pdfplumber returned None or only whitespace for the page.\n38:     section_type is populated only during Doc04 processing; None for all other docs.\n39:     \"\"\"\n40:     page_number: int\n41:     text: str           # cleaned text; empty string when page has no extractable text\n42:     raw_text: str       # original text from pdfplumber before cleaning\n43:     is_empty: bool\n44:     section_type: Optional[str] = None   # 'official_exam_rules' | 'forum' | None\n45:     section_name: Optional[str] = None   # e.g. 'Section 1', 'Section 2', 'Forum'\n46: \n47: \n48: @dataclass\n49: class ExtractionResult:\n50:     \"\"\"\n51:     Result of extracting text from a single PDF file.\n52: \n53:     success is False when the file is missing, unreadable, or raises an error.\n54:     When success is False, pages will be empty and error will explain the reason.\n55:     page_count is the number of pages in the PDF (even if some are empty).\n56:     empty_page_count is the number of pages with no extractable text.\n57:     \"\"\"\n58:     doc_id: str\n59:     filepath: str\n60:     success: bool\n61:     pages: list[PageData] = field(default_factory=list)\n62:     error: Optional[str] = None\n63:     page_count: int = 0\n64:     empty_page_count: int = 0\n65: \n66: \n67: # â”€â”€ Custom exception â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n68: \n69: class Doc04SectionError(ValueError):\n70:     \"\"\"\n71:     Raised when Doc04 section-boundary detection cannot classify any page\n72:     as 'official_exam_rules'. This prevents silent ingestion of a document\n73:     whose structure does not match expectations.\n74:     \"\"\"\n75: \n76: \n77: # â”€â”€ Text cleaning â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n78: \n79: def clean_text(raw: str) -> str:\n80:     \"\"\"\n81:     Normalise whitespace and remove common PDF formatting artifacts\n82:     without altering the semantic content of the text.\n83: \n84:     Operations performed (in order):\n85:       1. Replace form-feed characters (page breaks in some PDFs) with a newline.\n86:       2. Replace carriage-return + newline pairs with a plain newline.\n87:       3. Collapse runs of three or more consecutive blank lines into two blank lines\n88:          (preserves paragraph breaks while removing excessive whitespace).\n89:       4. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from each line.\n90:       5. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from the whole string.\n91: \n92:     Does NOT:\n93:       - Remove hyphens, dashes, or punctuation (which carry meaning).\n94:       - Merge lines (which would destroy heading detection).\n95:       - Alter numbers, dates, or percentages.\n96:     \"\"\"\n97:     if not raw:\n98:         return \"\"\n99: \n100:     text = raw\n101:     text = text.replace(\"\\f\", \"\\n\")          # form-feed â†’ newline\n102:     text = text.replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\")        # Windows line endings\n103:     text = text.replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\")          # bare carriage returns\n104:     # Collapse 3+ consecutive blank lines to 2\n105:     text = re.sub(r\"\\n{3,}\", \"\\n\\n\", text)\n106:     # Strip trailing whitespace from each line (but keep the newline)\n107:     lines = [line.rstrip() for line in text.split(\"\\n\")]\n108:     text = \"\\n\".join(lines)\n109:     return text.strip()\n110: \n111: \n112: # â”€â”€ Core extraction â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n113: \n114: def extract_pages(pdf_path: str | Path) -> ExtractionResult:\n115:     \"\"\"\n116:     Extract text from every page of a PDF file using pdfplumber.\n117: \n118:     Returns an ExtractionResult. If the file is missing or pdfplumber raises\n119:     any error, success=False is returned with a descriptive error message.\n120:     No exception is propagated to the caller.\n121: \n122:     Args:\n123:         pdf_path: Absolute or relative path to the PDF file.\n124: \n125:     Returns:\n126:         ExtractionResult with per-page text and metadata.\n127:     \"\"\"\n128:     # Import pdfplumber lazily so the rest of the module is importable even if\n129:     # pdfplumber is not installed (e.g. during lightweight unit tests that mock this).\n130:     try:\n131:         import pdfplumber\n132:     except ImportError:\n133:         return ExtractionResult(\n134:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n135:             filepath=str(pdf_path),\n136:             success=False,\n137:             error=\"pdfplumber is not installed. Run: pip install pdfplumber\",\n138:         )\n139: \n140:     path = Path(pdf_path)\n141: \n142:     if not path.exists():\n143:         return ExtractionResult(\n144:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n145:             filepath=str(path),\n146:             success=False,\n147:             error=f\"File not found: {path}\",\n148:         )\n149: \n150:     if not path.is_file():\n151:         return ExtractionResult(\n152:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n153:             filepath=str(path),\n154:             success=False,\n155:             error=f\"Path exists but is not a file: {path}\",\n156:         )\n157: \n158:     pages: list[PageData] = []\n159:     empty_count = 0\n160: \n161:     try:\n162:         with pdfplumber.open(str(path)) as pdf:\n163:             total_pages = len(pdf.pages)\n164:             for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):\n165:                 page_num = i + 1   # 1-indexed\n166:                 try:\n167:                     raw = page.extract_text() or \"\"\n168:                 except Exception as page_err:\n169:                     logger.warning(\n170:                         \"pdfplumber failed to extract page %d of %s: %s\",\n171:                         page_num, path.name, page_err,\n172:                     )\n173:                     raw = \"\"\n174: \n175:                 cleaned = clean_text(raw)\n176:                 is_empty = len(cleaned) == 0\n177:                 if is_empty:\n178:                     empty_count += 1\n179: \n180:                 pages.append(PageData(\n181:                     page_number=page_num,\n182:                     text=cleaned,\n183:                     raw_text=raw,\n184:                     is_empty=is_empty,\n185:                 ))\n186: \n187:         logger.info(\n188:             \"Extracted %d pages from %s (%d empty).\",\n189:             total_pages, path.name, empty_count,\n190:         )\n191:         return ExtractionResult(\n192:             doc_id=\"unknown\",         # caller sets doc_id from DOC_REGISTRY\n193:             filepath=str(path),\n194:             success=True,\n195:             pages=pages,\n196:             page_count=total_pages,\n197:             empty_page_count=empty_count,\n198:         )\n199: \n200:     except Exception as err:\n201:         logger.error(\"Failed to open or read %s: %s\", path, err)\n202:         return ExtractionResult(\n203:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n204:             filepath=str(path),\n205:             success=False,\n206:             error=f\"PDF extraction failed: {err}\",\n207:         )\n208: \n209: \n210: # â”€â”€ Doc04 section detection â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n211: \n212: def detect_doc04_sections(\n213:     pages: list[PageData],\n214:     section_config: dict,\n215: ) -> list[PageData]:\n216:     \"\"\"\n217:     Classify each page of Doc04 as either 'official_exam_rules' or 'forum'.\n218: \n219:     The classification is page-level: once a section header is detected on a page,\n220:     all content on that page and subsequent pages (until the next header) receives\n221:     the same section_type.\n222: \n223:     Strategy:\n224:       1. Scan each page's text for official-section header patterns.\n225:       2. Scan for forum-section header patterns.\n226:       3. The first matching pattern on a page changes the current section state.\n227:       4. Defaults to 'official_exam_rules' at the start of the document\n228:          (Doc04 opens with official rules before the forum section).\n229: \n230:     Raises:\n231:         Doc04SectionError: if no page could be classified as 'official_exam_rules'.\n232:                            This prevents silent ingestion of unverified content.\n233: \n234:     Args:\n235:         pages: List of PageData extracted from Doc04 by extract_pages().\n236:         section_config: The 'section_config' dict from DOC_REGISTRY['doc04'],\n237:                         containing 'official_patterns' and 'forum_patterns' lists.\n238: \n239:     Returns:\n240:         A new list of PageData with section_type and section_name set on every page.\n241:     \"\"\"\n242:     if not pages:\n243:         raise Doc04SectionError(\n244:             \"Doc04 produced no pages; cannot verify official exam rule sections.\"\n245:         )\n246: \n247:     official_patterns = [\n248:         re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"official_patterns\", [])\n249:     ]\n250:     forum_patterns = [\n251:         re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"forum_patterns\", [])\n252:     ]\n253: \n254:     # Default: document starts with official content (Doc04 Â§1 opens the file)\n255:     current_section_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n256:     current_section_name = \"Section 1\"\n257: \n258:     classified: list[PageData] = []\n259: \n260:     for page in pages:\n261:         # Check the first non-empty line of the page for a section header\n262:         first_lines = page.text[:300]   # only scan the top of the page\n263: \n264:         new_type = None\n265:         new_name = None\n266: \n267:         for pattern in official_patterns:\n268:             match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n269:             if match:\n270:                 new_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n271:                 new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n272:                 break\n273: \n274:         if new_type is None:\n275:             for pattern in forum_patterns:\n276:                 match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n277:                 if match:\n278:                     new_type = \"forum\"\n279:                     new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n280:                     break\n281: \n282:         if new_type is not None:\n283:             current_section_type = new_type\n284:             current_section_name = new_name or current_section_name\n285: \n286:         classified.append(PageData(\n287:             page_number=page.page_number,\n288:             text=page.text,\n289:             raw_text=page.raw_text,\n290:             is_empty=page.is_empty,\n291:             section_type=current_section_type,\n292:             section_name=current_section_name,\n293:         ))\n294: \n295:     # Safety assertion: at least one page must be official_exam_rules\n296:     official_pages = [p for p in classified if p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"]\n297:     if not official_pages:\n298:         raise Doc04SectionError(\n299:             \"Doc04 section detection found zero pages classified as \"\n300:             \"'official_exam_rules'. Find candidate split points at sentence-ending punctuation followed by\n382:              whitespace ('. ', '! ', '? ') or at double newlines (paragraph breaks).\n383:           2. Accumulate text until the chunk would exceed CHUNK_SIZE.\n384:           3. At that point, split at the most recent candidate split point.\n385:           4. The next chunk begins CHUNK_OVERLAP characters before the current end\n386:              (or at the last sentence boundary before that point).\n387:           5. If no split point is found within CHUNK_SIZE characters (e.g. very long\n388:              sentence), force-split at the nearest word boundary.\n389: \n390:         Empty text produces an empty list.\n391:         Text shorter than CHUNK_SIZE produces a single chunk.\n392:         \"\"\"\n393:         if not text:\n394:             return []\n395: \n396:         size = self.chunk_size\n397:         overlap = self.chunk_overlap\n398: \n399:         # Sentence/paragraph boundary positions (end of sentence, inclusive)\n400:         boundary_re = re.compile(r\"(?<=[.!?])\\s+|(?<=\\n)\\n\")\n401:         boundary_positions = [m.start() for m in boundary_re.finditer(text)]\n402: \n403:         chunks: list[tuple[str, int, int]] = []\n404:         start = 0\n405:         text_len = len(text)\n406: \n407:         while start < text_len:\n408:             end = min(start + size, text_len)\n409: \n410:             if end < text_len:\n411:                 # Find the latest sentence boundary at or before `end`\n412:                 best_boundary = None\n413:                 for pos in reversed(boundary_positions):\n414:                     if start < pos <= end:\n415:                         best_boundary = pos\n416:                         break\n417: \n418:                 if best_boundary is not None:\n419:                     end = best_boundary\n420:                 else:\n421:                     # No sentence boundary: find nearest word boundary\n422:                     while end > start and not text[end - 1].isspace():\n423:                         end -= 1\n424:                     if end == start:\n425:                         end = min(start + size, text_len)   # force-split\n426: \n427:             chunk_text = text[start:end].strip()\n428:             if chunk_text:\n429:                 chunks.append((chunk_text, start, end))\n430: \n431:             if end >= text_len:\n432:                 break\n433: \n434:             # Advance start with overlap (back up `overlap` chars from end,\n435:             # but no further back than the last sentence boundary before end)\n436:             overlap_start = max(start + 1, end - Final Exam Rules\"\n148:                 r\"(?i)^2[\\.\\)]\\s+\",              # \"2. <anything>\"\n149:                 r\"(?i)^final\\s+exam\\s+rules\",    # \"Final Exam Rules\"\n150:                 r\"(?i)^examination\\s+rules\",     # \"Examination Rules\"\n151:             ],\n152:             \"forum_patterns\": [\n153:                 r\"(?i)^section\\s+[3-9]\\b\",       # \"Section 3\" and beyond\n154:                 r\"(?i)^student\\s+forum\",         # \"Student Forum Excerpts\"\n155:                 r\"(?i)^forum\\s+excerpt\",         # \"Forum Excerpts\"\n156:                 r\"(?i)^student\\s+comment\",       # \"Student Comments\"\n157:                 r\"(?i)^discussion\\s+forum\",      # \"Discussion Forum\"\n158:                 r\"(?i)^unmoderated\",             # \"Unmoderated comments\"\n159:             ],\n160:         },\n161:         \"topic_scope\": [\n162:             \"final_exam\", \"exam_format\", \"exam_device\",\n163:             \"proctoring\", \"exam_date\",\n164:         ],\n165:     },\n166: }\n167: \n168: \n169: # â”€â”€ Topic-to-Document Precedence â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n170: # Maps each topic category to the list of authoritative doc IDs (in priority order).\n171: # Used by retriever.py (Module 5) to enforce document authority.\n172: # \"doc04_official\" is a virtual alias for doc04 chunks with section_type='official_exam_rules'.\n173: # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n174: \n175: TOPIC_PRECEDENCE = {\n176:     # Grading and assessment â€” Doc 03 is sole authority; Doc 02 is excluded\n177:     \"grading\":              [\"doc03\"],\n178:     \"assessment\":           [\"doc03\"],\n179:     \"passing_requirement\":  [\"doc03\"],\n180:     \"distinction\":          [\"doc03\"],\n181:     \"late_submission\":      [\"doc03\"],\n182:     \"penalty\":              [\"doc03\"],\n183: \n184:     # Assignment and quiz submission deadlines â€” Doc 03 authority\n185:     \"assignment_deadline\":  [\"doc03\"],\n186:     \"quiz_deadline\":        [\"doc03\"],\n187: \n188:     # Final exam logistics and date â€” Doc 04 official sections only\n189:     # \"doc04_official\" maps to: doc_chunks WHERE section_type='official_exam_rules'\n190:     \"final_exam\":           [\"doc04_official\"],\n191:     \"exam_format\":          [\"doc04_official\"],\n192:     \"exam_device\":          [\"doc04_official\"],\n193:     \"proctoring\":           [\"doc04_official\"],\n194:     \"exam_date\":            [\"doc04_official\"],\n195: \n196:     # General course information â€” Doc 01 sole authority\n197:     \"schedule\":             [\"doc01\"],   # weekly schedule (NOT exam date)\n198:     \"faculty\":              [\"doc01\"],\n199:     \"objective\":            [\"doc01\"],\n200:     \"certificate\":          [\"doc01\"],\n201:     \"course_structure\":     [\"doc01\"],\n202: \n203:     # Forum comments â€” structurally excluded, never an answer source\n204:     \"forum\":                [],\n205: }"}

Now I'll write the full test suite for Module 3.","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_file","args":{"Content":"\"\"\"\ntests/test_document_service.py â€” Module 3: Course Document Management Test Suite\n\nAll tests use synthetic PDFs generated with fpdf2 so they run without the\nreal official DPM-101 PDFs (which are not in the repository).\n\nTest groups:\n  A. pdf_parser  â€” text extraction, whitespace cleaning, page numbering\n  B. doc04       â€” section detection, forum exclusion, Doc04SectionError\n  C. Fail-safe    â€” missing / unreadable required documents block healthy status\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport io\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\n# â”€â”€ Make sure the project root is on sys.path â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n# Needed when pytest is invoked from outside the project root.\nPROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nif str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:\n    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))\n\n# â”€â”€ Imports under test â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\nfrom backend.utils.pdf_parser import (\n    PageData,\n    ExtractionResult,\n    Doc04SectionError,\n    clean_text,\n    extract_pages,\n    detect_doc04_sections,\n)\nfrom backend.services.document_service import (\n    ChunkData,\n    ProcessingResult,\n    DocumentProcessor,\n)\nfrom config import DOC_REGISTRY, config\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# Helpers â€” synthetic PDF builders (fpdf2)\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\ndef _make_pdf(pages: list[str], *, tmp_path: Path, filename: str = \"test.pdf\") -> Path:\n    \"\"\"\n    Create a minimal PDF with one text string per page using fpdf2.\n    Returns the full path to the written file.\n    \"\"\"\n    from fpdf import FPDF  # fpdf2\n\n    pdf = FPDF()\n    pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=False)\n    pdf.set_font(\"Helvetica\", size=11)\n\n    for page_text in pages:\n        pdf.add_page()\n        for line in page_text.splitlines():\n            pdf.cell(0, 7, line, new_x=\"LMARGIN\", new_y=\"NEXT\")\n\n    out = tmp_path / filename\n    pdf.output(str(out))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"\n    Create a synthetic Doc04 PDF with:\n      Page 1: 'Section 1\\nFinal Exam Rules â€“ date, duration, format, proctoring'\n      Page 2: 'Section 2\\nDevice & proctoring requirements'\n      Page 3: 'Section 3\\nStudent Forum Excerpts'\n      Page 4: Forum comment text\n    \"\"\"\n    pages = [\n        \"Section 1\\nFinal Exam Date: November 20, 2026.\\nDuration: 90 minutes.\\nFormat: Closed-book. AI-proctored.\",\n        \"Section 2\\nDevice requirements: Desktop or laptop required.\\nWebcam and microphone required.\\nMobile and tablet not permitted.\",\n        \"Section 3\\nStudent Forum Excerpts\",\n        \"Student comment: I heard we can use phones for the exam.\",\n    ]\n    return _make_pdf(pages, tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_04.pdf\")\n\n\ndef _minimal_doc_registry(doc_id: str, pdf_path: Path, **overrides) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"\n    Build a minimal DOC_REGISTRY entry for a single document,\n    suitable for constructing a DocumentProcessor in tests.\n    \"\"\"\n    base = {\n        \"doc_id\": doc_id,\n        \"filename\": pdf_path.name,\n        \"title\": f\"Test Document {doc_id}\",\n        \"last_updated\": \"2026-01-01\",\n        \"policy_status\": \"current\",\n        \"is_required\": True,\n        \"is_outdated\": False,\n        \"section_config\": None,\n        \"topic_scope\": [],\n    }\n    base.update(overrides)\n    return {doc_id: base}\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# A. pdf_parser â€” extraction, cleaning, page numbering\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestCleanText:\n    def test_empty_string(self):\n        assert clean_text(\"\") == \"\"\n\n    def test_none_equivalent_empty(self):\n        # pdfplumber can return \"\" for empty pages\n        assert clean_text(\"   \") == \"\"\n\n    def test_strips_leading_trailing_whitespace(self):\n        assert clean_text(\"  hello world  \") == \"hello world\"\n\n    def test_collapses_multiple_blank_lines(self):\n        raw = \"line1\\n\\n\\n\\n\\nline2\"\n        result = clean_text(raw)\n        # 3+ blank lines collapsed to 2\n        assert \"\\n\\n\\n\" not in result\n        assert \"line1\" in result\n        assert \"line2\" in result\n\n    def test_form_feed_replaced(self):\n        raw = \"page1\\fpage2\"\n        result = clean_text(raw)\n        assert \"\\f\" not in result\n        assert \"page1\" in result\n        assert \"page2\" in result\n\n    def test_crlf_normalized(self):\n        raw = \"line1\\r\\nline2\\r\\nline3\"\n        result = clean_text(raw)\n        assert \"\\r\" not in result\n        assert \"line1\" in result\n        assert \"line2\" in result\n\n    def test_does_not_strip_meaningful_hyphens(self):\n        raw = \"AI-proctored examination\"\n        assert \"AI-proctored\" in clean_text(raw)\n\n    def test_preserves_numbers_and_dates(self):\n        raw = \"Exam date: November 20, 2026. Duration: 90 minutes.\"\n        result = clean_text(raw)\n        assert \"November 20, 2026\" in result\n        assert \"90 minutes\" in result\n\n    def test_does_not_merge_lines(self):\n        raw = \"Heading\\nSubheading\"\n        result = clean_text(raw)\n        assert \"Heading\\nSubheading\" in result\n\n\nclass TestExtractPages:\n    def test_missing_file_returns_failure(self, tmp_path):\n        result = extract_pages(tmp_path / \"nonexistent.pdf\")\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert \"not found\" in result.error.lower() or \"File not\" in result.error\n\n    def test_directory_instead_of_file_returns_failure(self, tmp_path):\n        result = extract_pages(tmp_path)   # tmp_path is a directory\n        assert result.success is False\n\n    def test_valid_pdf_returns_success(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Hello World\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is True\n        assert result.page_count == 1\n\n    def test_page_numbers_are_one_indexed(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Page 1\", \"Page 2\", \"Page 3\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is True\n        page_numbers = [p.page_number for p in result.pages]\n        assert page_numbers == [1, 2, 3]\n\n    def test_text_is_extracted(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Exam date: November 20, 2026.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is True\n        combined = \" \".join(p.text for p in result.pages)\n        assert \"November 20, 2026\" in combined\n\n    def test_multipage_page_count(self, tmp_path):\n        pages_text = [f\"Content of page {i}\" for i in range(1, 6)]\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf(pages_text, tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is True\n        assert result.page_count == 5\n        assert len(result.pages) == 5\n\n    def test_empty_page_counted(self, tmp_path):\n        # fpdf2 blank page (space only) may extract as empty\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Real content\", \"   \", \"More content\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is True\n        assert result.page_count == 3\n\n    def test_page_data_has_raw_and_clean_text(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Sample text.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        page = result.pages[0]\n        assert isinstance(page.text, str)\n        assert isinstance(page.raw_text, str)\n\n    def test_section_type_none_for_non_doc04(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"General course info.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        for page in result.pages:\n            assert page.section_type is None\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# B. Doc04 section detection\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nDOC04_SECTION_CONFIG = DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"][\"section_config\"]\n\n\ndef _make_pages(texts: list[str]) -> list[PageData]:\n    \"\"\"Create a list of PageData from plain text strings (no PDF needed).\"\"\"\n    return [\n        PageData(\n            page_number=i + 1,\n            text=t,\n            raw_text=t,\n            is_empty=(len(t.strip()) == 0),\n        )\n        for i, t in enumerate(texts)\n    ]\n\n\nclass TestDoc04SectionDetection:\n    def test_official_pages_classified_correctly(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nExam date: November 20, 2026.\",\n            \"Section 2\\nDevice requirements.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert all(p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\" for p in classified)\n\n    def test_forum_pages_classified_correctly(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nFinal Exam Rules.\",\n            \"Section 3\\nStudent Forum Excerpts\",\n            \"Student comment about the exam.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[0].section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"\n        assert classified[1].section_type == \"forum\"\n        assert classified[2].section_type == \"forum\"\n\n    def test_sticky_section_propagates(self):\n        \"\"\"Section type persists to subsequent pages with no header.\"\"\"\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nOfficial rule.\",\n            \"Continued official rule text without a new header.\",\n            \"Still same section.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert all(p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\" for p in classified)\n\n    def test_forum_sticky_after_switch(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nFinal Exam Date.\",\n            \"Section 3\\nForum section.\",\n            \"No header â€” should inherit forum.\",\n            \"Also no header â€” still forum.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[0].section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"\n        assert classified[1].section_type == \"forum\"\n        assert classified[2].section_type == \"forum\"\n        assert classified[3].section_type == \"forum\"\n\n    def test_raises_when_no_official_pages(self):\n        \"\"\"If the PDF has no official-section pages, Doc04SectionError must be raised.\"\"\"\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Student Forum Excerpts\",\n            \"Student comment: use your phone.\",\n        ])\n        with pytest.raises(Doc04SectionError):\n            detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n\n    def test_raises_on_empty_page_list(self):\n        with pytest.raises(Doc04SectionError):\n            detect_doc04_sections([], DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n\n    def test_section_name_set(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\"Section 1\\nRule text.\"])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[0].section_name is not None\n        assert len(classified[0].section_name) > 0\n\n    def test_case_insensitive_official_header(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\"SECTION 1\\nExam rule.\"])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[0].section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"\n\n    def test_case_insensitive_forum_header(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nRule.\",\n            \"STUDENT FORUM\\nSome comment.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[1].section_type == \"forum\"\n\n    def test_exam_date_in_official_section(self):\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nFinal Exam Date: November 20, 2026.\\nDuration: 90 minutes.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[0].section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"\n        assert \"November 20, 2026\" in classified[0].text\n\n    def test_forum_comment_cannot_override_official(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        A forum page claiming to override the exam date must NOT be classified official.\n        \"\"\"\n        pages = _make_pages([\n            \"Section 1\\nExam date: November 20, 2026.\",\n            \"Student Forum\\nI heard exam is on December 1.\",\n        ])\n        classified = detect_doc04_sections(pages, DOC04_SECTION_CONFIG)\n        assert classified[1].section_type == \"forum\"\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# C. DocumentProcessor.process_document\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestProcessDocument:\n    def test_missing_required_doc_returns_failure(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\n            \"doc01\",\n            tmp_path / \"document_01.pdf\",   # file not created\n            is_required=True,\n        )\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=500, chunk_overlap=50)\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc01\"])\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert result.skipped is True\n\n    def test_missing_optional_doc_returns_skipped(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\n            \"doc02\",\n            tmp_path / \"document_02.pdf\",   # file not created\n            is_required=False,\n        )\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=500, chunk_overlap=50)\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc02\"])\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert result.skipped is True\n\n    def test_valid_pdf_returns_success_and_chunks(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf(\n            [\"This is the course handbook. It describes the course structure and schedule.\"],\n            tmp_path=tmp_path,\n            filename=\"document_01.pdf\",\n        )\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=500, chunk_overlap=50)\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc01\"])\n        assert result.success is True\n        assert result.total_chunks > 0\n\n    def test_chunk_ids_are_unique(self, tmp_path):\n        pages = [f\"Content of page {i}. \" * 5 for i in range(1, 4)]\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf(pages, tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=200, chunk_overlap=30)\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc01\"])\n        ids = [c.chunk_id for c in result.chunks]\n        assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), \"Chunk IDs must be unique\"\n\n    def test_chunk_ids_contain_doc_id_and_page(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Sample text.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc01\"])\n        for chunk in result.chunks:\n            assert chunk.doc_id == \"doc01\"\n            assert chunk.chunk_id.startswith(\"doc01_p\")\n\n    def test_doc02_chunks_marked_outdated(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf(\n            [\"Assignment worth 30%. Late penalty 10% per day.\"],\n            tmp_path=tmp_path,\n            filename=\"document_02.pdf\",\n        )\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\n            \"doc02\", pdf_path,\n            is_outdated=True,\n            is_required=False,\n            policy_status=\"superseded\",\n        )\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc02\"])\n        assert result.success is True\n        assert all(c.is_outdated for c in result.chunks), \\\n            \"All doc02 chunks must be marked is_outdated=True\"\n        assert result.outdated_chunks == result.total_chunks\n\n    def test_doc03_chunks_not_outdated(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf(\n            [\"Passing requirement: 50%. Distinction: 85%.\"],\n            tmp_path=tmp_path,\n            filename=\"document_03.pdf\",\n        )\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\n            \"doc03\", pdf_path,\n            is_outdated=False,\n            policy_status=\"current\",\n        )\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc03\"])\n        assert result.success is True\n        assert all(not c.is_outdated for c in result.chunks), \\\n            \"doc03 chunks must NOT be marked outdated\"\n\n    def test_chunk_contains_source_metadata(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Course info.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        registry = chunk.page_number >= 1\n        assert chunk.last_updated == \"2026-01-01\"\n\n    def test_doc04_forum_chunks_excluded(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path)\n        registry chunks must be present\"\n\n    def test_doc04_official_chunks_not_excluded(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path)\n        registry = {\n            \"doc04\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_04.pdf\",\n            }\n        }\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc04\"])\n        official = [c for c in result.chunks if c.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"]\n        assert all(not c.is_excluded for c in official), \\\n            \"Official exam rule chunks must NOT be excluded\"\n\n    def test_doc04_forum_chunks_have_forum_section_type(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path)\n DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc04\"])\n        forum = [c for c in result.chunks if c.is_excluded]\n        assert all(c.section_type == \"forum\" for c in forum)\n\n    def test_doc04_exam_date_in_official_chunk(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path)\n        registry = {\n            \"doc04\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_04.pdf\",\n            }\n        }\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc04\"])\n        official_texts = \" \".join(c.text for c in result.chunks if not c.is_excluded)\n        assert \"November 20, 2026\" in retrievable_texts = \" \".join(c.text for c in result.chunks if not c.is_excluded)\n        # The forum comment \"I heard we can use phones\" must NOT be in retrievable content\n        assert TestProcessAll:\n    def _make_full_registry(self, tmp_path: Path, include_doc04: bool = True) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Create a minimal 4-document registry with real synthetic PDFs.\n        doc02 is optional (is_required=False).\n        \"\"\"\n        doc04_pdf = _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path) if include_doc04 else None\n\n        docs = {\n            \"doc01\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc01\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_01.pdf\",\n                \"is_required\": True,\n            },\n            \"doc02\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc02\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_02.pdf\",\n                \"is_required\": False,\n                \"is_outdated\": True,\n            },\n            \"doc03\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc03\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_03.pdf\",\n                \"is_required\": True,\n            },\n            \"doc04\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_04.pdf\",\n                \"is_required\": True,\n            },\n        }\n\n        _make_pdf([\"Course Handbook content.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        _make_pdf([\"Old grading policy.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_02.pdf\")\n        _make_pdf([\"Current grading policy. Passing: 50%.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_03.pdf\")\n        # doc04 already created above if include_doc04\n\n        return docs\n\n    def test_process_all_returns_all_four_doc_ids(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        assert set(results.keys()) == {\"doc01\", \"doc02\", \"doc03\", \"doc04\"}\n\n    def test_all_required_docs_succeed(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        for doc_id in [\"doc01\", \"doc03\", \"doc04\"]:\n            assert results[doc_id].success is True, \\\n                f\"{doc_id} must succeed when PDF is present\"\n\n    def test_processing_report_contains_all_doc_ids(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        for doc_id in [\"DOC01\", \"DOC02\", \"DOC03\", \"DOC04\"]:\n            assert doc_id in report\n\n    def test_processing_report_success_message_when_all_ok(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"All required documents loaded successfully\" in report\n\n    def test_processing_report_degraded_when_required_missing(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"Missing required doc must produce DEGRADED status in report.\"\"\"\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        # Remove doc03 PDF to simulate missing required file\n        (tmp_path / \"document_03.pdf\").unlink()\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"DEGRADED\" in report\n\n    def test_missing_optional_doc02_does_not_trigger_degraded(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        (tmp_path / \"document_02.pdf\").unlink()   # remove optional doc02\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"DEGRADED\" not in report\n\n    def test_report_mentions_excluded_chunks(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"excluded\" in report.lower() or \"forum\" in report.lower()\n\n    def test_report_mentions_outdated_chunks(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"outdated\" in report.lower() or \"superseded\" in report.lower()\n\n    def test_process_all_never_raises(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"process_all() must not raise even when all PDFs are missing.\"\"\"\n        registry = self._make_full_registry(tmp_path)\n        for fname in [\"document_01.pdf\", \"document_02.pdf\",\n                      \"document_03.pdf\", \"document_04.pdf\"]:\n            fp = tmp_path / fname\n            if fp.exists():\n                fp.unlink()\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        # Must not raise\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        assert isinstance(results, dict)\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# E. TestChunking:\n    def _processor(self, tmp_path, chunk_size=200, chunk_overlap=30):\n        return DocumentProcessor(\n            DOC_REGISTRY, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=chunk_size, chunk_overlap=chunk_overlap\n        )\n\n    def test_short_text_produces_single_chunk(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Short.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        reg = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        p = DocumentProcessor(reg, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=500, chunk_overlap=50)\n        result = p.process_document(reg[\"doc01\"])\n        assert result.total_chunks == 1\n\n    def test_long_text_produces_multiple_chunks(self, tmp_path):\n        long_text = \"This is a sentence about the course. \" * 60\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([long_text], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        reg = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        p = DocumentProcessor(reg, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=200, chunk_overlap=30)\n        result = p.process_document(reg[\"doc01\"])\n        assert result.total_chunks > 1\n\n    def test_chunks_do_not_exceed_chunk_size_greatly(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        Chunks may slightly exceed CHUNK_SIZE due to sentence-boundary logic,\n        but must not exceed 1.5Ã— CHUNK_SIZE in length.\n        \"\"\"\n        long_text = \"Important exam rule text. \" * 50\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([long_text], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        reg = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        chunk_size = 200\n        p = DocumentProcessor(reg, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=chunk_size, chunk_overlap=30)\n        result = p.process_document(reg[\"doc01\"])\n        for chunk in result.chunks:\n            assert len(chunk.text) <= int(chunk_size * 1.5), \\\n                f\"Chunk too long: {len(chunk.text)} chars (limit {int(chunk_size * 1.5)})\"\n\n    def test_overlapping_chunks_share_text(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        With overlap > 0, adjacent chunks must share some content (the overlap region).\n        \"\"\"\n        long_text = \"Alpha beta gamma delta epsilon. \" * 20\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([long_text], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        reg = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        p = DocumentProcessor(reg, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=100, chunk_overlap=30)\n        result = p.process_document(reg[\"doc01\"])\n        if result.total_chunks > 1:\n            # Check that at least one adjacent pair shares at least one word\n            shared = False\n            for i in range(len(result.chunks) - 1):\n                words_a = set(result.chunks[i].text.split())\n                words_b = set(result.chunks[i + 1].text.split())\n                if words_a & words_b:\n                    shared = True\n                    break\n            assert shared, \"Adjacent chunks should share words in the overlap region\"\n\n    def test_chunks_cover_all_content(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        The union of all chunk texts should cover the significant words\n        from the original document.\n        \"\"\"\n        content = \"Passing requirement is fifty percent. Distinction at eighty-five percent.\"\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([content], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_03.pdf\")\n        reg = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc03\", pdf_path)\n        p = DocumentProcessor(reg, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=50, chunk_overlap=10)\n        result = p.process_document(reg[\"doc03\"])\n        all_text = \" \".join(c.text for c in result.chunks).lower()\n        assert \"passing\" in all_text or \"percent\" in all_text\n\n    def test_chunk_char_start_end_valid(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"char_start must be < char_end and both must be non-negative.\"\"\"\n        content = \"Some text about the exam schedule and grading policy.\"\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([content], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        reg = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc01\", pdf_path)\n        p = DocumentProcessor(reg, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=30, chunk_overlap=5)\n        result = p.process_document(reg[\"doc01\"])\n        for chunk in result.chunks:\n            assert chunk.char_start >= 0\n            assert chunk.char_end > chunk.char_start\n\n    def test_doc04_forum_chunk_is_excluded_flag(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_doc04_pdf(tmp_path)\n        registry = {\"doc04\": {**DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"], \"filename\": \"document_04.pdf\"}}\n        p = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path), chunk_size=300, chunk_overlap=30)\n        result = p.process_document(registry[\"doc04\"])\n        for chunk in result.chunks:\n            if chunk.section_type == \"forum\":\n                assert chunk.is_excluded is True\n            else:\n                assert chunk.is_excluded is False\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# F. PDF hashing\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestPdfHashing:\n    def test_hash_is_hex_string_of_length_64(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Content.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor({}, str(tmp_path))\n        h = processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf_path)\n        assert h is not None\n        assert len(h) == 64\n        assert all(c in \"0123456789abcdef\" for c in h)\n\n    def test_hash_is_deterministic(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Deterministic content.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor({}, str(tmp_path))\n        h1 = processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf_path)\n        h2 = processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf_path)\n        assert h1 == h2\n\n    def test_different_files_have_different_hashes(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf1 = _make_pdf([\"Content A.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"a.pdf\")\n        pdf2 = _make_pdf([\"Content B.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"b.pdf\")\n        processor = DocumentProcessor({}, str(tmp_path))\n        assert processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf1) != processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf2)\n\n    def test_hash_returns_none_for_missing_file(self, tmp_path):\n        processor = DocumentProcessor({}, str(tmp_path))\n        h = processor.compute_pdf_hash(tmp_path / \"ghost.pdf\")\n        assert h is None\n\n    def test_hash_matches_manual_sha256(self, tmp_path):\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"Hashable content.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        processor = DocumentProcessor({}, str(tmp_path))\n        result_hash = processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf_path)\n        manual = hashlib.sha256(pdf_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        assert result_hash == manual\n\n\n# Fail-safe: missing required documents block healthy status\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestFailSafe:\n    def test_required_missing_result_not_success(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\n            \"doc01\",\n            tmp_path / \"document_01.pdf\",   # not created\n            is_required=True,\n        )\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc01\"])\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert result.chunks == []\n\n    def test_report_degraded_when_doc01_missing(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = {\n            \"doc01\": {\n                **DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc01\"],\n                \"filename\": \"document_01.pdf\",\n                \"is_required\": True,\n            }\n        }\n        # doc01 PDF deliberately not created\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"DEGRADED\" in report\n\n    def test_report_degraded_when_doc03_missing(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = {\n            \"doc01\": {**DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc01\"], \"filename\": \"document_01.pdf\", \"is_required\": True},\n            \"doc03\": {**DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc03\"], \"filename\": \"document_03.pdf\", \"is_required\": True},\n        }\n        _make_pdf([\"Course info.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        # doc03 deliberately missing\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"DEGRADED\" in report\n\n    def test_report_degraded_when_doc04_missing(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = {\n            \"doc01\": {**DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc01\"], \"filename\": \"document_01.pdf\", \"is_required\": True},\n            \"doc04\": {**DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"], \"filename\": \"document_04.pdf\", \"is_required\": True},\n        }\n        _make_pdf([\"Course info.\"], tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_01.pdf\")\n        # doc04 deliberately missing\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        results = processor.process_all()\n        report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n        assert \"DEGRADED\" in report\n\n    def test_doc04_section_error_produces_failed_result(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        If Doc04's PDF contains no official-section pages, the result must be\n        success=False (not a partial success), and the error must be recorded.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Doc04 PDF with no official headers at all â€” only forum text\n        all_forum_pdf = _make_pdf(\n            [\n                \"Student Forum Excerpts\\nI think the exam is easy.\",\n                \"Another student: It is totally open book.\",\n            ],\n            tmp_path=tmp_path,\n            filename=\"document_04.pdf\",\n        )\n        registry = {\"doc04\": {**DOC_REGISTRY[\"doc04\"], \"filename\": \"document_04.pdf\"}}\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc04\"])\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert result.error is not None\n        assert result.chunks == []\n\n    def test_processing_result_error_field_set_on_missing(self, tmp_path):\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\n            \"doc03\",\n            tmp_path / \"document_03.pdf\",\n            is_required=True,\n        )\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc03\"])\n        assert result.error is not None\n        assert len(result.error) > 0\n","Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_document_service.py"}}]}

{"step_index":282,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T14:10:29Z","input_tokens":2444,"cache_read_tokens":82400,"output_tokens":790,"tool_calls":[{"name":"edit_file","args":{"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_document_service.py","Replacement":"def _make_pdf(pages: list[str], *, tmp_path: Path, filename: str = \"test.pdf\") -> Path:\n    \"\"\"\n    Create a minimal PDF with one text string per page.\n\n    Tries fpdf2 first (project dependency); falls back to reportlab if fpdf2\n    is not installed (e.g. in the codex sandbox environment where only\n    reportlab is pre-installed). Both produce pdfplumber-readable PDFs.\n\n    Returns the full path to the written file.\n    \"\"\"\n    out = tmp_path / filename\n\n    try:\n        from fpdf import FPDF  # fpdf2\n        pdf = FPDF()\n        pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=False)\n        pdf.set_font(\"Helvetica\", size=11)\n        for page_text in pages:\n            pdf.add_page()\n            for line in page_text.splitlines():\n                pdf.cell(0, 7, line, new_x=\"LMARGIN\", new_y=\"NEXT\")\n        pdf.output(str(out))\n\n    except ImportError:\n        # Fallback: reportlab (available in codex sandbox runtime)\n        from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas as rl_canvas\n        from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4\n        c = rl_canvas.Canvas(str(out), pagesize=A4)\n        width, height = A4\n        for page_text in pages:\n            y = height - 72   # start near top\n            for line in page_text.splitlines():\n                # reportlab encodes latin-1 by default; replace non-latin chars\n                safe_line = line.encode(\"latin-1\", errors=\"replace\").decode(\"latin-1\")\n                c.drawString(72, y, safe_line)\n                y -= 14\n                if y < 72:\n                    break\n            c.showPage()\n        c.save()\n\n    return out","Target":"def _make_pdf(pages: list[str], *, tmp_path: Path, filename: str = \"test.pdf\") -> Path:\n    \"\"\"\n    Create a minimal PDF with one text string per page using fpdf2.\n    Returns the full path to the written file.\n    \"\"\"\n    from fpdf import FPDF  # fpdf2\n\n    pdf = FPDF()\n    pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=False)\n    pdf.set_font(\"Helvetica\", size=11)\n\n    for page_text in pages:\n        pdf.add_page()\n        for line in page_text.splitlines():\n            pdf.cell(0, 7, line, new_x=\"LMARGIN\", new_y=\"NEXT\")\n\n    out = tmp_path / filename\n    pdf.output(str(out))\n    return out"}}]}

Check which PDFs exist â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n    print(THIN_SEP)\n    print(\"1. PDF AVAILABILITY CHECK\")\n    print(THIN_SEP)\n\n    all_present = True\n    for doc_id, doc_config in DOC_REGISTRY.items():\n        path = docs_dir / doc_config[\"filename\"]\n        status = \"âœ“ FOUND\" if path.exists() else \"âœ— MISSING\"\n        required = \"(required)\" if doc_config[\"is_required\"] else \"(optional â€” audit only)\"\n        size = f\"  [{path.stat().st_size:,} bytes]\" if path.exists() else \"\"\n        print(f\"  {doc_id}: {doc_config['filename']:35s} {status}{size} {required}\")\n        if not path.exists() and doc_config[\"is_required\"]:\n            all_present = False\n\n    if not all_present:\n        print(\"\\nâš   One or more REQUIRED PDFs are missing.\")\n        print(\"   Place all four official PDFs in:\", docs_dir)\n        print(\"   Real-document validation cannot proceed until they are present.\")\n        print(\"\\n\" + SEPARATOR)\n        sys.exit(1)\n\n    # â”€â”€ 2. Run DocumentProcessor on all four PDFs â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n    print(\"\\n\" + THIN_SEP)\n    print(\"2. DOCUMENT PROCESSING\")\n    print(THIN_SEP)\n\n    processor = DocumentProcessor(\n        DOC_REGISTRY,\n        str(docs_dir),\n        chunk_size=config.CHUNK_SIZE,\n        chunk_overlap=config.CHUNK_OVERLAP,\n    )\n    results = processor.process_all()\n\n    # â”€â”€ 3. Per-document extraction report â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n    print(\"\\n\" + THIN_SEP)\n    print(\"3. PER-DOCUMENT EXTRACTION RESULTS\")\n    print(THIN_SEP)\n\n    for doc_id, result in results.items():\n        doc_config = DOC_REGISTRY[doc_id]\n        print(f\"\\n[{doc_id.upper()}] {doc_config['title']}\")\n        print(f\"  File          : {doc_config['filename']}\")\n        print(f\"  Policy status : {doc_config['policy_status']}\")\n        print(f\"  Is outdated   : {doc_config['is_outdated']}\")\n\n        if result.success:\n            print(f\"  Pages         : {result.page_count} ({result.empty_page_count} empty)\")\n            print(f\"  Chunks total  : {result.total_chunks}\")\n            print(f\"  Retrievable   : {result.official_chunks}\")\n            if result.excluded_chunks:\n                print(f\"  Excluded      : {result.excluded_chunks} (forum â€” never served)\")\n            if result.outdated_chunks:\n                print(f\"  Outdated      : {result.outdated_chunks} (superseded by doc03)\")\n\n            # Show first chunk as extraction sample\n            official_chunks = [c for c in result.chunks if not c.is_excluded]\n            if official_chunks:\n                sample = official_chunks[0]\n                preview = sample.text[:200].replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                print(f\"  First chunk   : [{sample.chunk_id}] p{sample.page_number}\")\n                print(f\"  Preview       : {preview!r}...\")\n\n            # PDF hash\n            pdf_path = docs_dir / doc_config[\"filename\"]\n            pdf_hash = processor.compute_pdf_hash(pdf_path)\n            print(f\"  SHA-256       : {pdf_hash[:16]}...{pdf_hash[-8:]}\")\n\n        else:\n            print(f\"  Status : FAILED â€” {result.error}\")\n\n    # â”€â”€ 4. Document precedence verification â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n    print(\"\\n\" + THIN_SEP)\n    print(\"4. DOCUMENT PRECEDENCE VERIFICATION\")\n    print(THIN_SEP)\n\n    checks = [\n        (\"doc01\", False, False, \"Doc01 â€” general course info (current, not outdated)\"),\n        (\"doc02\", True,  True,  \"Doc02 â€” superseded grading V1 (outdated=True, is_required=False)\"),\n        (\"doc03\", False, False, \"Doc03 â€” current grading authority (current, not outdated)\"),\n        (\"doc04\", False, False, \"Doc04 â€” official exam info (not outdated; forum filtered)\"),\n    ]\n\n    for doc_id, expect_outdated, expect_superseded, description in checks:\n        result = results.get(doc_id)\n        config_entry = DOC_REGISTRY[doc_id]\n        actual_outdated = config_entry[\"is_outdated\"]\n        actual_superseded = config_entry[\"policy_status\"] == \"superseded\"\n        ok = (actual_outdated == expect_outdated) and (actual_superseded == expect_superseded)\n        mark = \"âœ“\" if ok else \"âœ—\"\n        print(f\"  {mark} {description}\")\n        if not ok:\n            print(f\"    Expected is_outdated={expect_outdated}, superseded={expect_superseded}\")\n            print(f\"    Got      is_outdated={actual_outdated}, superseded={actual_superseded}\")\n\n    # â”€â”€ 5. Doc04 section filtering verification â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n    print(\"\\n\" + THIN_SEP)\n    print(\"5. DOC04 SECTION FILTERING VERIFICATION\")\n    print(THIN_SEP)\n\n    doc04_result = results.get(\"doc04\")\n    if doc04_result and doc04_result.success:\n        official = [c for c in doc04_result.chunks if not c.is_excluded]\n        forum    = [c for c in doc04_result.chunks if c.is_excluded]\n        print(f\"  Official exam rule chunks : {len(official)}\")\n        print(f\"  Forum chunks (excluded)   : {len(forum)}\")\n\n        if official:\n            all_official_text = \" \".join(c.text for c in official).lower()\n        else:\n            all_official_text = \"\"\n\n        # Key exam facts to verify\n        exam_checks = [\n            (\"November 20, 2026\",    \"Exam date\"),\n            (\"90\",                   \"90-minute duration\"),\n            (\"closed\",               \"Closed-book rule\"),\n            (\"proctor\",              \"AI-proctoring\"),\n            (\"desktop\",              \"Desktop/laptop requirement\"),\n            (\"webcam\",               \"Webcam requirement\"),\n            (\"mobile\",               \"Mobile restriction\"),\n        ]\n        print(\"\\n  Exam fact extraction (from official chunks only):\")\n        for keyword, label in exam_checks:\n            found = keyword.lower() in all_official_text\n            mark = \"âœ“\" if found else \"âš  NOT FOUND\"\n            print(f\"    {mark}  {label} ({keyword!r})\")\n\n        # Verify forum content is NOT in official chunks\n        forum_text = \" \".join(c.text for c in forum).lower()\n        if forum:\n            print(f\"\\n  Forum content excluded     : âœ“ ({len(forum)} forum chunks found, none retrievable)\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"\\n  Forum chunks found         : 0 (Doc04 may have no forum section â€” verify PDF)\")\n\n    elif doc04_result and not doc04_result.success:\n        print(f\"  âœ— Doc04 processing failed: {doc04_result.error}\")\n    else:\n        print(\"  Doc04 result not available.\")\n\n    # â”€â”€ 6. Final summary â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n    print(\"\\n\" + SEPARATOR)\n    print(processor.get_processing_report(results))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\validate_documents.py"}}]}
