{"step_index":299,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T14:18:27Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-10T19:48:27+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-10T19:48:29+05:30\nShowing lines 1-324 of 324\n1: \"\"\"\n2: backend/utils/pdf_parser.py â€” Low-level PDF text extraction for DPM-101 Chatbot\n3: \n4: Responsibilities:\n5:   - Open PDF files using pdfplumber and extract per-page text.\n6:   - Clean whitespace and formatting artifacts without altering meaning.\n7:   - Detect Doc04 section boundaries to separate official exam rules\n8:     from unmoderated student forum comments.\n9:   - Return structured data only â€” no business logic, no chunking here.\n10: \n11: This module must NOT:\n12:   - Import or call the Gemini API.\n13:   - Perform TF-IDF indexing or retrieval.\n14:   - Access the SQLite database.\n15:   - Fabricate or assume document content not present in the PDF.\n16: \"\"\"\n17: \n18: from __future__ import annotations\n19: \n20: import re\n21: import logging\n22: from dataclasses import dataclass, field\n23: from pathlib import Path\n24: from typing import Optional\n25: \n26: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n27: \n28: \n29: # â”€â”€ Data classes â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n30: \n31: @dataclass\n32: class PageData:\n33:     \"\"\"\n34:     Represents one extracted page from a PDF.\n35: \n36:     page_number is 1-indexed (matches the visible page number in the PDF viewer).\n37:     is_empty is True when pdfplumber returned None or only whitespace for the page.\n38:     section_type is populated only during Doc04 processing; None for all other docs.\n39:     \"\"\"\n40:     page_number: int\n41:     text: str           # cleaned text; empty string when page has no extractable text\n42:     raw_text: str       # original text from pdfplumber before cleaning\n43:     is_empty: bool\n44:     section_type: Optional[str] = None   # 'official_exam_rules' | 'forum' | None\n45:     section_name: Optional[str] = None   # e.g. 'Section 1', 'Section 2', 'Forum'\n46: \n47: \n48: @dataclass\n49: class ExtractionResult:\n50:     \"\"\"\n51:     Result of extracting text from a single PDF file.\n52: \n53:     success is False when the file is missing, unreadable, or raises an error.\n54:     When success is False, pages will be empty and error will explain the reason.\n55:     page_count is the number of pages in the PDF (even if some are empty).\n56:     empty_page_count is the number of pages with no extractable text.\n57:     \"\"\"\n58:     doc_id: str\n59:     filepath: str\n60:     success: bool\n61:     pages: list[PageData] = field(default_factory=list)\n62:     error: Optional[str] = None\n63:     page_count: int = 0\n64:     empty_page_count: int = 0\n65: \n66: \n67: # â”€â”€ Custom exception â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n68: \n69: class Doc04SectionError(ValueError):\n70:     \"\"\"\n71:     Raised when Doc04 section-boundary detection cannot classify any page\n72:     as 'official_exam_rules'. This prevents silent ingestion of a document\n73:     whose structure does not match expectations.\n74:     \"\"\"\n75: \n76: \n77: # â”€â”€ Text cleaning â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n78: \n79: def clean_text(raw: str) -> str:\n80:     \"\"\"\n81:     Normalise whitespace and remove common PDF formatting artifacts\n82:     without altering the semantic content of the text.\n83: \n84:     Operations performed (in order):\n85:       1. Replace form-feed characters (page breaks in some PDFs) with a newline.\n86:       2. Replace carriage-return + newline pairs with a plain newline.\n87:       3. Collapse runs of three or more consecutive blank lines into two blank lines\n88:          (preserves paragraph breaks while removing excessive whitespace).\n89:       4. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from each line.\n90:       5. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from the whole string.\n91: \n92:     Does NOT:\n93:       - Remove hyphens, dashes, or punctuation (which carry meaning).\n94:       - Merge lines (which would destroy heading detection).\n95:       - Alter numbers, dates, or percentages.\n96:     \"\"\"\n97:     if not raw:\n98:         return \"\"\n99: \n100:     text = raw\n101:     text = text.replace(\"\\f\", \"\\n\")          # form-feed â†’ newline\n102:     text = text.replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\")        # Windows line endings\n103:     text = text.replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\")          # bare carriage returns\n104:     # Collapse 3+ consecutive blank lines to 2\n105:     text = re.sub(r\"\\n{3,}\", \"\\n\\n\", text)\n106:     # Strip trailing whitespace from each line (but keep the newline)\n107:     lines = [line.rstrip() for line in text.split(\"\\n\")]\n108:     text = \"\\n\".join(lines)\n109:     return text.strip()\n110: \n111: \n112: # â”€â”€ Core extraction â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n113: \n114: def extract_pages(pdf_path: str | Path) -> ExtractionResult:\n115:     \"\"\"\n116:     Extract text from every page of a PDF file using pdfplumber.\n117: \n118:     Returns an ExtractionResult. If the file is missing or pdfplumber raises\n119:     any error, success=False is returned with a descriptive error message.\n120:     No exception is propagated to the caller.\n121: \n122:     Args:\n123:         pdf_path: Absolute or relative path to the PDF file.\n124: \n125:     Returns:\n126:         ExtractionResult with per-page text and metadata.\n127:     \"\"\"\n128:     # Import pdfplumber lazily so the rest of the module is importable even if\n129:     # pdfplumber is not installed (e.g. during lightweight unit tests that mock this).\n130:     try:\n131:         import pdfplumber\n132:     except ImportError:\n133:         return ExtractionResult(\n134:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n135:             filepath=str(pdf_path),\n136:             success=False,\n137:             error=\"pdfplumber is not installed. Run: pip install pdfplumber\",\n138:         )\n139: \n140:     path = Path(pdf_path)\n141: \n142:     if not path.exists():\n143:         return ExtractionResult(\n144:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n145:             filepath=str(path),\n146:             success=False,\n147:             error=f\"File not found: {path}\",\n148:         )\n149: \n150:     if not path.is_file():\n151:         return ExtractionResult(\n152:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n153:             filepath=str(path),\n154:             success=False,\n155:             error=f\"Path exists but is not a file: {path}\",\n156:         )\n157: \n158:     pages: list[PageData] = []\n159:     empty_count = 0\n160: \n161:     try:\n162:         with pdfplumber.open(str(path)) as pdf:\n163:             total_pages = len(pdf.pages)\n164:             for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):\n165:                 page_num = i + 1   # 1-indexed\n166:                 try:\n167:                     raw = page.extract_text() or \"\"\n168:                 except Exception as page_err:\n169:                     logger.warning(\n170:                         \"pdfplumber failed to extract page %d of %s: %s\",\n171:                         page_num, path.name, page_err,\n172:                     )\n173:                     raw = \"\"\n174: \n175:                 cleaned = clean_text(raw)\n176:                 is_empty = len(cleaned) == 0\n177:                 if is_empty:\n178:                     empty_count += 1\n179: \n180:                 pages.append(PageData(\n181:                     page_number=page_num,\n182:                     text=cleaned,\n183:                     raw_text=raw,\n184:                     is_empty=is_empty,\n185:                 ))\n186: \n187:         logger.info(\n188:             \"Extracted %d pages from %s (%d empty).\",\n189:             total_pages, path.name, empty_count,\n190:         )\n191:         return ExtractionResult(\n192:             doc_id=\"unknown\",         # caller sets doc_id from DOC_REGISTRY\n193:             filepath=str(path),\n194:             success=True,\n195:             pages=pages,\n196:             page_count=total_pages,\n197:             empty_page_count=empty_count,\n198:         )\n199: \n200:     except Exception as err:\n201:         logger.error(\"Failed to open or read %s: %s\", path, err)\n202:         return ExtractionResult(\n203:             doc_id=\"unknown\",\n204:             filepath=str(path),\n205:             success=False,\n206:             error=f\"PDF extraction failed: {err}\",\n207:         )\n208: \n209: \n210: # â”€â”€ Doc04 section detection â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n211: \n212: def detect_doc04_sections(\n213:     pages: list[PageData],\n214:     section_config: dict,\n215: ) -> list[PageData]:\n216:     \"\"\"\n217:     Classify each page of Doc04 as either 'official_exam_rules' or 'forum'.\n218: \n219:     The classification is page-level: once a section header is detected on a page,\n220:     all content on that page and subsequent pages (until the next header) receives\n221:     the same section_type.\n222: \n223:     Strategy:\n224:       1. Scan each page's text for official-section header patterns.\n225:       2. Scan for forum-section header patterns.\n226:       3. The first matching pattern on a page changes the current section state.\n227:       4. Defaults to 'official_exam_rules' at the start of the document\n228:          (Doc04 opens with official rules before the forum section).\n229: \n230:     Raises:\n231:         Doc04SectionError: if no page could be classified as 'official_exam_rules'.\n232:                            This prevents silent ingestion of unverified content.\n233: \n234:     Args:\n235:         pages: List of PageData extracted from Doc04 by extract_pages().\n236:         section_config: The 'section_config' dict from DOC_REGISTRY['doc04'],\n237:                         containing 'official_patterns' and 'forum_patterns' lists.\n238: \n239:     Returns:\n240:         A new list of PageData with section_type and section_name set on every page.\n241:     \"\"\"\n242:     if not pages:\n243:         raise Doc04SectionError(\n244:             \"Doc04 produced no pages; cannot verify official exam rule sections.\"\n245:         )\n246: \n247:     official_patterns = [\n248:         re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"official_patterns\", [])\n249:     ]\n250:     forum_patterns = [\n251:         re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"forum_patterns\", [])\n252:     ]\n253: \n254:     # Default: document starts with official content (Doc04 Â§1 opens the file)\n255:     current_section_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n256:     current_section_name = \"Section 1\"\n257: \n258:     classified: list[PageData] = []\n259: \n260:     for page in pages:\n261:         # Check the first non-empty line of the page for a section header\n262:         first_lines = page.text[:300]   # only scan the top of the page\n263: \n264:         new_type = None\n265:         new_name = None\n266: \n267:         for pattern in official_patterns:\n268:             match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n269:             if match:\n270:                 new_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n271:                 new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n272:                 break\n273: \n274:         if new_type is None:\n275:             for pattern in forum_patterns:\n276:                 match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n277:                 if match:\n278:                     new_type = \"forum\"\n279:                     new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n280:                     break\n281: \n282:         if new_type is not None:\n283:             current_section_type = new_type\n284:             current_section_name = new_name or current_section_name\n285: \n286:         classified.append(PageData(\n287:             page_number=page.page_number,\n288:             text=page.text,\n289:             raw_text=page.raw_text,\n290:             is_empty=page.is_empty,\n291:             section_type=current_section_type,\n292:             section_name=current_section_name,\n293:         ))\n294: \n295:     # Safety assertion: at least one page must be official_exam_rules\n296:     official_pages = [p for p in classified if p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"]\n297:     if not official_pages:\n298:         raise Doc04SectionError(\n299:             \"Doc04 section detection found zero pages classified as \"\n300:             \"'official_exam_rules'. The document structure may differ from \"\n301:             \"expectations. Inspect the actual PDF headings and update \"\n302:             \"DOC_REGISTRY['doc04']['section_config']['official_patterns'] in config.py.\"\n303:         )\n304: \n305:     official_count = len(official_pages)\n306:     forum_count = len(classified) - official_count\n307:     logger.info(\n308:         \"Doc04 section classification complete: %d official pages, %d forum pages.\",\n309:         official_count, forum_count,\n310:     )\n311:     return classified\n312: \n313: \n314: def _extract_section_name(text_snippet: str, match: re.Match) -> str:\n315:     \"\"\"\n316:     Extract a human-readable section name from the matched text.\n317:     Returns the matched line, truncated at 60 characters.\n318:     \"\"\"\n319:     start = max(0, match.start() - 1)\n320:     line_end = text_snippet.find(\"\\n\", start)\n321:     if line_end == -1:\n322:         line_end = len(text_snippet)\n323:     line = text_snippet[start:line_end].strip()\n324:     return line[:60]"}
{"step_index":300,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T14:18:28Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-10T19:48:28+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-10T19:48:29+05:30\nShowing lines 1-120 of 445\n1: \"\"\"\n2: backend/services/document_service.py â€” Document processing for DPM-101 Chatbot\n3: \n4: Responsibilities:\n5:   - Coordinate loading and processing of all four official DPM-101 PDFs.\n6:   - Apply document authority rules from DOC_REGISTRY.\n7:   - Apply Doc04 section filtering (official vs. forum).\n8:   - Produce overlapping, section-aware text chunks with full source metadata.\n9:   - Report the processing status of every document clearly.\n10: \n11: This module must NOT:\n12:   - Import or call the Gemini API.\n13:   - Perform TF-IDF indexing or retrieval.\n14:   - Access the SQLite database (chunked data is returned in memory only;\n15:     DB persistence is added in Module 5 as part of startup ingestion).\n16:   - Fabricate document content.\n17: \"\"\"\n18: \n19: from __future__ import annotations\n20: \n21: import hashlib\n22: import logging\n23: import re\n24: from dataclasses import dataclass, field\n25: from pathlib import Path\n26: from typing import Optional\n27: \n28: from backend.utils.pdf_parser import (\n29:     ExtractionResult,\n30:     Doc04SectionError,\n31:     PageData,\n32:     detect_doc04_sections,\n33:     extract_pages,\n34: )\n35: \n36: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n37: \n38: \n39: # â”€â”€ Data classes â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n40: \n41: @dataclass\n42: class ChunkData:\n43:     \"\"\"\n44:     A single retrievable text chunk produced from an official course document.\n45: \n46:     chunk_id is a stable, deterministic identifier:\n47:       {doc_id}_p{page:03d}_c{index:04d}\n48: \n49:     is_excluded: True  â†’ chunk must never be returned by the retriever.\n50:                  This flag is set for Doc04 forum sections.\n51:     is_outdated: True  â†’ chunk's grading/submission content is superseded by Doc03.\n52:                  This flag is set for all Doc02 chunks.\n53: \n54:     section_type values:\n55:       'official'              â€” general content (Doc01, Doc02, Doc03)\n56:       'official_exam_rules'   â€” Doc04 Â§1 and Â§2 (authoritative exam content)\n57:       'forum'                 â€” Doc04 Â§3+ (student forum; always excluded)\n58:     \"\"\"\n59:     chunk_id: str\n60:     doc_id: str\n61:     doc_title: str\n62:     source_filename: str\n63:     last_updated: str\n64:     policy_status: str          # 'current' | 'superseded' | 'official_exam_information'\n65:     page_number: int\n66:     section_name: str\n67:     section_type: str           # 'official' | 'official_exam_rules' | 'forum'\n68:     is_excluded: bool           # True â†’ retrieval SQL filters this out\n69:     is_outdated: bool           # True â†’ Doc02 grading content; not authoritative\n70:     text: str\n71:     char_start: int             # character offset within the page text\n72:     char_end: int\n73: \n74: \n75: @dataclass\n76: class ProcessingResult:\n77:     \"\"\"\n78:     Result of processing a single document from the DOC_REGISTRY.\n79: \n80:     success:          PDF was found, read, and chunked without errors.\n81:     chunks:           List of ChunkData produced. Empty on failure.\n82:     skipped:          True when file is missing but document is not required.\n83:     error:            Human-readable failure reason. None on success.\n84:     official_chunks:  Count of chunks with is_excluded=False.\n85:     excluded_chunks:  Count of chunks with is_excluded=True (forum content).\n86:     outdated_chunks:  Count of chunks with is_outdated=True (Doc02).\n87:     \"\"\"\n88:     doc_id: str\n89:     success: bool\n90:     chunks: list[ChunkData] = field(default_factory=list)\n91:     skipped: bool = False\n92:     error: Optional[str] = None\n93:     page_count: int = 0\n94:     empty_page_count: int = 0\n95:     official_chunks: int = 0\n96:     excluded_chunks: int = 0\n97:     outdated_chunks: int = 0\n98: \n99:     @property\n100:     def total_chunks(self) -> int:\n101:         return len(self.chunks)\n102: \n103: \n104: # â”€â”€ DocumentProcessor â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n105: \n106: class DocumentProcessor:\n107:     \"\"\"\n108:     Coordinates PDF extraction, section filtering, chunking, and status reporting\n109:     for all documents registered in DOC_REGISTRY.\n110: \n111:     Usage:\n112:         from config import DOC_REGISTRY, config\n113:         processor = DocumentProcessor(DOC_REGISTRY, config.DOCUMENTS_DIR,\n114:                                       config.CHUNK_SIZE, config.CHUNK_OVERLAP)\n115:         results = processor.process_all()\n116:         report = processor.get_processing_report(results)\n117:         print(report)\n118: \n119:     The returned results dict is keyed by doc_id.\n120:     \"\"\""}

Helpers â€” synthetic PDF builders (fpdf2)\n56: # â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n57: \n58: def _make_pdf(pages: list[str], *, tmp_path: Path, filename: str = \"test.pdf\") -> Path:\n59:     \"\"\"\n60:     Create a minimal PDF with one text string per page.\n61: \n62:     Tries fpdf2 first (project dependency); falls back to reportlab if fpdf2\n63:     is not installed (e.g. in the codex sandbox environment where only\n64:     reportlab is pre-installed). AI-proctored.\",\n112:         \"Section 2\\nDevice requirements: Desktop or laptop required.\\nWebcam and microphone required.\\nMobile and tablet not permitted.\",\n113:         \"Section 3\\nStudent Forum Excerpts\",\n114:         \"Student comment: I heard we can use phones for the exam.\",\n115:     ]\n116:     return _make_pdf(pages, tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_04.pdf\")\n117: \n118: \n119: def _minimal_doc_registry(doc_id: str, pdf_path: Path, **overrides) -> dict:\n120:     \"\"\""}

Minimum proctored final exam score: 40%.\"],\n            tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"doc03.pdf\",\n        )\n\n        reg02 = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc02\", pdf02,\n                                      is_outdated=True, is_required=True,\n                                      policy_status=\"superseded\")\n        reg03 = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc03\", pdf03,\n                                      is_outdated=False, is_required=True,\n                                      policy_status=\"current\")\n\n        combined = {**reg02, **reg03}\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(combined, str(tmp_path))\n\n        r02 = processor.process_document(reg02[\"doc02\"])\n        r03 = processor.process_document(reg03[\"doc03\"])\n\n        assert all(c.is_outdated for c in r02.chunks), \"All doc02 chunks must be outdated\"\n        assert all(not c.is_outdated for c in r03.chunks), \"No doc03 chunk must be outdated\"\n\n    def test_doc02_does_not_contain_current_policy(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        Verify that doc02 chunks are distinguishable from doc03 chunks by\n        is_outdated flag â€” confirming the retriever can filter them out.\n        \"\"\"\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf(\n            [\"Assignment worth 30%. Deadline: Week end.\"],\n            tmp_path=tmp_path, filename=\"document_02.pdf\",\n        )\n        registry = _minimal_doc_registry(\"doc02\", pdf_path,\n                                         is_outdated=True,\n                                         is_required=True,\n                                         policy_status=\"superseded\")\n        processor = DocumentProcessor(registry, str(tmp_path))\n        result = processor.process_document(registry[\"doc02\"])\n        retrievable_non_outdated = [c for c in result.chunks if not c.is_outdated]\n        assert retrievable_non_outdated == [], \\\n            \"No doc02 chunk should have is_outdated=False\"\n","Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_document_service.py"}}]}

{"step_index":381,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T15:13:22Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-10T20:43:22+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-10T20:43:22+05:30\nShowing lines 375-430 of 445\n375:         Split a page's text into overlapping chunks at sentence boundaries.\n376: \n377:         Returns a list of (chunk_text, char_start, char_end) tuples.\n378:         char_start and char_end are character offsets into the original page text.\n379: \n380:         Strategy:\n381:           1. Find candidate split points at sentence-ending punctuation followed by\n382:              whitespace ('. ', '! ', '? ') or at double newlines (paragraph breaks).\n383:           2. Accumulate text until the chunk would exceed CHUNK_SIZE.\n384:           3. At that point, split at the most recent candidate split point.\n385:           4. The next chunk begins CHUNK_OVERLAP characters before the current end\n386:              (or at the last sentence boundary before that point).\n387:           5. If no split point is found within CHUNK_SIZE characters (e.g. very long\n388:              sentence), force-split at the nearest word boundary.\n389: \n390:         Empty text produces an empty list.\n391:         Text shorter than CHUNK_SIZE produces a single chunk.\n392:         \"\"\"\n393:         if not text:\n394:             return []\n395: \n396:         size = self.chunk_size\n397:         overlap = self.chunk_overlap\n398: \n399:         # Sentence/paragraph boundary positions (end of sentence, inclusive)\n400:         boundary_re = re.compile(r\"(?<=[.!?])\\s+|(?<=\\n)\\n\")\n401:         boundary_positions = [m.start() for m in boundary_re.finditer(text)]\n402: \n403:         chunks: list[tuple[str, int, int]] = []\n404:         start = 0\n405:         text_len = len(text)\n406: \n407:         while start < text_len:\n408:             end = min(start + size, text_len)\n409: \n410:             if end < text_len:\n411:                 # Find the latest sentence boundary at or before `end`\n412:                 best_boundary = None\n413:                 for pos in reversed(boundary_positions):\n414:                     if start < pos <= end:\n415:                         best_boundary = pos\n416:                         break\n417: \n418:                 if best_boundary is not None:\n419:                     end = best_boundary\n420:                 else:\n421:                     # No sentence boundary: find nearest word boundary\n422:                     while end > start and not text[end - 1].isspace():\n423:                         end -= 1\n424:                     if end == start:\n425:                         end = min(start + size, text_len)   # force-split\n426: \n427:             chunk_text = text[start:end].strip()\n428:             if chunk_text:\n429:                 chunks.append((chunk_text, start, end))\n430: "}

Mock page.extract_text on page 2 to raise an error\n        import pdfplumber\n        real_open = pdfplumber.open\n\n        class MockPage:\n            def __init__(self, page, idx):\n                self._page = page\n                self._idx = idx\n\n            def extract_text(self):\n                if self._idx == 1:\n                    raise RuntimeError(\"Simulated unreadable corrupted font table\")\n                return self._page.extract_text()\n\n        class MockPdf:\n            def __init__(self, real_pdf):\n                self._real_pdf = real_pdf\n                self.pages = [MockPage(p, i) for i, p in enumerate(real_pdf.pages)]\n\n            def __enter__(self):\n                return self\n\n            def __exit__(self, *args):\n                self._real_pdf.__exit__(*args)\n\n        monkeypatch.setattr(pdfplumber, \"open\", lambda path: MockPdf(real_open(path)))\n\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert result.failed_page_count == 1\n        assert \"Simulated unreadable\" in result.error\n\n    def test_pdf_containing_only_whitespace_fails_extraction(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        A PDF where all pages contain only whitespace, tabs, or newlines\n        must be rejected as having no extractable text (success=False).\n        \"\"\"\n        pdf_path = _make_pdf([\"    \\n\\t  \\n  \", \"\\n\\n   \"], tmp_path=tmp_path)\n        result = extract_pages(pdf_path)\n        assert result.success is False\n        assert \"No extractable text\" in result.error\n","Target":"        assert len(official_chunks) > 0, \"Must have official exam chunks\"\n        assert len(forum_chunks) > 0, \"Must have excluded forum chunks\"\n        assert any(\"November 20, 2026\" in c.text for c in official_chunks)\n        assert all(\"phones\" not in c.text for c in official_chunks)"}}]}

ABOUT THE COURSE\n7: DPM-101 is an 8-week online course covering user research, product roadmapping,\n8: metrics, and AI feature design.\n9: \n10: 2. WEEKLY SCHEDULE & EFFORT\n11:   - Duration: 8 weeks (self-paced video lectures + live weekend doubt sessions)\n12:   - Expected Effort: 4 to 5 hours per week\n13:   - Discussion Forum: Open 24/7. Teaching assistants reply within 24 hours.\n14: \n15: 3. ASSESSMENT WEIGHTS\n16:   - Weekly Quizzes (6 quizzes, best 5 counted):   30% of total score\n17:   - Capstone Product Case Submission:             30% of total score\n18:   - Proctored Final Exam:                         40% of total score\n19: \n20: 4. CERTIFICATE TRACKS & FEE\n21:   - Audit Track (Free): Access to all lecture videos and reading material. Does not\n22:     include graded assignments, the final exam, or a certificate.\n23:   - Verified Certificate Track (Rs. 1,500): Full access to graded quizzes, capstone\n24:     evaluation, the proctored final exam, and the official Verified Certificate upon\n25:     passing.\n26:   - Upgrading from the Audit Track to the Verified Track is open until the end of Week 4."}

UPDATED PASSING CRITERIA (CURRENT COHORT)\n11:   - To earn the Verified Certificate, learners must achieve an overall weighted score\n12:     of at least 60% (increased from the earlier 50% threshold), AND must score at least\n13:     40% in the Proctored Final Exam separately.\n14:   - Learners scoring 85% or above still receive a \"Pass with Distinction\" badge.\n15: \n16: 2. Defaults to 'official_exam_rules' at the start of the document\n305:          (Doc04 opens with official rules before the forum section).\n306: \n307:     Raises:\n308:         Doc04SectionError: if no page could be classified as 'official_exam_rules'.\n309:                            This prevents silent ingestion of unverified content.\n310: \n311:     Args:\n312:         pages: List of PageData extracted from Doc04 by extract_pages().\n313:         section_config: The 'section_config' dict from DOC_REGISTRY['doc04'],\n314:                         containing 'official_patterns' and 'forum_patterns' lists.\n315: \n316:     Returns:\n317:         A new list of PageData with section_type and section_name set on every page.\n318:     \"\"\"\n319:     if not pages:\n320:         raise Doc04SectionError(\n321:             \"Doc04 produced no pages; cannot verify official exam rule sections.\"\n322:         )\n323: \n324:     official_patterns = [\n325:         re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"official_patterns\", [])\n326:     ]\n327:     forum_patterns = [\n328:         re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"forum_patterns\", [])\n329:     ]\n330: \n331:     # Default: document starts with official content (Doc04 Â§1 opens the file)\n332:     current_section_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n333:     current_section_name = \"Section 1\"\n334: \n335:     classified: list[PageData] = []\n336: \n337:     for page in pages:\n338:         # Check the first non-empty line of the page for a section header\n339:         first_lines = page.text[:300]   # only scan the top of the page\n340: \n341:         new_type = None\n342:         new_name = None\n343: \n344:         for pattern in official_patterns:\n345:             match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n346:             if match:\n347:                 new_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n348:                 new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n349:                 break\n350: \n351:         if new_type is None:\n352:             for pattern in forum_patterns:\n353:                 match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n354:                 if match:\n355:                     new_type = \"forum\"\n356:                     new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n357:                     break\n358: \n359:         if new_type is not None:\n360:             current_section_type = new_type\n361:             current_section_name = new_name or current_section_name\n362: \n363:         classified.append(PageData(\n364:             page_number=page.page_number,\n365:             text=page.text,"}

{"step_index":532,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T15:32:13Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-10T21:02:13+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-10T21:02:13+05:30\nShowing lines 320-375 of 462\n320:         path = Path(filepath)\n321:         if not path.exists() or not path.is_file():\n322:             return None\n323:         try:\n324:             sha256 = hashlib.sha256()\n325:             with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n326:                 for block in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b\"\"):\n327:                     sha256.update(block)\n328:             return sha256.hexdigest()\n329:         except OSError as err:\n330:             logger.error(\"Cannot hash %s: %s\", path, err)\n331:             return None\n332: \n333:     # â”€â”€ Private helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n334: \n335:     def _chunk_pages(\n336:         self, pages: list[PageData], doc_config: dict\n337:     ) -> list[ChunkData]:\n338:         \"\"\"\n339:         Produce overlapping, section-aware text chunks from a list of pages.\n340: \n341:         Each page is chunked independently to prevent chunks from spanning\n342:         page boundaries. Within a page, chunks respect sentence boundaries\n343:         where possible.\n344: \n345:         Chunk metadata includes source document identity, page number,\n346:         section type, and exclusion/outdated flags.\n347:         \"\"\"\n348:         chunks: list[ChunkData] = []\n349:         doc_id = doc_config[\"doc_id\"]\n350:         is_outdated = doc_config.get(\"is_outdated\", False)\n351:         policy_status = doc_config.get(\"policy_status\", \"current\")\n352:         doc_title = doc_config.get(\"title\", doc_id)\n353:         filename = doc_config.get(\"filename\", \"\")\n354:         last_updated = doc_config.get(\"last_updated\", \"\")\n355: \n356:         for page in pages:\n357:             if page.is_empty:\n358:                 continue\n359: \n360:             # Determine section metadata for this page\n361:             section_type = page.section_type or \"official\"\n362:             section_name = page.section_name or \"\"\n363:             is_excluded = section_type == \"forum\"\n364: \n365:             page_chunks = self._split_into_chunks(page.text)\n366: \n367:             for chunk_index, (text, char_start, char_end) in enumerate(page_chunks):\n368:                 chunk_id = f\"{doc_id}_p{page.page_number:03d}_c{chunk_index:04d}\"\n369:                 chunks.append(ChunkData(\n370:                     chunk_id=chunk_id,\n371:                     doc_id=doc_id,\n372:                     doc_title=doc_title,\n373:                     source_filename=filename,\n374:                     last_updated=last_updated,\n375:                     policy_status=policy_status,"}

{"step_index":541,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T15:33:13Z","input_tokens":2602,"cache_read_tokens":122569,"output_tokens":2540,"tool_calls":[{"name":"edit_file","args":{"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\backend\\utils\\pdf_parser.py","Replacement":"def detect_doc04_sections(\n    pages: list[PageData],\n    section_config: dict,\n) -> list[PageData]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Classify content of Doc04 as either 'official_exam_rules' or 'forum'.\n\n    Supports both multi-page PDFs (where each page is a PageData) and\n    single-file text documents (where page_count == 1, containing all sections).\n    For single-page documents, if multiple sections are present in that page's text,\n    it splits the page into sub-pages/sections so that official rules and forum\n    comments are properly isolated.\n\n    Raises:\n        Doc04SectionError: if no page/section could be classified as 'official_exam_rules'.\n\n    Args:\n        pages: List of PageData extracted from Doc04 by extract_pages().\n        section_config: The 'section_config' dict from DOC_REGISTRY['doc04'],\n                        containing 'official_patterns' and 'forum_patterns' lists.\n\n    Returns:\n        A list of PageData with section_type and section_name set on every item.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not pages:\n        raise Doc04SectionError(\n            \"Doc04 produced no pages; cannot verify official exam rule sections.\"\n        )\n\n    official_patterns = [\n        re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"official_patterns\", [])\n    ]\n    forum_patterns = [\n        re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"forum_patterns\", [])\n    ]\n\n    # Special handling for single-page documents (such as .txt files or single-page PDFs)\n    # that contain all sections in one text block.\n    if len(pages) == 1 and pages[0].text:\n        single_page = pages[0]\n        lines = single_page.text.split(\"\\n\")\n        sub_pages: list[PageData] = []\n        current_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n        current_name = \"Section 1\"\n        current_lines: list[str] = []\n        sub_page_idx = 1\n\n        for line in lines:\n            line_str = line.strip()\n            new_type = None\n            new_name = None\n\n            for pattern in official_patterns:\n                match = pattern.search(line_str)\n                if match:\n                    new_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n                    new_name = _extract_section_name(line_str, match)\n                    break\n\n            if new_type is None:\n                for pattern in forum_patterns:\n                    match = pattern.search(line_str)\n                    if match:\n                        new_type = \"forum\"\n                        new_name = _extract_section_name(line_str, match)\n                        break\n\n            # If section boundary detected and we have accumulated lines, flush\n            if new_type is not None and current_lines:\n                chunk_text = \"\\n\".join(current_lines).strip()\n                if chunk_text:\n                    sub_pages.append(PageData(\n                        page_number=sub_page_idx,\n                        text=clean_text(chunk_text),\n                        raw_text=chunk_text,\n                        is_empty=False,\n                        section_type=current_type,\n                        section_name=current_name,\n                    ))\n                    sub_page_idx += 1\n                current_lines = [line]\n                current_type = new_type\n                current_name = new_name or current_name\n            else:\n                current_lines.append(line)\n                if new_type is not None:\n                    current_type = new_type\n                    current_name = new_name or current_name\n\n        if current_lines:\n            chunk_text = \"\\n\".join(current_lines).strip()\n            if chunk_text:\n                sub_pages.append(PageData(\n                    page_number=sub_page_idx,\n                    text=clean_text(chunk_text),\n                    raw_text=chunk_text,\n                    is_empty=False,\n                    section_type=current_type,\n                    section_name=current_name,\n                ))\n\n        if sub_pages:\n            official_pages = [p for p in sub_pages if p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"]\n            if not official_pages:\n                raise Doc04SectionError(\n                    \"Doc04 section detection found zero pages classified as 'official_exam_rules'.\"\n                )\n            return sub_pages\n\n    # Multi-page documents (PDFs)\n    current_section_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n    current_section_name = \"Section 1\"\n    classified: list[PageData] = []\n\n    for page in pages:\n        first_lines = page.text[:300]\n        new_type = None\n        new_name = None\n\n        for pattern in official_patterns:\n            match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n            if match:\n                new_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n                new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n                break\n\n        if new_type is None:\n            for pattern in forum_patterns:\n                match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n                if match:\n                    new_type = \"forum\"\n                    new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n                    break\n\n        if new_type is not None:\n            current_section_type = new_type\n            current_section_name = new_name or current_section_name\n\n        classified.append(PageData(\n            page_number=page.page_number,\n            text=page.text,\n            raw_text=page.raw_text,\n            is_empty=page.is_empty,\n            section_type=current_section_type,\n            section_name=current_section_name,\n        ))\n\n    official_pages = [p for p in classified if p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"]\n    if not official_pages:\n        raise Doc04SectionError(\n            \"Doc04 section detection found zero pages classified as \"\n            \"'official_exam_rules'. The document structure may differ from \"\n            \"expectations. Inspect the actual headings and update \"\n            \"DOC_REGISTRY['doc04']['section_config']['official_patterns'] in config.py.\"\n        )\n\n    return classified","Target":"def detect_doc04_sections(\n    pages: list[PageData],\n    section_config: dict,\n) -> list[PageData]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Classify each page of Doc04 as either 'official_exam_rules' or 'forum'.\n\n    The classification is page-level: once a section header is detected on a page,\n    all content on that page and subsequent pages (until the next header) receives\n    the same section_type.\n\n    Strategy:\n      1. Scan each page's text for official-section header patterns.\n      2. Scan for forum-section header patterns.\n      3. The first matching pattern on a page changes the current section state.\n      4. Defaults to 'official_exam_rules' at the start of the document\n         (Doc04 opens with official rules before the forum section).\n\n    Raises:\n        Doc04SectionError: if no page could be classified as 'official_exam_rules'.\n                           This prevents silent ingestion of unverified content.\n\n    Args:\n        pages: List of PageData extracted from Doc04 by extract_pages().\n        section_config: The 'section_config' dict from DOC_REGISTRY['doc04'],\n                        containing 'official_patterns' and 'forum_patterns' lists.\n\n    Returns:\n        A new list of PageData with section_type and section_name set on every page.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not pages:\n        raise Doc04SectionError(\n            \"Doc04 produced no pages; cannot verify official exam rule sections.\"\n        )\n\n    official_patterns = [\n        re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"official_patterns\", [])\n    ]\n    forum_patterns = [\n        re.compile(p) for p in section_config.get(\"forum_patterns\", [])\n    ]\n\n    # Default: document starts with official content (Doc04 Â§1 opens the file)\n    current_section_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n    current_section_name = \"Section 1\"\n\n    classified: list[PageData] = []\n\n    for page in pages:\n        # Check the first non-empty line of the page for a section header\n        first_lines = page.text[:300]   # only scan the top of the page\n\n        new_type = None\n        new_name = None\n\n        for pattern in official_patterns:\n            match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n            if match:\n                new_type = \"official_exam_rules\"\n                new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n                break\n\n        if new_type is None:\n            for pattern in forum_patterns:\n                match = pattern.search(first_lines)\n                if match:\n                    new_type = \"forum\"\n                    new_name = _extract_section_name(first_lines, match)\n                    break\n\n        if new_type is not None:\n            current_section_type = new_type\n            current_section_name = new_name or current_section_name\n\n        classified.append(PageData(\n            page_number=page.page_number,\n            text=page.text,\n            raw_text=page.raw_text,\n            is_empty=page.is_empty,\n            section_type=current_section_type,\n            section_name=current_section_name,\n        ))\n\n    # Safety assertion: at least one page must be official_exam_rules\n    official_pages = [p for p in classified if p.section_type == \"official_exam_rules\"]\n    if not official_pages:\n        raise Doc04SectionError(\n            \"Doc04 section detection found zero pages classified as \"\n            \"'official_exam_rules'. The document structure may differ from \"\n            \"expectations. Inspect the actual PDF headings and update \"\n            \"DOC_REGISTRY['doc04']['section_config']['official_patterns'] in config.py.\"\n        )\n\n    official_count = len(official_pages)\n    forum_count = len(classified) - official_count\n    logger.info(\n        \"Doc04 section classification complete: %d official pages, %d forum pages.\",\n        official_count, forum_count,\n    )\n    return classified"}}]}

Do not start Module 5.\n\n## 1. Objective\n\nIntegrate Google's official Gemini API into the existing Flask backend using the official `google-genai` Python SDK.\n\nThe integration must be reliable, secure, configurable, testable and compatible with the existing project architecture.\n\nThe chatbot will eventually use Gemini to generate answers grounded in official DPM-101 course documents.\n\n## 2. Before implementation\n\nInspect the existing project completely, especially:\n\n- `config.py`\n- `requirements.txt`\n- `.env.example`\n- `.gitignore`\n- `backend/app.py`\n- `backend/services/`\n- `tests/`\n- Module 1 architecture decisions.\n\nUnderstand the existing structure before making changes.\n\nDo not recreate existing files unnecessarily.\n\n## 3. Gemini SDK integration\n\nUse:\n\n- Official package: `google-genai`\n- Python SDK: `google.genai`\n- Flask backend\n- API key from environment configuration.\n\nRequirements:\n\n1. Use the currently installed and compatible SDK version.\n2. Verify the correct SDK initialization and text-generation methods against that version.\n3. Do not use the deprecated `google-generativeai` package.\n4. Do not invent SDK methods or parameters.\n5. Keep Gemini integration inside a dedicated service, such as `backend/services/gemini_service.py`.\n6. Keep model configuration outside business logic.\n\n## 4. API key security\n\nRead the Gemini API key from:\n\n`GEMINI_API_KEY`\n\nRequirements:\n\n- Never hardcode the API key.\n- Never expose it to frontend JavaScript.\n- Never print or log the API key.\n- Never return the API key in API responses.\n- Keep `.env` excluded from Git.\n- Keep `.env.example` limited to placeholder values.\n- Fail clearly when the key is missing.\n- Do not overwrite an existing valid `.env` file.\n\n## 5. Model configuration\n\nUse environment-based configuration for:\n\n- Gemini model name.\n- API key.\n- Generation temperature.\n- Maximum output tokens.\n- Request timeout, where supported.\n\nChoose a currently supported Gemini Flash model after verifying availability and SDK compatibility.\n\nDo not assume that a model name is valid without checking it.\n\nDo not hardcode model settings in multiple files.\n\n## 6. Gemini service implementation\n\nImplement a dedicated service with responsibilities such as:\n\n- Initialize the Gemini client.\n- Validate configuration.\n- Accept a text-generation request.\n- Send the request to Gemini.\n- Extract generated text safely.\n- Handle empty or malformed responses.\n- Handle API errors.\n- Handle timeouts.\n- Handle quota or rate-limit errors.\n- Handle authentication failures.\n- Handle unavailable models or unsupported requests.\n\nDo not silently convert API failures into successful chatbot answers.\n\nReturn clear, sanitized internal errors without exposing secrets or sensitive provider details to users.\n\n## 7. Reliability\n\nImplement appropriate:\n\n- Request timeout handling.\n- Limited retries for transient failures only.\n- Exponential backoff where appropriate.\n- Safe handling of rate limits.\n- Proper resource/client handling.\n\nDo not retry authentication failures, invalid requests or other permanent failures unnecessarily.\n\nAvoid unlimited retries and excessive API calls.\n\n## 8. Integration boundaries\n\nFor this module:\n\n- Integrate Gemini into the backend service layer.\n- Preserve the existing Flask application.\n- Do not modify the health endpoint to call Gemini.\n- Do not make Gemini calls during application startup.\n- Do not expose Gemini directly to the frontend.\n- Do not implement document retrieval or TF-IDF.\n- Do not implement policy precedence or answer-grounding logic yet.\n- Do not implement conversation history, SQLite caching or duplicate request prevention.\n- Do not create the complete chatbot workflow.\n\nThose responsibilities belong to later modules.\n\n## 9. Testing requirements\n\nCreate comprehensive automated tests using mocks so that normal tests do not consume Gemini API quota.\n\nTest:\n\n1. Successful Gemini client initialization.\n2. Missing API key.\n3. Valid generation request.\n4. Correct generated-text extraction.\n5. Empty Gemini response.\n6. Malformed response.\n7. Authentication failure.\n8. Rate-limit failure.\n9. Network failure.\n10. Timeout.\n11. Retry behavior.\n12. No API key leakage in logs or error responses.\n13. Existing health endpoint remains independent of Gemini.\n14. Existing Module 2 and Module 3 tests continue passing.\n\nIf an actual Gemini API key is available, perform one minimal live connectivity test separately from automated tests.\n\nNever display the key in the report or terminal output.\n\nIf live testing is unavailable, state that clearly. Do not pretend a mocked test proves live API connectivity.\n\n## 10. Code quality\n\n- Follow the existing project architecture.\n- Use clear function and variable names.\n- Add appropriate type hints.\n- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.\n- Avoid duplicate configuration.\n- Add meaningful comments only where needed.\n- Keep the implementation maintainable.\n- Do not modify unrelated modules.\n\n## 11. Final verification report\n\nAfter implementation, provide:\n\n1. Files inspected.\n2. Files created or modified.\n3. SDK version and compatibility verification.\n4. Gemini model selected and availability verification.\n5. API key security verification.\n6. Service implementation details.\n7. Automated test results.\n8. Live API connectivity result, if performed.\n9. Existing regression test results.\n10. Remaining limitations or defects.\n11. Final Module 4 status.\n\nClearly distinguish mocked tests from actual Gemini API testing.\n\n## STRICT STOP CONDITION\n\nDo not start Module 5.\n\nDo not claim Module 4 is fully verified if live connectivity or other required checks remain incomplete.\n\nFinish Module 4, provide the complete report and wait for my review before proceeding.\n</USER_REQUEST>\n<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>\nThe current local time is: 2026-11-10T21:07:27+05:30.\n</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>"}

{"step_index":627,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T15:41:28Z","input_tokens":2405,"cache_read_tokens":159132,"output_tokens":3285,"tool_calls":[{"name":"write_file","args":{"Content":"\"\"\"\nbackend/services/gemini_service.py â€” Dedicated Gemini API Integration Service\n\nModule 4: Gemini API Integration\nIntegrates Google's official Gemini API using the official `google-genai` SDK (`google.genai`).\n\nKey responsibilities:\n  - Initialize the Gemini client securely from configuration.\n  - Expose `generate_text()` to send prompts and receive grounded text answers.\n  - Extract text cleanly and safely from responses.\n  - Handle transient errors (e.g. rate limits, 503 server errors) with exponential backoff retries.\n  - Fail immediately without retries on non-transient errors (invalid API key, 400 Bad Request).\n  - Never leak or log API keys or secrets in logs, exceptions, or error responses.\n  - Return structured, sanitized results via `GeminiResponse`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nimport re\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Optional, Any\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GeminiResponse:\n    \"\"\"\n    Standard response object returned by GeminiService.\n\n    success: True if text was generated successfully; False on error.\n    text: Generated text string (empty on failure).\n    model: Model name used for generation.\n    error: Sanitized error description if success=False; None otherwise.\n    error_type: Classification of error ('auth', 'quota', 'timeout', 'network', 'invalid_request', 'unknown').\n    prompt_tokens: Prompt token count if provided by provider metadata.\n    candidates_tokens: Generated candidate token count if provided.\n    total_tokens: Total token count if provided.\n    \"\"\"\n    success: bool\n    text: str = \"\"\n    model: str = \"\"\n    error: Optional[str] = None\n    error_type: Optional[str] = None\n    prompt_tokens: Optional[int] = None\n    candidates_tokens: Optional[int] = None\n    total_tokens: Optional[int] = None\n\n\nclass GeminiConfigurationError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when Gemini configuration (e.g. missing API key) is invalid.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GeminiService:\n    \"\"\"\n    Encapsulates interaction with the Google Gemini API using google-genai SDK.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        api_key: Optional[str] = None,\n        model: Optional[str] = None,\n        temperature: Optional[float] = None,\n        max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,\n        request_timeout: Optional[float] = None,\n        max_retries: Optional[int] = None,\n        client: Optional[Any] = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize GeminiService.\n\n        If parameters are omitted, values are pulled from config.py.\n        An explicit `client` can be injected for testing.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Delay importing config to avoid circular imports\n        from config import config\n\n        self.api_key = api_key if api_key is not None else config.GEMINI_API_KEY\n        self.model = model if model is not None else config.GEMINI_MODEL\n        self.temperature = (\n            temperature if temperature is not None else config.GEMINI_TEMPERATURE\n        )\n        self.max_output_tokens = (\n            max_output_tokens if max_output_tokens is not None else config.GEMINI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS\n        )\n        self.request_timeout = (\n            request_timeout if request_timeout is not None else config.GEMINI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT\n        )\n        self.max_retries = (\n            max_retries if max_retries is not None else config.GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES\n        )\n\n        self._client = client\n\n    def get_client(self) -> Any:\n        \"\"\"\n        Get or initialize the google.genai.Client instance.\n\n        Raises:\n            GeminiConfigurationError if API key is missing or empty.\n        \"\"\"\n        if self._client is not None:\n            return self._client\n\n        if not self.api_key or not self.api_key.strip():\n            raise GeminiConfigurationError(\n                \"Gemini API key is not configured. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in your environment or .env.\"\n            )\n\n        try:\n            from google import genai\n            self._client = genai.Client(api_key=self.api_key)\n            return self._client\n        except Exception as e:\n            sanitized = self._sanitize_message(str(e))\n            logger.error(\"Failed to initialize Gemini Client: %s\", sanitized)\n            raise RuntimeError(f\"Failed to initialize Gemini Client: {sanitized}\") from e\n\n    def generate_text(\n        self,\n        prompt: str,\n        system_instruction: Optional[str] = None,\n        temperature: Optional[float] = None,\n        max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,\n    ) -> GeminiResponse:\n        \"\"\"\n        Send a text generation request to Gemini with retry logic for transient errors.\n\n        Args:\n            prompt: User/context prompt text to send.\n            system_instruction: Optional system instruction for grounding / persona.\n            temperature: Optional override for temperature.\n            max_output_tokens: Optional override for max output tokens.\n\n        Returns:\n            GeminiResponse object containing success, text, and sanitized error info.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not prompt or not prompt.strip():\n            return GeminiResponse(\n                success=False,\n                model=self.model,\n                error=\"Prompt cannot be empty.\",\n                error_type=\"invalid_request\",\n            )\n\n        try:\n            client = self.get_client()\n        except GeminiConfigurationError as cfg_err:\n            return GeminiResponse(\n                success=False,\n                model=self.model,\n                error=str(cfg_err),\n                error_type=\"auth\",\n            )\n        except Exception as init_err:\n            return GeminiResponse(\n                success=False,\n                model=self.model,\n                error=self._sanitize_message(str(init_err)),\n                error_type=\"unknown\",\n            )\n\n        # Build GenerateContentConfig\n        eff_temp = temperature if temperature is not None else self.temperature\n        eff_tokens = max_output_tokens if max_output_tokens is not None else self.max_output_tokens\n\n        try:\n            from google.genai import types\n            config_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {\n                \"temperature\": eff_temp,\n                \"max_output_tokens\": eff_tokens,\n            }\n            if system_instruction:\n                config_kwargs[\"system_instruction\"] = system_instruction\n\n            config_obj = types.GenerateContentConfig(**config_kwargs)\n        except Exception as cfg_build_err:\n            return GeminiResponse(\n                success=False,\n                model=self.model,\n                error=f\"Failed to build configuration: {self._sanitize_message(str(cfg_build_err))}\",\n                error_type=\"invalid_request\",\n            )\n\n        retries = 0\n        backoff_delay = 1.0\n\n        while True:\n            try:\n                response = client.models.generate_content(\n                    model=self.model,\n                    contents=prompt,\n                    config=config_obj,\n                )\n                return self._parse_response(response)\n\n            except Exception as exc:\n                is_transient, error_type, clean_msg = self._classify_exception(exc)\n\n                if is_transient and retries < self.max_retries:\n                    retries += 1\n                    logger.warning(\n                        \"Gemini API transient failure (attempt %d/%d, retrying in %.1fs): %s\",\n                        retries, self.max_retries, backoff_delay, clean_msg,\n                    )\n                    time.sleep(backoff_delay)\n                    backoff_delay *= 2.0\n                    continue\n\n                logger.error(\n                    \"Gemini API error (error_type=%s, permanent or retries exhausted): %s\",\n                    error_type, clean_msg,\n                )\n                return GeminiResponse(\n                    success=False,\n                    model=self.model,\n                    error=clean_msg,\n                    error_type=error_type,\n                )\n\n    def _parse_response(self, response: Any) -> GeminiResponse:\n        \"\"\"\n        Safely extract text and metadata from google.genai GenerateContentResponse.\n        \"\"\"\n        if response is None:\n            return GeminiResponse(\n                success=False,\n                model=self.model,\n                error=\"Empty response received from Gemini API.\",\n                error_type=\"malformed_response\",\n            )\n\n        # Attempt standard .text property\n        generated_text = \"\"\n        try:\n            if hasattr(response, \"text\") and response.text:\n                generated_text = response.text\n            elif hasattr(response, \"candidates\") and response.candidates:\n                candidate = response.candidates[0]\n                if hasattr(candidate, \"content\") and hasattr(candidate.content, \"parts\"):\n                    parts_text = [\n                        p.text for p in candidate.content.parts if hasattr(p, \"text\") and p.text\n                    ]\n                    generated_text = \"\".join(parts_text)\n        except Exception as parse_err:\n            logger.warning(\"Error parsing Gemini response candidates: %s\", parse_err)\n            generated_text = \"\"\n\n        # Extract usage metadata if available\n        prompt_tokens = None\n        candidates_tokens = None\n        total_tokens = None\n\n        if hasattr(response, \"usage_metadata\") and response.usage_metadata:\n            meta = response.usage_metadata\n            prompt_tokens = getattr(meta, \"prompt_token_count\", None)\n            candidates_tokens = getattr(meta, \"candidates_token_count\", None)\n            total_tokens = getattr(meta, \"total_token_count\", None)\n\n        if not generated_text or not generated_text.strip():\n            # Check for safety ratings / finish reason\n            finish_reason = \"empty\"\n            if hasattr(response, \"candidates\") and response.candidates:\n                candidate = response.candidates[0]\n                finish_reason = getattr(candidate, \"finish_reason\", \"empty\")\n\n            return GeminiResponse(\n                success=False,\n                model=self.model,\n                error=f\"Gemini returned an empty response (finish_reason: {finish_reason}).\",\n                error_type=\"empty_response\",\n                prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,\n                candidates_tokens=candidates_tokens,\n                total_tokens=total_tokens,\n            )\n\n        return GeminiResponse(\n            success=True,\n            text=generated_text.strip(),\n            model=self.model,\n            prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,\n            candidates_tokens=candidates_tokens,\n            total_tokens=total_tokens,\n        )\n\n    def _classify_exception(self, exc: Exception) -> tuple[bool, str, str]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Classify an exception into (is_transient, error_type, sanitized_message).\n        \"\"\"\n        msg = str(exc)\n        repr_str = repr(exc)\n        lower = f\"{msg} {repr_str}\".lower()\n        sanitized = self._sanitize_message(msg or repr_str)\n\n        # 1. Authentication / Permission errors (Non-transient)\n        if any(w in lower for w in (\"api_key_invalid\", \"api key not valid\", \"unauthenticated\", \"permission_denied\", \"invalid api key\")):\n            return False, \"auth\", f\"Authentication failed: {sanitized}\"\n\n        # 2. Quota / Rate limit (Transient if rate limit, Non-transient if hard quota exceeded)\n        if any(w in lower for w in (\"resource_exhausted\", \"quota exceeded\", \"rate limit\", \"429\")):\n            return True, \"quota\", f\"Gemini quota or rate limit exceeded: {sanitized}\"\n\n        # 3. Timeouts (Transient)\n        if any(w in lower for w in (\"timeout\", \"timed out\", \"deadline_exceeded\", \"connecttimeouterror\")):\n            return True, \"timeout\", f\"Request timed out: {sanitized}\"\n\n        # 4. Network / Connection errors (Transient)\n        if any(w in lower for w in (\"connection refused\", \"connection error\", \"connection reset\", \"broken pipe\", \"failed to establish a new connection\", \"remotedisconnected\")):\n            return True, \"network\", f\"Network connectivity error: {sanitized}\"\n\n        # 5. Service unavailable / Server errors (Transient)\n        if any(w in lower for w in (\"503\", \"502\", \"504\", \"unavailable\", \"server error\", \"internal server error\")):\n            return True, \"server_error\", f\"Gemini server error: {sanitized}\"\n\n        # 6. Invalid request / bad model (Non-transient)\n        if any(w in lower for w in (\"400\", \"invalid_argument\", \"model not found\", \"not supported for model\")):\n            return False, \"invalid_request\", f\"Invalid request or model configuration: {sanitized}\"\n\n        # Default fallback (Non-transient to prevent infinite loops)\n        return False, \"unknown\", f\"Gemini API request failed: {sanitized}\"\n\n    def _sanitize_message(self, text: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        Remove API key or sensitive credentials from error strings.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not text:\n            return \"\"\n        sanitized = text\n        if self.api_key and len(self.api_key) > 5:\n            sanitized = sanitized.replace(self.api_key, \"[REDACTED_API_KEY]\")\n        # Redact generic AIzaSy keys pattern\n        sanitized = re.sub(r\"AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35}\", \"[REDACTED_API_KEY]\", sanitized)\n        return sanitized\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\backend\\services\\gemini_service.py"}}]}

Health endpoint remains completely independent of Gemini\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch\nimport pytest\n\nfrom backend.services.gemini_service import (\n    GeminiService,\n    GeminiResponse,\n    GeminiConfigurationError,\n)\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Fixtures â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef mock_client():\n    \"\"\"Create a mock genai.Client with a mock models.generate_content method.\"\"\"\n    client = MagicMock()\n    mock_resp = MagicMock()\n    mock_resp.text = \"Hello! I am grounded in DPM-101 course documents.\"\n    mock_resp.candidates = [MagicMock()]\n    mock_resp.candidates[0].content.parts = [MagicMock(text=mock_resp.text)]\n    mock_resp.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count = 10\n    mock_resp.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count = 15\n    mock_resp.usage_metadata.total_token_count = 25\n    client.models.generate_content.return_value = mock_resp\n    return client\n\n\n# â”€â”€ 1. Client Initialization & Configuration â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestGeminiInitialization:\n    def test_missing_api_key_raises_configuration_error(self):\n        \"\"\"Missing or empty API key must raise GeminiConfigurationError.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"\")\n        with pytest.raises(GeminiConfigurationError, match=\"not configured\"):\n            service.get_client()\n\n    def test_whitespace_api_key_raises_configuration_error(self):\n        \"\"\"Whitespace-only API key must also raise GeminiConfigurationError.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"   \")\n        with pytest.raises(GeminiConfigurationError, match=\"not configured\"):\n            service.get_client()\n\n    def test_successful_client_initialization_with_injected_client(self, mock_client):\n        \"\"\"Injected client should be returned directly without calling genai.Client.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"test_key\", client=mock_client)\n        assert service.get_client() is mock_client\n\n    @patch(\"google.genai.Client\")\n    def test_successful_client_initialization_via_sdk(self, mock_genai_client_class):\n        \"\"\"Valid API key should call genai.Client(api_key=...).\"\"\"\n        mock_instance = MagicMock()\n        mock_genai_client_class.return_value = mock_instance\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"valid_test_api_key_123\")\n        client = service.get_client()\n\n        mock_genai_client_class.assert_called_once_with(api_key=\"valid_test_api_key_123\")\n        assert client is mock_instance\n\n\n# â”€â”€ 2. Generation Requests & Response Extraction â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestGeminiGeneration:\n    def test_valid_generation_request(self, mock_client):\n        \"\"\"Valid prompt must return success=True and populated text.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"test_key\", client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"What is the passing criteria?\")\n\n        assert resp.success is True\n        assert \"grounded in DPM-101\" in resp.text\n        assert resp.error is None\n        assert resp.prompt_tokens == 10\n        assert resp.candidates_tokens == 15\n        assert resp.total_tokens == 25\n\n    def test_empty_prompt_rejected_without_api_call(self, mock_client):\n        \"\"\"Empty or whitespace prompt must return invalid_request without calling client.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"test_key\", client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"   \")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"invalid_request\"\n        assert \"empty\" in resp.error.lower()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.assert_not_called()\n\n    def test_unconfigured_api_key_returns_auth_error(self):\n        \"\"\"generate_text without configured API key must return success=False with auth error.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"\")\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Hello\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"auth\"\n        assert \"not configured\" in resp.error\n\n    def test_text_extraction_from_candidates_parts_fallback(self):\n        \"\"\"If response.text is empty, fallback to candidates[0].content.parts.\"\"\"\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_resp = MagicMock()\n        mock_resp.text = None  # Part 2 text.\"\n\n    def test_empty_gemini_response(self):\n        \"\"\"When Gemini returns an empty candidate or text, return empty_response error.\"\"\"\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_resp = MagicMock()\n        mock_resp.text = \"\"\n        mock_resp.candidates = [MagicMock(finish_reason=\"SAFETY\")]\n        mock_resp.candidates[0].content.parts = []\n        mock_resp.usage_metadata = None\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.return_value = mock_resp\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"test_key\", client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Controversial topic\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"empty_response\"\n        assert \"SAFETY\" in resp.error\n\n    def test_none_malformed_response(self):\n        \"\"\"When client returns None, return malformed_response.\"\"\"\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.return_value = None\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"test_key\", client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Hello\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"malformed_response\"\n\n\n# â”€â”€ 3. Error Handling & Retry Policies â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestGeminiErrorHandlingAndRetries:\n    def test_authentication_failure_no_retries(self):\n        \"\"\"Authentication failure (e.g. 403 API_KEY_INVALID) must fail immediately with no retry.\"\"\"\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = RuntimeError(\n            \"API_KEY_INVALID: API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key.\"\n        )\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"bad_key\", max_retries=3, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Hello\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"auth\"\n        assert \"Authentication failed\" in resp.error\n        # Permanent error: must only be called ONCE\n        assert mock_client.models.generate_content.call_count == 1\n\n    def test_quota_rate_limit_transient_retries_and_succeeds(self, monkeypatch):\n        \"\"\"Transient 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED should retry with backoff and succeed if recovered.\"\"\"\n        monkeypatch.setattr(\"time.sleep\", lambda s: None)  # fast test\n\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        success_resp = MagicMock()\n        success_resp.text = \"Recovered response\"\n        success_resp.candidates = []\n        success_resp.usage_metadata = None\n\n        # Fails once with 429, succeeds on second attempt\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = [\n            RuntimeError(\"429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Rate limit exceeded\"),\n            success_resp,\n        ]\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"key\", max_retries=2, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Question\")\n\n        assert resp.success is True\n        assert resp.text == \"Recovered response\"\n        assert mock_client.models.generate_content.call_count == 2\n\n    def test_quota_rate_limit_exhausted_retries_fails(self, monkeypatch):\n        \"\"\"Transient 429 that never recovers should exhaust max_retries and fail safely.\"\"\"\n        monkeypatch.setattr(\"time.sleep\", lambda s: None)\n\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = RuntimeError(\n            \"429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota exceeded\"\n        )\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"key\", max_retries=2, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Question\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"quota\"\n        # Initial try + 2 retries = 3 calls\n        assert mock_client.models.generate_content.call_count == 3\n\n    def test_network_failure_transient_retry(self, monkeypatch):\n        \"\"\"Connection error must be classified as network and retried.\"\"\"\n        monkeypatch.setattr(\"time.sleep\", lambda s: None)\n\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = ConnectionError(\n            \"Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno 111] Connection refused\"\n        )\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"key\", max_retries=1, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Question\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"network\"\n        assert mock_client.models.generate_content.call_count == 2\n\n    def test_timeout_failure_transient_retry(self, monkeypatch):\n        \"\"\"Request timeout must be classified as timeout and retried.\"\"\"\n        monkeypatch.setattr(\"time.sleep\", lambda s: None)\n\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = TimeoutError(\n            \"Request timed out while waiting for response\"\n        )\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"key\", max_retries=1, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Question\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == \"timeout\"\n        assert mock_client.models.generate_content.call_count == 2\n\n    def test_invalid_model_request_no_retries(self):\n        \"\"\"400 / model not found must be classified as invalid_request and NOT retried.\"\"\"\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = ValueError(\n            \"400 Invalid argument: models/nonexistent-model is not found\"\n        )\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"key\", max_retries=2, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Question\")\n\n        assert resp.success is False\n        assert resp.error_type == API Key Security & Sanitization â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestApiKeySecurity:\n    def test_api_key_is_redacted_from_error_strings(self):\n        \"\"\"Real or synthetic API keys must never appear in error messages.\"\"\"\n        secret_key = \"[REDACTED_API_KEY]\"\n        mock_client = MagicMock()\n        mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = RuntimeError(\n            f\"Error with key {secret_key}: request refused\"\n        )\n\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=secret_key, max_retries=0, client=mock_client)\n        resp = service.generate_text(\"Hello\")\n\n        assert secret_key not in resp.error\n        assert \"[REDACTED_API_KEY]\" in resp.error\n\n    def test_generic_aiza_key_pattern_redacted(self):\n        \"\"\"Generic AIza... key patterns must also be stripped by sanitizer.\"\"\"\n        service = GeminiService(api_key=\"dummy_key\")\n        leaked_text = \"Failed with credentials [REDACTED_API_KEY]\"\n        sanitized = service._sanitize_message(leaked_text)\n\n        assert \"AIzaSy\" not in sanitized\n        assert \"[REDACTED_API_KEY]\" in sanitized\n\n\n# â”€â”€ 5. Missing API keys do not crash the app.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Service Implementation Architecture\n\n```text\nUser / Module Caller (e.g., chat_service in Module 6)\n       â”‚\n       â–¼\nGeminiService.generate_text(prompt, system_instruction=...)\n       â”‚\n       â”œâ”€â”€ Validate prompt & API key configuration (fail fast if empty)\n       â”œâ”€â”€ Build types.GenerateContentConfig(temp, tokens, system_instruction)\n       â”‚\n       â”œâ”€â”€ Retry Loop (Max retries = 2, exponential backoff)\n       â”‚     â”‚\n       â”‚     â”œâ”€â”€ client.models.generate_content(...)\n       â”‚     â”‚\n       â”‚     â”œâ”€â”€ [Transient Error: 429, Timeout, 503, Network] â”€â”€â–º Backoff (1s, 2s) & Retry\n       â”‚     â”‚\n       â”‚     â””â”€â”€ [Permanent Error: Auth, 400 Invalid Model] â”€â”€â”€â”€â–º Fail immediately (No retry)\n       â”‚\n       â–¼\n_parse_response() â”€â”€â–º Clean text extraction & usage token metadata\n       â”‚\n       â–¼\nReturns GeminiResponse(success, text, model, error, error_type, tokens)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6.
