__future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport uuid\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom typing import Optional, Any\n\nfrom config import config\nfrom backend.services.policy_service import PolicyService, PolicyAnswer\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Database Initialization & Connection Helper â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\ndef get_db_connection(db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    \"\"\"\n    Open an isolated SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled and WAL mode.\n    \"\"\"\n    path = db_path or config.DB_PATH\n    # Ensure parent directory exists for file-based DBs\n    if path != \":memory:\" and not path.startswith(\"file:\"):\n        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)\n\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=15.0)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\")\n    # WAL mode improves concurrency in multi-request environments (ignore error for in-memory DB)\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\")\n    except sqlite3.OperationalError:\n        pass\n    return conn\n\n\ndef init_db(db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"\n    Initialize SQLite schema for conversations and messages if not already present.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = get_db_connection(db_path)\n    try:\n        with conn:\n            conn.execute(\"\"\"\n                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                );\n            \"\"\")\n\n            conn.execute(\"\"\"\n                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (\n                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n                    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'assistant')),\n                    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                    sources TEXT,\n                    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n                );\n            \"\"\")\n\n            conn.execute(\"\"\"\n                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_conversation_created\n                ON messages(conversation_id, created_at ASC);\n            \"\"\")\n\n            conn.execute(\"\"\"\n                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_updated\n                ON conversations(updated_at DESC);\n            \"\"\")\n        logger.info(\"Chat database schema initialized successfully at %s\", db_path or config.DB_PATH)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Context Resolution Helper â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n# Ambiguous follow-ups that require clarification if multiple candidate topics exist\nAMBIGUOUS_PATTERNS = [\n    r\"^(what about the deadline\\??|when is the deadline\\??|deadline\\??)$\",\n    r\"^(can i get an extension\\??|is there an extension\\??)$\",\n    r\"^(is that allowed\\??|can i do that\\??)$\",\n    r\"^(what about it\\??|how does that work\\??)$\",\n]\n\n# Patterns that indicate an anaphoric follow-up question\nFOLLOW_UP_PRONOUNS = [\n    r\"\\b(it|this|that|they|them)\\b\",\n    r\"^how long\\b\",\n    r\"^what date\\b\",\n    r\"^can i take it\\b\",\n    r\"^can i submit (it )?late\\b\",\n    r\"^what device\\b\",\n    r\"^is it open[- ]book\\b\",\n    r\"^what can i bring\\b\",\n]\n\n\nclass ChatService:\n    \"\"\"\n    Service managing conversation persistence, message ordering, and contextual follow-up.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        db_path: Optional[str] = None,\n        policy_service: Optional[PolicyService] = None,\n        max_context_messages: int = 6,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.db_path = db_path or config.DB_PATH\n        self.policy_service = policy_service or PolicyService()\n        self.max_context_messages = max_context_messages\n        # Ensure schema is ready\n        init_db(self.db_path)\n\n    def _get_connection(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n        return get_db_connection(self.db_path)\n\n    # â”€â”€ Conversation Lifecycle â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n    def create_conversation(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Create a new conversation record with status='active'.\n        \"\"\"\n        conv_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            with conn:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conversations (id, created_at, updated_at, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'active');\",\n                    (conv_id, now_iso, now_iso),\n                )\n            return {\n                \"id\": conv_id,\n                \"created_at\": now_iso,\n                \"updated_at\": now_iso,\n                \"status\": \"active\",\n            }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def get_conversation(\n        self, conversation_id: str, include_deleted: bool = False\n    ) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Retrieve conversation metadata by ID.\n        Returns None if non-existent or deleted (unless include_deleted=True).\n        \"\"\"\n        if not conversation_id or not isinstance(conversation_id, str):\n            return None\n\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            if include_deleted:\n                cursor.execute(\n                    \"SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\",\n                    (conversation_id,),\n                )\n            else:\n                cursor.execute(\n                    \"SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, status FROM conversations WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n                    (conversation_id,),\n                )\n            row = cursor.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return None\n            return {\n                \"id\": row[\"id\"],\n                \"created_at\": row[\"created_at\"],\n                \"updated_at\": row[\"updated_at\"],\n                \"status\": row[\"status\"],\n            }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def list_conversations(\n        self, include_deleted: bool = False, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0\n    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        List conversations ordered by most recently updated.\n        \"\"\"\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            if include_deleted:\n                cursor.execute(\n                    \"SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, status FROM conversations ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;\",\n                    (limit, offset),\n                )\n            else:\n                cursor.execute(\n                    \"SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, status FROM conversations WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;\",\n                    (limit, offset),\n                )\n            rows = cursor.fetchall()\n            return [\n                {\n                    \"id\": row[\"id\"],\n                    \"created_at\": row[\"created_at\"],\n                    \"updated_at\": row[\"updated_at\"],\n                    \"status\": row[\"status\"],\n                }\n                for row in rows\n            ]\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def verify_conversation_active(self, conversation_id: str) -> tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Check if a conversation exists and is active.\n        Returns (True, None) or (False, error_message).\n        \"\"\"\n        if not conversation_id or not isinstance(conversation_id, str):\n            return False, \"Invalid conversation ID format\"\n\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\n                \"SELECT status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\",\n                (conversation_id,),\n            )\n            row = cursor.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return False, \"Conversation not found\"\n            if row[\"status\"] != \"active\":\n                return False, \"Conversation has been deleted and cannot accept new messages\"\n            return True, None\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def delete_conversation(self, conversation_id: str, hard_delete: bool = False) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"\n        Delete a conversation and its messages safely.\n        By default, uses soft-delete for the conversation record (status='deleted')\n        and purges all message records to prevent orphans.\n        If hard_delete=True, removes the conversation row entirely.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not conversation_id or not isinstance(conversation_id, str):\n            return False\n\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT id, status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conversation_id,))\n            row = cursor.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return False\n\n            now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n            with conn:\n                # Purge messages first\n                conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conversation_id,))\n                if hard_delete:\n                    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conversation_id,))\n                else:\n                    conn.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE conversations SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?;\",\n                        (now_iso, conversation_id),\n                    )\n            return True\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def update_conversation_activity(\n        self, conversation_id: str, timestamp: Optional[str] = None\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"\n        Update the updated_at timestamp of a conversation.\n        \"\"\"\n        now_iso = timestamp or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            with conn:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n                    (now_iso, conversation_id),\n                )\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    # â”€â”€ Message Operations â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n    def save_user_message(self, conversation_id: str, content: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Save a user message and advance the conversation's updated_at timestamp.\n        \"\"\"\n        msg_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            with conn:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources) VALUES (?, ?, 'user', ?, ?, NULL);\",\n                    (msg_id, conversation_id, content, now_iso),\n                )\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?;\",\n                    (now_iso, conversation_id),\n                )\n            return {\n                \"id\": msg_id,\n                \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n                \"role\": \"user\",\n                \"content\": content,\n                \"created_at\": now_iso,\n                \"sources\": None,\n            }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def save_assistant_message(\n        self, conversation_id: str, content: str, sources: Optional[list[str]] = None\n    ) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Save an assistant message with optional source attributions and update timestamp.\n        \"\"\"\n        msg_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n        sources_json = json.dumps(sources) if sources else None\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            with conn:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources) VALUES (?, ?, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?);\",\n                    (msg_id, conversation_id, content, now_iso, sources_json),\n                )\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?;\",\n                    (now_iso, conversation_id),\n                )\n            return {\n                \"id\": msg_id,\n                \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n                \"role\": \"assistant\",\n                \"content\": content,\n                \"created_at\": now_iso,\n                \"sources\": sources or [],\n            }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def get_conversation_messages(\n        self, conversation_id: str, limit: int = 100\n    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Retrieve messages for a conversation ordered chronologically (created_at ASC).\n        \"\"\"\n        conn = self._get_connection()\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources\n                FROM messages\n                WHERE conversation_id = ?\n                ORDER BY created_at ASC\n                LIMIT ?;\n                \"\"\",\n                (conversation_id, limit),\n            )\n            rows = cursor.fetchall()\n            messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n            for r in rows:\n                raw_sources = r[\"sources\"]\n                parsed_sources = json.loads(raw_sources) if raw_sources else None\n                messages.append({\n                    \"id\": r[\"id\"],\n                    \"conversation_id\": r[\"conversation_id\"],\n                    \"role\": r[\"role\"],\n                    \"content\": r[\"content\"],\n                    \"created_at\": r[\"created_at\"],\n                    \"sources\": parsed_sources,\n                })\n            return messages\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    # â”€â”€ Context-Aware Follow-Up Resolution â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n    def resolve_context(\n        self, user_text: str, history: list[dict[str, Any]]\n    ) -> tuple[str, bool, Optional[str]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Evaluate user_text against previous history context.\n        Returns:\n          (resolved_query, is_ambiguous, clarification_prompt)\n\n        Rules:\n          - If the user query is self-contained, return as-is without context contamination.\n          - If it contains pronouns (\"it\", \"this\") or short ellipses (\"how long\"), resolve entity.\n          - If multiple conflicting candidates exist or query is vague, flag as ambiguous.\n        \"\"\"\n        clean_q = user_text.strip()\n        q_lower = clean_q.lower()\n\n        if not history:\n            return clean_q, False, None\n\n        # 1. Check for genuine ambiguity (e.g. \"What about the deadline?\" with multiple past topics)\n        is_ambiguous_phrase = any(re.search(pat, q_lower) for pat in AMBIGUOUS_PATTERNS)\n        if is_ambiguous_phrase:\n            # Check what was discussed in history\n            history_text = \" \".join(m[\"content\"].lower() for m in history)\n            has_quizzes = \"quiz\" in history_text\n            has_capstone = \"capstone\" in history_text\n            if has_quizzes and has_capstone:\n                return (\n                    clean_q,\n                    True,\n                    \"Could you please clarify whether you are referring to the weekly quiz deadlines or the Capstone Product Case deadline?\",\n                )\n\n        # 2. Check if the query has follow-up pronouns or ellipses\n        needs_context = False\n        for pat in FOLLOW_UP_PRONOUNS:\n            if re.search(pat, q_lower):\n                needs_context = True\n                break\n\n        # Also check for short questions without subject (e.g., \"How long?\", \"Duration?\", \"Can I take it on mobile?\")\n        if len(q_lower.split()) <= 4 and any(w in q_lower for w in (\"how long\", \"duration\", \"date\", \"when\", \"format\")):\n            needs_context = True\n\n        if not needs_context:\n            # Self-contained question â€” do not contaminate with previous turn\n            return clean_q, False, None\n\n        # 3. Find the most recent core course entity discussed in history\n        # Reverse iterate through history to find the latest turn's topic\n        recent_topic = None\n        for m in reversed(history):\n            content_lower = m[\"content\"].lower()\n            if any(w in content_lower for w in (\"final exam\", \"proctored exam\", \"proctored final\", \"exam\")):\n                recent_topic = \"final exam\"\n                break\n            elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"capstone\", \"product case\", \"capstone case\")):\n                recent_topic = \"capstone\"\n                break\n            elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"quiz\", \"quizzes\", \"weekly quiz\")):\n                recent_topic = \"quiz\"\n                break\n            elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"verified certificate\", \"verified track\", \"certificate fee\", \"cost\")):\n                recent_topic = \"certificate\"\n                break\n            elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"course duration\", \"workload\", \"overview\")):\n                recent_topic = \"course\"\n                break\n\n        if not recent_topic:\n            return clean_q, False, None\n\n        # 4. Resolve query based on entity\n        resolved = clean_q\n        if recent_topic == \"final exam\":\n            # \"How long is it?\" -> \"How long is the final exam?\"\n            if re.search(r\"\\b(how long|duration)\\b\", q_lower):\n                resolved = \"What is the duration of the final exam?\"\n            elif re.search(r\"\\b(device|laptop|desktop|mobile|tablet|phone)\\b\", q_lower):\n                resolved = f\"{clean_q} (referring to the final exam)\"\n            elif re.search(r\"\\b(open[- ]book|closed[- ]book|notes|ai|chatgpt)\\b\", q_lower):\n                resolved = f\"{clean_q} (referring to the final exam)\"\n            elif re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", q_lower):\n                resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"the final exam\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n        elif recent_topic == \"capstone\":\n            # \"Can I submit it one day late?\" -> \"Can I submit the capstone one day late?\"\n            if re.search(r\"\\b(submit|submission|late|extension|deadline|due)\\b\", q_lower):\n                if re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", q_lower):\n                    resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"the capstone case\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                else:\n                    resolved = f\"{clean_q} for the capstone case\"\n        elif recent_topic == \"quiz\":\n            if re.search(r\"\\b(submit|submission|late|miss|missed)\\b\", q_lower):\n                if re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that|one)\\b\", q_lower):\n                    resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"a weekly quiz\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                else:\n                    resolved = f\"{clean_q} for weekly quizzes\"\n\n        return resolved, False, None\n\n    # â”€â”€ High-Level Message Processing Pipeline â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n    def process_message(self, conversation_id: str, user_text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Complete message handling pipeline:\n          1. Verify conversation exists and is active.\n          2. Save user message.\n          3. Retrieve recent conversation history (last N messages).\n          4. Resolve context for follow-up questions.\n          5. Call Module 5 PolicyService.\n          6. Save assistant message and source attribution.\n          7. Update conversation activity timestamp.\n          8. Return structured assistant payload.\n        \"\"\"\n        # 1. Verification\n        is_active, err_msg = self.verify_conversation_active(conversation_id)\n        if not is_active:\n            raise ValueError(err_msg)\n\n        clean_text = user_text.strip()\n\n        # 2. Save User Message\n        user_msg = self.save_user_message(conversation_id, clean_text)\n\n        # 3. Retrieve recent history for context\n        history = self.get_conversation_messages(\n            conversation_id, limit=self.max_context_messages\n        )\n        # Exclude the newly saved user message from historical context window\n        history_before = [m for m in history if m[\"id\"] != user_msg[\"id\"]]\n\n        # 4. Context Resolution\n        resolved_q, is_ambiguous, clarification = self.resolve_context(\n            clean_text, history_before\n        )\n\n        if is_ambiguous and clarification:\n            assistant_msg = self.save_assistant_message(\n                conversation_id, clarification, sources=[]\n            )\n            return {\n                \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n                \"message_id\": assistant_msg[\"id\"],\n                \"role\": \"assistant\",\n                \"content\": clarification,\n                \"sources\": [],\n                \"created_at\": assistant_msg[\"created_at\"],\n                \"is_in_scope\": True,\n                \"is_supported\": True,\n            }\n\n        # 5. Call Module 5 Policy Pipeline\n        policy_ans: PolicyAnswer = self.policy_service.ask(resolved_q)\n\n        # 6. Save Assistant Message\n        assistant_msg = self.save_assistant_message(\n            conversation_id=conversation_id,\n            content=policy_ans.answer,\n            sources=policy_ans.sources,\n        )\n\n        # 7. Return Result Payload\n        return {\n            \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n            \"message_id\": assistant_msg[\"id\"],\n            \"role\": \"assistant\",\n            \"content\": policy_ans.answer,\n            \"sources\": policy_ans.sources,\n            \"created_at\": assistant_msg[\"created_at\"],\n            \"is_in_scope\": policy_ans.is_in_scope,\n            \"is_supported\": policy_ans.is_supported,\n        }\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\backend\\services\\chat_service.py"}}]}

â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef temp_db_path(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Provides a fresh isolated SQLite database path per test.\"\"\"\n    db_file = tmp_path / \"test_chat.db\"\n    return str(db_file)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef mock_policy_service():\n    \"\"\"Provides a mock PolicyService returning controlled grounded responses.\"\"\"\n    service = MagicMock(spec=PolicyService)\n    service.ask.return_value = PolicyAnswer(\n        question=\"What is the passing requirement?\",\n        answer=(\n            \"To pass the course and earn the Verified Certificate, you must achieve an overall \"\n            \"weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in \"\n            \"the Proctored Final Exam separately.\\n\\nSource: Grading Policy V2.\"\n        ),\n        sources=[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"],\n        is_in_scope=True,\n        is_supported=True,\n    )\n    return service\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef chat_service(temp_db_path, mock_policy_service):\n    \"\"\"Provides an isolated ChatService instance backed by temp SQLite and mock policy.\"\"\"\n    return ChatService(\n        db_path=temp_db_path,\n        policy_service=mock_policy_service,\n        max_context_messages=6,\n    )\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client(chat_service):\n    \"\"\"Provides a Flask test client with the isolated ChatService injected.\"\"\"\n    app = create_app({\"TESTING\": True, \"chat_service\": chat_service})\n    with app.test_client() as test_client:\n        yield test_client\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 1: Conversation Lifecycle (Tests 1 to 9) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestConversationLifecycle:\n\n    def test_01_create_conversation(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"1. Create a conversation via POST /api/v1/conversations.\"\"\"\n        resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        assert resp.status_code == 201\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert \"id\" in data\n        assert data[\"status\"] == \"active\"\n        assert \"created_at\" in data\n        assert \"updated_at\" in data\n\n    def test_02_retrieve_existing_conversation(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"2. Retrieve an existing conversation via GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv['id']}\")\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert data[\"id\"] == conv[\"id\"]\n        assert data[\"status\"] == \"active\"\n\n    def test_03_list_multiple_conversations(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"3. List multiple conversations ordered by most recently updated.\"\"\"\n        conv1 = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        conv2 = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        # Update conv1 so it has a later updated_at\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv1[\"id\"], \"Hello from conv 1\")\n\n        resp = client.get(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert \"conversations\" in data\n        ids = [c[\"id\"] for c in data[\"conversations\"]]\n        assert conv1[\"id\"] in ids\n        assert conv2[\"id\"] in ids\n        # conv1 should appear before conv2 due to recent activity\n        assert ids.index(conv1[\"id\"]) < ids.index(conv2[\"id\"])\n\n    def test_04_save_user_message(self, chat_service):\n        \"\"\"4. Save a user message directly through the service.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        msg = chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], \"What is the capstone deadline?\")\n        assert msg[\"conversation_id\"] == conv[\"id\"]\n        assert msg[\"role\"] == \"user\"\n        assert msg[\"content\"] == \"What is the capstone deadline?\"\n        assert \"created_at\" in msg\n\n    def test_05_save_assistant_message(self, chat_service):\n        \"\"\"5. Save an assistant message with source attributions.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        sources = [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]\n        msg = chat_service.save_assistant_message(\n            conv[\"id\"], \"Deadline is 15 November 2026.\", sources=sources\n        )\n        assert msg[\"role\"] == \"assistant\"\n        assert msg[\"content\"] == \"Deadline is 15 November 2026.\"\n        assert msg[\"sources\"] == sources\n\n    def test_06_retrieve_messages_chronological_order(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"6. Retrieve messages belonging to a conversation in chronological order.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], \"First message\")\n        chat_service.save_assistant_message(conv[\"id\"], \"First reply\")\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], \"Second message\")\n\n        resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv['id']}/messages\")\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        messages = data[\"messages\"]\n        assert len(messages) == 3\n        assert messages[0][\"content\"] == \"First message\"\n        assert messages[1][\"content\"] == \"First reply\"\n        assert messages[2][\"content\"] == \"Second message\"\n\n    def test_07_update_conversation_activity_timestamp(self, chat_service):\n        \"\"\"7. Verify conversation updated_at updates on message activity.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        original_updated_at = conv[\"updated_at\"]\n        # Advance time by saving a message\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], \"Activity update test\")\n        updated_conv = chat_service.get_conversation(conv[\"id\"])\n        assert updated_conv[\"updated_at\"] >= original_updated_at\n\n    def test_08_delete_conversation(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"8. Delete a conversation via DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        resp = client.delete(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv['id']}\")\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert data[\"success\"] is True\n\n        # Subsequent GET should return 404\n        get_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv['id']}\")\n        assert get_resp.status_code == 404\n\n    def test_09_verify_messages_deleted_with_conversation(self, chat_service, temp_db_path):\n        \"\"\"9. Ensure deleting a conversation purges all associated messages.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], \"Message to be purged\")\n        chat_service.save_assistant_message(conv[\"id\"], \"Reply to be purged\")\n\n        # Verify messages exist\n        assert len(chat_service.get_conversation_messages(conv[\"id\"])) == 2\n\n        # Delete conversation\n        chat_service.delete_conversation(conv[\"id\"])\n\n        # Check DB directly: messages table must have 0 rows for this conversation\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv[\"id\"],))\n            count = cursor.fetchone()[0]\n            assert count == 0\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 2: API Validation & Error Handling (Tests 10 to 18) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestApiValidation:\n\n    def test_10_missing_message_content(self, client):\n        \"\"\"10. POST /messages with missing message field returns 400.\"\"\"\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 400\n        assert \"required\" in resp.get_json()[\"error\"].lower()\n\n    def test_11_empty_message(self, client):\n        \"\"\"11. POST /messages with empty string returns 400.\"\"\"\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 400\n        assert \"empty\" in resp.get_json()[\"error\"].lower()\n\n    def test_12_whitespace_only_message(self, client):\n        \"\"\"12. POST /messages with whitespace string returns 400.\"\"\"\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"   \\n\\t   \"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 400\n        assert \"whitespace\" in resp.get_json()[\"error\"].lower()\n\n    def test_13_non_string_message(self, client):\n        \"\"\"13. POST /messages with non-string data returns 400.\"\"\"\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        for invalid_val in [12345, [\"hello\"], {\"text\": \"hi\"}, True]:\n            resp = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": invalid_val},\n            )\n            assert resp.status_code == 400\n            assert \"must be a string\" in resp.get_json()[\"error\"].lower()\n\n    def test_14_excessively_long_message(self, client):\n        \"\"\"14. POST /messages with >4000 characters returns 400.\"\"\"\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        long_msg = \"A\" * 4500\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": long_msg},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 400\n        assert \"maximum allowed length\" in resp.get_json()[\"error\"].lower()\n\n    def test_15_invalid_conversation_id(self, client):\n        \"\"\"15. Malicious or SQL-injection conversation ID returns 404.\"\"\"\n        resp = client.post(\n            \"/api/v1/conversations/' OR 1=1 --/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Hello\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 404\n\n    def test_16_non_existent_conversation(self, client):\n        \"\"\"16. Request to a non-existent UUID returns 404.\"\"\"\n        resp = client.post(\n            \"/api/v1/conversations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the pass score?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 404\n        assert \"not found\" in resp.get_json()[\"error\"].lower()\n\n    def test_17_malformed_json_request(self, client):\n        \"\"\"17. Non-JSON request body returns 400.\"\"\"\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            data=\"this is not json\",\n            content_type=\"text/plain\",\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 400\n\n    def test_18_correct_http_status_codes(self, client):\n        \"\"\"18. Verify 200, 201, 400, 404, and 405 status codes.\"\"\"\n        # 201 on create\n        c_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        assert c_resp.status_code == 201\n        conv_id = c_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # 200 on message post\n        m_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the passing criteria?\"},\n        )\n        assert m_resp.status_code == 200\n\n        # 400 on bad payload\n        bad_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={},\n        )\n        assert bad_resp.status_code == 400\n\n        # 404 on not found\n        nf_resp = client.get(\"/api/v1/conversations/not-found-id\")\n        assert nf_resp.status_code == 404\n\n        # 405 on method not allowed\n        mna_resp = client.put(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        assert mna_resp.status_code == 405\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 3: Context Handling & Follow-Ups (Tests 19 to 24) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestContextHandling:\n\n    def test_19_follow_up_uses_relevant_context(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"19. Follow-up 'How long is it?' resolves 'it' to final exam.\"\"\"\n        # Configure policy mock to return specific answer based on question text\n        def policy_side_effect(q):\n            if \"exam\" in q.lower() and (\"duration\" in q.lower() or \"how long\" in q.lower()):\n                return PolicyAnswer(\n                    question=q,\n                    answer=\"The Proctored Final Exam duration is 90 minutes. Source: Official Exam Rules.\",\n                    sources=[\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\"],\n                )\n            return PolicyAnswer(\n                question=q,\n                answer=\"The final exam is on 20 November 2026. Source: Official Exam Rules.\",\n                sources=[\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\"],\n            )\n\n        chat_service.policy_service.ask.side_effect = policy_side_effect\n\n        # Turn 1: Ask about exam date\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the final exam date?\"},\n        )\n\n        # Turn 2: Follow-up question\n        resp2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"How long is it?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp2.status_code == 200\n        ans = resp2.get_json()[\"content\"]\n        assert \"90 minutes\" in ans\n\n    def test_20_unrelated_previous_messages_do_not_contaminate(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"20. Self-contained question does not receive contamination from previous turn.\"\"\"\n        chat_service.policy_service.ask.side_effect = lambda q: PolicyAnswer(\n            question=q,\n            answer=\"The exam is scheduled on 20 November 2026.\",\n            sources=[\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\"],\n        )\n\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        # Turn 1: Fee inquiry\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the Verified Certificate fee?\"},\n        )\n\n        # Turn 2: Completely independent exam question\n        resp2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the final exam?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp2.status_code == 200\n        # The query passed to policy_service should not have fee contamination\n        called_q = chat_service.policy_service.ask.call_args[0][0]\n        assert \"fee\" not in called_q.lower()\n        assert \"final exam\" in called_q.lower()\n\n    def test_21_previous_assistant_answers_cannot_override_official_policy(self, chat_service):\n        \"\"\"21. Old assistant answers cannot override current official policy.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        # Simulate a previous compromised assistant answer claiming 50%\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], \"What was the passing score in 2025?\")\n        chat_service.save_assistant_message(\n            conv[\"id\"], \"In earlier cohorts, the passing score was 50%.\"\n        )\n\n        # Now student asks current passing requirement\n        # PolicyService ask should still be invoked and enforce 60% + 40%\n        res = chat_service.process_message(conv[\"id\"], \"What is the passing requirement now?\")\n        assert \"60%\" in res[\"content\"]\n        assert \"40%\" in res[\"content\"]\n\n    def test_22_ambiguous_follow_up_requests_clarification(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"22. Vague follow-up 'What about the deadline?' with multiple topics requests clarification.\"\"\"\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        # Turn 1: Discusses both weekly quizzes and capstone\n        chat_service.save_user_message(conv_id, \"Tell me about weekly quizzes and the capstone case.\")\n        chat_service.save_assistant_message(\n            conv_id, \"The course has 6 weekly quizzes and 1 capstone case.\"\n        )\n\n        # Turn 2: Ambiguous question\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What about the deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        content = resp.get_json()[\"content\"]\n        assert \"clarify\" in content.lower()\n        assert \"quiz\" in content.lower()\n        assert \"capstone\" in content.lower()\n\n    def test_23_conversation_context_window_respected(self, chat_service):\n        \"\"\"23. Only the configured max_context_messages are used for context.\"\"\"\n        chat_service.max_context_messages = 4\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n\n        # Add 10 historical messages\n        for i in range(10):\n            chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], f\"Message {i}\")\n            chat_service.save_assistant_message(conv[\"id\"], f\"Reply {i}\")\n\n        history = chat_service.get_conversation_messages(\n            conv[\"id\"], limit=chat_service.max_context_messages\n        )\n        assert len(history) <= 4\n\n    def test_24_official_policy_retrieval_still_happens_for_follow_ups(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"24. Follow-up queries still receive authoritative source attribution.\"\"\"\n        chat_service.policy_service.ask.side_effect = lambda q: PolicyAnswer(\n            question=q,\n            answer=\"Late submissions are not accepted. Source: Grading Policy V2.\",\n            sources=[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"],\n        )\n\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the capstone deadline?\"},\n        )\n\n        follow_up_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Can I submit it one day late?\"},\n        )\n        assert follow_up_resp.status_code == 200\n        sources = follow_up_resp.get_json()[\"sources\"]\n        assert \"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\" in sources\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 4: Data Safety & Integrity (Tests 25 to 30) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestDataSafetyAndIntegrity:\n\n    def test_25_cross_conversation_isolation(self, client):\n        \"\"\"25. Messages in Conversation A never appear in Conversation B.\"\"\"\n        conv_a = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        conv_b = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        client.post(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_a}/messages\", json={\"message\": \"Secret message in A\"})\n        client.post(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_b}/messages\", json={\"message\": \"Public message in B\"})\n\n        msgs_a = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_a}/messages\").get_json()[\"messages\"]\n        msgs_b = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_b}/messages\").get_json()[\"messages\"]\n\n        contents_a = [m[\"content\"] for m in msgs_a]\n        contents_b = [m[\"content\"] for m in msgs_b]\n\n        assert \"Secret message in A\" in contents_a\n        assert \"Secret message in A\" not in contents_b\n        assert \"Public message in B\" in contents_b\n        assert \"Public message in B\" not in contents_a\n\n    def test_26_sql_injection_defense(self, client):\n        \"\"\"26. SQL injection payloads in message text or parameters are safely escaped.\"\"\"\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        malicious_msg = \"'; DROP TABLE messages; SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE '1'='1\"\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": malicious_msg},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n\n        # Verify messages table is intact\n        msgs = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}/messages\").get_json()[\"messages\"]\n        assert any(malicious_msg in m[\"content\"] for m in msgs)\n\n    def test_27_foreign_key_integrity(self, temp_db_path):\n        \"\"\"27. Inserting message with non-existent conversation_id triggers FK violation.\"\"\"\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n        try:\n            with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):\n                with conn:\n                    conn.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at) \"\n                        \"VALUES ('bad-id', 'non-existent-conv-id', 'user', 'test', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z');\"\n                    )\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def test_28_deleted_conversation_cannot_accept_new_messages(self, client):\n        \"\"\"28. Posting to a deleted conversation returns 404.\"\"\"\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        # Delete conversation\n        del_resp = client.delete(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}\")\n        assert del_resp.status_code == 200\n\n        # Attempt to post new message\n        post_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Are you still there?\"},\n        )\n        assert post_resp.status_code == 404\n\n    def test_29_api_keys_never_stored_in_conversation_records(self, chat_service, client):\n        \"\"\"29. If an API key appears in query or error, it is never stored in DB.\"\"\"\n        secret_key = \"AIzaSyFakeSecretKeyNotToBeStored\"\n        chat_service.policy_service.ask.return_value = PolicyAnswer(\n            question=\"My key is AIzaSyFakeSecretKeyNotToBeStored\",\n            answer=\"The exam is closed book.\",\n            sources=[\"Official Exam Rules\"],\n        )\n\n        conv = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Can I use AI tools in the exam?\"},\n        )\n\n        msgs = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}/messages\").get_json()[\"messages\"]\n        for m in msgs:\n            assert secret_key not in m[\"content\"]\n\n    def test_30_concurrent_message_writes(self, chat_service):\n        \"\"\"30. Concurrent threads saving messages do not corrupt SQLite database.\"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        errors = []\n\n        def worker(thread_idx):\n            try:\n                for i in range(5):\n                    chat_service.save_user_message(conv[\"id\"], f\"Thread {thread_idx} msg {i}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                errors.append(e)\n\n        threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(t,)) for t in range(4)]\n        for t in threads:\n            t.start()\n        for t in threads:\n            t.join()\n\n        assert len(errors) == 0\n        messages = chat_service.get_conversation_messages(conv[\"id\"], limit=50)\n        assert len(messages) == 20  # 4 threads * 5 messages\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 5: Regression & Integration (Tests 31 to 34) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestRegressionAndIntegration:\n\n    def test_31_modules_1_to_5_integration_intact(self, client):\n        \"\"\"31. {"step_index":969,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T17:27:39Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-10T22:57:39+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-10T22:57:39+05:30\nShowing lines 1-150 of 176\n1: # IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot\n2: \n3: A context-aware chatbot that answers student questions strictly using official\n4: DPM-101 course documents. Built as a Technical Internship project (Module 2 of 12).\n5: \n6: ---\n7: \n8: ## Project Overview\n9: \n10: | Component | Technology |\n11: |---|---|\n12: | Frontend | HTML, CSS, JavaScript |\n13: | Backend | Python Flask |\n14: | AI | Google Gemini (`google-genai` SDK) |\n15: | Retrieval | TF-IDF (RAG pattern) |\n16: | Database | SQLite |\n17: | Deployment | Render |\n18: \n19: The chatbot answers questions **only from four official course PDFs** â€” it does not\n20: use Gemini's general knowledge.\n21: \n22: ---\n23: \n24: ## Prerequisites\n25: \n26: | Requirement | Version |\n27: |---|---|\n28: | Python | 3.11 or higher |\n29: | pip | bundled with Python |\n30: | Git | any recent version |\n31: \n32: ---\n33: \n34: ## Setup\n35: \n36: ### 1. Clone the repository\n37: \n38: ```bash\n39: git clone <your-repo-url>\n40: cd dpm101-chatbot\n41: ```\n42: \n43: ### 2. Create and activate the virtual environment\n44: \n45: **Windows (PowerShell)**\n46: ```powershell\n47: python -m venv venv\n48: .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n49: ```\n50: \n51: **macOS / Linux**\n52: ```bash\n53: python3 -m venv venv\n54: source venv/bin/activate\n55: ```\n56: \n57: You should see `(venv)` in your prompt when it is active.\n58: \n59: ### 3. Install dependencies\n60: \n61: ```bash\n62: pip install -r requirements.txt\n63: ```\n64: \n65: ### 4. Configure environment variables\n66: \n67: ```bash\n68: # Windows\n69: copy .env.example .env\n70: \n71: # macOS / Linux\n72: cp .env.example .env\n73: ```\n74: \n75: Open `.env` and fill in your values:\n76: \n77: ```env\n78: GEMINI_API_KEY=your_actual_api_key_here\n79: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash\n80: FLASK_DEBUG=True\n81: FLASK_SECRET_KEY=any-long-random-string\n82: ```\n83: \n84: > **Important:** Never commit `.env` to Git. It is excluded by `.gitignore`.\n85: \n86: ---\n87: \n88: ## Running the Application\n89: \n90: ```bash\n91: python app.py\n92: ```\n93: \n94: The Flask development server starts on `http://localhost:5000`.\n95: \n96: ---\n97: \n98: ## Testing the Health Endpoint\n99: \n100: **Using curl**\n101: ```bash\n102: curl http://localhost:5000/health\n103: ```\n104: \n105: **Expected response (HTTP 200)**\n106: ```json\n107: {\n108:   \"status\": \"healthy\",\n109:   \"service\": \"DPM-101 Helpdesk Chatbot\"\n110: }\n111: ```\n112: \n113: **Using pytest** (Flask test client â€” no server needed)\n114: ```bash\n115: pytest tests/ -v\n116: ```\n117: \n118: ---\n119: \n120: ## Project Structure\n121: \n122: ```\n123: dpm101-chatbot/\n124: â”œâ”€â”€ app.py               # Flask application factory + /health endpoint\n125: â”œâ”€â”€ config.py            # Configuration via python-dotenv\n126: â”œâ”€â”€ requirements.txt     # Python dependencies\n127: â”œâ”€â”€ .env.example         # Environment variable template (safe to commit)\n128: â”œâ”€â”€ .gitignore\n129: â”œâ”€â”€ README.md\n130: â”‚\n131: â”œâ”€â”€ backend/             # Application logic (implemented in later modules)\n132: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ __init__.py\n133: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ routes/          # Flask blueprints\n134: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ services/        # Business logic (Gemini, cache, retrieval, session)\n135: â”‚   â””â”€â”€ utils/           # PDF parser, ingestion, TF-IDF index, text utilities\n136: â”‚\n137: â”œâ”€â”€ frontend/            # Static files served by Flask\n138: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ index.html       # Chat UI (implemented in Module 10)\n139: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n140: â”‚   â””â”€â”€ js/\n141: â”‚\n142: â”œâ”€â”€ data/                # Runtime SQLite database (gitignored, rebuilt on startup)\n143: â”‚   â””â”€â”€ .gitkeep\n144: â”‚\n145: â””â”€â”€ tests/               # pytest test suite\n146:     â””â”€â”€ test_health.py\n147: ```\n148: \n149: ---\n150: "}

This includes details on the conversation lifecycle, the database schema (with `conversations` and `messages` tables), and API endpoint documentation. Specifically, documenting the `POST /api/v1/conversations`, `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`, `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`, and `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/<id>` endpoints. Added example requests and responses along with a description of the conversation context behavior, including follow-ups, pronoun resolution, and disambiguation.\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"edit_file","args":{"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\README.md","Replacement":"| Module | Title | Status |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Project Setup & Architecture | âœ… Complete |\n| 2 | Environment & Repository Setup | âœ… Complete |\n| 3 | Course Document Management | âœ… Complete |\n| 4 | Gemini API Integration | âœ… Complete |\n| 5 | Policy Management & Answer Accuracy | âœ… Complete |\n| 6 | Chat Management & Conversation History | âœ… Complete |\n| 7 | SQLite Caching System | â¬œ Planned |\n| 8 | Request Management & Duplicate Prevention | â¬œ Planned |\n| 9 | Statistics & Live Counters | â¬œ Planned |\n| 10 | Frontend Chat Interface | â¬œ Planned |\n| 11 | Integration, Testing & Error Handling | â¬œ Planned |\n| 12 | Deployment & Final Submission | â¬œ Planned |\n\n---\n\n## Module 6: Chat Management & Conversation History\n\nModule 6 adds persistent conversation management, message history, and context-aware follow-up question handling backed by SQLite.\n\n### 1. Database Schema\n\nThe database uses SQLite with WAL mode and foreign-key constraints enabled:\n\n#### Table `conversations`\n| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `id` | `TEXT` | `PRIMARY KEY` | UUID string identifying the conversation |\n| `created_at` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | ISO 8601 UTC creation timestamp |\n| `updated_at` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | ISO 8601 UTC last activity timestamp |\n| `status` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'` | `'active'` or `'deleted'` |\n\n#### Table `messages`\n| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `id` | `TEXT` | `PRIMARY KEY` | UUID string identifying the message |\n| `conversation_id` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL, FK` | Foreign key referencing `conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` |\n| `role` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL, CHECK` | Role: `'user'` or `'assistant'` |\n| `content` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | Message text content |\n| `created_at` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | ISO 8601 UTC creation timestamp |\n| `sources` | `TEXT` | `NULL` | JSON-serialized array of document sources (assistant only) |\n\n#### Indexes\n- `idx_messages_conversation_created` on `messages(conversation_id, created_at ASC)`\n- `idx_conversations_updated` on `conversations(updated_at DESC)`\n\n---\n\n### 2. Chat API Endpoints\n\nAll chat endpoints use the `/api/v1` prefix.\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `POST` | `/api/v1/conversations` | Create a new active conversation. |\n| `GET` | `/api/v1/conversations` | List active conversations ordered by `updated_at DESC`. |\n| `GET` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}` | Get metadata for a specific conversation. |\n| `GET` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | Retrieve messages for a conversation in chronological order. |\n| `POST` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | Send a user message and receive the policy-grounded assistant reply. |\n| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}` | Delete a conversation and purge its message history. |\n\n---\n\n### 3. Example Request & Response\n\n#### Send Message\n`POST /api/v1/conversations/4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1/messages`\n\n**Headers:**\n`Content-Type: application/json`\n\n**Request Body:**\n```json\n{\n  \"message\": \"What is the passing criteria?\"\n}\n```\n\n**Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n```json\n{\n  \"conversation_id\": \"4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1\",\n  \"message_id\": \"e2c36c1d-10fb-4d32-9cb1-c30d95955a02\",\n  \"role\": \"assistant\",\n  \"content\": \"To pass the course and earn the Verified Certificate, you must achieve an overall weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in the Proctored Final Exam separately.\\n\\nSource: Grading Policy V2.\",\n  \"sources\": [\n    \"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"\n  ],\n  \"created_at\": \"2026-11-10T22:50:00.000000+00:00\",\n  \"is_in_scope\": true,\n  \"is_supported\": true\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4. Context-Aware Follow-Up Handling\n\nThe system inspects recent conversation turns (up to the configured context window limit, default 6 messages) to disambiguate follow-up queries:\n- **Pronoun Resolution**: `\"How long is it?\"` after discussing the final exam resolves to `\"What is the duration of the final exam?\"` and answers 90 minutes.\n- **Assignment Context**: `\"Can I submit it one day late?\"` after discussing the capstone resolves to capstone late submission rules.\n- **Ambiguity Detection**: If a student asks a vague question (*\"What about the deadline?\"*) when multiple topics (quizzes and capstone) were discussed, the chatbot prompts the user for clarification.\n- **Contamination Prevention**: Self-contained queries never inherit unrelated context from prior turns.\n- **Policy Invariance**: Old assistant answers in chat history are treated as conversation context only, never as authoritative policy documents.\n\n---\n\n### 5. Known Limitations & Ephemeral Storage Disclosure\n\n- **SQLite Ephemeral Storage**: On free cloud platforms like Render, local files (including SQLite databases) are ephemeral and reset whenever the container restarts or re-deploys. Persistent production storage requires an external volume mount or a managed PostgreSQL database.\n- **Identifier vs. Authentication**: Conversation IDs are unique operational identifiers, not proof of user identity or authenticated session ownership. Authentication is not implemented in this module.\n- **Context Window**: Follow-up resolution operates over the most recent 6 messages (`MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES = 6`) to protect processing latency and prevent context drift.\n\n---\n\n## Known Limitations (Module 6 Scope)","Target":"| Module | Title | Status |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Project Setup & Architecture | âœ… Complete |\n| 2 | Environment & Repository Setup | âœ… Complete |\n| 3 | Course Document Management | â¬œ Planned |\n| 4 | Gemini API Integration | â¬œ Planned |\n| 5 | Policy Management & Answer Accuracy | â¬œ Planned |\n| 6 | Chat Management & Conversation History | â¬œ Planned |\n| 7 | SQLite Caching System | â¬œ Planned |\n| 8 | Request Management & Duplicate Prevention | â¬œ Planned |\n| 9 | Statistics & Live Counters | â¬œ Planned |\n| 10 | Frontend Chat Interface | â¬œ Planned |\n| 11 | Integration, Testing & Error Handling | â¬œ Planned |\n| 12 | Deployment & Final Submission | â¬œ Planned |\n\n---\n\n## Known Limitations (Module 2 Scope)"}}]}

Context-Aware Follow-Up Handling\n251: \n252: The system inspects recent conversation turns (up to the configured context window limit, default 6 messages) to disambiguate follow-up queries:\n253: - **Pronoun Resolution**: `\"How long is it?\"` after discussing the final exam resolves to `\"What is the duration of the final exam?\"` and answers 90 minutes.\n254: - **Assignment Context**: `\"Can I submit it one day late?\"` after discussing the capstone resolves to capstone late submission rules.\n255: - **Ambiguity Detection**: If a student asks a vague question (*\"What about the deadline?\"*) when multiple topics (quizzes and capstone) were discussed, the chatbot prompts the user for clarification.\n256: - **Contamination Prevention**: Self-contained queries never inherit unrelated context from prior turns.\n257: - **Policy Invariance**: Old assistant answers in chat history are treated as conversation context only, never as authoritative policy documents.\n258: \n259: ---\n260: \n261: ### 5. Known Limitations & Ephemeral Storage Disclosure\n262: \n263: - **SQLite Ephemeral Storage**: On free cloud platforms like Render, local files (including SQLite databases) are ephemeral and reset whenever the container restarts or re-deploys. Persistent production storage requires an external volume mount or a managed PostgreSQL database.\n264: - **Identifier vs. Authentication**: Conversation IDs are unique operational identifiers, not proof of user identity or authenticated session ownership. Authentication is not implemented in this module.\n265: - **Context Window**: Follow-up resolution operates over the most recent 6 messages (`MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES = 6`) to protect processing latency and prevent context drift.\n266: \n267: ---\n268: \n269: ## Known Limitations (Module 6 Scope)\n270: \n271: - The chatbot does not yet answer questions â€” it only serves a health check.\n272: - Gemini API is not called in this module.\n273: - No documents have been loaded yet.\n274: - The `/health` endpoint reports `gemini_status` as `\"unknown\"` until a real\n275:   chat request is made in a later module."}

The report will encompass the implementation summary, created/modified files, database schema, service methods, API endpoints, conversation context implementation, integration with previous modules, security/data-safety checks, and comprehensive test cases with results.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":false,"Summary":"Module 6 Chat Management & Conversation History Report covering implementation summary, files created/modified, SQLite database schema, service methods, API endpoints, context resolution, integration with Modules 1-5, security checks, 34 dedicated test results, 212-test full regression suite, known limitations, and final recommendation.","UserFacing":true},"Content":"# Module 6 â€” Chat Management & Conversation History Report\n\n**Project:** IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot  \n**Module:** Module 6 â€” Chat Management & Conversation History  \n**Date:** 2026-11-10  \n**Python Runtime:** Python 3.11.9 (`venv\\Scripts\\python.exe`)  \n**Final Status:** **PASS** (34/34 Module 6 Tests Passing; 212/212 Full Regression Suite Passing)\n\n---\n\n## 1. Implementation Summary\n\nModule 6 implements persistent, multi-turn chat management and conversation history for the DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot. The implementation provides:\n- **Persistent Storage**: SQLite database tables (`conversations` and `messages`) managed through Python's standard `sqlite3` library with WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, and indices.\n- **Full Conversation Lifecycle**: Starting conversations, listing active conversations, viewing message history chronologically, deleting conversations, and cascade-purging messages without leaving orphans.\n- **Context-Aware Follow-Up Resolution**: Disambiguates anaphoric follow-up questions (e.g. *\"How long is it?\"*, *\"Can I submit it one day late?\"*) by resolving entities from recent conversation turns without allowing prior messages to contaminate independent queries or override authoritative course policies.\n- **Full Policy Integration**: Messages are processed through the existing Module 5 `PolicyService`, preserving document precedence (Doc03 over Doc02), official forum exclusion (Doc04 Section 3), post-generation invariant assertions, and deterministic fallbacks.\n- **RESTful API Blueprint**: Registered under `/api/v1` with validation, consistent JSON responses, and HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 405).\n\n---\n\n## 2. Files Created and Modified\n\n| File Path | Type | Role in Module 6 |\n| :--- | :---: | :--- |\n| `backend/services/chat_service.py` | **Created** | Core chat service managing SQLite tables, transactions, lifecycle methods, context disambiguation, and orchestration with `PolicyService`. |\n| `backend/routes/chat_routes.py` | **Created** | Flask Blueprint (`/api/v1`) exposing conversation and message endpoints with validation and error formatting. |\n| `backend/routes/__init__.py` | **Modified** | Exported `chat_bp`. |\n| `backend/services/__init__.py` | **Modified** | Exported `ChatService`, `init_db`, `get_db_connection`. |\n| `app.py` | **Modified** | Integrated `chat_bp`, supported `test_config` dependency injection for isolated testing, preserved `/health`. |\n| `README.md` | **Modified** | Documented conversation lifecycle, SQLite schema, API endpoints, example request/response, context behavior, and ephemeral storage limits. |\n| `tests/test_chat_service.py` | **Created** | 34 automated test cases covering conversation lifecycle, API validation, context resolution, data safety, and regression. |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Database Schema\n\nThe SQLite database is initialized with `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;` and `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;`.\n\n```mermaid\nerDiagram\n    CONVERSATIONS ||--o{ MESSAGES : \"has\"\n    CONVERSATIONS {\n        text id PK \"UUID\"\n        text created_at \"ISO 8601 UTC\"\n        text updated_at \"ISO 8601 UTC\"\n        text status \"active | deleted\"\n    }\n    MESSAGES {\n        text id PK \"UUID\"\n        text conversation_id FK \"References conversations(id)\"\n        text role \"user | assistant\"\n        text content \"Message text\"\n        text created_at \"ISO 8601 UTC\"\n        text sources \"JSON array of document titles\"\n    }\n```\n\n### Table Definitions & Constraints:\n1. **`conversations`**:\n   - `id TEXT PRIMARY KEY`: Unique UUID identifier.\n   - `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`: UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.\n   - `updated_at TEXT NOT NULL`: UTC timestamp updated on every message insertion.\n   - `status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'`: Soft-delete status indicator (`'active'` or `'deleted'`).\n2. **`messages`**:\n   - `id TEXT PRIMARY KEY`: Unique message UUID.\n   - `conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL`: Foreign key referencing `conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`.\n   - `role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'assistant'))`: Role of message author.\n   - `content TEXT NOT NULL`: Message text.\n   - `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`: UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.\n   - `sources TEXT`: JSON-serialized list of source document titles (or `NULL`).\n3. **Indices**:\n   - `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_conversation_created ON messages(conversation_id, created_at ASC);`\n   - `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_updated ON conversations(updated_at DESC);`\n\n---\n\n## 4. Service Methods (`ChatService`)\n\n`backend/services/chat_service.py` provides the following methods:\n\n| Method | Parameters | Return Type | Description |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| `create_conversation()` | None | `dict` | Creates new conversation with status `'active'`. |\n| `get_conversation()` | `conversation_id, include_deleted=False` | `Optional[dict]` | Returns conversation metadata or `None`. |\n| `list_conversations()` | `include_deleted=False, limit=50, offset=0` | `list[dict]` | Returns active conversations ordered by `updated_at DESC`. |\n| `verify_conversation_active()` | `conversation_id` | `tuple[bool, Optional[str]]` | Validates existence and verifies status is `'active'`. |\n| `delete_conversation()` | `conversation_id, hard_delete=False` | `bool` | Deletes conversation messages and soft/hard deletes conversation. |\n| `update_conversation_activity()` | `conversation_id, timestamp=None` | `None` | Updates `updated_at` timestamp. |\n| `save_user_message()` | `conversation_id, content` | `dict` | Saves user message and advances `updated_at`. |\n| `save_assistant_message()` | `conversation_id, content, sources=None` | `dict` | Saves assistant response with serialized sources. |\n| `get_conversation_messages()` | `conversation_id, limit=100` | `list[dict]` | Returns chronological message history (`created_at ASC`). |\n| `resolve_context()` | `user_text, history` | `tuple[str, bool, Optional[str]]` | Resolves follow-up queries or flags ambiguity. |\n| `process_message()` | `conversation_id, user_text` | `dict` | Complete turn: saves user msg, resolves context, calls policy pipeline, saves assistant msg, returns payload. |\n\n---\n\n## 5. API Endpoints (`backend/routes/chat_routes.py`)\n\nAll routes are registered under `/api/v1` on Flask:\n\n### 1. Create Conversation\n- **Route**: `POST /api/v1/conversations`\n- **Status Code**: `201 Created`\n- **Response**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"id\": \"4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1\",\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-10T22:50:00.000000+00:00\",\n    \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-10T22:50:00.000000+00:00\",\n    \"status\": \"active\"\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 2. List Conversations\n- **Route**: `GET /api/v1/conversations`\n- **Query Parameters**: `limit` (default 50), `offset` (default 0)\n- **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n- **Response**: List of active conversations ordered by most recently updated.\n\n### 3. Get Conversation Details\n- **Route**: `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}`\n- **Status Code**: `200 OK` (or `404 Not Found` if deleted/non-existent).\n\n### 4. Get Message History\n- **Route**: `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages`\n- **Query Parameters**: `limit` (default 100)\n- **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n- **Response**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversation_id\": \"4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1\",\n    \"messages\": [\n      {\n        \"id\": \"msg-1\",\n        \"conversation_id\": \"4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1\",\n        \"role\": \"user\",\n        \"content\": \"What is the final exam date?\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-10T22:50:01.000000+00:00\",\n        \"sources\": null\n      },\n      {\n        \"id\": \"msg-2\",\n        \"conversation_id\": \"4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1\",\n        \"role\": \"assistant\",\n        \"content\": \"The Proctored Final Exam takes place on 20 November 2026...\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-10T22:50:02.000000+00:00\",\n        \"sources\": [\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\"]\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 5. Send Message\n- **Route**: `POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages`\n- **Request Body**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"message\": \"How long is it?\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Validation**:\n  - Rejects non-JSON with `400 Bad Request`.\n  - Rejects missing or non-string `message` with `400 Bad Request`.\n  - Rejects empty or whitespace-only `message` with `400 Bad Request`.\n  - Rejects `len(message) > 4000` with `400 Bad Request`.\n  - Rejects non-existent or deleted conversation IDs with `404 Not Found`.\n- **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n- **Response**: Complete assistant answer with sources and scope flags.\n\n### 6. Delete Conversation\n- **Route**: `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}`\n- **Status Code**: `200 OK` with `{\"success\": true, \"conversation_id\": \"...\"}`\n- **Behavior**: Purges messages and marks conversation deleted; future messages to this ID return 404.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Conversation Context Implementation\n\nThe follow-up resolution engine in `ChatService.resolve_context()` enforces strict boundaries:\n\n1. **Pronoun & Ellipsis Resolution**:\n   - Turn 1: *\"What is the final exam date?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Answer gives Nov 20, 2026.\n   - Turn 2: *\"How long is it?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Resolves entity `exam` and rewrites to: *\"What is the duration of the final exam?\"*, answering 90 minutes.\n   - Turn 1: *\"What is the capstone deadline?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Answer gives Nov 15, 2026.\n   - Turn 2: *\"Can I submit it one day late?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Resolves entity `capstone` and rewrites to: *\"Can I submit the capstone case one day late?\"*, answering no late submissions accepted.\n2. **Contamination Guard**:\n   - Self-contained questions (e.g. Turn 1 about fee, Turn 2 asking *\"When is the final exam?\"*) contain explicit subjects. Context resolution is **not** triggered, preventing unrelated context from polluting the question.\n3. **Ambiguity Clarification**:\n   - Vague follow-ups (*\"What about the deadline?\"*) occurring after both quizzes and capstone were mentioned prompt a clarification:\n     *\"Could you please clarify whether you are referring to the weekly quiz deadlines or the Capstone Product Case deadline?\"*\n4. **Policy Invariance**:\n   - Historical conversation turns provide conversational context only. Every resolved query is executed against the official Module 5 `PolicyService` which queries official text files and applies post-generation safety assertions.\n5. **Bounded Context Window**:\n   - Only the last 6 messages (`MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES = 6`) are inspected.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Integration with Modules 1â€“5\n\n- **Module 1 & 2 (Architecture & Environment)**: Decoupled app factory (`app.py`), `/health` endpoint remains independent of Gemini and DB, CORS enabled.\n- **Module 3 (Document Management)**: Uses authoritative documents in `data/documents/`, Doc04 Section 3 unmoderated forum exclusion maintained.\n- **Module 4 (Gemini API Integration)**: Handled via `GeminiService` with backoff retries, secret key redaction (`AIza...`), and timeout management.\n- **Module 5 (Policy Accuracy)**: All answers originate from `PolicyService.ask()`. Precedence (Doc03 over Doc02), passing score invariants (60% overall + 40% exam minimum), capstone deadline, closed-book exam rules, and deterministic fallbacks are strictly maintained.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Security and Data-Safety Checks\n\n- **SQL Injection**: Parameterized SQL queries (`?`) are used exclusively. Malicious SQL strings in message bodies or conversation IDs are safely treated as passive strings without syntax execution.\n- **Foreign-Key Integrity**: `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;` is enforced on every connection. Inserting messages with invalid conversation IDs triggers an `IntegrityError`.\n- **Cross-Conversation Isolation**: Messages are queried strictly by `conversation_id = ?`. Messages in Conversation A are never visible in Conversation B.\n- **Secret Redaction**: API keys (pattern `AIza...`) are scrubbed before reaching logs or database tables.\n- **Concurrency**: SQLite transactions and WAL mode prevent database corruption during concurrent multi-threaded writes.\n- **Authorization Disclaimer**: Conversation IDs are unique operational identifiers, not proof of authenticated user identity. Multi-user session ownership is not claimed.\n\n---\n\n## 9. (resolved_query, is_ambiguous, clarification_prompt)\n409: \n410:         Rules:\n411:           - If the user query is self-contained, return as-is without context contamination.\n412:           - If it contains pronouns (\"it\", \"this\") or short ellipses (\"how long\"), resolve entity.\n413:           - If multiple conflicting candidates exist or query is vague, flag as ambiguous.\n414:         \"\"\"\n415:         clean_q = user_text.strip()\n416:         q_lower = clean_q.lower()\n417: \n418:         if not history:\n419:             return clean_q, False, None\n420: \n421:         # 1. Check if the query has follow-up pronouns or ellipses\n436:         needs_context = False\n437:         for pat in FOLLOW_UP_PRONOUNS:\n438:             if re.search(pat, q_lower):\n439:                 needs_context = True\n440:                 break\n441: \n442:         # Also check for short questions without subject (e.g., \"How long?\", \"Duration?\", \"Can I take it on mobile?\")\n443:         if len(q_lower.split()) <= 4 and any(w in q_lower for w in (\"how long\", \"duration\", \"date\", \"when\", \"format\")):\n444:             needs_context = True\n445: \n446:         if not needs_context:\n447:             # Self-contained question â€” do not contaminate with previous turn\n448:             return clean_q, False, None\n449: \n450:         # 3. Find the most recent core course entity discussed in history\n451:         # Reverse iterate through history to find the latest turn's topic\n452:         recent_topic = None\n453:         for m in reversed(history):\n454:             content_lower = m[\"content\"].lower()\n455:             if any(w in content_lower for w in (\"final exam\", \"proctored exam\", \"proctored final\", \"exam\")):\n456:                 recent_topic = \"final exam\"\n457:                 break\n458:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"capstone\", \"product case\", \"capstone case\")):\n459:                 recent_topic = \"capstone\"\n460:                 break\n461:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"quiz\", \"quizzes\", \"weekly quiz\")):\n462:                 recent_topic = \"quiz\"\n463:                 break\n464:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"verified certificate\", \"verified track\", \"certificate fee\", \"cost\")):\n465:                 recent_topic = \"certificate\"\n466:                 break\n467:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"course duration\", \"workload\", \"overview\")):\n468:                 recent_topic = \"course\"\n469:                 break\n470: \n471:         if not recent_topic:\n472:             return clean_q, False, None\n473: \n474:         # 4. Resolve query based on entity\n475:         resolved = clean_q\n476:         if recent_topic == \"final exam\":\n477:             # \"How long is it?\" -> \"How long is the final exam?\"\n478:             if re.search(r\"\\b(how long|duration)\\b\", q_lower):\n479:                 resolved = \"What is the duration of the final exam?\"\n480:             elif re.search(r\"\\b(device|laptop|desktop|mobile|tablet|phone)\\b\", q_lower):\n481:                 resolved = f\"{clean_q} (referring to the final exam)\"\n482:             elif re.search(r\"\\b(open[- ]book|closed[- ]book|notes|ai|chatgpt)\\b\", q_lower):\n483:                 resolved = f\"{clean_q} (referring to the final exam)\"\n484:             elif re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", q_lower):\n485:                 resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"the final exam\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n486:         elif recent_topic == \"capstone\":\n487:             # \"Can I submit it one day late?\" -> \"Can I submit the capstone one day late?\"\n488:             if re.search(r\"\\b(submit|submission|late|extension|deadline|due)\\b\", q_lower):\n489:                 if re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", q_lower):\n490:                     resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"the capstone case\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n491:                 else:\n492:                     resolved = f\"{clean_q} for the capstone case\"\n493:         elif recent_topic == \"quiz\":\n494:             if re.search(r\"\\b(submit|submission|late|miss|missed)\\b\", q_lower):\n495:                 if re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that|one)\\b\", q_lower):\n496:                     resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"a weekly quiz\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n497:                 else:\n498:                     resolved = f\"{clean_q} for weekly quizzes\"\n499: \n500:         return resolved, False, None\n501: \n502:     #
