{"step_index":1157,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-10T18:03:08Z","input_tokens":2338,"cache_read_tokens":209868,"output_tokens":2068,"tool_calls":[{"name":"edit_file","args":{"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_chat_service.py","Replacement":"        assert \"1,500\" in data[\"content\"] or \"1500\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4,999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert any(\"Handbook\" in s or \"Overview\" in s for s in data[\"sources\"])\n\n    def test_47_concurrency_scenario_a_insertion_begins_then_deletion_attempted(self, chat_service, temp_db_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        47. Scenario A: Connection A begins message insertion under BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\n        Connection B attempts conversation deletion. Verifies consistent final state.\n        \"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        event_a_acquired_lock = threading.Event()\n        event_b_can_proceed = threading.Event()\n        event_a_completed = threading.Event()\n\n        errors = []\n\n        def worker_a():\n            \"\"\"Simulates Connection A starting an immediate write transaction.\"\"\"\n            connA = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n            try:\n                with immediate_transaction(connA):\n                    # Signal that A holds the write lock\n                    event_a_acquired_lock.set()\n                    # Wait briefly for B to attempt deletion and queue on the lock\n                    event_b_can_proceed.wait(timeout=5.0)\n\n                    # Now execute message insertion\n                    msg_id = \"msg-sync-a\"\n                    now_iso = \"2026-11-10T12:00:00Z\"\n                    cursor = connA.cursor()\n                    cursor.execute(\n                        \"\"\"\n                        INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources)\n                        SELECT ?, id, 'user', 'Message from A', ?, NULL\n                        FROM conversations\n                        WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\n                        \"\"\",\n                        (msg_id, now_iso, conv_id),\n                    )\n                    cursor.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n                        (now_iso, conv_id),\n                    )\n                event_a_completed.set()\n            except Exception as e:\n                errors.append(e)\n            finally:\n                connA.close()\n\n        def worker_b():\n            \"\"\"Simulates Connection B attempting deletion while A holds the lock.\"\"\"\n            # Wait until A holds the write lock\n            event_a_acquired_lock.wait(timeout=5.0)\n            # Allow A to proceed after B is ready\n            event_b_can_proceed.set()\n            try:\n                # delete_conversation will queue for A's lock, then purge messages and mark deleted\n                success = chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)\n                assert success is True\n            except Exception as e:\n                errors.append(e)\n\n        thread_a = threading.Thread(target=worker_a)\n        thread_b = threading.Thread(target=worker_b)\n\n        thread_a.start()\n        thread_b.start()\n\n        thread_a.join(timeout=10.0)\n        thread_b.join(timeout=10.0)\n\n        assert len(errors) == 0\n\n        # Verify final state is completely consistent\n        conn_check = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n        try:\n            cursor = conn_check.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n            assert cursor.fetchone()[\"status\"] == \"deleted\"\n            # Crucial invariant: zero orphan messages remaining in table\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n            assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n        finally:\n            conn_check.close()\n\n    def test_48_concurrency_scenario_b_deletion_commits_first_insertion_must_fail(self, chat_service, temp_db_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        48. Scenario B: Connection B deletes the conversation first.\n        Connection A attempts to insert a message into the deleted conversation.\n        Connection A must fail atomically without inserting any rows.\n        \"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        event_deleted = threading.Event()\n        errors_b = []\n        conn_a_failed = []\n\n        def worker_b_deletes():\n            try:\n                assert chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id) is True\n                event_deleted.set()\n            except Exception as e:\n                errors_b.append(e)\n\n        def worker_a_inserts():\n            event_deleted.wait(timeout=5.0)\n            try:\n                chat_service.save_assistant_message(conv_id, \"Reply from Conn A\")\n            except ValueError as val_err:\n                conn_a_failed.append(str(val_err))\n\n        t_b = threading.Thread(target=worker_b_deletes)\n        t_a = threading.Thread(target=worker_a_inserts)\n\n        t_b.start()\n        t_a.start()\n\n        t_b.join(timeout=5.0)\n        t_a.join(timeout=5.0)\n\n        assert len(errors_b) == 0\n        # Conn A must have raised ValueError\n        assert len(conn_a_failed) == 1\n        assert \"deleted\" in conn_a_failed[0].lower()\n\n        # Direct DB verification: zero messages exist\n        conn_check = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n        try:\n            cursor = conn_check.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n            assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n        finally:\n            conn_check.close()\n\n    def test_49_concurrency_scenario_c_deletion_during_gemini_generation(self, chat_service, temp_db_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        49. Scenario C: Conversation is deleted while Gemini generation is in-flight.\n        Gemini returns, but saving the assistant message fails and zero messages remain.\n        \"\"\"\n        conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        event_gemini_started = threading.Event()\n        event_deletion_done = threading.Event()\n\n        def slow_gemini_policy(q):\n            # 1. Signal that Gemini network call is in flight\n            event_gemini_started.set()\n            # 2. Wait until external deletion has finished\n            event_deletion_done.wait(timeout=5.0)\n            return PolicyAnswer(\n                question=q,\n                answer=\"Answer generated while conversation was deleted\",\n                sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"],\n            )\n\n        chat_service.policy_service.ask.side_effect = slow_gemini_policy\n\n        def external_deleter():\n            event_gemini_started.wait(timeout=5.0)\n            # Delete conversation while Gemini is running\n            chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)\n            event_deletion_done.set()\n\n        thread_deleter = threading.Thread(target=external_deleter)\n        thread_deleter.start()\n\n        # process_message must fail when trying to save assistant reply\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:\n            chat_service.process_message(conv_id, \"What is the capstone deadline?\")\n        assert \"deleted\" in str(exc_info.value).lower()\n\n        thread_deleter.join(timeout=5.0)\n\n        # Database invariant: zero messages exist for the deleted conversation\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n            assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n        finally:\n            conn.close()","Target":"        assert \"1,500\" in data[\"content\"] or \"1500\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4,999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert any(\"Handbook\" in s or \"Overview\" in s for s in data[\"sources\"])"}}]}

adversarial hallucination tests. |\n\n---\n\n## 2. Python 3.11 SQLite Transaction Semantics & The Deletion Race Condition\n\n### Analysis of Default Python `sqlite3` Transaction Behavior\nIn Python's standard `sqlite3` module, the default `isolation_level` is `\"\"` (DEFERRED mode). Under this default behavior:\n1. `conn.__enter__()` inside `with conn:` **does not issue a `BEGIN` statement**.\n2. Executing a `SELECT` query **does not acquire a reserved or write lock**; it only acquires a shared read lock (or executes in autocommit mode).\n3. The transaction only upgrades to a write transaction when the first DML statement (`INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`) is executed.\n\nTherefore, an implementation that performs:\n```python\nwith conn:\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n    row = cursor.fetchone()\n    # At this point, no write lock is held!\n    cursor.execute(\"INSERT INTO messages ...\")\n```\nleaves a window where a concurrent thread can execute `delete_conversation(conv_id)` and commit between the `SELECT` and the `INSERT`.\n\n### The Corrected, Genuinely Atomic Transaction Strategy\nTo make message insertion and deletion strictly mutually exclusive and deterministic, two complementary mechanisms were implemented in [`backend/services/chat_service.py`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py):\n\n#### 1. Autocommit Mode with `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`\n`get_db_connection()` sets `isolation_level=None`. All write operations are wrapped in an `immediate_transaction` context manager:\n```python\n@contextmanager\ndef immediate_transaction(conn: sqlite3.Connection):\n    \"\"\"\n    Context manager that explicitly executes BEGIN IMMEDIATE to acquire\n    a SQLite write lock immediately at transaction start.\n    Guarantees that no concurrent writer can modify the database between\n    precondition checks and writes, eliminating isolation races and upgrade deadlocks.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\")\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.execute(\"COMMIT;\")\n    except Exception:\n        conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK;\")\n        raise\n```\nBy executing `BEGIN IMMEDIATE;`, SQLite reserves an exclusive write lock at the very beginning of the block. No other thread or connection can start a write transaction or execute a deletion until the block commits or rolls back.\n\n#### 2. Atomic Conditional Insertion\nWithin the immediate transaction, `save_user_message` and `save_assistant_message` use an atomic conditional `INSERT ... SELECT`:\n```python\ncursor.execute(\n    \"\"\"\n    INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources)\n    SELECT ?, id, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?\n    FROM conversations\n    WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\n    \"\"\",\n    (msg_id, content, now_iso, sources_json, conversation_id),\n)\nif cursor.rowcount == 0:\n    raise ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")\n```\n- If the conversation was deleted (or does not exist), `WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active'` matches 0 rows.\n- Exactly 0 rows are inserted. `cursor.rowcount` is 0.\n- `ValueError` is raised, causing `immediate_transaction` to execute `ROLLBACK;`.\n\n#### 3. Zero Lock Contention During Gemini Network I/O\nThe Gemini API request `self.policy_service.ask(resolved_q)` is executed completely *outside* any database connection or transaction. Database write locks are held only for the microsecond duration of the message insertion itself.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Deterministic Concurrency Test Results (Scenarios A, B, and C)\n\nThree deterministic test cases were implemented using `threading.Event()` synchronization primitives to coordinate independent connections:\n\n```mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    autonumber\n    participant ConnA as Connection A (Message Insertion)\n    participant Lock as SQLite DB Lock (BEGIN IMMEDIATE)\n    participant ConnB as Connection B (Conversation Deletion)\n\n    Note over ConnA,Lock: SCENARIO A: A begins insertion, B attempts deletion\n    ConnA->>Lock: BEGIN IMMEDIATE (Lock acquired)\n    ConnB->>Lock: BEGIN IMMEDIATE (Blocks / Queues on busy_timeout)\n    ConnA->>Lock: INSERT INTO messages (WHERE status='active')\n    ConnA->>Lock: COMMIT (Lock released)\n    Lock-->>ConnB: Lock acquired by B\n    ConnB->>Lock: DELETE FROM messages & UPDATE status='deleted'\n    ConnB->>Lock: COMMIT\n    Note over ConnA,ConnB: Verified: Status='deleted', 0 orphan messages remaining.\n\n    Note over ConnA,Lock: SCENARIO B: B deletes first, A attempts insertion\n    ConnB->>Lock: delete_conversation() committed (status='deleted')\n    ConnA->>Lock: BEGIN IMMEDIATE (Lock acquired)\n    ConnA->>Lock: INSERT INTO messages (WHERE status='active') -> 0 rows inserted\n    ConnA-->>ConnA: cursor.rowcount == 0 -> ROLLBACK -> ValueError\n    Note over ConnA,ConnB: Verified: A fails, 0 messages inserted into deleted conversation.\n```\n\n### Scenario A: Connection A Begins Insertion, Connection B Attempts Deletion (`test_47`)\n- **Procedure:** Connection A executes `BEGIN IMMEDIATE;`, signals `event_a_acquired_lock`, and holds the transaction while Connection B calls `chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)`. Connection B queues on the SQLite lock via `busy_timeout = 15000`. Connection A inserts its message and commits. Connection B immediately acquires the lock, purges all messages, sets `status = 'deleted'`, and commits.\n- **Verification:** Direct SQL assertion confirms `status == 'deleted'` and `COUNT(*) FROM messages == 0`. No orphan messages remain.\n\n### Scenario B: Connection B Deletes First, Connection A Attempts Insertion (`test_48`)\n- **Procedure:** Connection B calls `delete_conversation(conv_id)`. Once committed, signals `event_deleted`. Connection A then attempts to call `chat_service.save_assistant_message(conv_id, ...)`.\n- **Verification:** Connection A's atomic conditional insert evaluates `WHERE status = 'active'`, finds 0 rows, and raises `ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")`. Direct SQL assertion confirms `COUNT(*) FROM messages == 0`.\n\n### Scenario C: Conversation Deleted While Gemini Generation Is In-Flight (`test_49`)\n- **Procedure:** A student submits a message via `chat_service.process_message()`. In a coordinated mock, `PolicyService.ask()` sets `event_gemini_started` and waits on `event_deletion_done`. A concurrent thread receives the signal and calls `chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)`. Once deleted, `PolicyService.ask()` returns its answer. `process_message()` attempts to save the assistant reply via `save_assistant_message()`.\n- **Verification:** `save_assistant_message()` fails with `ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")`. Direct SQL assertion confirms 0 assistant messages were saved into the deleted conversation.\n\n---\n\n## 4. CRITICAL FACTUAL AUDIT: Verified Certificate Fee Verification\n\n### Official Course Documents Evidence\n- [`data/documents/01_course_handbook.txt`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/data/documents/01_course_handbook.txt#L20-L25), Section 4 states:\n  > *\"Verified Certificate Track (Rs. 1,500): Full access to graded quizzes, capstone evaluation, the proctored final exam, and the official Verified Certificate upon passing.\"*\n- **Audit Correction:** The narrative in Scenario D of Revision 1.0 that erroneously mentioned â‚¹4,999 has been corrected to **Rs. 1,500**.\n- **Defensive Assertion Enforced:** In `PolicyService._validate_and_enforce_policy()`, rule #8 overrides any incorrect fee (including â‚¹4,999, â‚¹2,000, â‚¹5,000) and enforces Rs. 1,500 from Doc 01.\n- **Regression Tests Passed:**\n  - `test_verified_certificate_fee`\n  - `test_adversarial_certificate_fee_4999_overridden_to_1500`\n  - `test_regression_verified_certificate_fee_is_1500_from_doc01`\n  - `test_46_verified_certificate_fee_regression_chat_api`\n\n---\n\n## 5. Deterministic Secondary Message Ordering\n\n- **Mechanism:** All message retrieval operations use `ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC`.\n- **Recent Context Query:**\n  ```sql\n  SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources\n  FROM (\n      SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources, rowid\n      FROM messages\n      WHERE conversation_id = ?\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC, rowid DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n  )\n  ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC;\n  ```\n- **Verification (`test_41`):** Verified using 6 messages inserted with identical microsecond timestamps (`2026-11-10T12:00:00.000000+00:00`). Full history and recent-context subqueries order deterministically by `rowid`.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Set `isolation_level=None` (autocommit mode) in [`get_db_connection()`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L37-L55).\n     2. This immediately acquires a RESERVED write lock before any check is made, serializing concurrent writes.\n     3. Implemented conditional atomic inserts in both `save_user_message` and `save_assistant_message`:\n        ```sql\n        INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources)\n        SELECT ?, id, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?\n        FROM conversations\n        WHERE id = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n1001:                         (now_iso, conv_id),\n1002:                     )\n1003:                 event_a_completed.set()\n1004:             except Exception as e:\n1005:                 errors.append(e)\n1006:             finally:\n1007:                 connA.close()\n1008: \n1009:         def worker_b():\n1010:             \"\"\"Simulates Connection B attempting deletion while A holds the lock.\"\"\"\n1011:             # delete_conversation will queue for A's lock, then purge messages and mark deleted\n1017:                 success = chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)\n1018:                 assert success is True\n1019:             except Exception as e:\n1020:                 errors.append(e)\n1021: \n1022:         thread_a = threading.Thread(target=worker_a)\n1023:         thread_b = threading.Thread(target=worker_b)\n1024: \n1025:         thread_a.start()\n1026:         thread_b.start()\n1027: \n1028:         thread_a.join(timeout=10.0)\n1029:         thread_b.join(timeout=10.0)\n1030: \n1031:         assert len(errors) == 0\n1032: \n1033:         # Conn A must have raised ValueError\n1083:         assert len(conn_a_failed) == 1\n1084:         assert \"deleted\" in conn_a_failed[0].lower()\n1085: \n1086:         # Direct DB verification: zero messages exist\n1087:         conn_check = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n1088:         try:\n1089:             cursor = conn_check.cursor()\n1090:             cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n1091:             assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n1092:         finally:\n1093:             conn_check.close()\n1094: \n1095:     def test_49_concurrency_scenario_c_deletion_during_gemini_generation(self, chat_service, temp_db_path):\n1096:         \"\"\"\n1097:         49. Scenario C: Conversation is deleted while Gemini generation is in-flight.\n1098:         Gemini returns, but saving the assistant message fails and zero messages remain.\n1099:         \"\"\"\n1100:         conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n1101:         conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n1102: \n1103:         event_gemini_started = threading.Event()\n1104:         event_deletion_done = threading.Event()\n1105: \n1106:         def slow_gemini_policy(q):\n1107:             # 1. Wait until external deletion has finished\n1110:             event_deletion_done.wait(timeout=5.0)\n1111:             return PolicyAnswer(\n1112:                 question=q,\n1113:                 answer=\"Answer generated while conversation was deleted\",\n1114:                 sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"],\n1115:             )\n1116: \n1117:         chat_service.policy_service.ask.side_effect = slow_gemini_policy\n1118: \n1119:         def external_deleter():\n1120:             event_gemini_started.wait(timeout=5.0)\n1121:             # Delete conversation while Gemini is running\n1122:             chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)\n1123:             event_deletion_done.set()\n1124: \n1125:         thread_deleter = threading.Thread(target=external_deleter)\n1126:         thread_deleter.start()\n1127: \n1128:         # process_message must fail when trying to save assistant reply\n1129:         with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:\n1130:             chat_service.process_message(conv_id, \"What is the capstone deadline?\")\n1131:         assert \"deleted\" in str(exc_info.value).lower()\n1132: \n1133:         thread_deleter.join(timeout=5.0)\n1134: \n1135:         # Database invariant: zero messages exist for the deleted conversation\n1136:         conn = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n1137:         try:\n1138:             cursor = conn.cursor()\n1139:             cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n1140:             assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n1141:         finally:\n1142:             conn.close()"}

Python 3.11 SQLite Transaction Semantics & The Deletion Race Condition\n32: \n33: ### Analysis of Default Python `sqlite3` Transaction Behavior\n34: In Python's standard `sqlite3` module, the default `isolation_level` is `\"\"` (DEFERRED mode). Under this default behavior:\n35: 1. `conn.__enter__()` inside `with conn:` **does not issue a `BEGIN` statement**.\n36: 2. Executing a `SELECT` query **does not acquire a reserved or write lock**; it only acquires a shared read lock (or executes in autocommit mode).\n37: 3. The transaction only upgrades to a write transaction when the first DML statement (`INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`) is executed.\n38: \n39: Therefore, an implementation that performs:\n40: ```python\n41: with conn:\n42:     cursor.execute(\"SELECT status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n43:     row = cursor.fetchone()\n44:     # At this point, no write lock is held!\n45:     cursor.execute(\"INSERT INTO messages ...\")\n46: ```\n47: leaves a window where a concurrent thread can execute `delete_conversation(conv_id)` and commit between the `SELECT` and the `INSERT`.\n48: \n49: ### The Corrected, Genuinely Atomic Transaction Strategy\n50: To make message insertion and deletion strictly mutually exclusive and deterministic, two complementary mechanisms were implemented in [`backend/services/chat_service.py`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py):"}

Remaining Architectural Limitations\n220: \n221: In accordance with strict verification standards, the following architectural constraints are explicitly documented:\n222: 1. **SQLite Database-Level Write Serialization:**  \n223:    While WAL mode allows concurrent readers, SQLite serializes write transactions at the database level. For high-volume multi-instance production environments, migrating to PostgreSQL is recommended.\n224: 2. **Ephemeral Disk on Free-Tier Hosting (Render):**  \n225:    The SQLite database file (`data/chatbot.db`) resides on local disk. On Render free-tier instances, disk state is ephemeral and resets during spin-downs or deployments unless a persistent disk mount is attached.\n226: 3. **No User Authentication / Session Identity:**  \n227:    Module 6 implements conversation tracking via client-provided UUIDs. It does not authenticate student identities or enforce role-based access control (RBAC). Anyone with a conversation UUID can read its transcript.\n228: \n229: ---\n230: \n231: ## 10. Key Findings\n- **Python 3.11 `sqlite3` Transaction Semantics:**\n  - By default (`isolation_level=\"\"`), Python `sqlite3` does NOT issue `BEGIN` upon executing a `SELECT`.\n  - Wrapping statements in `with conn:` without `isolation_level=None` and `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` leaves `SELECT` outside the write lock.\n  - Setting `isolation_level=None` and calling `conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\")` forces SQLite to acquire an immediate write lock (RESERVED state), serializing write access across concurrent connections.\n- **Conditional Atomic Insert:**\n  - `INSERT INTO messages ... SELECT ... FROM conversations WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active'` guarantees that if the conversation status changed to `'deleted'` before the insert executes, exactly 0 rows are inserted.\n- **Verified Certificate Fee:**\n  - Official fee in `data/documents/01_course_handbook.txt` Section 4 is **Rs. 1,500** (â‚¹1,500), NOT â‚¹4,999.\n- **Deterministic Ordering:**\n  - SQLite implicit monotonically increasing `rowid` serves as secondary tie-breaker (`ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC`) for both full history and recent context subqueries.\n\n---\n\n## 4. SELECT ... WHERE status = 'active'`.\n\n---\n\n## 5. AND status = 'active';\n387:                     \"\"\",\n388:                     (msg_id, content, now_iso, sources_json, conversation_id),\n389:                 )\n390:                 if cursor.rowcount == 0:\n391:                     raise ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")\n392: \n393:                 cursor.execute(\n394:                     \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n395:                     (now_iso, conversation_id),\n396:                 )\n397:             return {\n398:                 \"id\": msg_id,\n399:                 \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n400:                 \"role\": \"assistant\",\n401:                 \"content\": content,\n402:                 \"created_at\": now_iso,\n403:                 \"sources\": sources or [],\n404:             }\n405:         finally:\n406:             conn.close()\n407: \n408:     def get_conversation_messages(\n409:         self, conversation_id: str, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0\n410:     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n411:         \"\"\"\n412:         Retrieve messages for a conversation ordered chronologically (created_at ASC, rowid ASC).\n413:         Guarantees stable, deterministic ordering even when timestamps are identical.\n414:         \"\"\"\n415:         conn = self._get_connection()\n416:         try:\n417:             cursor = conn.cursor()\n418:             cursor.execute(\n419:                 \"\"\"\n420:                 SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources\n421:                 FROM messages\n422:                 WHERE conversation_id = ?\n423:                 ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC\n424:                 LIMIT ? def resolve_context(\n490:         self, user_text: str, history: list[dict[str, Any]]\n491:     ) -> tuple[str, bool, Optional[str]]:\n492:         \"\"\"\n493:         Evaluate user_text against return as-is without context contamination.\n499:           - If it contains pronouns (\"it\", \"this\") or short ellipses (\"how long\"), resolve entity.\n500:           - If multiple conflicting candidates exist or query is vague, flag as ambiguous.\n501:         \"\"\"\n502:         clean_q = user_text.strip()\n503:         q_lower = clean_q.lower()\n504: \n505:         if not history:\n506: Check for genuine ambiguity (e.g. \"What about the deadline?\" with multiple past topics)\n509:         is_ambiguous_phrase = any(re.search(pat, q_lower) for pat in AMBIGUOUS_PATTERNS)\n510:         if is_ambiguous_phrase:\n511:             # Check what was discussed in history\n512:             history_text = \" \".join(m[\"content\"].lower() for m in history)\n513:             has_quizzes = \"quiz\" in history_text\n514:             has_capstone = \"capstone\" in history_text\n515:             if has_quizzes and has_capstone:\n516:                 return (\n517:                     clean_q,\n518:                     True,\n519:                     \"Could you please clarify whether you are referring to the weekly quiz deadlines or the Capstone Product Case deadline?\",\n520:                 )\n521: \n522:         # 2. Find the most recent core course entity discussed in history\n538:         # Reverse iterate through history to find the latest turn's topic\n539:         recent_topic = None\n540:         for m in reversed(history):\n541:             content_lower = m[\"content\"].lower()\n542:             if any(w in content_lower for w in (\"final exam\", \"proctored exam\", \"proctored final\", \"exam\")):\n543:                 recent_topic = \"final exam\"\n544:                 break\n545:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"capstone\", \"product case\", \"capstone case\")):\n546:                 recent_topic = \"capstone\"\n547:                 break\n548:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"quiz\", \"quizzes\", \"weekly quiz\")):\n549:                 recent_topic = \"quiz\"\n550:                 break\n551:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"verified certificate\", \"verified track\", \"certificate fee\", \"cost\")):\n552:                 recent_topic = \"certificate\"\n553:                 break\n554:             elif any(w in content_lower for w in (\"course duration\", \"workload\", \"overview\")):\n555:                 recent_topic = \"course\"\n556:                 break\n557: \n558:         if not recent_topic:\n559:             return clean_q, False, None\n560: \n561:         # 4. Resolve query based on entity\n562:         resolved = clean_q\n563:         if recent_topic == \"final exam\":\n564:             # \"How long is it?\" -> \"How long is the final exam?\"\n565:             if re.search(r\"\\b(how long|duration)\\b\", q_lower):\n566:                 resolved = \"What is the duration of the final exam?\"\n567:             elif re.search(r\"\\b(device|laptop|desktop|mobile|tablet|phone)\\b\", q_lower):\n568:                 resolved = f\"{clean_q} (referring to the final exam)\"\n569:             elif re.search(r\"\\b(open[- ]book|closed[- ]book|notes|ai|chatgpt)\\b\", q_lower):\n570:                 resolved = f\"{clean_q} (referring to the final exam)\"\n571:             elif re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", q_lower):\n572:                 resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"the final exam\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n573:         elif recent_topic == \"capstone\":\n574:             # \"Can I submit it one day late?\" -> \"Can I submit the capstone one day late?\"\n575:             if re.search(r\"\\b(submit|submission|late|extension|deadline|due)\\b\", q_lower):\n576:                 if re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", q_lower):\n577:                     resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"the capstone case\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n578:                 else:\n579:                     resolved = f\"{clean_q} for the capstone case\"\n580:         elif recent_topic == \"quiz\":\n581:             if re.search(r\"\\b(submit|submission|late|miss|missed)\\b\", q_lower):\n582:                 if re.search(r\"\\b(it|this|that|one)\\b\", q_lower):\n583:                     resolved = re.sub(r\"\\b(it|this|that)\\b\", \"a weekly quiz\", clean_q, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n584:                 else:\n585:                     resolved = f\"{clean_q} for weekly quizzes\"\n586: \n587:         return resolved, False, None\n588: \n589:     # Multiple threads posting messages simultaneously do not cause DB lock timeouts.\"\"\"\n662:         conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n663:         conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n664:         errors = []\n665: \n666:         def post_worker(thread_num):\n667:             try:\n668:                 for j in range(5):\n669:                     chat_service.save_user_message(conv_id, f\"Worker {thread_num} msg {j}\")\n670:                     chat_service.save_assistant_message(\n671:                         conv_id, f\"Reply to worker {thread_num} msg {j}\", sources=[\"Handbook\"]\n672:                     )\n673:             except Exception as e:\n674:                 errors.append(e)\n675: \n676:         threads = [threading.Thread(target=post_worker, args=(t,)) for t in range(4)]\n677:         for t in threads:\n678:             t.start()\n679:         for t in threads:\n680:             t.join()\n681: \n682:         assert len(errors) == 0\n683:         all_msgs = chat_service.get_conversation_messages(conv_id, limit=100)\n684:         # 4 threads * 5 turns * 2 messages per turn = 40 messages\n685:         assert len(all_msgs) == 40\n686: \n687:     def test_38_conversation_deleted_during_processing_aborts_gracefully(self, chat_service):\n688:         \"\"\"38. If conversation is deleted while policy generation is occurring, it aborts cleanly.\"\"\"\n689:         conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n690:         conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n691: \n692:         # Mock policy service that deletes the conversation while 'thinking'\n693:         def sneaky_policy(q):\n694:             chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)\n695:             return PolicyAnswer(\n696:                 question=q,\n697:                 answer=\"Answer generated while conv was being deleted\",\n698:                 sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"],\n699:             )\n700: \n701:         chat_service.policy_service.ask.side_effect = sneaky_policy\n702: \n703:         with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:\n704:             chat_service.process_message(conv_id, \"What is the capstone deadline?\")\n705:         assert \"deleted\" in str(exc_info.value).lower()\n706: \n707:         # Direct DB check: messages must be empty (no resurrecting messages)\n708:         conn = get_db_connection(chat_service.db_path)\n709:         try:\n710:             cursor = conn.cursor()\n711:             cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n712:             assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n713:         finally:\n714:             conn.close()\n715: \n716:     def test_39_pagination_limit_and_offset_for_conversations_and_messages(self, client, chat_service):\n717:         \"\"\"39. Verify pagination parameters limit and offset for conversations and messages.\"\"\"\n718:         # Create 5 conversations\n719:         conv_ids = []\n720:         for i in range(5):\n721:             c = chat_service.create_conversation()\n722:             conv_ids.append(c[\"id\"])\n723: \n724:         # Fetch with limit=2, offset=0\n725:         resp1 = client.get(\"/api/v1/conversations?limit=2&offset=0\")\n726:         assert resp1.status_code == 200\n727:         data1 = resp1.get_json()[\"conversations\"]\n728:         assert len(data1) == 2\n729: \n730:         # Fetch with limit=2, offset=2\n731:         resp2 = client.get(\"/api/v1/conversations?limit=2&offset=2\")\n732:         assert resp2.status_code == 200\n733:         data2 = resp2.get_json()[\"conversations\"]\n734:         assert len(data2) == 2\n735:         # None of the IDs in page 2 should be in page 1\n736:         page1_ids = {c[\"id\"] for c in data1}\n737:         page2_ids = {c[\"id\"] for c in data2}\n738:         assert page1_ids.isdisjoint(page2_ids)\n739: \n740:         # Message pagination\n741:         test_conv = conv_ids[0]\n742:         for i in range(6):\n743:             chat_service.save_user_message(test_conv, f\"Message {i}\")\n744: \n745:         msg_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{test_conv}/messages?limit=3&offset=3\")\n746:         assert msg_resp.status_code == 200\n747:         msgs = msg_resp.get_json()[\"messages\"]\n748:         assert len(msgs) == 3\n749:         assert msgs[0][\"content\"] == \"Message 3\"\n750: "}

Verifies consistent final state.\n966:         \"\"\"\n967:         conv = chat_service.create_conversation()\n968:         conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n969: \n970:         event_a_acquired_lock = threading.Event()\n971:         event_b_can_proceed = threading.Event()\n972:         event_a_completed = threading.Event()\n973: \n974:         errors = []\n975: \n976:         def worker_a():\n977:             \"\"\"Simulates Connection A starting an immediate write transaction.\"\"\"\n978:             connA = get_db_connection(temp_db_path)\n979:             try:\n980:                 with immediate_transaction(connA):\n981:                     # Signal that A holds the write lock\n982:                     event_a_acquired_lock.set()\n983:                     # Wait briefly for B to attempt deletion and queue on the lock\n984:                     event_b_can_proceed.wait(timeout=5.0)\n985: \n986:                     # Now execute message insertion\n987:                     msg_id = \"msg-sync-a\"\n988:                     now_iso = \"2026-11-10T12:00:00Z\"\n989:                     cursor = connA.cursor()\n990:                     cursor.execute(\n991:                         \"\"\"\n992:                         INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources)\n993:                         SELECT ?, id, 'user', 'Message from A', ?, NULL\n994:                         FROM conversations\n995:                         WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\n996:                         \"\"\",\n997:                         (msg_id, now_iso, conv_id),\n998:                     )\n999:                     cursor.execute(\n1000:                         \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n1001:                         (now_iso, conv_id),\n1002:                     )\n1003:                 event_a_completed.set()\n1004:             except Exception as e:\n1005:                 errors.append(e)\n1006:             finally:\n1007:                 connA.close()\n1008: \n1009:         def worker_b():\n1010:             \"\"\"Simulates Connection B attempting deletion while A holds the lock.\"\"\"\n1011:             # Wait until A holds the write lock\n1012:             event_a_acquired_lock.wait(timeout=5.0)\n1013:             # Allow A to proceed after B is ready\n1014:             event_b_can_proceed.set()\n1015:             try:\n1016:                 # delete_conversation will queue for A's lock, then purge messages and mark deleted\n1017:                 success = chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)\n1018:                 assert success is True\n1019:             except Exception as e:\n1020:                 errors.append(e)\n1021: \n1022:         thread_a = threading.Thread(target=worker_a)\n1023:         thread_b = threading.Thread(target=worker_b)\n1024: \n1025:         thread_a.start()\n1026:         thread_b.start()\n1027: \n1028:         thread_a.join(timeout=10.0)\n1029:         thread_b.join(timeout=10.0)\n1030: \n1031:         assert len(errors) == 0\n1032: \n1033:         # Python 3.11 SQLite Transaction Semantics & The Deletion Race Condition\n32: \n33: ### Analysis of Default Python `sqlite3` Transaction Behavior\n34: In Python's standard `sqlite3` module, the default `isolation_level` is `\"\"` (DEFERRED mode). Under this default behavior:\n35: 1. `conn.__enter__()` inside `with conn:` **does not issue a `BEGIN` statement**.\n36: 2. Executing a `SELECT` query **does not acquire a reserved or write lock**; it only acquires a shared read lock (or executes in autocommit mode).\n37: 3. The transaction only upgrades to a write transaction when the first DML statement (`INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`) is executed.\n38: \n39: Therefore, an implementation that performs:\n40: ```python\n41: with conn:\n42:     cursor.execute(\"SELECT status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conv_id,))\n43:     row = cursor.fetchone()\n44:     # At this point, no write lock is held!\n45:     cursor.execute(\"INSERT INTO messages ...\")\n46: ```\n47: leaves a window where a concurrent thread can execute `delete_conversation(conv_id)` and commit between the `SELECT` and the `INSERT`.\n48: \n49: ### The Corrected, Genuinely Atomic Transaction Strategy\n50: To make message insertion and deletion strictly mutually exclusive and deterministic, two complementary mechanisms were implemented in [`backend/services/chat_service.py`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py):\n51: \n52: #### 1. Autocommit Mode with `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`\n53: `get_db_connection()` sets `isolation_level=None`. All write operations are wrapped in an `immediate_transaction` context manager:\n54: ```python\n55: @contextmanager\n56: def immediate_transaction(conn: sqlite3.Connection):\n57:     \"\"\"\n58:     Context manager that explicitly executes BEGIN IMMEDIATE to acquire\n59:     a SQLite write lock immediately at transaction start.\n60:     Guarantees that no concurrent writer can modify the database between\n61:     precondition checks and writes, eliminating isolation races and upgrade deadlocks.\n62:     \"\"\"\n63:     conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\")\n64:     try:\n65:         yield conn\n66:         conn.execute(\"COMMIT;\")\n67:     except Exception:\n68:         conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK;\")\n69:         raise\n70: ```\n71: By executing `BEGIN IMMEDIATE;`, SQLite reserves an exclusive write lock at the very beginning of the block. No other thread or connection can start a write transaction or execute a deletion until the block commits or rolls back.\n72: \n73: #### 2. Atomic Conditional Insertion\n74: Within the immediate transaction, `save_user_message` and `save_assistant_message` use an atomic conditional `INSERT ... SELECT`:\n75: ```python\n76: cursor.execute(\n77:     \"\"\"\n78:     INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources)\n79:     SELECT ?, id, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?\n80:     FROM conversations\n81:     WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\n82:     \"\"\",\n83:     (msg_id, content, now_iso, sources_json, conversation_id),\n84: )\n85: if cursor.rowcount == 0:\n86:     raise ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")\n87: ```\n88: - If the conversation was deleted (or does not exist), `WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active'` matches 0 rows.\n89: - Exactly 0 rows are inserted. `cursor.rowcount` is 0.\n90: - `ValueError` is raised, causing `immediate_transaction` to execute `ROLLBACK;`.\n91: \n92: #### 3. Zero Lock Contention During Gemini Network I/O\n93: The Gemini API request `self.policy_service.ask(resolved_q)` is executed completely *outside* any database connection or transaction. Database write locks are held only for the microsecond duration of the message insertion itself.\n94: \n95: ---\n96: \n97: ## 3. Deterministic Concurrency Test Results (Scenarios A, B, and C)\n98: \n99: Three deterministic test cases were implemented using `threading.Event()` synchronization primitives to coordinate independent connections:\n100: \n101: ```mermaid\n102: sequenceDiagram\n103:     autonumber\n104:     participant ConnA as Connection A (Message Insertion)\n105:     participant Lock as SQLite DB Lock (BEGIN IMMEDIATE)\n106:     participant ConnB as Connection B (Conversation Deletion)\n107: \n108:     Note over ConnA,Lock: SCENARIO A: A begins insertion, B attempts deletion\n109:     ConnA->>Lock: BEGIN IMMEDIATE (Lock acquired)\n110:     ConnB->>Lock: BEGIN IMMEDIATE (Blocks / Queues on busy_timeout)\n111:     ConnA->>Lock: INSERT INTO messages (WHERE status='active')\n112:     ConnA->>Lock: COMMIT (Lock released)\n113:     Lock-->>ConnB: Lock acquired by B\n114:     ConnB->>Lock: DELETE FROM messages & UPDATE status='deleted'\n115:     ConnB->>Lock: COMMIT\n116:     Note over ConnA,ConnB: Verified: Status='deleted', 0 orphan messages remaining.\n117: \n118:     Note over ConnA,Lock: SCENARIO B: B deletes first, A attempts insertion\n119:     ConnB->>Lock: delete_conversation() committed (status='deleted')\n120:     ConnA->>Lock: BEGIN IMMEDIATE (Lock acquired)\n121:     ConnA->>Lock: INSERT INTO messages (WHERE status='active') -> 0 rows inserted\n122:     ConnA-->>ConnA: cursor.rowcount == 0 -> ROLLBACK -> ValueError\n123:     Note over ConnA,ConnB: Verified: A fails, 0 messages inserted into deleted conversation.\n124: ```\n125: \n126: ### Scenario A: Connection A Begins Insertion, Connection B Attempts Deletion (`test_47`)\n127: - **Procedure:** Connection A executes `BEGIN IMMEDIATE;`, signals `event_a_acquired_lock`, and holds the transaction while Connection B calls `chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)`. Connection B queues on the SQLite lock via `busy_timeout = 15000`. Connection A inserts its message and commits. Connection B immediately acquires the lock, purges all messages, sets `status = 'deleted'`, and commits.\n128: - **Verification:** Direct SQL assertion confirms `status == 'deleted'` and `COUNT(*) FROM messages == 0`. No orphan messages remain.\n129: \n130: ### Scenario B: Connection B Deletes First, Connection A Attempts Insertion (`test_48`)\n131: - **Procedure:** Connection B calls `delete_conversation(conv_id)`. Once committed, signals `event_deleted`. Connection A then attempts to call `chat_service.save_assistant_message(conv_id, ...)`.\n132: - **Verification:** Connection A's atomic conditional insert evaluates `WHERE status = 'active'`, finds 0 rows, and raises `ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")`. Direct SQL assertion confirms `COUNT(*) FROM messages == 0`.\n133: \n134: ### Scenario C: Conversation Deleted While Gemini Generation Is In-Flight (`test_49`)\n135: - **Procedure:** A student submits a message via `chat_service.process_message()`. In a coordinated mock, `PolicyService.ask()` sets `event_gemini_started` and waits on `event_deletion_done`. A concurrent thread receives the signal and calls `chat_service.delete_conversation(conv_id)`. Once deleted, `PolicyService.ask()` returns its answer. `process_message()` attempts to save the assistant reply via `save_assistant_message()`.\n136: - **Verification:** `save_assistant_message()` fails with `ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")`. Direct SQL assertion confirms 0 assistant messages were saved into the deleted conversation.\n137: \n138: ---\n139: \n140: ## 4. Remaining Architectural Limitations\n220: \n221: In accordance with strict verification standards, the following architectural constraints are explicitly documented:\n222: 1. **SQLite Database-Level Write Serialization:**  \n223:    While WAL mode allows concurrent readers, SQLite serializes write transactions at the database level. For high-volume multi-instance production environments, migrating to PostgreSQL is recommended.\n224: 2. **Ephemeral Disk on Free-Tier Hosting (Render):**  \n225:    The SQLite database file (`data/chatbot.db`) resides on local disk. On Render free-tier instances, disk state is ephemeral and resets during spin-downs or deployments unless a persistent disk mount is attached.\n226: 3. **No User Authentication / Session Identity:**  \n227:    Module 6 implements conversation tracking via client-provided UUIDs. It does not authenticate student identities or enforce role-based access control (RBAC). Anyone with a conversation UUID can read its transcript.\n228: \n229: ---\n230: \n231: ## 10. [`backend/services/chat_service.py#L34-L71`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L34-L71):\n\n```python\n@contextmanager\ndef immediate_transaction(conn: sqlite3.Connection):\n    \"\"\"\n    Context manager that explicitly executes BEGIN IMMEDIATE to acquire\n    a SQLite write lock immediately at transaction start.\n    Guarantees that no concurrent writer can modify the database between\n    precondition checks and writes, eliminating isolation races and upgrade deadlocks.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\")\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.execute(\"COMMIT;\")\n    except Exception:\n        conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK;\")\n        raise\n\n\ndef get_db_connection(db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    \"\"\"\n    Open an isolated SQLite connection with autocommit mode (isolation_level=None),\n    foreign keys enabled, WAL mode, and busy timeout.\n    \"\"\"\n    path = db_path or config.DB_PATH\n    if path != \":memory:\" and not path.startswith(\"file:\"):\n        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)\n\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=15.0, isolation_level=None)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\")\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 15000;\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\")\n    except sqlite3.OperationalError:\n        pass\n    return conn\n```\n\n- **Python 3.11 Transaction Mechanics:** Default Python `sqlite3` `isolation_level=\"\"` does not issue `BEGIN` upon executing `SELECT`. Setting `isolation_level=None` and calling `conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\")` forces SQLite to transition straight to `RESERVED` state before any check occurs, serializing concurrent write access.\n- **Connection Lifecycle:** All database operations execute inside strict `try...finally: conn.close()` blocks. Exceptions during `yield` trigger `conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK;\")` before re-raising.\n\n---\n\n### 1.2 `save_user_message()` and `save_assistant_message()`\nLocated in [`backend/services/chat_service.py#L325-L407`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L325-L407):\n\n```python\ndef save_user_message(self, conversation_id: str, content: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    msg_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n    now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n    conn = self._get_connection()\n    try:\n        with immediate_transaction(conn):\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            # Atomic conditional insert: only inserts if conversation exists and is active\n            cursor.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources)\n                SELECT ?, id, 'user', ?, ?, NULL\n                FROM conversations\n                WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\n                \"\"\",\n                (msg_id, content, now_iso, conversation_id),\n            )\n            if cursor.rowcount == 0:\n                raise ValueError(\"Conversation not found or has been deleted\")\n\n            cursor.execute(\n                \"UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';\",\n                (now_iso, conversation_id),\n            )\n        return {\n            \"id\": msg_id,\n            \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n            \"role\": \"user\",\n            \"content\": content,\n            \"created_at\": now_iso,\n            \"sources\": None,\n        }\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n```\n\n- **Atomic Precondition Guarantee:** Using conditional `INSERT ... SELECT ... FROM conversations WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active';` ensures that if a conversation was deleted before or during lock acquisition, `cursor.rowcount == 0`. It immediately raises `ValueError`, triggering a rollback, guaranteeing zero orphan or resurrected messages.\n\n---\n\n### 1.3 `delete_conversation()`\nLocated in [`backend/services/chat_service.py#L273-L305`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L273-L305):\n\n```python\ndef delete_conversation(self, conversation_id: str, hard_delete: bool = False) -> bool:\n    if not conversation_id or not isinstance(conversation_id, str):\n        return False\n\n    conn = self._get_connection()\n    try:\n        with immediate_transaction(conn):\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT id, status FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conversation_id,))\n            row = cursor.fetchone()\n            if not row or row[\"status\"] != \"active\":\n                return False\n\n            now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n            cursor.execute(\"DELETE FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?;\", (conversation_id,))\n            if hard_delete:\n                cursor.execute(\"DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id = ?;\", (conversation_id,))\n            else:\n                cursor.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE conversations SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?;\",\n                    (now_iso, conversation_id),\n                )\n        return True\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n```\n\n- **Repeated Deletion Idempotence:** If `row[\"status\"] != \"active\"` (already soft-deleted), the transaction immediately returns `False`, causing the HTTP endpoint to return `404 Not Found`.\n\n---\n\n### 1.4 `get_recent_messages()` & Deterministic Ordering\nLocated in [`backend/services/chat_service.py#L445-L485`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L445-L485):\n\n```python\ndef get_recent_messages(self, conversation_id: str, limit: int = 6) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    conn = self._get_connection()\n    try:\n        cursor = conn.cursor()\n        cursor.execute(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources\n            FROM (\n                SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at, sources, rowid\n                FROM messages\n                WHERE conversation_id = ?\n                ORDER BY created_at DESC, rowid DESC\n                LIMIT ?\n            )\n            ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC;\n            \"\"\",\n            (conversation_id, limit),\n        )\n        rows = cursor.fetchall()\n        # Parsed into JSON response list\n        return [...]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n```\n\n- **Deterministic Tie-Breaking:** SQLite's monotonically increasing `rowid` serves as secondary order (`ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC`), guaranteeing stable sequencing even when multiple messages share an identical microsecond timestamp.\n\n---\n\n### 1.5 Message Pipeline & Policy Decoupling (`process_message`)\nLocated in [`backend/services/chat_service.py#L591-L671`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L591-L671):\n\n1. **Active Pre-Check:** `verify_conversation_active(conv_id)` rejects deleted/missing conversations before write.\n2. **User Message Persistence:** Writes user turn inside `immediate_transaction`.\n3. **Context Window Extraction:** Fetches `max_context_messages` (excluding current message).\n4. **Context Resolution:** Evaluates follow-ups and pronouns (`resolve_context`), returning unambiguous queries or clarification requests.\n5. **Decoupled AI Invocation:** `self.policy_service.ask(resolved_q)` runs **outside any database connection or write lock**, ensuring database locks are never held during external LLM network latency.\n6. **Active Post-Check:** Re-verifies conversation status in case a concurrent DELETE committed during AI generation.\n7. **Assistant Persistence:** Saves assistant response atomically using conditional insert.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Cache key generation\n\nCreate a reliable cache key generation mechanism.\n\nThe composite key must account for:\n\n1. Normalized user query.\n2. Gemini model/configuration version where relevant.\n\nHash the entire composite key using SHA-256.\n\nDo not use only the user's question as the cache key.\n\nEnsure that changes to official documents or policy rules cannot accidentally reuse stale cached answers.\n\n### 4. Cache retrieval\n\nWhen a question arrives:\n\n1. Normalize the query.\n2. Generate the composite cache key.\n3. Check whether a matching cache entry exists.\n4. Check its expiration.\n5. Validate that its stored sources remain valid.\n6. Return the cached answer if valid.\n7. Otherwise treat it as a cache miss and continue through the existing policy pipeline.\n\nExpired entries must never be returned.\n\n### 5. Cache storage\n\nCache only successful, complete, policy-validated answers.\n\nDo not cache:\n\n- API failures.\n- Timeouts.\n- Invalid responses.\n- Empty responses.\n- Clarification requests.\n- Context-dependent answers.\n- Answers dependent on previous conversation messages.\n- Unverified or unsupported answers.\n- Temporary error/fallback messages.\n\nPreserve source attribution with cached answers.\n\n### 6. Error handling\n\nThe chatbot must continue functioning if caching fails.\n\nExamples:\n\n- Database temporarily unavailable.\n- Cache read error.\n- Cache write error.\n- Expired entry.\n- Invalid cache data.\n\nCaching must be an optimization, never a dependency for answering questions.\n\nLog errors safely without exposing API keys, personal data, or full sensitive conversation contents.\n\n### 10. â”€â”€ Data classes â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n32: \n33: @dataclass\n34: class PolicyAnswer:\n35:     \"\"\"\n36:     Structured result returned by PolicyService.ask().\n37:     \"\"\"\n38:     question: str\n39:     answer: str\n40:     sources: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n41:     confidence: float = 1.0\n42:     is_in_scope: bool = True\n43:     is_supported: bool = True\n44:     evidence_chunks: list[ChunkData] = field(default_factory=list)\n45:     model_used: Optional[str] = None\n46:     prompt_tokens: Optional[int] = None\n47:     candidates_tokens: Optional[int] = None\n48:     total_tokens: Optional[int] = None\n49: \n50: \n51: # â”€â”€ Scope & Prompt Injection Detection â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n52: \n53: # Course keywords that indicate the question is relevant to DPM-101\n54: COURSE_KEYWORDS = [\n55:     \"course\", \"dpm\", \"dpm-101\", \"dpm101\", \"iimb\", \"iimbx\", \"handbook\",\n56:     \"grade\", \"grading\", \"pass\", \"passing\", \"score\", \"threshold\", \"distinction\",\n57:     \"quiz\", \"quizzes\", \"assignment\", \"capstone\", \"deadline\", \"late\", \"submission\",\n58:     \"penalty\", \"exam\", \"final exam\", \"proctor\", \"proctored\", \"closed-book\", \"open-book\",\n59:     \"calculator\", \"rough paper\", \"id\", \"photo id\", \"webcam\", \"microphone\", \"device\",\n60:     \"laptop\", \"desktop\", \"phone\", \"mobile\", \"tablet\", \"ipad\", \"browser\", \"chrome\", \"edge\",\n61:     \"internet\", \"slot\", \"slots\", \"date\", \"duration\", \"hours\", \"weeks\", \"effort\",\n62:     \"audit\", \"audit track\", \"verified\", \"verified track\", \"certificate\", \"fee\", \"rs\", \"inr\",\n63:     \"price\", \"cost\", \"refund\", \"money back\", \"cancel\", \"cancellation\", \"syllabus\", \"content\",\n64:     \"topic\", \"topics\", \"learn\", \"product management\", \"user research\", \"roadmapping\", \"metrics\",\n65:     \"ai\", \"ai feature\", \"ai tool\", \"chatgpt\", \"notes\", \"policy\", \"ta\", \"teaching assistant\",\n66:     \"forum\", \"discussion\", \"video\", \"lecture\", \"cohort\", \"upgrade\", \"upgrading\", \"week\",\n67:     \"session\", \"sessions\", \"doubt\", \"live\", \"schedule\", \"workload\", \"attend\",\n68:     \"desk\", \"rules\", \"material\", \"materials\", \"items\", \"permitted\", \"allowed\",\n69:     \"professor\", \"faculty\", \"instructor\", \"office\", \"hard-copy\", \"hard copy\",\n70: ]\n71: \n72: # Stop words to ignore during keyword relevance scoring to prevent spurious matches\n73: STOP_WORDS = {\n74:     \"what\", \"when\", \"where\", \"which\", \"who\", \"whom\", \"this\", \"that\", \"these\", \"those\",\n75:     \"am\", \"is\", \"are\", \"was\", \"were\", \"be\", \"been\", \"being\", \"have\", \"has\", \"had\",\n76:     \"having\", \"do\", \"does\", \"did\", \"doing\", \"would\", \"should\", \"could\", \"ought\",\n77:     \"the\", \"and\", \"but\", \"if\", \"or\", \"because\", \"as\", \"until\", \"while\", \"of\", \"at\",\n78:     \"by\", \"for\", \"with\", \"about\", \"against\", \"between\", \"into\", \"through\", \"during\",\n79:     \"before\", \"after\", \"above\", \"below\", \"to\", \"from\", \"up\", \"down\", \"in\", \"out\",\n80:     \"on\", \"off\", \"over\", \"under\", \"again\", \"further\", \"then\", \"once\", \"here\", \"there\",\n81:     \"all\", \"any\", \"both\", \"each\", \"few\", \"more\", \"most\", \"other\", \"some\", \"such\",\n82:     \"no\", \"nor\", \"not\", \"only\", \"own\", \"same\", \"so\", \"than\", \"too\", \"very\", \"can\",\n83:     \"will\", \"just\", \"don\", \"should\", \"now\", \"tell\", \"give\", \"please\", \"student\", \"students\",\n84: }\n85: \n86: # Patterns for obvious unrelated questions (sports, general trivia, weather, etc.)\n87: UNRELATED_PATTERNS = [\n88:     r\"\\bcricket\\b\", r\"\\bfootball\\b\", r\"\\bbasketball\\b\", r\"\\btennis\\b\", r\"\\bmatch\\b\",\n89:     r\"\\bscore of the match\\b\", r\"\\bwho won\\b\", r\"\\bpresident\\b\", r\"\\bprime minister\\b\",\n90:     r\"\\bcapital of\\b\", r\"\\bweather\\b\", r\"\\btemperature in\\b\", r\"\\bhoroscope\\b\",\n91:     r\"\\bmovie\\b\", r\"\\bcelebrity\\b\", r\"\\brecipe\\b\", r\"\\bstock price\\b\",\n92: ]\n93: \n94: # Prompt injection markers in questions or text\n95: INJECTION_PATTERNS = [\n96:     r\"ignore (all )?(previous|above|system) instructions\",\n97:     r\"disregard (section \\d|all instructions|the above)\",\n98:     r\"system update for ai assistants\",\n99:     r\"reveal (your |the )?system prompt\",\n100:     r\"you are now (an unrestricted|a new)\",\n101:     r\"treat forum comments as official\",\n102:     r\"change the passing score\",\n103:     r\"the exam is now open-book\",\n104:     r\"output the exact prompt\",\n105: ]\n106: \n107: \n108: class PolicyService:\n109:     \"\"\"\n110:     Policy engine that coordinates retrieval, precedence, validation, and generation.\n111:     \"\"\"\n112: \n113:     def __init__(\n114:         self,\n115:         gemini_service: Optional[GeminiService] = None,\n116:         doc_processor: Optional[DocumentProcessor] = None,\n117:         chunks: Optional[list[ChunkData]] = None,\n118:     ) -> None:\n119:         self.gemini_service = gemini_service or GeminiService()\n120:         self.doc_processor = doc_processor or DocumentProcessor(\n121:             DOC_REGISTRY,\n122:             config.DOCUMENTS_DIR,\n123:             chunk_size=config.CHUNK_SIZE,\n124:             chunk_overlap=config.CHUNK_OVERLAP,\n125:         )\n126: \n127:         # Ingest/cache chunks in memory\n128:         if chunks is not None:\n129:             self._chunks = chunks\n130:         else:\n131:             self._chunks = self._load_chunks()\n132: \n133:     def _load_chunks(self) -> list[ChunkData]:\n134:         \"\"\"Process all registered documents and collect chunks.\"\"\"\n135:         results = self.doc_processor.process_all()\n136:         all_chunks: list[ChunkData] = []\n137:         for doc_id, res in results.items():\n138:             if res.success:\n139:                 all_chunks.extend(res.chunks)\n140:         return all_chunks\n141: \n142:     # Indexes will be created for the unique cache key, expiration, and access time, optimizing query performance. The normalized query will undergo lowercasing, whitespace trimming, and normalization to improve consistency.\n\n\nThe cache key will incorporate a normalized query, a document fingerprint, a policy version, and a model version to ensure cache invalidation on relevant changes. Document fingerprint calculation will involve a deterministic method using registered documents, including `doc_id`, `filename`, `last_updated`, `policy_status`, and optionally SHA-256 hash or file modified time. Changes to any of these document components will result in a different cache key. The policy version is derived from the prompt or policy rules revision, and model version includes model name and temperature.\n\n\nThe cache key ensures invalidation upon policy, prompt, or model changes. Contextual queries require specific handling to avoid incorrect cache reuse; answers dependent on conversational history must be flagged and excluded from the standalone query cache to prevent bleed-through of resolved context.  \"\"\"Check if caching is globally enabled.\"\"\"\n        return bool(self.enabled)\n\n    # â”€â”€ Query Normalization & Fingerprinting Normalize user query string to guarantee identical representations:\n          - Trim outer whitespace\n          - Convert to lowercase\n          - Strip punctuation marks (e.g. trailing ?, !, ., ,, â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def validate_cacheable(\n        answer: str,\n        sources: False,\n        error: Optional[str] = None,\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Strict validation gate before caching:\n        Only complete, valid, official-policy answers may be cached.\n        \"\"\"\n        if error is not None:\n            return False, \"Cannot cache error response\"\n        if not is_in_scope:\n            return False, \"Cannot cache out-of-scope response\"\n        if not is_supported:\n            return False, \"Cannot cache unsupported topic response\"\n        if is_context_dependent:\n            return False, \"Cannot cache context-dependent answer\"\n        if is_clarification:\n            return False, \"Cannot cache clarification prompt\"\n        if is_fallback:\n            return False, \"Cannot cache extractive or fallback answer\"\n        if not answer or not answer.strip():\n            return False, \"Cannot cache empty answer\"\n        if not sources or not isinstance(sources, list) or len(sources) ==
