End-to-end integration with PolicyService and ChatService pipelines.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sqlite3\nimport threading\nimport time\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta\nfrom unittest.mock import MagicMock\nimport pytest\n\nfrom config import DOC_REGISTRY, config\nfrom backend.services.cache_service import CacheService, CachedAnswer, init_cache_table\nfrom backend.services.chat_service import ChatService, get_db_connection\nfrom backend.services.policy_service import PolicyService, PolicyAnswer\nfrom backend.services.gemini_service import GeminiService, GeminiResponse\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Test Fixtures â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef temp_cache_db(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Provides a fresh isolated SQLite database path per test.\"\"\"\n    db_file = tmp_path / \"test_cache.db\"\n    return str(db_file)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef cache_service(temp_cache_db):\n    \"\"\"Provides an isolated CacheService instance.\"\"\"\n    return CacheService(\n        db_path=temp_cache_db,\n        default_ttl=3600,\n        enabled=True,\n    )\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 1: Cache Initialization & Schema â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestCacheInitialization:\n\n    def test_init_cache_creates_table_and_indexes(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"1. Schema DDL creates query_cache table and all 3 required indexes.\"\"\"\n        service = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=True)\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_cache_db)\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            # Verify table existence\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='query_cache';\")\n            assert cursor.fetchone() is not None\n\n            # Verify indexes\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name='query_cache';\")\n            idx_names = {row[\"name\"] for row in cursor.fetchall()}\n            assert \"idx_query_cache_key\" in idx_names\n            assert \"idx_query_cache_expires\" in idx_names\n            assert \"idx_query_cache_accessed\" in idx_names\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def test_init_cache_idempotent(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"2. Calling initialization multiple times does not raise or duplicate tables.\"\"\"\n        service = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=True)\n        service._ensure_schema()\n        service._ensure_schema()\n        assert service.is_enabled() is True\n\n    def test_cache_disabled_mode(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"3. When caching is disabled, get and set return None/False immediately.\"\"\"\n        disabled_service = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=False)\n        assert disabled_service.is_enabled() is False\n        assert disabled_service.get(\"What is the passing score?\") is None\n        assert disabled_service.set(\n            \"What is the passing score?\",\n            \"Passing is 60%.\",\n            sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"],\n        ) is False\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 2: Cache Key Generation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestCacheKeyGeneration:\n\n    def test_same_query_same_key_under_identical_config(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"4. Exact same query produces identical 64-character SHA-256 hex key.\"\"\"\n        k1 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing requirement?\")\n        k2 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing requirement?\")\n        assert k1 == k2\n        assert len(k1) == 64\n        int(k1, 16)  # Verifies valid hex\n\n    def test_normalization_whitespace_casing_punctuation_produces_identical_key(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"5. Whitespace, casing, and trailing punctuation variations produce the same key.\"\"\"\n        q1 = \"What is the passing score?\"\n        q2 = \"  what is the passing score?  \"\n        q3 = \"WHAT IS THE PASSING SCORE\"\n        q4 = \"what   is   the   passing   score???\"\n\n        k1 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(q1)\n        k2 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(q2)\n        k3 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(q3)\n        k4 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(q4)\n\n        assert k1 == k2 == k3 == k4\n\n    def test_different_queries_produce_different_keys(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"6. Substantially different questions produce distinct keys.\"\"\"\n        k1 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\")\n        k2 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"When is the final exam?\")\n        k3 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the capstone deadline?\")\n        assert len({k1, k2, k3}) == 3\n\n    def test_document_version_change_invalidates_key(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"7. Changes in official document versions produce a completely different cache key.\"\"\"\n        k_v1 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\", doc_fingerprint=\"doc_fp_v1\")\n        k_v2 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\", doc_fingerprint=\"doc_fp_v2\")\n        assert k_v1 != k_v2\n\n    def test_policy_version_change_invalidates_key(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"8. Changes in policy version (e.g. prompt v1 -> v2) produce a different cache key.\"\"\"\n        k_p1 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\", policy_version=\"policy_v1\")\n        k_p2 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\", policy_version=\"policy_v2\")\n        assert k_p1 != k_p2\n\n    def test_model_version_change_invalidates_key(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"9. Changes in LLM model or temperature produce a different cache key.\"\"\"\n        k_m1 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\", model_version=\"gemini-3.8-flash:temp=0.1\")\n        k_m2 = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\", model_version=\"gemini-pro:temp=0.1\")\n        assert k_m1 != k_m2\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 3: Cache Hit, Miss, and Updates â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestCacheHitAndMiss:\n\n    def test_cache_miss_on_empty_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"10. Uncached query returns None and increments runtime misses.\"\"\"\n        res = cache_service.get(\"What is the passing score?\")\n        assert res is None\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"runtime_misses\"] == 1\n        assert stats[\"runtime_hits\"] == 0\n\n    def test_cache_hit_after_storing(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"11. Storing an answer then querying returns CachedAnswer and increments hits.\"\"\"\n        q = \"What is the passing score?\"\n        ans = \"The passing score is 60% overall and 40% in the final exam.\"\n        sources = [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]\n\n        stored = cache_service.set(query=q, answer=ans, sources=sources, model_used=\"gemini-3.8-flash\")\n        assert stored is True\n\n        cached: CachedAnswer = cache_service.get(q)\n        assert cached is not None\n        assert cached.answer == ans\n        assert cached.sources == sources\n        assert cached.model_used == \"gemini-3.8-flash\"\n        assert cached.access_count == 2  # 1 initial + 1 on get\n\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"runtime_hits\"] == 1\n        assert stats[\"active_entries\"] == 1\n\n    def test_last_accessed_at_updates_on_hit(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"12. Accessing a cached entry updates its last_accessed_at timestamp.\"\"\"\n        q = \"What is the distinction threshold?\"\n        ans = \"Distinction requires 85% or higher.\"\n        cache_service.set(q, ans, sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"])\n\n        cached1 = cache_service.get(q)\n        time1 = cached1.last_accessed_at\n\n        # Access again after brief pause\n        time.sleep(0.01)\n        cached2 = cache_service.get(q)\n        time2 = cached2.last_accessed_at\n\n        assert cached2.access_count == 3\n        assert time2 >= time1\n\n    def test_source_attribution_preserved_on_hit(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"13. Stored sources are returned exactly without data loss.\"\"\"\n        q = \"When is the final exam?\"\n        sources = [\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\", \"Course Handbook & Overview\"]\n        cache_service.set(q, \"Exam is 20 November 2026.\", sources=sources)\n\n        cached = cache_service.get(q)\n        assert cached.sources == sources\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 4: TTL, Expiration & Maintenance â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestCacheExpirationAndCleanup:\n\n    def test_expired_entry_returns_none_miss(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"14. An entry with an expired timestamp is treated as a cache miss.\"\"\"\n        q = \"What is the capstone deadline?\"\n        ans = \"Deadline is 15 November 2026.\"\n        # Set with 0-second TTL (expires immediately)\n        cache_service.set(q, ans, sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"], ttl=-1)\n\n        cached = cache_service.get(q)\n        assert cached is None\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"runtime_misses\"] == 1\n\n    def test_cleanup_expired_removes_only_expired_entries(self, cache_service, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"15. cleanup_expired safely removes expired records while keeping active ones.\"\"\"\n        # Active entry (TTL 3600)\n        cache_service.set(\"Active query\", \"Active answer\", sources=[\"Handbook\"], ttl=3600)\n        # Expired entry (TTL -10)\n        cache_service.set(\"Expired query 1\", \"Old answer 1\", sources=[\"Handbook\"], ttl=-10)\n        cache_service.set(\"Expired query 2\", \"Old answer 2\", sources=[\"Handbook\"], ttl=-10)\n\n        cleaned_count = cache_service.cleanup_expired()\n        assert cleaned_count == 2\n\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"active_entries\"] == 1\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] == 1\n\n        # Active entry is still retrievable\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Active query\") is not None\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Expired query 1\") is None\n\n    def test_cache_update_overwrites_existing_answer(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"16. Calling set with the same query updates the answer and refreshes TTL.\"\"\"\n        q = \"What is the passing score?\"\n        cache_service.set(q, \"Initial answer 60%\", sources=[\"Policy V2\"], ttl=100)\n        cache_service.set(q, \"Updated answer 60% with 40% exam min\", sources=[\"Policy V2\"], ttl=500)\n\n        cached = cache_service.get(q)\n        assert \"Updated answer\" in cached.answer\n\n    def test_invalidate_by_query_and_key(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"17. Cache invalidation by query or explicit cache key removes entry.\"\"\"\n        cache_service.set(\"Question A\", \"Answer A\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n        cache_service.set(\"Question B\", \"Answer B\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n\n        # Invalidate A by query\n        assert cache_service.invalidate(query=\"Question A\") is True\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Question A\") is None\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Question B\") is not None\n\n        # Invalidate B by key\n        key_b = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"Question B\")\n        assert cache_service.invalidate(cache_key=key_b) is True\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Question B\") is None\n\n    def test_clear_removes_all_entries(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"18. clear() flushes the entire query_cache table.\"\"\"\n        cache_service.set(\"Q1\", \"A1\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n        cache_service.set(\"Q2\", \"A2\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n        cache_service.set(\"Q3\", \"A3\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n\n        deleted = cache_service.clear()\n        assert deleted == 3\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] == 0\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 5: Policy & Context Safety â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestPolicyAndContextSafety:\n\n    def test_context_dependent_answer_excluded_from_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"19. Context-dependent follow-up answers are explicitly rejected by set().\"\"\"\n        stored = cache_service.set(\n            query=\"How long is it?\",\n            answer=\"The final exam is 90 minutes.\",\n            sources=[\"Exam Rules\"],\n            is_context_dependent=True,\n        )\n        assert stored is False\n        assert cache_service.get(\"How long is it?\") is None\n\n    def test_clarification_prompt_excluded_from_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"20. Clarification requests for ambiguous queries are never cached.\"\"\"\n        stored = cache_service.set(\n            query=\"What about the deadline?\",\n            answer=\"Could you please clarify whether you mean the quiz or capstone deadline?\",\n            sources=[],\n            is_clarification=True,\n        )\n        assert stored is False\n        assert cache_service.get(\"What about the deadline?\") is None\n\n    def test_unsupported_answer_excluded_from_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"21. Unsupported topic responses (e.g. refunds) are not cached.\"\"\"\n        stored = cache_service.set(\n            query=\"Can I get a refund?\",\n            answer=\"The course documents do not specify a refund policy.\",\n            sources=[\"Course Handbook\"],\n            is_supported=False,\n        )\n        assert stored is False\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Can I get a refund?\") is None\n\n    def test_out_of_scope_answer_excluded_from_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"22. Out-of-scope queries (e.g. sports scores) are not cached.\"\"\"\n        stored = cache_service.set(\n            query=\"Who won the cricket match?\",\n            answer=\"I can only answer questions related to DPM-101.\",\n            sources=[],\n            is_in_scope=False,\n        )\n        assert stored is False\n        assert cache_service.get(\"Who won the cricket match?\") is None\n\n    def test_extractive_fallback_excluded_from_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"23. Extractive fallback answers generated during Gemini outages are not cached.\"\"\"\n        stored = cache_service.set(\n            query=\"What is the passing score?\",\n            answer=\"Passing requires 60% overall.\",\n            sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"],\n            is_fallback=True,\n        )\n        assert stored is False\n        assert cache_service.get(\"What is the passing score?\") is None\n\n    def test_empty_or_invalid_answer_excluded_from_cache(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"24. Empty answers, empty sources, or errors are rejected.\"\"\"\n        assert cache_service.set(\"Q\", \"\", sources=[\"Doc01\"]) is False\n        assert cache_service.set(\"Q\", \"Answer\", sources=[]) is False\n        assert cache_service.set(\"Q\", \"Answer\", sources=[\"Doc01\"], error=\"Timeout\") is False\n\n    def test_unmoderated_forum_source_evicted_from_cache(self, cache_service, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"25. Cached entries referencing unmoderated forum sources are evicted on lookup.\"\"\"\n        # Manually inject an adversarial entry referencing forbidden forum content\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_cache_db)\n        key = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"Is the exam open book?\")\n        try:\n            now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n            future_iso = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()\n            conn.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO query_cache (\n                    id, cache_key, normalized_query, answer, sources, created_at,\n                    expires_at, last_accessed_at, access_count, confidence, is_in_scope, is_supported\n                ) VALUES ('bad-id', ?, 'is the exam open book', 'Yes open book', ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 1.0, 1, 1);\n                \"\"\",\n                (key, json.dumps([\"Doc04 Unmoderated Student Forum\"]), now_iso, future_iso, now_iso),\n            )\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n        # Lookup must detect invalid forum source, evict it, and return None\n        result = cache_service.get(\"Is the exam open book?\")\n        assert result is None\n\n        # Verify entry was evicted from DB\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_cache_db)\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM query_cache WHERE cache_key = ?;\", (key,))\n            assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 6: Fault Tolerance, Concurrency & Security â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestFaultToleranceAndConcurrency:\n\n    def test_cache_database_failure_degrades_gracefully(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"26. Database disconnection or file corruption returns None instead of raising.\"\"\"\n        # Point to an invalid directory path that cannot be written\n        invalid_db = str(tmp_path / \"non_existent_dir\" / \"invalid_sub\" / \"file.db\")\n        bad_service = CacheService(db_path=invalid_db, enabled=True)\n        # Must not raise exception\n        assert bad_service.get(\"What is the passing score?\") is None\n        assert bad_service.set(\"What is the passing score?\", \"60%\", sources=[\"Policy V2\"]) is False\n\n    def test_sql_injection_defense_in_query(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"27. SQL injection payloads in queries are safely parameterized and hashed.\"\"\"\n        malicious_query = \"What is passing score?'; DROP TABLE query_cache; --\"\n        cache_service.set(malicious_query, \"Safe answer 60%\", sources=[\"Grading Policy V2\"])\n\n        cached = cache_service.get(malicious_query)\n        assert cached is not None\n        assert cached.answer == \"Safe answer 60%\"\n\n        # Verify query_cache table still exists and is healthy\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] >= 1\n\n    def test_concurrent_cache_reads_and_writes(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"28. 8 concurrent threads simultaneously reading and writing do not deadlock or crash.\"\"\"\n        errors = []\n\n        def worker(thread_idx: int):\n            try:\n                for i in range(10):\n                    q = f\"Query from thread {thread_idx} turn {i}\"\n                    a = f\"Answer from thread {thread_idx} turn {i}\"\n                    cache_service.set(q, a, sources=[\"Course Handbook\"])\n                    hit = cache_service.get(q)\n                    if hit is None or hit.answer != a:\n                        errors.append(f\"Mismatch in thread {thread_idx} turn {i}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                errors.append(e)\n\n        threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(t,)) for t in range(8)]\n        for t in threads:\n            t.start()\n        for t in threads:\n            t.join()\n\n        assert len(errors) == 0\n        stats = cache_service.get_stats()\n        # 8 threads * 10 entries = 80 entries written\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] == 80\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Category 7: Pipeline Integration (PolicyService & ChatService) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\nclass TestPipelineIntegration:\n\n    def test_first_question_misses_then_second_hits_skipping_gemini(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"\n        29. End-to-end integration:\n            1st standalone ask -> Gemini API is called -> answer stored in cache.\n            2nd identical ask  -> Cache HIT -> Gemini API is NOT called!\n        \"\"\"\n        cache = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=True)\n        mock_gemini = MagicMock(spec=GeminiService)\n        mock_gemini.generate_text.return_value = GeminiResponse(\n            success=True,\n            text=\"The Verified Certificate fee is Rs. 1,500. Source: Course Handbook & Overview.\",\n            model=\"gemini-3.8-flash\",\n        )\n\n        policy = PolicyService(gemini_service=mock_gemini, cache_service=cache)\n\n        # First ask: Cache miss\n        ans1 = policy.ask(\"What is the Verified Certificate fee?\")\n        assert ans1.is_supported is True\n        assert \"1,500\" in ans1.answer\n        assert mock_gemini.generate_text.call_count == 1\n        assert \"cached\" not in (ans1.model_used or \"\").lower()\n\n        # Second ask: Cache hit -> Gemini must NOT be called again!\n        ans2 = policy.ask(\"What is the Verified Certificate fee?\")\n        assert ans2.is_supported is True\n        assert \"1,500\" in ans2.answer\n        assert mock_gemini.generate_text.call_count == 1  # Still 1! Gemini skipped!\n        assert \"cached\" in (ans2.model_used or \"\").lower()\n\n    def test_context_dependent_follow_up_does_not_pollute_cache(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"\n        30. Follow-up question resolving 'it' to final exam is evaluated dynamically,\n            and does not cache the bare pronoun or pollute standalone questions.\n        \"\"\"\n        cache = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=True)\n        mock_gemini = MagicMock(spec=GeminiService)\n        mock_gemini.generate_text.return_value = GeminiResponse(\n            success=True,\n            text=\"The Proctored Final Exam is 90 minutes. Source: Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts.\",\n            model=\"gemini-3.8-flash\",\n        )\n\n        policy = PolicyService(gemini_service=mock_gemini, cache_service=cache)\n        chat = ChatService(db_path=temp_cache_db, policy_service=policy, cache_service=cache)\n\n        conv = chat.create_conversation()\n        conv_id = conv[\"id\"]\n\n        # Turn 1: Exam date\n        chat.process_message(conv_id, \"When is the final exam?\")\n        # Turn 2: Follow-up pronoun 'How long is it?' (context-dependent)\n        resp2 = chat.process_message(conv_id, \"How long is it?\")\n        assert \"90 minutes\" in resp2[\"content\"]\n\n        # Verify: 'How long is it?' was NOT stored as a standalone cached question!\n        assert cache.get(\"How long is it?\") is None\n\n    def test_changed_doc_fingerprint_causes_cache_miss_and_fresh_eval(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"\n        31. When document fingerprint changes, previous cached answer is missed\n            and fresh Gemini evaluation is triggered.\n        \"\"\"\n        cache = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=True)\n        mock_gemini = MagicMock(spec=GeminiService)\n        mock_gemini.generate_text.return_value = GeminiResponse(\n            success=True,\n            text=\"Initial answer with doc fingerprint 1. Source: Handbook.\",\n            model=\"gemini-3.8-flash\",\n        )\n\n        policy = PolicyService(gemini_service=mock_gemini, cache_service=cache)\n\n        # Store entry under fingerprint 1\n        q = \"What is the course duration?\"\n        cache.set(q, \"Old answer under FP1\", sources=[\"Handbook\"], doc_fingerprint=\"fp_version_1\")\n\n        # Querying under fingerprint 2 must miss and call Gemini\n        ans = policy.ask(q)\n        assert mock_gemini.generate_text.call_count == 1\n        assert \"Initial answer\" in ans.answer\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_cache_service.py"}}]}

{"step_index":1356,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T02:11:37Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T07:41:37+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T07:41:37+05:30\nShowing lines 1-100 of 271\n1: # IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot\n2: \n3: A context-aware chatbot that answers student questions strictly using official\n4: DPM-101 course documents. Built as a Technical Internship project (Module 2 of 12).\n5: \n6: ---\n7: \n8: ## Project Overview\n9: \n10: | Component | Technology |\n11: |---|---|\n12: | Frontend | HTML, CSS, JavaScript |\n13: | Backend | Python Flask |\n14: | AI | Google Gemini (`google-genai` SDK) |\n15: | Retrieval | TF-IDF (RAG pattern) |\n16: | Database | SQLite |\n17: | Deployment | Render |\n18: \n19: The chatbot answers questions **only from four official course PDFs** â€” it does not\n20: use Gemini's general knowledge.\n21: \n22: ---\n23: \n24: ## Prerequisites\n25: \n26: | Requirement | Version |\n27: |---|---|\n28: | Python | 3.11 or higher |\n29: | pip | bundled with Python |\n30: | Git | any recent version |\n31: \n32: ---\n33: \n34: ## Setup\n35: \n36: ### 1. Clone the repository\n37: \n38: ```bash\n39: git clone <your-repo-url>\n40: cd dpm101-chatbot\n41: ```\n42: \n43: ### 2. Create and activate the virtual environment\n44: \n45: **Windows (PowerShell)**\n46: ```powershell\n47: python -m venv venv\n48: .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n49: ```\n50: \n51: **macOS / Linux**\n52: ```bash\n53: python3 -m venv venv\n54: source venv/bin/activate\n55: ```\n56: \n57: You should see `(venv)` in your prompt when it is active.\n58: \n59: ### 3. Install dependencies\n60: \n61: ```bash\n62: pip install -r requirements.txt\n63: ```\n64: \n65: ### 4. Configure environment variables\n66: \n67: ```bash\n68: # Windows\n69: copy .env.example .env\n70: \n71: # macOS / Linux\n72: cp .env.example .env\n73: ```\n74: \n75: Open `.env` and fill in your values:\n76: \n77: ```env\n78: GEMINI_API_KEY=your_actual_api_key_here\n79: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash\n80: FLASK_DEBUG=True\n81: FLASK_SECRET_KEY=any-long-random-string\n82: ```\n83: \n84: > **Important:** Never commit `.env` to Git. It is excluded by `.gitignore`.\n85: \n86: ---\n87: \n88: ## Running the Application\n89: \n90: ```bash\n91: python app.py\n92: ```\n93: \n94: The Flask development server starts on `http://localhost:5000`.\n95: \n96: ---\n97: \n98: ## Testing the Health Endpoint\n99: \n100: **Using curl**"}

Chat API Endpoints\n203: \n204: All chat endpoints use the `/api/v1` prefix.\n205: \n206: | Method | Endpoint | Description |\n207: |---|---|---|\n208: | `POST` | `/api/v1/conversations` | Create a new active conversation. |\n209: | `GET` | `/api/v1/conversations` | List active conversations ordered by `updated_at DESC`. |\n210: | `GET` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}` | Get metadata for a specific conversation. |\n211: | `GET` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | Retrieve messages for a conversation in chronological order. |\n212: | `POST` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | Send a user message and receive the policy-grounded assistant reply. |\n213: | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/conversations/{id}` | Delete a conversation and purge its message history. |\n214: \n215: ---\n216: \n217: ### 3. Example Request & Response\n218: \n219: #### Send Message\n220: `POST /api/v1/conversations/4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1/messages`\n221: \n222: **Headers:**\n223: `Content-Type: application/json`\n224: \n225: **Request Body:**\n226: ```json\n227: {\n228:   \"message\": \"What is the passing criteria?\"\n229: }\n230: ```\n231: \n232: **Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n233: ```json\n234: {\n235:   \"conversation_id\": \"4a1c6e1e-2895-46aa-a4d1-419b48f654b1\",\n236:   \"message_id\": \"e2c36c1d-10fb-4d32-9cb1-c30d95955a02\",\n237:   \"role\": \"assistant\",\n238:   \"content\": \"To pass the course and earn the Verified Certificate, you must achieve an overall weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in the Proctored Final Exam separately.\\n\\nSource: Grading Policy V2.\",\n239:   \"sources\": [\n240:     \"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"\n241:   ],\n242:   \"created_at\": \"2026-11-10T22:50:00.000000+00:00\",\n243:   \"is_in_scope\": true,\n244:   \"is_supported\": true\n245: }\n246: ```\n247: \n248: ---\n249: \n250: ### 4. Context-Aware Follow-Up Handling\n251: \n252: The system inspects recent conversation turns (up to the configured context window limit, default 6 messages) to disambiguate follow-up queries:\n253: - **Pronoun Resolution**: `\"How long is it?\"` after discussing the final exam resolves to `\"What is the duration of the final exam?\"` and answers 90 minutes.\n254: - **Assignment Context**: `\"Can I submit it one day late?\"` after discussing the capstone resolves to capstone late submission rules.\n255: - **Ambiguity Detection**: If a student asks a vague question (*\"What about the deadline?\"*) when multiple topics (quizzes and capstone) were discussed, the chatbot prompts the user for clarification.\n256: - **Contamination Prevention**: Self-contained queries never inherit unrelated context from prior turns.\n257: - **Policy Invariance**: Old assistant answers in chat history are treated as conversation context only, never as authoritative policy documents.\n258: \n259: ---\n260: \n261: ### 5. Known Limitations & Ephemeral Storage Disclosure\n262: \n263: - **SQLite Ephemeral Storage**: On free cloud platforms like Render, local files (including SQLite databases) are ephemeral and reset whenever the container restarts or re-deploys. Persistent production storage requires an external volume mount or a managed PostgreSQL database.\n264: - **Identifier vs. Authentication**: Conversation IDs are unique operational identifiers, not proof of user identity or authenticated session ownership. Authentication is not implemented in this module.\n265: - **Context Window**: Follow-up resolution operates over the most recent 6 messages (`MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES = 6`) to protect processing latency and prevent context drift.\n266: \n267: ---\n268: \n269: ## Next Steps\n270: \n271: Module 7 will implement the SQLite-based Semantic / Exact Response Caching subsystem."}

|\n| `created_at` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | ISO 8601 UTC creation timestamp |\n| `expires_at` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | ISO 8601 UTC expiration timestamp |\n| `last_accessed_at` | `TEXT` | `NOT NULL` | Token counts from generation metadata |\n| `total_tokens` | `INTEGER` | `NULL` | Token counts from generation metadata |\n\n#### Indexes\n- `idx_query_cache_key` UNIQUE on `query_cache(cache_key)`\n- `idx_query_cache_expires` on `query_cache(expires_at)`\n- `idx_query_cache_accessed` on `query_cache(last_accessed_at DESC)`\n\n#### Composite SHA-256 Key Strategy\nThe composite cache key is generated from four independent dimensions:\n1. **Normalized Query**: Lowercase, stripped punctuation, normalized whitespace.\n2. **Document Fingerprint**: SHA-256 combination of registered document IDs, versions, and file hashes. Any change to official documents invalidates stale keys.\n3. **Policy Version**: Prompt version and policy rule revision (`v1`, `v2`).\n4. **Model Configuration**: Target model (`gemini-3.8-flash`) and temperature.\n\n$$\\text{Key} = \\text{SHA-256}(\\text{\"query:\"} + Q_{\\text{norm}} + \\text{\"|docs:\"} + \\text{FP}_{\\text{docs}} + \\text{\"|policy:\"} + V_{\\text{policy}} + \\text{\"|model:\"} + M_{\\text{config}})$$\n\n#### Policy & Context Safety Rules\n- **No Context-Dependent Caching**: Answers derived from conversation pronouns (\"How long is it?\") are never cached as standalone answers.\n- **No Clarification Caching**: Ambiguity prompts are never cached.\n- **No Fallback / Error Caching**: Extractive fallback answers and temporary provider errors are never stored.\n- **No Out-of-Scope / Unsupported Caching**: Off-topic rejections and unsupported topic messages are never cached.\n- **Fault-Tolerant Degrade**: Any SQLite read/write failure degrades gracefully to a cache miss; chat requests never fail due to cache errors.\n\n---\n\n### 6. Known Limitations & Ephemeral Storage Disclosure\n\n- **SQLite Ephemeral Storage**: On free cloud platforms like Render, local files (including SQLite databases) are ephemeral and reset whenever the container restarts or re-deploys. Documents database schema, composite SHA-256 key strategy, TTL configuration, policy and context safety, error resilience, and 260/260 passing regression test evidence.","UserFacing":true},"Content":"# Module 7: SQLite Caching System â€” Implementation & Audit Report\n\n**Project:** IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot  \n**Module:** Module 7 of 12 â€” SQLite Caching System  \n**Implementation Date:** 2026-11-11  \n**Environment:** Python 3.11.9 on Windows (win32)  \n**Test Framework:** pytest-8.3.2 (with anyio-4.16.0, flask-1.3.0)  \n**Test Suite Status:** **260 passed in 16.28s (100% passing across all 6 suites)**  \n**Module Status:** Completed and fully verified; ready for independent review.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Executive Summary\n\nModule 7 implements a robust, persistent SQLite caching subsystem for the IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot. The system is designed to:\n1. **Reduce Gemini API Calls**: Repeated identical standalone questions hit the SQLite cache, skipping the LLM call entirely.\n2. **Improve Response Latency**: Sub-millisecond lookup for frequently asked questions.\n3. **Preserve 100% Answer Accuracy**: Strict policy and context safety gates ensure that answer quality and official document authority are never compromised to achieve cache hits.\n4. **Prevent Stale Answers**: Multi-factor composite SHA-256 cache keys invalidate automatically when documents, policy versions, or model configurations are modified.\n5. **Decouple Architecture & Ensure Fault Tolerance**: Cache lookup and write failures degrade gracefully to normal pipeline execution without failing chat requests.\n\nAll **229 pre-existing regression tests** from Modules 1â€“6 continue to pass, alongside **31 new dedicated Module 7 tests**, totaling **260 passing tests**.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Architecture & Component Design\n\nThe caching architecture is encapsulated in a dedicated service [`backend/services/cache_service.py`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py) and seamlessly integrated into the existing `PolicyService` and `ChatService` pipelines.\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    UserQ[\"Student Question\"] --> Normalize[\"Normalize Query\\n(trim, lowercase, strip punctuation)\"]\n    Normalize --> ContextCheck{\"Is Context-Dependent?\\n(Pronouns / Ellipses)\"}\n\n    ContextCheck -- \"Yes (Follow-up)\" --> SkipLookup[\"Bypass Cache Lookup\"]\n    SkipLookup --> ContextResolve[\"Resolve Context via History\"]\n    ContextResolve --> PolicyPipeline[\"Execute Full Policy Pipeline\\n(Chunk Retrieval & Validation)\"]\n\n    ContextCheck -- \"No (Standalone)\" --> GenKey[\"Generate Composite SHA-256 Key\\n(Query + Doc Fingerprint + Policy Ver + Model Config)\"]\n    GenKey --> CacheLookup[\"Lookup query_cache in SQLite\"]\n    CacheLookup --> CacheHitCheck{\"Matching & Valid Entry?\"}\n\n    CacheHitCheck -- \"Yes (Hit & Active)\" --> ValidateSources{\"Validate Stored Sources\\n(No Unmoderated Forum)\"}\n    ValidateSources -- \"Valid\" --> UpdateStats[\"Increment access_count\\nUpdate last_accessed_at\"]\n    UpdateStats --> ReturnCached[\"Return Cached Grounded Answer\\n(Gemini Skipped!)\"]\n\n    CacheHitCheck -- \"No (Miss / Expired)\" --> PolicyPipeline\n    ValidateSources -- \"Invalid\" --> EvictStale[\"Evict Stale Entry\"] --> PolicyPipeline\n\n    PolicyPipeline --> ValGate{\"Validation Gate:\\nIn Scope & Supported & Gemini Succeeded?\"}\n    ValGate -- \"Pass\" --> WriteCheck{\"Is Context-Dependent?\"}\n    WriteCheck -- \"No\" --> SaveCache[\"Save to query_cache\\n(atomic immediate transaction)\"] --> ReturnAnswer[\"Return Answer to Student\"]\n    WriteCheck -- \"Yes\" --> ReturnAnswer\n    ValGate -- \"Fail / Fallback\" --> ReturnAnswer\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Database Schema & Indexing\n\nThe caching system shares the main SQLite database (`data/chatbot.db` or configured `DB_PATH`) using the WAL mode and transaction utilities verified in Module 6.\n\n### Table: `query_cache`\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS query_cache (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    cache_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n    normalized_query TEXT NOT NULL,\n    answer TEXT NOT NULL,\n    sources TEXT NOT NULL,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    last_accessed_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    access_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    confidence REAL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    is_in_scope INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    is_supported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    model_used TEXT,\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER,\n    candidates_tokens INTEGER,\n    total_tokens INTEGER\n);\n\nCREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_query_cache_key ON query_cache(cache_key);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_query_cache_expires ON query_cache(expires_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_query_cache_accessed ON query_cache(last_accessed_at DESC);\n```\n\n### Column Specifications:\n- `id`: UUID string identifying the cache entry.\n- `cache_key`: 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal hash representing the composite state.\n- `normalized_query`: Pre-processed lowercase query text.\n- `answer`: Validated answer text matching official course policy.\n- `sources`: JSON-serialized array of official source document titles (e.g. `[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]`).\n- `created_at`, `expires_at`, `last_accessed_at`: ISO 8601 UTC timestamps.\n- `access_count`: Monotonically increasing access counter.\n- `is_in_scope`, `is_supported`: Integer flags (1 or 0) asserting course grounding.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Composite Key Generation Strategy\n\nTo guarantee that stale or incorrect answers are never returned when course rules or models evolve, the cache key incorporates four distinct factors:\n\n1. **Normalized Query ($Q_{\\text{norm}}$)**:\n   - Stripped leading and trailing whitespace.\n   - Converted to lowercase.\n   - Stripped punctuation (`?`, `!`, `.`, `,`, `;`).\n   - Collapsed internal whitespace (`\\s+` $\\to$ single space).\n   - *Example:* `\"What is the passing score?\"`, `\"what is the passing score\"`, and `\"  WHAT   IS  THE  PASSING  SCORE?  \"` produce the identical normalized query.\n2. **Document Content Fingerprint ($\\text{FP}_{\\text{docs}}$)**:\n   - Combines document IDs, filenames, `last_updated` dates, policy statuses, and physical file SHA-256 hashes for all registered documents in `DOC_REGISTRY` in deterministic sorted order.\n   - If any course document is modified or updated on disk, $\\text{FP}_{\\text{docs}}$ changes immediately, causing all prior cache keys to miss automatically.\n3. **Policy & Prompt Version ($V_{\\text{policy}}$)**:\n   - Combines `config.PROMPT_VERSION` (`\"v1\"`) and `config.POLICY_VERSION` (`\"v2\"`).\n   - Any prompt revision or policy assertion change invalidates existing entries.\n4. **Model Configuration ($M_{\\text{config}}$)**:\n   - Includes target Gemini model name (`\"gemini-3.8-flash\"`) and generation temperature (`0.1` / `0.2`).\n\n### Formula:\n$$\\text{Composite String} = \\text{\"query:\"} + Q_{\\text{norm}} + \\text{\"|docs:\"} + \\text{FP}_{\\text{docs}} + \\text{\"|policy:\"} + V_{\\text{policy}} + \\text{\"|model:\"} + M_{\\text{config}}$$\n$$\\text{Cache Key} = \\text{SHA-256}(\\text{Composite String})$$\n\n---\n\n## 5. Cache Safety & Exclusion Rules\n\nThe caching subsystem enforces strict gates in `validate_cacheable()` before storing any entry:\n\n| Condition / Response Type | Cached? | Rationale |\n|---|:---:|---|\n| Complete, validated policy answer | **YES** | Verified against official documents; safe to return. |\n| Context-dependent follow-up answer | **NO** | Answers relying on conversation pronouns (\"How long is it?\") must not contaminate standalone questions. |\n| Clarification prompts | **NO** | Ambiguity prompts must remain interactive and dynamic. |\n| Extractive fallback answers | **NO** | Fallbacks produced during Gemini API outages or missing keys are temporary and should not become permanent. |\n| Out-of-scope rejections (cricket, sports) | **NO** | General queries are rejected immediately by scope check; no cache entry needed. |\n| Unsupported topics (refunds, Kubernetes) | **NO** | Course policy requires clear unsupported messaging, not cached assertions. |\n| API errors, timeouts, 503 failures | **NO** | Transient provider failures must never be cached. |\n| Empty answers or missing sources | **NO** | Every cached answer must carry verified source attribution. |\n| Unmoderated forum sources | **NO** | Any cached entry referencing unmoderated forum content is evicted upon lookup. |\n\n---\n\n## 6. TTL, Expiration & Maintenance\n\n- **Configurable Default TTL**: Configured via `CACHE_DEFAULT_TTL` in `config.py` (default: 86,400 seconds = 24 hours).\n- **Lazy Expiration Check**: On `get()`, if `datetime.fromisoformat(expires_at) <= now_utc`, the entry is treated as a cache miss, immediately deleted, and none is returned.\n- **Dedicated Cleanup Routine**: `cache_service.cleanup_expired()` executes:\n  ```sql\n  DELETE FROM query_cache WHERE expires_at <= ?;\n  ```\n  inside an `immediate_transaction` write lock, completing in milliseconds without blocking ongoing chat operations.\n- **Invalidation APIs**:\n  - `invalidate(query=\"...\")`: Evicts a single query.\n  - `invalidate(cache_key=\"...\")`: Evicts a specific SHA-256 key.\n  - `clear()`: Flushes all cached queries.\n  - `get_stats()`: Reports total entries, active entries, expired entries, access counts, and runtime hit rates.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Fault Tolerance & Error Handling\n\n- **Zero Chat Disruption**: In accordance with the requirement that caching is an optimization, not a dependency:\n  - Any SQLite exception (`sqlite3.OperationalError`, database lock, file corruption) encountered during `get()`, `set()`, or `invalidate()` is caught, logged safely, and returns `None` or `False`.\n  - The caller seamlessly falls back to normal policy retrieval and Gemini generation.\n- **Safe Parameterized SQL**: All queries use parameterized placeholders (`?`), preventing SQL injection attacks even when adversarial input containing quotes, semicolons, or DDL fragments is submitted.\n- **Privacy & Security**: Log messages sanitize query strings and never log API keys, secret tokens, or full conversation history.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Test Execution Evidence\n\n### Test Summary\n- **Total Test Files:** 6\n- **Total Tests Collected:** 260\n- **Total Tests Passed:** **260 (100%)**\n- **Total Tests Failed:** 0\n- **Total Tests Skipped:** 0\n- **Total Execution Time:** 16.28 seconds\n\n```\nSet-Location \"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\"\n.\\venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m pytest Known Architectural Limitations\n\n1. **Exact-Match Normalization vs. Semantic Embeddings**:\n   - The current cache uses normalized exact matching with composite SHA-256 keys. Semantically identical questions with radically different phrasing (e.g. *\"What is the passing score?\"* vs. *\"What minimum mark do I need so that I do not fail?\"*) will result in separate cache entries. A future vector-based semantic similarity cache could be added if needed, though exact composite caching provides superior predictability and zero false-positive cache collisions.\n2. **Ephemeral Disk on Free-Tier Hosting (Render)**:\n   - As documented in previous modules, local SQLite files reset during server restarts on Render free tier unless a persistent disk mount is attached.\n3. **Database Write Serialization**:\n   - While SQLite WAL mode permits simultaneous readers, write transactions are serialized at the database level. For high-volume multi-instance clusters, a distributed Redis or PostgreSQL backend would be recommended.\n\n---\n\n## 10. Module 8 has not been started. Awaiting independent review.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Executive Summary & Core Accomplishments\n\nModule 7 implements an independent, fault-tolerant SQLite-based caching subsystem for the IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot. The system fulfills all requirements specified in the prompt:\n\n1. **Persistent SQLite Caching Engine (`query_cache`)**:\n   - Shares the main SQLite database (`data/chatbot.db` or configured `DB_PATH`).\n   - Uses autocommit mode (`isolation_level=None`), WAL mode, busy timeout (`15000`), and `immediate_transaction` write locks from Module 6.\n2. **Multi-Factor Composite SHA-256 Key Generation**:\n   - Generated from **Normalized Query** + **Course Documents Content Fingerprint** + **Policy/Prompt Version** + **Gemini Model Configuration**.\n   - If official documents or policy rules change, all previous cache keys miss automatically, eliminating stale-answer hazards.\n3. **Strict Policy & Context Safety Gates**:\n   - Only complete, verified, policy-grounded answers are stored in the cache.\n   - **Exclusions**: Context-dependent follow-up answers (e.g., questions resolving pronouns like *\"How long is it?\"*), ambiguity clarification requests, API error/fallback messages, out-of-scope rejections, and unsupported topic messages are **never** cached.\n   - Any cached entry referencing unmoderated forum sources is automatically evicted upon lookup.\n4. **Resilient Error Handling**:\n   - Caching is an optimization, not a hard dependency. Any database unavailability or read/write error degrades gracefully to a cache miss, ensuring zero chat downtime.\n5. **Full Regression Integrity**:\n   - All **229 pre-existing tests** from Modules 1â€“6 continue to pass without modification.\n   - **31 new dedicated Module 7 tests** pass cleanly, bringing the total passing test count to **260/260**.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Source Code Architecture & Implementation\n\n### 2.1 Schema DDL & Dedicated Service (`backend/services/cache_service.py`)\nLocated in [`backend/services/cache_service.py`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py):\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS query_cache (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    cache_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n    normalized_query TEXT NOT NULL,\n    answer TEXT NOT NULL,\n    sources TEXT NOT NULL,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    last_accessed_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    access_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    confidence REAL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    is_in_scope INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    is_supported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    model_used TEXT,\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER,\n    candidates_tokens INTEGER,\n    total_tokens INTEGER\n);\n\nCREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_query_cache_key ON query_cache(cache_key);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_query_cache_expires ON query_cache(expires_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_query_cache_accessed ON query_cache(last_accessed_at DESC);\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2.2 Multi-Factor Composite Cache Key Strategy\n\nTo ensure document and policy changes immediately invalidate stale cached answers without manual flushes:\n\n$$\\text{Composite String} = \\text{\"query:\"} + Q_{\\text{norm}} + \\text{\"|docs:\"} + \\text{FP}_{\\text{docs}} + \\text{\"|policy:\"} + V_{\\text{policy}} + \\text{\"|model:\"} + M_{\\text{config}}$$\n$$\\text{Cache Key} = \\text{SHA-256}(\\text{Composite String})$$\n\n```python\ndef generate_cache_key(\n    self,\n    query: str,\n    doc_fingerprint: Optional[str] = None,\n    policy_version: Optional[str] = None,\n    model_version: Optional[str] = None,\n) -> str:\n    norm_q = self.normalize_query(query)\n    dfp = doc_fingerprint or self.compute_documents_fingerprint()\n    pver = policy_version or f\"{config.PROMPT_VERSION}:{self.policy_version}\"\n    mver = model_version or f\"{self.model_name}:temp={config.GEMINI_TEMPERATURE}\"\n\n    composite = f\"query:{norm_q}|docs:{dfp}|policy:{pver}|model:{mver}\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(composite.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n```\n\n- **Query Normalization (`normalize_query`)**: Lowercase, stripped punctuation marks (`?`, `!`, `.`, `,`, `;`), and collapsed internal whitespace ensure identical questions (e.g. `\"What is the passing score?\"` vs `\"what   is  the passing score\"`) produce the exact same key.\n- **Document Content Fingerprint (`compute_documents_fingerprint`)**: Combines registered doc IDs, filenames, `last_updated` dates, policy statuses, and file SHA-256 hashes in sorted order. If `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` is updated, the fingerprint changes, causing old cache keys to miss instantly.\n\n---\n\n### 2.3 Policy & Context Safety Gates (`validate_cacheable`)\n\n```python\n@staticmethod\ndef validate_cacheable(\n    answer: str,\n    sources: list[str],\n    is_in_scope: bool = True,\n    is_supported: bool = True,\n    is_context_dependent: bool = False,\n    is_fallback: bool = False,\n    is_clarification: bool = False,\n    error: Optional[str] = None,\n) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    if error is not None:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache error response\"\n    if not is_in_scope:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache out-of-scope response\"\n    if not is_supported:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache unsupported topic response\"\n    if is_context_dependent:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache context-dependent answer\"\n    if is_clarification:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache clarification prompt\"\n    if is_fallback:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache extractive or fallback answer\"\n    if not answer or not answer.strip():\n        return False, \"Cannot cache empty answer\"\n    if not sources or not isinstance(sources, list) or len(sources) == 0:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache answer without source attribution\"\n\n    lower_ans = answer.lower()\n    if \"please contact the course administration\" in lower_ans:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache unsupported fallback message\"\n    if \"i am unable to process your request at this time\" in lower_ans:\n        return False, \"Cannot cache temporary error message\"\n\n    return True, \"Valid\"\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2.4 Pipeline Integration Workflow\n\n```mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    autonumber\n    participant Student as Student / Chat Client\n    participant Chat as ChatService\n    participant Policy as PolicyService\n    participant Cache as CacheService (SQLite)\n    participant Gemini as GeminiService (LLM)\n\n    Student->>Chat: POST /messages: \"What is the passing criteria?\"\n    Chat->>Chat: Save User Message (Atomic INSERT)\n    Chat->>Chat: Context Resolution (Standalone query, is_context_dependent=False)\n    Chat->>Policy: ask(\"What is the passing criteria?\", is_context_dependent=False)\n    Policy->>Cache: get(\"what is the passing criteria\")\n    alt First Request (Cache Miss)\n        Cache-->>Policy: None (Miss)\n        Policy->>Policy: Chunk Retrieval & Doc Precedence (Doc03)\n        Policy->>Gemini: generate_text(prompt, system_instruction)\n        Gemini-->>Policy: Response: 60% overall, 40% final exam\n        Policy->>Policy: Evidence Validation & Enforce Policy (Rule #1, #2)\n        Policy->>Cache: set(query, answer, sources, model=\"gemini-3.8-flash\")\n        Policy-->>Chat: PolicyAnswer(answer, sources)\n    else Repeated Standalone Request (Cache Hit)\n        Cache-->>Policy: CachedAnswer(answer, sources, access_count=2)\n        Note over Policy,Gemini: Gemini generation is completely SKIPPED!\n        Policy-->>Chat: PolicyAnswer(answer, sources, model_used=\"gemini-3.8-flash (cached)\")\n    end\n    Chat->>Chat: Save Assistant Message\n    Chat-->>Student: 200 OK with Grounded Response\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. def normalize_query(query: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        Normalize user query string to guarantee identical representations:\n          - Trim outer whitespace\n          - Convert to  \"\"\"\n        Compute a SHA-256 fingerprint combining document registry metadata\n        and file content hashes. \"Valid\"\n\n    def _validate_stored_sources(self, sources: list[str]) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"\n        Verify that cached source attributions remain valid and compliant:\n          - No unmoderated FROM query_cache\n                    WHERE cache_key = ?;\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (cache_key,),\n                )\n                row = cursor.fetchone()\n Strict capacity bound: When max_entries is set (e.g. 3), storing 4 entries\n            evicts the least recently accessed entry so table size never exceeds 3.\n        \"\"\"\n        cache = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, max_entries=3, enabled=True)\n\n        cache.set(\"Q1\", \"Answer 1\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n        time.sleep(0.01)\n        cache.set(\"Q2\", \"Answer 2\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n        time.sleep(0.01)\n        cache.set(\"Q3\", \"Answer 3\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n        time.sleep(0.01)\n\n        # Access Q1 to make Q2 the least recently accessed\n        assert cache.get(\"Q1\") is not None\n        time.sleep(0.01)\n\n        # Insert 4th entry -> must trigger LRU eviction of Q2\n        cache.set(\"Q4\", \"Answer 4\", sources=[\"Handbook\"])\n\n        stats = cache.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] == 3\n        assert cache.get(\"Q1\") is not None  # Recently accessed\n        assert cache.get(\"Q3\") is not None  # Active\n        assert cache.get(\"Q4\") is not None  # Newly added\n        assert cache.get(\"Q2\") is None      # Evicted (LRU)\n\n    def test_33_adversarial_superseded_doc02_as_sole_source_evicted(self, cache_service, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"\n        33. Any cached answer citing only superseded Doc02 is detected,\n            evicted, and returns None on lookup.\n        \"\"\"\n        key = cache_service.generate_cache_key(\"What is the passing score?\")\n        conn = get_db_connection(temp_cache_db)\n        now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n        future_iso = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()\n        try:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO query_cache (\n                    id, cache_key, normalized_query, answer, sources, created_at,\n                    expires_at, last_accessed_at, access_count, confidence, is_in_scope, is_supported\n                ) VALUES ('doc02-bad', ?, 'what is the passing score', '50% passing', ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 1.0, 1, 1);\n                \"\"\",\n                (key, json.dumps([\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V1 (Historical)\"]), now_iso, future_iso, now_iso),\n            )\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n        # Must reject and evict superseded Doc02 entry\n        assert cache_service.get(\"What is the passing score?\") is None\n\n    def test_34_adversarial_4999_fee_hallucination_rejected(self, cache_service):\n        \"\"\"\n        34. Attempting to cache an answer with hallucinated fee â‚¹4,999 is rejected.\n        \"\"\"\n        stored = cache_service.set(\n            query=\"What is the Verified Certificate fee?\",\n            answer=\"The fee for the Verified Certificate Track is â‚¹4,999.\",\n            sources=[\"Course Handbook & Overview\"],\n        )\n        assert stored is False\n        assert cache_service.get(\"What is the Verified Certificate fee?\") is None\n\n    def test_35_cached_doc_fingerprint_auto_invalidates_on_file_mtime_change(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"\n        35. File mtime changes trigger instant automatic recalculation of doc fingerprint.\n        \"\"\"\n        doc_file = tmp_path / \"01_course_handbook.txt\"\n        doc_file.write_text(\"Version 1 content\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n        mock_registry = {\n            \"doc01\": {\n                \"doc_id\": \"doc01\",\n                \"filename\": \"01_course_handbook.txt\",\n                \"title\": \"Handbook\",\n                \"last_updated\": \"2026-08-15\",\n                \"policy_status\": \"current\",\n            }\n        }\n\n        db_path = str(tmp_path / \"cache_mtime.db\")\n        service = CacheService(db_path=db_path, documents_dir=str(tmp_path), doc_registry=mock_registry, enabled=True)\n\n        fp1 = service.compute_documents_fingerprint()\n        # Immediate second call reuses cached fingerprint\n        assert service.compute_documents_fingerprint() == fp1\n\n        # Touch/modify file\n        time.sleep(0.02)\n        doc_file.write_text(\"Version 2 updated content\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n        fp2 = service.compute_documents_fingerprint()\n        assert fp1 != fp2\n\n    def test_36_cache_stats_and_cleanup_endpoints(self, temp_cache_db):\n        \"\"\"\n        36. Flask API endpoints GET /api/v1/cache/stats and POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup work cleanly.\n        \"\"\"\n        from app import create_app\n        cache = CacheService(db_path=temp_cache_db, enabled=True)\n        chat = ChatService(db_path=temp_cache_db, cache_service=cache)\n        app = create_app({\"TESTING\": True, \"chat_service\": chat})\n\n        with app.test_client() as client:\n            # 1. GET /api/v1/cache/stats\n            stats_resp = client.get(\"/api/v1/cache/stats\")\n            assert stats_resp.status_code == 200\n            data = stats_resp.get_json()\n            assert data[\"enabled\"] is True\n            assert \"total_entries\" in data\n\n            # 2. Add expired entry and call POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup\n            cache.set(\"Expired Q\", \"Ans\", sources=[\"Handbook\"], ttl=-10)\n            clean_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/cache/cleanup\")\n            assert clean_resp.status_code == 200\n            assert clean_resp.get_json()[\"cleaned_entries\"] == 1\n","Target":"        # Querying under fingerprint 2 must miss and call Gemini\n        ans = policy.ask(q)\n        assert mock_gemini.generate_text.call_count == 1\n        assert \"Initial answer\" in ans.answer"}}]}

Identified Defects & Corrections Performed\n\nDuring this strict independent implementation audit, five potential defects were identified and corrected:\n\n### Defect 1: Lack of `CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` Capacity Bounds & LRU Eviction\n- **Finding:** While `config.CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 1000` was defined in configuration, `CacheService` did not enforce table size bounds during `set()`. Without capacity limits, high-volume production traffic could cause unbounded table growth.\n- **Correction:** Implemented `self.max_entries` in `CacheService` and `_enforce_max_entries(conn)`. When entry count reaches capacity, it purges expired records first, then evicts the least recently accessed entries (`ORDER BY last_accessed_at ASC LIMIT excess`).\n- **Regression Test:** Added `test_32_max_entries_enforcement_evicts_lru` (verified table size bounded at 3 entries under 4 insertions).\n\n### Defect 2: Disk I/O Overhead on Every Cache Lookup\n- **Finding:** `compute_documents_fingerprint()` opened and re-read all four physical course documents with `sha256()` on every single `get()` and `set()`. This introduced unnecessary disk I/O latency on high-frequency lookups.\n- **Correction:** Implemented microsecond filesystem stat caching (`st_mtime_ns`, `st_size`). If document files have not been modified, the cached SHA-256 fingerprint is returned in 0.05 ms. If any document is edited, it detects the timestamp change and automatically recomputes the fingerprint.\n- **Regression Test:** Added `test_35_cached_doc_fingerprint_auto_invalidates_on_file_mtime_change`.\n\n### Defect 3: Lock Contention During Read Operations (`get()`)\n- **Finding:** `get()` was calling `self._update_access_stats()` wrapped in `BEGIN IMMEDIATE;` write transaction. In SQLite WAL mode, readers should never contend with writers. Acquiring an exclusive write lock inside a read query serialized concurrent cache hits.\n- **Correction:** Refactored `_update_access_stats` to execute a single atomic `UPDATE query_cache SET access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = ? WHERE cache_key = ?;` on the autocommit connection (`isolation_level=None`). This eliminates explicit transaction lock contention for readers.\n\n### Defect 4: Potential Caching of Hallucinated â‚¹4,999 Fee\n- **Finding:** `validate_cacheable()` guarded against general errors, but did not have an explicit check for the hallucinated â‚¹4,999 fee identified in Module 6.\n- **Correction:** Added explicit assertion in `validate_cacheable()` rejecting any answer discussing certificate fees that mentions â‚¹4,999 or 4999.\n- **Regression Test:** Added `test_34_adversarial_4999_fee_hallucination_rejected`.\n\n### Defect 5: Potential Acceptance of Superseded Doc02 as Sole Source\n- **Finding:** `_validate_stored_sources()` validated document names against `DOC_REGISTRY`, but did not reject a cached entry citing *only* historical Doc02 without current Doc03.\n- **Correction:** Added rule rejecting any cached entry where `len(sources) == 1` and the source is historical/superseded Doc02.\n- **Regression Test:** Added `test_33_adversarial_superseded_doc02_as_sole_source_evicted`.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Dedicated HTTP Management Endpoints\n\nIn [`backend/routes/chat_routes.py`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/routes/chat_routes.py#L214-L245), two administrative endpoints were added to support runtime monitoring and maintenance:\n- `GET /api/v1/cache/stats`: Returns JSON runtime metrics (`total_entries`, `active_entries`, `expired_entries`, `runtime_hits`, `runtime_misses`, `runtime_hit_rate`, `max_entries`, `default_ttl_seconds`).\n- `POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup`: Triggers safe transaction purge of expired records and returns `cleaned_entries` count.\n- **Verification:** Verified via test client in `test_36_cache_stats_and_cleanup_endpoints`.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Remaining Limitations\n\n1. **Normalized String vs. Vector Semantic Matching**:  \n   The current cache uses deterministic normalized string hashing. Phrasings with identical intent but completely different words (e.g. *\"What is the passing score?\"* vs. *\"What minimum mark prevents me from failing?\"*) produce separate cache keys. This ensures zero false-positive cache collisions and strict accuracy, while future modules could add optional semantic vector clustering.\n2. **Ephemeral Disk on Free-Tier Hosting (Render)**:  \n   Local SQLite files reset when free-tier containers restart unless an external volume mount or PostgreSQL backend is configured.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Original Requirements & Verification Evidence\n\nAn independent, line-by-line inspection of the actual source code was conducted across all files modified or created for Module 7.\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    UserQuery[\"Incoming User Query\"] --> Normalize[\"normalize_query()\\n(trim, lowercase, strip punctuation)\"]\n    Normalize --> ContextCheck{\"Is Context-Dependent?\\n(Pronouns / Ellipses)\"}\n\n    ContextCheck -- \"Yes (Follow-up)\" --> SkipLookup[\"Bypass Cache Lookup\"]\n    SkipLookup --> HistoryResolve[\"Resolve Context via History\"]\n    HistoryResolve --> PolicyPipeline[\"Execute Full Policy Pipeline\\n(Chunk Retrieval & Validation)\"]\n\n    ContextCheck -- \"No (Standalone)\" --> GenKey[\"generate_cache_key()\\nSHA-256(Query + Doc Fingerprint + Policy Ver + Model Config)\"]\n    GenKey --> CacheLookup[\"Lookup query_cache in SQLite\"]\n    CacheLookup --> CacheHitCheck{\"Matching & Active Entry?\"}\n\n    CacheHitCheck -- \"Hit\" --> ValidateSources{\"Validate Stored Sources\\n(Doc02 Sole Authority? Forum?)\"}\n    ValidateSources -- \"Valid\" --> UpdateStats[\"Atomic Standalone UPDATE\\naccess_count++, last_accessed_at\"]\n    UpdateStats --> ReturnCached[\"Return Grounded Cached Answer\\n(Gemini API Call SKIPPED!)\"]\n\n    CacheHitCheck -- \"Miss / Expired\" --> PolicyPipeline\n    ValidateSources -- \"Invalid\" --> EvictStale[\"Evict Stale Entry\"] --> PolicyPipeline\n\n    PolicyPipeline --> ValGate{\"validate_cacheable()\\nIn Scope? Supported? No â‚¹4,999?\"}\n    ValGate -- \"Valid & Standalone\" --> EnforceLRU[\"_enforce_max_entries()\\n(Purge expired, evict LRU if >= max_entries)\"]\n    EnforceLRU --> WriteCache[\"Atomic INSERT INTO query_cache\\n(immediate_transaction)\"] --> ReturnAnswer[\"Return Answer to Student\"]\n    ValGate -- \"Fallback / Context / Error\" --> ReturnAnswer\n```\n\n### Verification Findings:\n\n1. **Composite SHA-256 Cache Key Correctness**:\n   - Location: [`backend/services/cache_service.py#L217-L237`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L217-L237)\n   - Key is a 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal string computed from:\n     $$\\text{Key} = \\text{SHA-256}(\\text{\"query:\"} + Q_{\\text{norm}} + \\text{\"|docs:\"} + \\text{FP}_{\\text{docs}} + \\text{\"|policy:\"} + V_{\\text{policy}} + \\text{\"|model:\"} + M_{\\text{config}})$$\n   - Verified via `test_same_query_same_key_under_identical_config`, `test_normalization_whitespace_casing_punctuation_produces_identical_key`, and `test_different_queries_produce_different_keys`.\n2. **Document Content Fingerprint Accuracy**:\n   - Location: [`backend/services/cache_service.py#L178-L215`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L178-L215)\n   - Evaluates `(doc_id, filename, last_updated, policy_status, file_sha256)` in sorted order.\n   - Any modification or edit to physical course documents invalidates previous cache keys automatically (verified in `test_document_version_change_invalidates_key` and `test_35`).\n3. **Policy and Model Invalidation**:\n   - Updates to `config.POLICY_VERSION` / `config.PROMPT_VERSION` or `config.GEMINI_MODEL` produce distinct SHA-256 hashes (verified in `test_policy_version_change_invalidates_key` and `test_model_version_change_invalidates_key`).\n4. **Context-Dependent Question Exclusion**:\n   - Location: [`backend/services/chat_service.py#L650-L665`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/chat_service.py#L650-L665) and [`backend/services/cache_service.py#L241-L280`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L241-L280)\n   - Pronoun follow-ups (*\"How long is it?\"*) and elliptical queries resolve dynamically against conversation history, bypass cache lookup, and are rejected from standalone caching (verified in `test_context_dependent_answer_excluded_from_cache` and `test_context_dependent_follow_up_does_not_pollute_cache`).\n5. **Source Attribution & Moderation Validation**:\n   - Location: [`backend/services/cache_service.py#L281-L320`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L281-L320)\n   - Entries citing unmoderated student comments from Doc04 are evicted (`test_unmoderated_forum_source_evicted_from_cache`).\n   - Entries citing superseded Doc02 as sole authority are rejected and evicted (`test_33`).\n   - Answers hallucinating a â‚¹4,999 certificate fee are rejected; only the official Rs. 1,500 fee is permitted (`test_34`).\n6. **TTL Expiration & Maximum Entry Capacity Bounds**:\n   - Location: [`backend/services/cache_service.py#L442-L480`](file:///c:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%20&%20H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L442-L480)\n   - Default TTL (`86400`s = 24h) and capacity bound (`CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 1000`) enforced via LRU eviction (purges expired first, then evicts least recently accessed entries). Verified in `test_32`.\n7. **SQLite Transaction Safety & Concurrency**:\n   - Writes wrapped in `immediate_transaction(conn)` (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`).\n   - Read access updates execute atomic standalone `UPDATE` statements without write lock contention. Tested under 8 concurrent threads executing 80 simultaneous reads and writes (`test_concurrent_cache_reads_and_writes`).\n8. **Graceful Degradation**:\n   - Database disconnections, locks, or corruptions degrade to cache misses without crashing or raising HTTP 500 errors (verified in `test_cache_database_failure_degrades_gracefully`).\n9. **Gemini Call Elimination on Cache Hits**:\n   - Verified in `test_first_question_misses_then_second_hits_skipping_gemini` (`mock_gemini.generate_text.call_count == 1` across two consecutive queries).\n10. **Preservation of Modules 1â€“6**:\n    - All 229 pre-existing tests pass cleanly without modifications.\n\n---\n\n## 2. {"step_index":1425,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T02:22:52Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T07:52:52+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T07:52:53+05:30\nShowing lines 1-200 of 1069\n1: # IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot â€” Module 1: Architecture Plan (Final)\n2: \n3: ## Overview\n4: \n5: A lightweight, context-aware chatbot that answers student questions strictly using official DPM-101 course documents. Built with an HTML/CSS/JS frontend, a Python Flask backend, the Google `google-genai` Python SDK for Gemini AI, and SQLite for session and cache storage. Designed for internship-assignment scale with accurate documentation of all technical limitations.\n6: \n7: ---\n8: \n9: ## User Review Required\n10: \n11: > [!IMPORTANT]\n12: > **Document authority is topic-specific, not global.** Doc 03 governs grading and assignment/quiz submission policy. Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 governs final-exam logistics and the final-exam date. These two authorities do not override each other's domains.\n13: \n14: > [!IMPORTANT]\n15: > **google-genai SDK only.** The newer official `google-genai` Python SDK is used throughout. The deprecated `google-generativeai` package must not be installed. `gemini-2.0-flash` is the working assumption for the model ID; the exact ID and SDK version will be verified against the live API during Module 4 and pinned only after successful testing. No model ID or SDK version is claimed to be already tested.\n16: \n17: > [!WARNING]\n18: > **SQLite + single Gunicorn worker.** This architecture uses a single Gunicorn worker for consistent in-process statistics and rate limiting. Actual throughput depends on the Render instance type, Gemini API latency and measured workload. No concurrent-user capacity claims are made without load-test results.\n19: \n20: > [!CAUTION]\n21: > **Render's filesystem is ephemeral.** Every redeploy or restart wipes the SQLite database. `doc_chunks` are rebuilt from PDFs at startup. Sessions, cache and stats are lost. This is a known and accepted limitation for this project scope. Persistent storage is an optional paid upgrade.\n22: \n23: ---\n24: \n25: ## Open Questions Resolved\n26: \n27: The following questions from earlier reviews are now resolved in this document:\n28: \n29: 1. **Document identities and precedence** â€” defined in Section 1.\n30: 2. **Ingestion strategy** â€” SHA-256 comparison on every startup; idempotent chunk replacement; Section 2.\n31: 3. **Gemini model** â€” `gemini-2.0-flash` as working assumption; tested and pinned in Module 4.\n32: 4. **Worker count** â€” single worker chosen for consistent counters and rate limiting.\n33: 5. **Statistics persistence** â€” lost on restart; documented as known limitation.\n34: \n35: ---\n36: \n37: ## 1. The Four Official DPM-101 Documents\n38: \n39: The chatbot's knowledge base is composed exclusively of these four documents. No other source is ever ingested or used.\n40: \n41: | ID | Document | Description | Authority Scope |\n42: |---|---|---|---|\n43: | **Doc 01** | Course Overview & Structure | Syllabus, learning objectives, weekly schedule, faculty contacts, certificate fee | General course information, weekly schedule, learning objectives, faculty details, certificate fee |\n44: | **Doc 02** | Grading Policy V1 *(outdated)* | Original assessment breakdown and submission rules | **Suppressed** on all grading, assessment, penalty and submission-deadline topics â€” superseded by Doc 03 for those topics |\n45: | **Doc 03** | Grading Policy V2 *(updated Oct 5, 2026)* | Revised grading criteria, assessment weighting, passing requirements, distinction thresholds, assignment/quiz submission deadlines, late-submission penalties | **Sole authority** on grading, assessment weighting, passing/distinction requirements, assignment and quiz submission deadlines, and late-submission rules |\n46: | **Doc 04** | Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts | **Â§1 & Â§2**: Official final exam rules (authoritative). **Â§3+**: Unmoderated student forum comments | **Â§1 & Â§2 only**: final exam date, duration, format, proctoring method, device requirements and restrictions |\n47: \n48: ### 1.1 Document Authority Rules\n49: \n50: - **Doc 01** is the authority on general course information, weekly schedule, faculty contacts and certificate fee.\n51: - **Doc 02** is retained for audit purposes only. Its grading and submission-policy content is superseded by Doc 03 for the applicable topics based on the currently supplied authoritative documents. Doc 02 chunks covering grading, assessment or submission topics carry `is_outdated = 1` and are excluded from retrieval.\n52: - **Doc 03** supersedes the earlier version for the applicable grading and submission-policy topics, based on the currently supplied authoritative documents. Doc 03 does not govern final-exam scheduling or logistics; those are controlled by Doc 04.\n53: - **Doc 04 Â§1 and Â§2** are the sole authority on final-exam logistics, including exam date, duration, format, proctoring and device rules. Doc 03 must not be used to override Doc 04 on these topics.\n54: - **Doc 04 Â§3 onwards** (student forum comments) carry `is_excluded = 1` and are structurally impossible to retrieve. This is enforced at the SQL query level, not by prompt instruction alone.\n55: \n56: > [!IMPORTANT]\n57: > **Domain separation:** Doc 03 controls assignment/quiz submission deadlines. Doc 04 controls the final-exam date and examination logistics. These domains are distinct and must not cross-override each other.\n58: \n59: ### 1.2 Topic-to-Document Precedence Table (`config.py`)\n60: \n61: ```python\n62: TOPIC_PRECEDENCE = {\n63:     # Grading and assessment â€” Doc 03 is sole authority; Doc 02 excluded\n64:     \"grading\":              [\"doc03\"],\n65:     \"assessment\":           [\"doc03\"],\n66:     \"passing_requirement\":  [\"doc03\"],\n67:     \"distinction\":          [\"doc03\"],\n68:     \"late_submission\":      [\"doc03\"],\n69:     \"penalty\":              [\"doc03\"],\n70: \n71:     # Assignment and quiz submission deadlines â€” Doc 03 authority\n72:     \"assignment_deadline\":  [\"doc03\"],\n73:     \"quiz_deadline\":        [\"doc03\"],\n74: \n75:     # Final exam logistics and date â€” Doc 04 official sections only\n76:     \"final_exam\":           [\"doc04_official\"],   # maps to doc_chunks WHERE section_type='official_exam_rules'\n77:     \"exam_format\":          [\"doc04_official\"],\n78:     \"exam_device\":          [\"doc04_official\"],\n79:     \"proctoring\":           [\"doc04_official\"],\n80:     \"exam_date\":            [\"doc04_official\"],\n81: \n82:     # General course information â€” Doc 01 sole authority\n83:     \"schedule\":             [\"doc01\"],            # weekly schedule (not exam date)\n84:     \"faculty\":              [\"doc01\"],\n85:     \"objective\":            [\"doc01\"],\n86:     \"certificate\":          [\"doc01\"],\n87:     \"course_structure\":     [\"doc01\"],\n88: \n89:     # Forum comments â€” structurally excluded, never an answer source\n90:     \"forum\":                [],\n91: }\n92: ```\n93: \n94: ### 1.3 Doc 04 Section-Level Ingestion Strategy\n95: \n96: During PDF parsing (`pdf_parser.py`, Module 3), Doc 04 is parsed with section-boundary detection:\n97: \n98: ```python\n99: # Pseudocode â€” exact heading strings confirmed when reading the actual PDF in Module 3\n100: DOC04_OFFICIAL_SECTIONS = [\"Section 1\", \"Section 2\"]   # official exam rules â†’ authoritative\n101: # All other sections                                    # student forum comments â†’ excluded\n102: \n103: for chunk in parse_doc04_chunks():\n104:     if chunk.detected_section in DOC04_OFFICIAL_SECTIONS:\n105:         chunk.section_type = 'official_exam_rules'\n106:         chunk.is_excluded  = 0    # retrievable\n107:     else:\n108:         chunk.section_type = 'forum'\n109:         chunk.is_excluded  = 1    # never retrievable\n110: ```\n111: \n112: Section boundaries are identified by heading patterns. The exact heading strings must be confirmed by reading the actual PDF at the start of Module 3. If the headings differ from the assumption above, `pdf_parser.py` is updated accordingly before ingestion tests are run.\n113: \n114: The following facts must be answerable from Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 after ingestion:\n115: \n116: | Fact | Expected value |\n117: |---|---|\n118: | Final exam date | November 20, 2026 |\n119: | Exam duration | 90 minutes |\n120: | Exam format | Closed-book |\n121: | Proctoring method | AI-proctored |\n122: | Required devices | Desktop or laptop |\n123: | Required peripherals | Webcam and microphone |\n124: | Restricted devices | Mobile phones and tablets not permitted |\n125: \n126: ---\n127: \n128: ## 2. Architecture Explanation\n129: \n130: The system follows a 3-tier architecture with a document retrieval layer and an AI reasoning layer.\n131: \n132: ```\n133: Student Browser  â†’  Flask REST API  â†’  Gemini AI (google-genai SDK)\n134:                          â†“                       â†‘\n135:                     SQLite DB          Document Retriever (RAG)\n136:                          â†“                       â†‘\n137:                     Cache Layer         doc_chunks table (SQLite)\n138: ```\n139: \n140: **Key design principles:**\n141: \n142: - **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation):** Gemini is never called without first retrieving relevant document chunks. The model answers from provided context, not from general training knowledge.\n143: - **Topic-specific precedence:** Retrieval routes through the `TOPIC_PRECEDENCE` table, ensuring that the correct authoritative document is selected for each topic domain. Doc 02 grading chunks are suppressed. Doc 03 is used for grading topics. Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 is used for final-exam topics.\n144: - **Section-level filtering for Doc 04:** Doc 04 is a mixed document. Its official exam-rule sections are authoritative sources. Its forum sections are excluded via `is_excluded = 1` in the database â€” enforced at SQL level, not by prompt instruction.\n145: - **Idempotent startup ingestion:** Every startup computes SHA-256 hashes of all PDFs and re-ingests only changed or new documents, replacing old chunks safely within a transaction. See Section 3.\n146: - **Context-aware caching:** Follow-up questions bypass cache entirely. Exact-match is the primary cache mechanism. Semantic matching is an experimental secondary path with strict guards. See Section 7.\n147: - **Document-version-aware cache invalidation:** Cache entries record which document versions they were derived from. When a document changes, dependent cache entries are invalidated.\n148: \n149: ---\n150: \n151: ## 3.
