Executive Summary & Audit Scope\n\nThis report documents the final code-level audit and approval verification for **Module 9: Statistics & Live Counters** in accordance with Phase 3 audit requirements.\n\n### Audit Objectives Verified\n1. **Total Request Counting Order of Operations**: Verified that valid chat message requests increment `total_requests` before duplicate detection and rate limiting, while malformed payloads (HTTP 400) and nonexistent conversations (HTTP 404) are strictly excluded.\n2. **Gemini Call Counting & Retries**: Verified that `gemini_calls` is incremented at the **actual Gemini API invocation boundary** (`client.models.generate_content`) inside `GeminiService.generate_text()`. When transient errors trigger exponential backoff retries, each actual network attempt is accurately recorded.\n3. **Exactly-Once Error Counting**: Verified that Gemini model failures and unhandled server exceptions increment `errors` exactly once per failed request without double-counting, while client errors (400, 404, 409) and rate limits (429) do not count as server errors.\n4. **API Response Contract & Security**: Confirmed that only `GET /api/stats` is exposed, returning the exact 6 fields specified in Architecture Â§9 with zero leakage of IP addresses, request IDs, prompts, or secrets.\n5. **Thread Safety**: Verified that instance-level `threading.Lock` coordinates all updates and reads across concurrent worker threads (`--workers 1 --threads 2`).\n6. **Zero Impact on Regression Baseline**: All 293 approved regression tests from Modules 1â€“8 continue to pass without modification.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Audit Findings & Corrections Applied\n\n### Finding 1: Order of Operations for Request Counting\n- **Observation:** `increment_requests()` was originally placed after idempotency registration. If an idempotency conflict occurred (`IdempotencyConflictError`), the order was ambiguous.\n- **Correction:** Moved `get_stats_service().increment_requests()` immediately after conversation active verification (`is_active` check in Step 4 of `chat_routes.py`).\n- **Verified Order of Operations:**\n  1. Valid message request arrives (passed JSON validation, message string checks, and active conversation check).\n  2. Request counter increments (`total_requests += 1`).\n  3. Duplicate detection occurs (`request_mgr.start_request()`, completed duplicate replay, in-flight wait).\n  4. Rate limiting occurs (`rate_limiter.check_and_consume()`).\n  5. Normal chat processing continues under conversation lock.\n\n### Finding 2: Gemini Call Counting Boundary and Retry Behavior\n- **Observation:** In the initial implementation, `increment_gemini_calls()` was placed in `policy_service.py` before calling `generate_text()`. If `GeminiService` retried on transient errors (e.g. HTTP 429/503), the retry network calls were not captured.\n- **Correction:** Relocated `get_stats_service().increment_gemini_calls()` directly inside the `while True:` loop of `GeminiService.generate_text()` immediately preceding `client.models.generate_content()`.\n- **Result:** `gemini_calls` consistently represents **actual network API invocations** to Google Gemini. If a transient failure occurs and retries, each network attempt increments `gemini_calls`. If Gemini is bypassed (cache hit, out-of-scope, unsupported topic, or extractive fallback without API call), `gemini_calls` is not incremented.\n\n### Finding 3: Scope of Imports\n- **Observation:** Inline `from backend.services.stats_service import get_stats_service` inside conditional blocks could trigger `UnboundLocalError` if called conditionally across different code branches.\n- **Correction:** Imported `get_stats_service` at the top module level in `backend/routes/chat_routes.py`, `backend/services/policy_service.py`, and `backend/services/gemini_service.py`.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Exact Metric Definitions & Instrumentation Architecture\n\n| Metric | Exact Definition | Instrumentation Location | What is INCLUDED | What is EXCLUDED |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| `total_requests` | Total valid chat message requests received at the message endpoint. | `backend/routes/chat_routes.py` (after conversation active verification) | Standard requests, completed duplicate replays, in-flight duplicate waits, rate-limited requests (429). | Malformed JSON (400), empty/oversized messages (400), invalid idempotency keys (400), nonexistent/deleted conversations (404). |\n| `cache_hits` | Number of queries served directly from the SQLite cache. | `backend/services/policy_service.py` (inside `ask()` when `cached is not None`) | Valid, unexpired, policy-validated cache hits. | Cache misses, context-dependent bypasses, expired entries, unsupported topic declines. |\n| `gemini_calls` | Actual network API attempts made to Google Gemini. | `backend/services/gemini_service.py` (inside `generate_text()` before `client.models.generate_content()`) | Every network API attempt to `models.generate_content()`, including retries on transient 429/503 errors. | Cache hits, out-of-scope declines, unsupported topic declines, extractive fallbacks without Gemini, `/api/stats` calls. |\n| `errors` | Server-side operational and generation failures during message processing. | `backend/services/policy_service.py` (on `gemini_resp.success == False`) & `backend/routes/chat_routes.py` (on unhandled 500 exceptions) | Gemini API failures (even when handled by extractive fallback), unhandled exceptions resulting in HTTP 500. Exactly once per failed request. | Client validation errors (400), conversation not found (404), conversation lock busy (409), rate limit rejections (429). |\n| `uptime_seconds` | Elapsed seconds since the worker process started. | `backend/services/stats_service.py` | Integer `int(time.time() - start_time)`. | Resets to 0 upon process reboot / container restart. |\n| `worker_note` | Mandatory single-worker disclaimer string. | `backend/services/stats_service.py` | Exact string: `\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"` | Static string. |\n\n---\n\n## 4. API Response Contract Verification\n\n### Endpoint\n`GET /api/stats`\n\n### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)\n```json\n{\n  \"total_requests\": 847,\n  \"cache_hits\": 503,\n  \"gemini_calls\": 344,\n  \"errors\": 12,\n  \"uptime_seconds\": 7200,\n  \"worker_note\": \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"\n}\n```\n\n### Security & Access Control\n- **Read-Only:** Allowed HTTP methods: `GET`. Requests using `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH` return `HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed`.\n- **Zero Information Leakage:** Exposes only the 6 required numerical counters and the worker note. No IP addresses, user identifiers, session IDs, request IDs, prompts, or secrets.\n- **Zero Gemini Quota:** Fetching statistics queries memory attributes inside a thread lock; no Gemini calls are ever made.\n- **No Reset Endpoints:** No public administrative reset endpoints exist.\n\n---\n\n## 5. attempt (2 total)**. | PASS |\n| `test_gemini_exhausted_retries_increments_errors_once` | **Exhausted retries increment `gemini_calls` for each attempt (3 total) and `errors` exactly once**. | PASS Remaining Architectural Limitations\n\n1. **Single-Worker In-Memory Scope**: Counters reside in the single Gunicorn worker RAM (`--workers 1 --threads 2`). If scaled to multiple Gunicorn processes, an external shared store (e.g. Redis) would be required to aggregate across workers.\n2. **Ephemeral Container Reset**: On free cloud hosting (Render), redeployments or container restarts wipe in-memory state. Zero frontend files were modified in Module 9.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Counters reset to zero upon process reboot, as disclosed in `worker_note`.\n3. **No Time-Series Rollups**: Tracks cumulative totals since worker boot; hourly or historical time-series rollups are not persisted in SQLite.\n4. **Frontend Interface**: Frontend UI display is strictly scheduled for **Module 10: Frontend Chat Interface**. Zero frontend files were modified in Module 9.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Audit Recommendation: PASS\n\nModule 9 meets 100% of the original requirements, architectural specifications, concurrency safety, and metric precision criteria with **313 / 313 passing tests**.\n\n**Recommendation: OFFICIAL PASS AND APPROVAL.**\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\module9_implementation_report.md"}}]}

Audit Findings & Traceability Analysis\n\n#### A. Total Request Counting Order of Operations\n- **Inspection:** Traced execution flow in `backend/routes/chat_routes.py`.\n- **Finding:** In the initial implementation, `increment_requests()` was placed after `request_mgr.start_request()`. If an idempotency key conflict (`IdempotencyConflictError`) was raised, the order between incoming arrival and store coordination was ambiguous.\n- **Correction Applied:** Moved `get_stats_service().increment_requests()` immediately after conversation active verification (`is_active` check in Step 4 of `chat_routes.py`).\n- **Verified Order of Operations:**\n  1. Valid message request arrives (passed JSON validation, non-empty string checks, length bounds, and active conversation check).\n  2. Request counter increments (`total_requests += 1`).\n  3. Duplicate detection occurs (`request_mgr.start_request()`, completed duplicate replay, in-flight wait).\n  4. Rate limiting occurs (`rate_limiter.check_and_consume()`).\n  5. Normal chat processing continues under per-conversation thread lock.\n- **Validation:**\n  - Rate-limited requests (HTTP 429) **are counted**.\n  - Duplicate replays (HTTP 200 with `X-Duplicate-Request: true`) **are counted**.\n  - Malformed JSON (400), empty/oversized messages (400), invalid idempotency keys (400), and nonexistent conversations (404) **are excluded**.\n  - A request cannot increment the counter twice (linear execution path).\n  - Concurrent requests cannot lose increments (synchronized via `threading.Lock`).\n\n#### B. Gemini Call Counting & Retry Behavior\n- **Inspection:** Inspected `backend/services/gemini_service.py` and `backend/services/policy_service.py`.\n- **Finding:** `increment_gemini_calls()` was previously called in `policy_service.py` before calling `generate_text()`. If `GeminiService` retried on transient errors (HTTP 429/503), the counter recorded only 1 logical generation request, omitting the retry network calls.\n- **Correction Applied:** Moved `get_stats_service().increment_gemini_calls()` directly inside the `while True:` loop of `GeminiService.generate_text()` immediately preceding `client.models.generate_content(...)`. Removed the redundant call from `policy_service.py`.\n- **Result:** `gemini_calls` consistently represents **actual network API invocations** to Google Gemini:\n  - Cache hits: **0 calls**.\n  - Topic declines & unsupported topics: **0 calls**.\n  - Extractive fallbacks without Gemini: **0 calls**.\n  - Health and stats endpoint requests: **0 calls**.\n  - Standard generation: **1 call**.\n  - Generation with 1 transient retry: **2 calls** (1 initial + 1 retry).\n\n#### C. Error Counting & Double-Counting Prevention\n- **Inspection:** Traced error paths in `policy_service.py` and `chat_routes.py`.\n- **Verification:**\n  - When Gemini fails (e.g. quota exhausted or unhandled provider error), `policy_service.py` increments `errors` **exactly once** and returns an extractive fallback. `process_message` succeeds with HTTP 200, so `chat_routes.py` does not increment `errors`.\n  - When an unhandled server exception crashes request handling, `chat_routes.py` catches it in `except Exception as exc:` and increments `errors` **exactly once** before returning HTTP 500.\n  - Client errors (HTTP 400, 404, 409) and rate-limit rejections (HTTP 429) **never increment `errors`**.\n\n#### D. API Response Contract & Security\n- **Path:** Strictly `GET /api/stats`.\n- **Methods:** Only `GET` is permitted; `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH` return `HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed`.\n- **Response Schema:** Exactly the 6 mandated fields:\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"total_requests\": 847,\n    \"cache_hits\": 503,\n    \"gemini_calls\": 344,\n    \"errors\": 12,\n    \"uptime_seconds\": 7200,\n    \"worker_note\": \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Security:** Zero leakage of IP addresses, request IDs, session tokens, prompts, or secrets.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Corrections Made During Audit\n\n1. **`backend/routes/chat_routes.py`**:\n   - Reordered `increment_requests()` to execute immediately upon conversation verification, before duplicate detection and rate limiting.\n   - Moved `get_stats_service` import to module top level to prevent `UnboundLocalError`.\n2. **`backend/services/gemini_service.py`**:\n   - Placed `get_stats_service().increment_gemini_calls()` directly at the `client.models.generate_content()` boundary inside the retry loop.\n   - Moved `get_stats_service` import to module top level.\n3. **`backend/services/policy_service.py`**:\n   - Removed duplicate `increment_gemini_calls()` (delegated to `gemini_service.py`).\n   - Moved `get_stats_service` import to module top level.\n4. **`tests/test_stats_service.py`**:\n   - Added `test_gemini_retries_increment_network_attempts` (verifies retry increments `gemini_calls` for each network call).\n   - Added `test_gemini_exhausted_retries_increments_errors_once` (verifies exhausted retries track 3 calls and 1 error).\n   - Added `test_invalid_requests_do_not_increment_total_requests` (verifies 400/404 are excluded from `total_requests`).\n\n---\n\n### 3. Exact Metric Definitions\n\n| Metric | Trigger Condition & Scope | Included | Excluded |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `total_requests` | Incremented upon valid chat message arrival at `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`. | Valid queries, duplicate replays, in-flight waits, rate-limited queries (429). | Malformed JSON (400), invalid format (400), missing conversation (404). |\n| `cache_hits` | Incremented inside `PolicyService.ask()` when `cache_service.get()` returns a valid `CachedAnswer`. | Active, valid SQLite cache hits. | Cache misses, context bypasses, expired entries. |\n| `gemini_calls` | Incremented inside `GeminiService.generate_text()` immediately before `client.models.generate_content()`. | Every actual network API attempt to Gemini, including retries. | Cache hits, topic declines, extractive fallbacks, stats calls. |\n| `errors` | Incremented on Gemini API generation failure or unhandled server-side 500 exceptions. | Model failures, provider crashes, unhandled server errors (exactly once per failure). | Client errors (400, 404, 409), rate limits (429). |\n| `uptime_seconds` | Computed as `int(time.time() - start_time)`. | Elapsed seconds since Gunicorn worker start. | Resets on process reboot / container restart. |\n| `worker_note` | Static architectural disclaimer string. | `\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. DO NOT IMPLEMENT ANYTHING.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Mandatory Project Inspection\n\nBefore preparing the implementation plan, inspect:\n\n1. The original project assignment and requirements.\n2. The original 12-module roadmap.\n3. The complete existing project architecture.\n4. The complete frontend directory and all existing HTML, CSS and JavaScript files.\n5. Backend routes and API contracts.\n6. Conversation management and message handling.\n7. Request management, duplicate prevention and rate limiting.\n8. Cache and policy response behavior.\n9. Statistics endpoint `/api/stats`.\n10. README and previous module implementation reports.\n\nModules 1â€“9 are officially approved.\n\nDo not assume that the frontend is empty. Inspect what already exists and preserve reusable work.\n\n## 2. Core Frontend Requirements\n\nDesign and plan a complete chatbot experience with the following capabilities.\n\n### A. Professional Chat Interface\n\n- Clean, modern, professional design.\n- Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.\n- Clear application branding: IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk.\n- Professional typography, spacing, colors and visual hierarchy.\n- Consistent design system.\n- Smooth, subtle interactions.\n- Avoid unnecessary animations and visual clutter.\n\n### B. Chat Functionality\n\n- Send student questions to the existing backend.\n- Display user and assistant messages distinctly.\n- Support Enter to send and Shift+Enter for a new line.\n- Show loading/typing indicators while waiting.\n- Prevent accidental duplicate submissions.\n- Handle long messages and long responses correctly.\n- Automatically scroll to the latest message when appropriate.\n- Display readable timestamps if supported by existing API data.\n\n### C. Conversation Management\n\nIntegrate the existing backend endpoints:\n\n- Create conversation.\n- List conversations.\n- Retrieve conversation history.\n- Retrieve conversation messages.\n- Send messages.\n- Delete conversations.\n\nSupport:\n- New chat.\n- Previous conversation history.\n- Switching between conversations.\n- Deleting a conversation with confirmation.\n- Empty conversation state.\n- Conversation loading and error states.\n\nRespect the existing backend API contracts. Do not invent new endpoints.\n\n### D. Source Attribution\n\nThe chatbot is an academic course helpdesk.\n\nPlan a clear way to display the official source documents returned by the backend.\n\nStudents should be able to distinguish:\n- Assistant answers.\n- Source documents.\n- Any supported source references or citations.\n\nDo not fabricate source references or display unsupported citations.\n\n### E. Error Handling\n\nPlan user-friendly handling for:\n\n- Network failures.\n- Backend unavailable.\n- Gemini service failures and fallback responses.\n- HTTP 400.\n- HTTP 404.\n- HTTP 409.\n- HTTP 429 and Retry-After.\n- HTTP 500.\n- Empty responses.\n- Duplicate request replay.\n\nNever expose stack traces, API keys, internal exceptions or sensitive backend information.\n\n### F. Live Statistics\n\nIntegrate the existing read-only endpoint:\n\n`GET /api/stats`\n\nDisplay the six existing metrics:\n\n- Total Requests\n- Cache Hits\n- Gemini Calls\n- Errors\n- Uptime\n- Worker Note\n\nRequirements:\n- Statistics must not interfere with chat functionality.\n- Refresh periodically only if appropriate.\n- Handle statistics endpoint failure gracefully.\n- Do not invent metrics or calculate unsupported values.\n- Respect the existing single-worker limitation.\n\n### G. Accessibility and Usability\n\nPlan:\n- Semantic HTML.\n- Keyboard accessibility.\n- Visible focus indicators.\n- Appropriate contrast.\n- Accessible labels.\n- Screen-reader-friendly status updates.\n- Mobile-friendly controls.\n- Clear empty, loading, success and error states.\n\n## 3. Technical Constraints\n\n- Frontend: HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript.\n- Backend: Existing Python Flask application.\n- Preserve the existing REST API contracts.\n- Do not introduce React, Vue, Angular or another frontend framework.\n- Do not add dependencies unless absolutely necessary and justified.\n- Do not expose Gemini API keys or environment variables.\n- Do not hardcode production URLs.\n- Support local development and the planned Render deployment.\n- Keep frontend code modular and maintainable.\n- Avoid unnecessary backend modifications.\n\n## 4. Executive Summary & Assignment Traceability\n\nModule 10 introduces the user-facing **Frontend Chat Interface** for the IIMBx Digital Product Management (DPM-101) Course Helpdesk. The objective is to build a modern, polished, responsive, accessible, and fully functional chat application utilizing vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that seamlessly integrates with the existing Flask backend APIs.\n\n### Traceability to Original Specification\nEvery frontend component directly supports the architectural commitments established in Modules 1â€“9:\n\n| Architecture Reference | Original Specification & Expected Behavior | Planned Frontend Implementation | Verification Method |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **Roadmap Â§15 (Module 10)** | `index.html`, `main.css`, `chat.css`, `chat.js`, `ui.js`. Loading states, source citations, follow-up indicator, error display. | Modular HTML/CSS/JS frontend served directly by Flask from `frontend/`. | Browser functional testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile. |\n| **Security Â§11.3 (XSS Defense)** | Safe text rendering via `textContent` or safe DOM text nodes; no `innerHTML` insertion of model output. | Custom plain-text / safe Markdown formatter that constructs DOM elements and text nodes without `innerHTML`. | Security inspection & automated XSS payload test. |\n| **API Integration (Â§Â§6, 9)** | Integrates `/api/v1/conversations`, `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`, and `/api/stats`. | Dedicated API client module (`api.js`) encapsulating fetch requests with error parsing. | Network inspection and mock backend integration tests. |\n| **Source Attribution (Â§1.1)** | Prominently display authoritative sources (Doc 01, Doc 03, Doc 04) and flag unsupported claims. | Distinct source attribution badges/cards below each assistant response with document metadata. | Visual inspection against 12 acceptance test questions. |\n| **Duplicate Prevention (Â§8)** | Client sends `X-Request-ID` and disables send button during in-flight processing. | Client generates `crypto.randomUUID()`, disables UI during requests, and renders `[Cached / Replayed]` tag. | Rapid double-click verification in browser. |\n| **Rate Limit Handling (Â§8)** | Gracefully handle HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header. | Dynamic warning banner with active second-by-second countdown timer. | Visual rate-limit trigger test. |\n| **Live Stats Display (Module 9)** | Read-only integration of `GET /api/stats` without disrupting chat. | Collapsible modal/drawer displaying the 6 official operational counters and worker disclaimer. | Modal trigger and live refresh verification. |\n\n---\n\n## 2. Existing Frontend & Backend Architecture Analysis\n\n### 2.1 Existing Frontend Files\n- **Current State:** `frontend/index.html` contains an 13-line placeholder created during Module 2 setup. No CSS or JavaScript files currently exist in `frontend/`.\n- **Serving Architecture:** In `app.py`, Flask is already configured with:\n  ```python\n  app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"frontend\"), static_url_path=\"\")\n  \n  @app.route(\"/\")\n  def index():\n      return app.send_static_file(\"index.html\")\n  ```\n  Flask natively serves `frontend/index.html` at the root URL `/`, and all static assets inside `frontend/css/` and `frontend/js/` are automatically accessible via relative paths (`/css/...`, `/js/...`).\n- **No Build Tools Required:** No Webpack, Vite, Node.js, or frontend compilers are needed. The application runs purely on modern ES6+ vanilla JavaScript and native CSS.\n\n### 2.2 Existing Backend API Endpoints to Integrate\nThe frontend will communicate strictly with the established REST API:\n\n1. `GET /health`: Server liveness and system health check.\n2. `POST /api/v1/conversations`: Creates a new active conversation.\n3. `GET /api/v1/conversations?limit=50&offset=0`: Retrieves list of previous conversations sorted by `updated_at DESC`.\n4. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}`: Retrieves metadata for a specific conversation.\n5. `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}`: Deletes a conversation and purges its messages.\n6. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages?limit=100`: Retrieves chronological message history.\n7. `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`: Submits student question, returning policy-grounded assistant reply.\n8. `GET /api/stats`: Fetches operational statistics (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`).\n\n---\n\n## 3. UI/UX Design System & Layout Architecture\n\n### 3.1 Design Aesthetic: IIMBx Academic Professional\nThe visual design reflects an authoritative, academic, student-first helpdesk:\n- **Primary Colors:**\n  - Deep Academic Navy (`--color-primary: #0B2545`): Header, primary brand elements, user message bubbles.\n  - Slate Blue (`--color-primary-light: #134074`): Hover states, secondary buttons, borders.\n  - Accent Gold / Amber (`--color-accent: #C59B27`): IIMBx certificate badge accents, subtle highlight tags.\n  - Background Neutral (`--color-bg: #F4F7FB`): Calm, neutral canvas reducing eye strain.\n  - Card & Surface White (`--color-surface: #FFFFFF`): Message bubbles, modals, conversation list cards.\n  - Assistant Surface (`--color-assistant-bg: #F0F4F9`): Soft cool gray-blue for assistant responses.\n  - Text Primary (`--color-text-main: #1D2A44`): High contrast readability ($> 10:1$ ratio).\n  - Text Muted (`--color-text-muted: #5A6B82`): Timestamps, source captions, metadata.\n  - Status Colors:\n    - Success Green (`#1E7E34`): Live connected status.\n    - Warning Amber (`#D97706`): Rate limit countdown, ambiguous question alert.\n    - Error Red (`#DC2626`): Network errors, server failures.\n- **Typography:**\n  - Modern system font stack: `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`.\n  - Monospace for code/numbers: `ui-monospace, \"Cascadia Code\", \"Source Code Pro\", Menlo, Consolas, monospace`.\n  - Accessible font sizes: Base $16\\text{px}$, line height $1.55$, heading scales ($18\\text{px}$ to $24\\text{px}$).\n\n### 3.2 Responsive Wireframe Component Structure and File Organization\n\n```\ndpm101-chatbot/\nâ””â”€â”€ frontend/\n    â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA landmarks, modal dialogs\n    â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # CSS variables, typography, reset, grid layout, buttons\n    â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Chat bubbles, sidebar, composer, animations, stats modal\n    â””â”€â”€ js/\n        â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # REST client wrapper for all backend routes\n        â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage manager (active conversation, cached IDs)\n        â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM rendering, auto-scroll, toasts, modal controllers\n        â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Main coordinator, event bindings, life-cycle manager\n```\n\n### 4.1 Responsibilities by Module\n1. **`index.html`**:\n   - Declares semantic regions: `<aside class=\"sidebar\">`, `<main class=\"chat-main\">`, `<header>`, `<section class=\"message-feed\">`, `<form class=\"composer\">`.\n   - Embeds accessibility attributes: `role=\"log\"`, `aria-live=\"polite\"`, `aria-label`, visible focus landmarks.\n   - Embeds the Live Stats modal dialog (`<dialog id=\"stats-dialog\">`) with fallback drawer.\n2. **`css/main.css`**:\n   - Design tokens: colors, spacing, borders, shadows, transitions.\n   - Modern layout: CSS Grid / Flexbox desktop split-view, mobile collapsible drawer.\n   - Accessibility styles: High-contrast focus rings (`:focus-visible`), reduced motion queries (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion)`).\n3. **`css/chat.css`**:\n   - Message bubble styling: distinct user vs. assistant alignment, rounded borders, avatar icons.\n   - Source pill badges: visually distinctive badges displaying document authorities.\n   - Loading indicator: pulsing three-dot wave animation.\n   - Status badges & toast notification styling.\n4. **`js/api.js`**:\n   - Fetch API wrapper with automatic JSON serialization, error normalization, request timeouts, and `X-Request-ID` injection.\n   - Explicit methods: `fetchHealth()`, `listConversations()`, `createConversation()`, `deleteConversation()`, `getMessages()`, `sendMessage()`, `fetchStats()`.\n5. **`js/storage.js`**:\n   - Manages `localStorage` key `dpm101_active_conv_id`.\n   - Handles graceful fallback if localStorage is disabled or restricted in private browsing.\n6. **`js/ui.js`**:\n   - **XSS-Safe Content Renderer**: Converts model output to safe HTML text nodes, converting line breaks to `<p>` and formatting bullet lists without using `innerHTML` on untrusted strings.\n   - Auto-scroll to bottom with user-scroll detection (does not hijack scroll if student is reading older history).\n   - Character counter update logic.\n   - Banner and Toast notification manager (e.g. Rate-limit countdown timer).\n7. **`js/app.js`**:\n   - Application startup: checks backend health, restores or creates active conversation, renders message history.\n   - Event listeners: Form submission, `Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline, mobile sidebar toggle, stats modal toggle.\n   - Prevents duplicate clicks by toggling composer disabled state.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Detailed API Integration Mapping\n\n| User Action | Backend Endpoint | HTTP Method | Request Body & Headers | Success Handling | Error & Degraded Handling |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| **App Startup** | `GET /health` | `GET` | Headers: standard | Header displays \"â— Helpdesk Active\" | Header displays \"â— Server Connecting...\", retry on 5s backoff |\n| **Load Sidebar** | `GET /api/v1/conversations` | `GET` | Params: `limit=50&offset=0` | Renders conversation list in sidebar; selects active ID | Shows empty state \"No past chats\" or inline retry button |\n| **Click \"+ New Chat\"** | `POST /api/v1/conversations` | `POST` | Headers: `Content-Type: application/json` | Appends new conversation to sidebar; switches view to clean welcome screen | Toast notification: \"Failed to create conversation. Please try again.\" |\n| **Select Chat** | `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | `GET` | Params: `limit=100` | Clears chat window, renders past messages in order, scrolls to bottom | Shows \"Failed to load messages\" banner with retry option |\n| **Delete Chat** | `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}` | `DELETE` | Headers: standard | Removes item from sidebar; if current chat deleted, opens clean New Chat | Toast: \"Unable to delete conversation.\" |\n| **Send Message** | `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | `POST` | Body: `{\"message\": str, \"request_id\": uuid}`<br>Header: `X-Request-ID: uuid` | Renders user message immediately; renders assistant message with source badges; updates conversation `updated_at` | **400:** Input validation alert.<br>**404:** Re-creates conversation.<br>**409:** Busy notification.<br>**429:** Starts countdown timer.<br>**500/503:** In-line error message. |\n| **Open Stats** | `GET /api/stats` | `GET` | Headers: standard | Populates modal with 6 metrics (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`) | Displays \"Statistics temporarily unavailable\" inside modal without disrupting chat |\n\n---\n\n## 6. Source Attribution & Citation Presentation\n\nOfficial document citations are vital for student confidence. Assistant responses will feature a dedicated source badge component:\n\n1. **Source Pills**:\n   - If `sources` contains items (e.g. `[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]`):\n     - Renders a styled badge below the answer:\n       `ðŸ“„ Official Source: Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)`\n     - Clear visual separation from the main text with a subtle divider.\n2. **Topic Precedence Clarifications**:\n   - For Doc 04 responses: clearly states `Source: Final Exam Rules (Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2)`.\n   - For Doc 01 responses: states `Source: Course Overview & Structure (Doc 01)`.\n3. **Unsupported / Out-of-Scope Badges**:\n   - If `is_supported: false` (e.g. refund questions or Kubernetes trivia):\n     - Renders a neutral notice: `â„¹ï¸ Not Specified in Official Documents`.\n4. **Duplicate / Replay Badges**:\n   - If response contains `is_duplicate: true` or `X-Duplicate-Request` header:\n     - Displays subtle metadata: `âš¡ Cached Response (Replayed)`.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Error Handling & Resilience Mechanics\n\nThe UI handles all edge cases gracefully without exposing technical stack traces or crashing:\n\n1. **Rate Limiting (HTTP 429)**:\n   - When the backend returns 429, it provides `retry_after` (in seconds).\n   - The frontend disables the send button and renders an alert banner:  \n     `â³ Rate limit reached. You can send another message in 12s.`\n   - A live JavaScript `setInterval` counts down each second (`11s... 10s... 1s`). When it hits 0, the input and button automatically re-enable.\n2. **Concurrent Request Conflict (HTTP 409)**:\n   - If a student triggers an in-flight conflict:\n     `âš ï¸ A message is already being processed for this conversation. Please wait a moment.`\n3. **Stale / Deleted Conversation (HTTP 404)**:\n   - If a conversation was deleted or wiped by a server restart:\n     `Conversation expired or reset. Starting a fresh conversation...`\n   - The UI automatically calls `createConversation()` and sends the message into the new conversation.\n4. **Network Drop / Server Down**:\n   - If `fetch()` throws `TypeError: Failed to fetch`:\n     `ðŸ“¡ Connection lost. The server is unreachable. Please verify your internet or try again shortly.`\n5. **Accidental Rapid Double-Click**:\n   - The send button is disabled immediately upon click, and re-enabled only after the response completes or errors out.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Security & Safe Rendering Specifications\n\n### 8.1 Safe Text Formatting Engine\nTo strictly satisfy Architecture Specification Â§11.3 (\"Do not rely on stripping HTML... Gemini-generated responses are rendered using textContent or safe DOM escaping. innerHTML insertion of model-generated content is not used\"):\n\n- The frontend will implement a safe tokenizer function:\n  ```javascript\n  function renderSafeContent(container, rawText) {\n      container.replaceChildren(); // Clear existing content\n      const paragraphs = rawText.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/);\n      paragraphs.forEach(paraText => {\n          const p = document.createElement('p');\n          // Handle line breaks within paragraphs\n          const lines = paraText.split('\\n');\n          lines.forEach((line, idx) => {\n              if (idx > 0) p.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));\n              // Format simple bold (**text**) safely using DOM nodes\n              formatInlineSafe(p, line);\n          });\n          container.appendChild(p);\n      });\n  }\n  ```\n- **Zero Raw HTML Injection**: Model responses containing `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `onload=`, or malicious HTML entities are treated as plain text strings via `document.createTextNode()`, eliminating XSS vulnerabilities.\n\n### 8.2 Client-Side Idempotency\n- Before sending `POST /messages`, `api.js` calls `crypto.randomUUID()` to generate an RFC 4122 v4 UUID.\n- Injected both as `X-Request-ID` header and `request_id` in the request body.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Live Statistics Drawer / Modal Integration\n\nTo integrate the Module 9 `GET /api/stats` endpoint seamlessly:\n\n1. **Trigger & Presentation**:\n   - A clean button in the top navigation bar: `ðŸ“Š Live Stats` with a status dot.\n   - Clicking opens a non-modal drawer or accessible `<dialog>` card.\n2. **Displayed Metrics**:\n   - **Total Requests Received**: Numerical counter.\n   - **Cache Hits**: Number of queries served instantly from SQLite cache.\n   - **Gemini AI Invocations**: Number of actual LLM generation calls.\n   - **Errors Encountered**: Server error count.\n   - **Server Uptime**: Formatted as `X days, Y hrs, Z mins`.\n   - **Worker Note Disclaimer**: Displays the verbatim disclaimer:  \n     `\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"`\n3. **Polling Strategy**:\n   - Fetched on initial drawer open.\n   - Refreshes automatically every 30 seconds **only** while the drawer/modal is open.\n   - Polling stops immediately when closed or when the browser tab is hidden (`document.visibilityState === 'hidden'`).\n4. **Graceful Fallback**:\n   - If `/api/stats` returns 503 or fails, the drawer displays `\"Statistics currently unavailable\"` without affecting ongoing chat conversations.\n\n---\n\n## 10. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance)\n\n1. **Semantic Structure**: Proper heading hierarchy (`<h1>` for app title, `<h2>` for chat landmarks).\n2. **Keyboard Navigation**:\n   - Full navigation without a mouse using `Tab`, `Shift+Tab`, `Enter`, and `Escape`.\n   - `Escape` closes any open drawer, modal, or confirmation dialog.\n   - `Enter` in composer sends message; `Shift+Enter` inserts newline.\n3. **Screen Reader Live Regions**:\n   - Message container has `role=\"log\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"`.\n   - Incoming assistant messages are announced automatically to assistive technology.\n   - Status updates (e.g. \"Assistant is typing...\") use `role=\"status\"` with `aria-atomic=\"true\"`.\n4. **Color Contrast & Focus**:\n   - Contrast ratio for all text elements exceeds $4.5:1$ against backgrounds.\n   - Distinct 2px high-visibility outline on `:focus-visible` for keyboard users.\n\n---\n\n## 11. Executive Summary & Assignment Traceability\n\nModule 10 introduces the user-facing **Frontend Chat Interface** for the IIMBx Digital Product Management (DPM-101) Course Helpdesk. The objective is to build a modern, polished, responsive, accessible, and fully functional chat application utilizing vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that seamlessly integrates with the existing Flask backend APIs.\n\n### Traceability to Original Specification\nEvery frontend component directly supports the architectural commitments established in Modules 1â€“9:\n\n| Architecture Reference | Original Specification & Expected Behavior | Planned Frontend Implementation | Verification Method |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **Roadmap Â§15 (Module 10)** | `index.html`, `main.css`, `chat.css`, `chat.js`, `ui.js`. Loading states, source citations, follow-up indicator, error display. | Modular HTML/CSS/JS frontend served directly by Flask from `frontend/`. | Browser functional testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile. |\n| **Security Â§11.3 (XSS Defense)** | Safe text rendering via `textContent` or safe DOM text nodes; no `innerHTML` insertion of model output. | Custom plain-text / safe Markdown formatter that constructs DOM elements and text nodes without `innerHTML`. | Security inspection & automated XSS payload test. |\n| **API Integration (Â§Â§6, 9)** | Integrates `/api/v1/conversations`, `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`, and `/api/stats`. | Dedicated API client module (`api.js`) encapsulating fetch requests with error parsing. | Network inspection and mock backend integration tests. |\n| **Source Attribution (Â§1.1)** | Prominently display authoritative sources (Doc 01, Doc 03, Doc 04) and flag unsupported claims. | Distinct source attribution badges/cards below each assistant response with document metadata. | Visual inspection against 12 acceptance test questions. |\n| **Duplicate Prevention (Â§8)** | Client sends `X-Request-ID` and disables send button during in-flight processing. | Client generates `crypto.randomUUID()`, disables UI during requests, and renders `[Cached / Replayed]` tag. | Rapid double-click verification in browser. |\n| **Rate Limit Handling (Â§8)** | Gracefully handle HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header. | Dynamic warning banner with active second-by-second countdown timer. | Visual rate-limit trigger test. |\n| **Live Stats Display (Module 9)** | Read-only integration of `GET /api/stats` without disrupting chat. | Collapsible modal/drawer displaying the 6 official operational counters and worker disclaimer. | Modal trigger and live refresh verification. |\n\n---\n\n## 2. Existing Frontend & Backend Architecture Analysis\n\n### 2.1 Existing Frontend Files\n- **Current State:** `frontend/index.html` contains an 13-line placeholder created during Module 2 setup. No CSS or JavaScript files currently exist in `frontend/`.\n- **Serving Architecture:** In `app.py`, Flask is already configured with:\n  ```python\n  app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"frontend\"), static_url_path=\"\")\n  \n  @app.route(\"/\")\n  def index():\n      return app.send_static_file(\"index.html\")\n  ```\n  Flask natively serves `frontend/index.html` at the root URL `/`, and all static assets inside `frontend/css/` and `frontend/js/` are automatically accessible via relative paths (`/css/...`, `/js/...`).\n- **No Build Tools Required:** No Webpack, Vite, Node.js, or frontend compilers are needed. The application runs purely on modern ES6+ vanilla JavaScript and native CSS.\n\n### 2.2 Existing Backend API Endpoints to Integrate\nThe frontend will communicate strictly with the established REST API:\n\n1. `GET /health`: Server liveness and system health check.\n2. `POST /api/v1/conversations`: Creates a new active conversation.\n3. `GET /api/v1/conversations?limit=50&offset=0`: Retrieves list of previous conversations sorted by `updated_at DESC`.\n4. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}`: Retrieves metadata for a specific conversation.\n5. `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}`: Deletes a conversation and purges its messages.\n6. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages?limit=100`: Retrieves chronological message history.\n7. `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`: Submits student question, returning policy-grounded assistant reply.\n8. `GET /api/stats`: Fetches operational statistics (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`).\n\n---\n\n## 3. UI/UX Design System & Layout Architecture\n\n### 3.1 Design Aesthetic: IIMBx Academic Professional\nThe visual design reflects an authoritative, academic, student-first helpdesk:\n- **Primary Colors:**\n  - Deep Academic Navy (`--color-primary: #0B2545`): Header, primary brand elements, user message bubbles.\n  - Slate Blue (`--color-primary-light: #134074`): Hover states, secondary buttons, borders.\n  - Accent Gold / Amber (`--color-accent: #C59B27`): IIMBx certificate badge accents, subtle highlight tags.\n  - Background Neutral (`--color-bg: #F4F7FB`): Calm, neutral canvas reducing eye strain.\n  - Card & Surface White (`--color-surface: #FFFFFF`): Message bubbles, modals, conversation list cards.\n  - Assistant Surface (`--color-assistant-bg: #F0F4F9`): Soft cool gray-blue for assistant responses.\n  - Text Primary (`--color-text-main: #1D2A44`): High contrast readability ($> 10:1$ ratio).\n  - Text Muted (`--color-text-muted: #5A6B82`): Timestamps, source captions, metadata.\n  - Status Colors:\n    - Success Green (`#1E7E34`): Live connected status.\n    - Warning Amber (`#D97706`): Rate limit countdown, ambiguous question alert.\n    - Error Red (`#DC2626`): Network errors, server failures.\n- **Typography:**\n  - Modern system font stack: `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`.\n  - Monospace for code/numbers: `ui-monospace, \"Cascadia Code\", \"Source Code Pro\", Menlo, Consolas, monospace`.\n  - Accessible font sizes: Base $16\\text{px}$, line height $1.55$, heading scales ($18\\text{px}$ to $24\\text{px}$).\n\n### 3.2 Responsive Wireframe Layout\n\n```\nâ”Œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\nâ”‚ (Shift+Enter=newline)â”‚        â”‚\nâ”‚  Base: 4 Official Docs  â”‚  â””â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”˜ 0/4000   â”‚\nâ””â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”´â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”˜\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Component Structure and File Organization\n\n```\ndpm101-chatbot/\nâ””â”€â”€ frontend/\n    â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA landmarks, modal dialogs\n    â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # CSS variables, typography, reset, grid layout, buttons\n    â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Chat bubbles, sidebar, composer, animations, stats modal\n    â””â”€â”€ js/\n        â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # REST client wrapper for all backend routes\n        â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage manager (active conversation, cached IDs)\n        â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM rendering, auto-scroll, toasts, modal controllers\n        â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Main coordinator, event bindings, life-cycle manager\n```\n\n### 4.1 Responsibilities by Module\n1. **`index.html`**:\n   - Declares semantic regions: `<aside class=\"sidebar\">`, `<main class=\"chat-main\">`, `<header>`, `<section class=\"message-feed\">`, `<form class=\"composer\">`.\n   - Embeds accessibility attributes: `role=\"log\"`, `aria-live=\"polite\"`, `aria-label`, visible focus landmarks.\n   - Embeds the Live Stats modal dialog (`<dialog id=\"stats-dialog\">`) with fallback drawer.\n2. **`css/main.css`**:\n   - Design tokens: colors, spacing, borders, shadows, transitions.\n   - Modern layout: CSS Grid / Flexbox desktop split-view, mobile collapsible drawer.\n   - Accessibility styles: High-contrast focus rings (`:focus-visible`), reduced motion queries (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion)`).\n3. **`css/chat.css`**:\n   - Message bubble styling: distinct user vs. assistant alignment, rounded borders, avatar icons.\n   - Source pill badges: visually distinctive badges displaying document authorities.\n   - Loading indicator: pulsing three-dot wave animation.\n   - Status badges & toast notification styling.\n4. **`js/api.js`**:\n   - Fetch API wrapper with automatic JSON serialization, error normalization, request timeouts, and `X-Request-ID` injection.\n   - Explicit methods: `fetchHealth()`, `listConversations()`, `createConversation()`, `deleteConversation()`, `getMessages()`, `sendMessage()`, `fetchStats()`.\n5. **`js/storage.js`**:\n   - Manages `localStorage` key `dpm101_active_conv_id`.\n   - Handles graceful fallback if localStorage is disabled or restricted in private browsing.\n6. **`js/ui.js`**:\n   - **XSS-Safe Content Renderer**: Converts model output to safe HTML text nodes, converting line breaks to `<p>` and formatting bullet lists without using `innerHTML` on untrusted strings.\n   - Auto-scroll to bottom with user-scroll detection (does not hijack scroll if student is reading older history).\n   - Character counter update logic.\n   - Banner and Toast notification manager (e.g. Rate-limit countdown timer).\n7. **`js/app.js`**:\n   - Application startup: checks backend health, restores or creates active conversation, renders message history.\n   - Event listeners: Form submission, `Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline, mobile sidebar toggle, stats modal toggle.\n   - Prevents duplicate clicks by toggling composer disabled state.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Detailed API Integration Mapping\n\n| User Action | Backend Endpoint | HTTP Method | Request Body & Headers | Success Handling | Error & Degraded Handling |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| **App Startup** | `GET /health` | `GET` | Headers: standard | Header displays \"â— Helpdesk Active\" | Header displays \"â— Server Connecting...\", retry on 5s backoff |\n| **Load Sidebar** | `GET /api/v1/conversations` | `GET` | Params: `limit=50&offset=0` | Renders conversation list in sidebar; selects active ID | Shows empty state \"No past chats\" or inline retry button |\n| **Click \"+ New Chat\"** | `POST /api/v1/conversations` | `POST` | Headers: `Content-Type: application/json` | Appends new conversation to sidebar; switches view to clean welcome screen | Toast notification: \"Failed to create conversation. Please try again.\" |\n| **Select Chat** | `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | `GET` | Params: `limit=100` | Clears chat window, renders past messages in order, scrolls to bottom | Shows \"Failed to load messages\" banner with retry option |\n| **Delete Chat** | `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}` | `DELETE` | Headers: standard | Removes item from sidebar; if current chat deleted, opens clean New Chat | Toast: \"Unable to delete conversation.\" |\n| **Send Message** | `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | `POST` | Body: `{\"message\": str, \"request_id\": uuid}`<br>Header: `X-Request-ID: uuid` | Renders user message immediately; renders assistant message with source badges; updates conversation `updated_at` | **400:** Input validation alert.<br>**404:** Re-creates conversation.<br>**409:** Busy notification.<br>**429:** Starts countdown timer.<br>**500/503:** In-line error message. |\n| **Open Stats** | `GET /api/stats` | `GET` | Headers: standard | Populates modal with 6 metrics (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`) | Displays \"Statistics temporarily unavailable\" inside modal without disrupting chat |\n\n---\n\n## 6. Source Attribution & Citation Presentation\n\nOfficial document citations are vital for student confidence. Assistant responses will feature a dedicated source badge component:\n\n1. **Source Pills**:\n   - If `sources` contains items (e.g. `[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]`):\n     - Renders a styled badge below the answer:\n       `ðŸ“„ Official Source: Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)`\n     - Clear visual separation from the main text with a subtle divider.\n2. **Topic Precedence Clarifications**:\n   - For Doc 04 responses: clearly states `Source: Final Exam Rules (Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2)`.\n   - For Doc 01 responses: states `Source: Course Overview & Structure (Doc 01)`.\n3. **Unsupported / Out-of-Scope Badges**:\n   - If `is_supported: false` (e.g. refund questions or Kubernetes trivia):\n     - Renders a neutral notice: `â„¹ï¸ Not Specified in Official Documents`.\n4. **Duplicate / Replay Badges**:\n   - If response contains `is_duplicate: true` or `X-Duplicate-Request` header:\n     - Displays subtle metadata: `âš¡ Cached Response (Replayed)`.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Error Handling & Resilience Mechanics\n\nThe UI handles all edge cases gracefully without exposing technical stack traces or crashing:\n\n1. **Rate Limiting (HTTP 429)**:\n   - When the backend returns 429, it provides `retry_after` (in seconds).\n   - The frontend disables the send button and renders an alert banner:  \n     `â³ Rate limit reached. You can send another message in 12s.`\n   - A live JavaScript `setInterval` counts down each second (`11s... 10s... 1s`). When it hits 0, the input and button automatically re-enable.\n2. **Concurrent Request Conflict (HTTP 409)**:\n   - If a student triggers an in-flight conflict:\n     `âš ï¸ A message is already being processed for this conversation. Please wait a moment.`\n3. **Stale / Deleted Conversation (HTTP 404)**:\n   - If a conversation was deleted or wiped by a server restart:\n     `Conversation expired or reset. Starting a fresh conversation...`\n   - The UI automatically calls `createConversation()` and sends the message into the new conversation.\n4. **Network Drop / Server Down**:\n   - If `fetch()` throws `TypeError: Failed to fetch`:\n     `ðŸ“¡ Connection lost. The server is unreachable. Please verify your internet or try again shortly.`\n5. **Accidental Rapid Double-Click**:\n   - The send button is disabled immediately upon click, and re-enabled only after the response completes or errors out.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Security & Safe Rendering Specifications\n\n### 8.1 Safe Text Formatting Engine\nTo strictly satisfy Architecture Specification Â§11.3 (\"Do not rely on stripping HTML... Gemini-generated responses are rendered using textContent or safe DOM escaping. innerHTML insertion of model-generated content is not used\"):\n\n- The frontend will implement a safe tokenizer function:\n  ```javascript\n  function renderSafeContent(container, rawText) {\n      container.replaceChildren(); // Clear existing content\n      const paragraphs = rawText.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/);\n      paragraphs.forEach(paraText => {\n          const p = document.createElement('p');\n          // Handle line breaks within paragraphs\n          const lines = paraText.split('\\n');\n          lines.forEach((line, idx) => {\n              if (idx > 0) p.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));\n              // Format simple bold (**text**) safely using DOM nodes\n              formatInlineSafe(p, line);\n          });\n          container.appendChild(p);\n      });\n  }\n  ```\n- **Zero Raw HTML Injection**: Model responses containing `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `onload=`, or malicious HTML entities are treated as plain text strings via `document.createTextNode()`, eliminating XSS vulnerabilities.\n\n### 8.2 Client-Side Idempotency\n- Before sending `POST /messages`, `api.js` calls `crypto.randomUUID()` to generate an RFC 4122 v4 UUID.\n- Injected both as `X-Request-ID` header and `request_id` in the request body.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Live Statistics Drawer / Modal Integration\n\nTo integrate the Module 9 `GET /api/stats` endpoint seamlessly:\n\n1. **Trigger & Presentation**:\n   - A clean button in the top navigation bar: `ðŸ“Š Live Stats` with a status dot.\n   - Clicking opens a non-modal drawer or accessible `<dialog>` card.\n2. **Displayed Metrics**:\n   - **Total Requests Received**: Numerical counter.\n   - **Cache Hits**: Number of queries served instantly from SQLite cache.\n   - **Gemini AI Invocations**: Number of actual LLM generation calls.\n   - **Errors Encountered**: Server error count.\n   - **Server Uptime**: Formatted as `X days, Y hrs, Z mins`.\n   - **Worker Note Disclaimer**: Displays the verbatim disclaimer:  \n     `\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"`\n3. **Polling Strategy**:\n   - Fetched on initial drawer open.\n   - Refreshes automatically every 30 seconds **only** while the drawer/modal is open.\n   - Polling stops immediately when closed or when the browser tab is hidden (`document.visibilityState === 'hidden'`).\n4. **Graceful Fallback**:\n   - If `/api/stats` returns 503 or fails, the drawer displays `\"Statistics currently unavailable\"` without affecting ongoing chat conversations.\n\n---\n\n## 10. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance)\n\n1. **Semantic Structure**: Proper heading hierarchy (`<h1>` for app title, `<h2>` for chat landmarks).\n2. **Keyboard Navigation**:\n   - Full navigation without a mouse using `Tab`, `Shift+Tab`, `Enter`, and `Escape`.\n   - `Escape` closes any open drawer, modal, or confirmation dialog.\n   - `Enter` in composer sends message; `Shift+Enter` inserts newline.\n3. **Screen Reader Live Regions**:\n   - Message container has `role=\"log\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"`.\n   - Incoming assistant messages are announced automatically to assistive technology.\n   - Status updates (e.g. \"Assistant is typing...\") use `role=\"status\"` with `aria-atomic=\"true\"`.\n4. **Color Contrast & Focus**:\n   - Contrast ratio for all text elements exceeds $4.5:1$ against backgrounds.\n   - Distinct 2px high-visibility outline on `:focus-visible` for keyboard users.\n\n---\n\n## 11. Comprehensive Testing Plan\n\n### 11.1 Manual Browser Testing Checklist\n- [ ] **First Page Load**: Confirm clean layout, greeting message, and 4 suggested questions appear.\n- [ ] **Suggested Questions**: Click each suggested question card; confirm it populates and triggers the question.\n- [ ] **Send Message**: Send `\"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\"`; verify typing indicator appears, response renders safely, and `Doc 03` source badge appears.\n- [ ] **Multi-Line Composer**: Type multi-line text with `Shift+Enter`; verify textarea expands up to 5 lines then scrolls.\n- [ ] **Duplicate Prevention**: Rapidly double-click `Send`; confirm second click is prevented and button is disabled during in-flight request.\n- [ ] **New Conversation**: Click `+ New Chat`; verify a new conversation is created, sidebar updates, and message area resets to welcome state.\n- [ ] **Switch Conversations**: Click between different past conversations in sidebar; verify message history loads correctly.\n- [ ] **Delete Conversation**: Click delete icon on a past conversation; confirm confirmation prompt appears and conversation is deleted upon confirmation.\n- [ ] **Rate Limit UI**: Send multiple rapid requests to trigger 429; confirm countdown banner appears and re-enables composer when timer reaches 0.\n- [ ] **Live Stats Modal**: Open Live Stats; verify all 6 fields render accurately with the worker note.\n- [ ] **XSS Injection Test**: Send `<script>alert('xss')</script>` and `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>`; verify text renders as literal plain text without execution.\n- [ ] **Responsive Breakpoints**: Test on mobile ($375\\text{px}$), tablet ($768\\text{px}$), and desktop ($1280\\text{px}$); confirm sidebar slides in as drawer on mobile.\n- [ ] **Keyboard Accessibility**: Navigate entire app using only `Tab`, `Enter`, and `Escape`.\n\n### 11.2 Integration Testing with Flask Test Client\nA dedicated test suite `tests/test_frontend_integration.py` will be created to verify:\n- Flask successfully serves `index.html` at `GET /`.\n- Flask successfully serves `css/main.css`, `css/chat.css`, and `js/*.js` with correct MIME types (`text/css`, `application/javascript`).\n- End-to-end integration: User creates conversation via API, loads it, sends message, and retrieves history.\n\n---\n\n## 12. Implementation Task Checklist (Phase 2 Preview)\n\n| Task ID | Task Description | Target File |\n|---|---|---|\n| **T10.1** | Create semantic HTML structure with ARIA roles, landmarks, sidebar, message feed, and stats dialog. | `frontend/index.html` |\n| **T10.2** | Build modern, accessible CSS design system: variables, reset, layout grid, typography, focus styles. | `frontend/css/main.css` |\n| **T10.3** | Build chat-specific CSS: message bubbles, source pills, typing animation, drawer, toast alerts. | `frontend/css/chat.css` |\n| **T10.4** | Implement REST API client module wrapping all backend endpoints with error normalization. | `frontend/js/api.js` |\n| **T10.5** | Implement LocalStorage state persistence for active conversation ID and user preferences. | `frontend/js/storage.js` |\n| **T10.6** | Implement safe DOM rendering engine (safe text formatting, no innerHTML, auto-scroll, modals). | `frontend/js/ui.js` |\n| **T10.7** | Implement main controller: event handlers, lifecycle management, keyboard bindings, stats polling. | `frontend/js/app.js` |\n| **T10.8** | Create frontend static serving and integration test suite. | `tests/test_frontend_integration.py` |\n| **T10.9** | Execute complete regression suite across Modules 1â€“10 (target: 313 + new frontend tests passing). | Full Test Run |\n| **T10.10**| Update `README.md` with frontend usage instructions, responsive layout guide, and screenshots. | `README.md` |\n\n---\n\n## 13. Acceptance Criteria\n\n1. **Design Quality**: Clean, modern, responsive interface branded for IIMBx DPM-101.\n2. **Functional Completeness**: Students can create, switch, and delete conversations, send messages, and review history.\n3. **Source Transparency**: Clear attribution badges for Doc 01, Doc 03, and Doc 04 on every grounded answer.\n4. **Resilience**: Polite, informative error messages for 400, 404, 409, 429 (with countdown), and 500 errors.\n5. **Security**: Zero `innerHTML` insertion of untrusted data; zero Gemini API key exposure in browser.\n6. **Live Stats**: Seamless display of `GET /api/stats` metrics with worker note.\n7. **Zero Backend Regressions**: All 313 existing backend tests pass without modification.\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\module10_implementation_plan.md"}}]}

Original Assignment Requirements Relevant to Module 10\n\nFrom the original Architecture Specification (`implementation_plan.md` Â§Â§4, 9, 11, 15):\n1. **Academic Branding:** Official IIMBx Digital Product Management (DPM-101) Course Helpdesk.\n2. **Safe Text Rendering (XSS Prevention Â§11.3):** Model responses rendered strictly using `textContent` and safe DOM text nodes; strictly **no `innerHTML` insertion** of model-generated text.\n3. **Conversation Management (Â§6):** Full support for conversation creation, listing, switching, retrieval of message history, and deletion.\n4. **Authoritative Source Attribution (Â§1.1):** Prominent display of official source badges for Doc 01, Doc 03, and Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2; clear indication when questions are out-of-scope or unsupported.\n5. **Duplicate Prevention & Idempotency (Â§8):** Client generates `X-Request-ID` (`crypto.randomUUID()`), disables send button during in-flight requests, and displays `[Cached / Replayed]` metadata on duplicate replay.\n6. **Rate-Limit Countdown (Â§8):** Displays an active second-by-second countdown banner on HTTP 429 using the server-provided `retry_after` duration.\n7. **Live Statistics Integration (Module 9):** Integrates the `GET /api/stats` endpoint in a non-intrusive modal/drawer displaying the 6 official operational metrics and worker note.\n\n---\n\n### 3. Proposed UI Design & Component Architecture\n\n#### A. Design System & Aesthetics\n- **Theme:** IIMBx Academic Professional.\n- **Color Palette:**\n  - Primary Navy: `#0B2545` (Header, user bubbles, brand landmarks)\n  - Slate Blue: `#134074` (Buttons, borders, interactive focus)\n  - Certificate Gold: `#C59B27` (Highlight tags, official badges)\n  - Background Canvas: `#F4F7FB` (Soft neutral)\n  - Assistant Surface: `#F0F4F9` (Cool gray-blue assistant bubble)\n  - Text Primary: `#1D2A44` (Contrast ratio $> 10:1$)\n- **Typography:** Modern clean system sans-serif (`-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto`).\n\n#### B. Component Layout\n1. **Header Bar:**\n   - IIMBx branding & course title.\n   - Live system status dot (green = online).\n   - \"ðŸ“Š Live Stats\" drawer button.\n   - Quick \"New Chat\" button for mobile.\n2. **Collapsible Sidebar (Conversations):**\n   - \"+ New Chat\" primary button.\n   - Chronological list of conversations sorted by `updated_at DESC`.\n   - Active conversation indicator pill.\n   - Delete conversation button with confirmation.\n   - Knowledge base disclaimer footer (\"Grounded in 4 official course documents\").\n3. **Main Chat Area:**\n   - **Welcome Screen (Empty State):** Explains course scope and presents 4 clickable suggested question cards (*Passing criteria, final exam date & rules, capstone deadline, best 5 of 6 quizzes*).\n   - **Message Feed:** Distinct user vs. assistant bubbles with readable timestamps.\n   - **Source Attribution Card:** Clean divider below assistant replies displaying authoritative documents (e.g. `ðŸ“„ Official Source: Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Doc 03)`).\n   - **Typing Indicator:** Pulsing three-dot wave animation (\"Assistant is consulting course documents...\").\n4. **Message Composer:**\n   - Auto-expanding multi-line textarea (up to 5 lines).\n   - Character counter (`0 / 4,000`).\n   - Shortcuts: `Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline.\n   - Send button disabled while in-flight or when input is empty.\n5. **Live Stats Modal (`GET /api/stats`):**\n   - Accessible `<dialog>` displaying: Total Requests, Cache Hits, Gemini Calls, Errors, Uptime, and verbatim Worker Note.\n\n---\n\n### 4. Risks & Unresolved Questions\n\n1. **Private Browsing LocalStorage Restrictions:** Handled gracefully in `storage.js` with an in-memory fallback if `localStorage` throws `SecurityError`.\n2. **Render Ephemeral Database Loss:** If a container restart deletes conversation records in SQLite, subsequent messages return HTTP 404; the frontend automatically catches 404, transparently creates a new conversation, and delivers the message without stranding the user.\n3. **No Unresolved Questions:** All API endpoints, schemas, and requirements are fully verified and approved.\n\n---\n\n### 7. Request Management\n\nVerify that:\n- `crypto.randomUUID()` is supported or has a safe fallback.\n- Header and body request IDs match.\n- A retry of the same logical request reuses its original request ID.\n- A genuinely new message gets a new request ID.\n- The UI handles duplicate replay without displaying duplicate messages.\n- HTTP 429 uses the actual backend Retry-After contract.\n\n## 6. Key Findings & Required Refinements for Phase 1B\n\n### 1. Conversation Recovery (Remove Silent Auto-Creation on 404)\n- **Problem in v1 plan:** Plan proposed automatically creating a new conversation and resending the user message if a 404 occurred.\n- **Correction:**\n  - Remove silent auto-resending completely.\n  - When a 404 occurs (e.g. conversation deleted or wiped after ephemeral server restart):\n    - Clearly display a visible notice: \"This conversation is no longer available on the server.\"\n    - Preserve the student's typed message in the input composer so it is not lost.\n    - Provide an explicit \"Start New Chat\" action button for the student.\n    - Never silently resend messages or imply deleted history can be recovered.\n\n### 2. Source Attribution (Exact Backend Match, No Hardcoded Badges)\n- **Backend Inspection:**\n  - `PolicyAnswer.sources` and `messages.sources` are JSON arrays of strings: e.g. `[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]` or `[]`.\n  - On unsupported questions or out-of-scope declines, `sources` is `[]` (empty list) and `is_supported: false`.\n- **Correction:**\n  - Render source badges **only** when `sources` is non-empty.\n  - Iterate over the returned `sources` array and create a badge for each source item (supports multiple sources).\n  - If `sources` is empty or missing, render no source badge.\n  - If `is_supported === false`, display an informative note: \"Information not present in official course documents.\"\n  - Never hardcode or fabricate document references.\n\n### 3. API Contract Verification (Exact Methods, Routes, Payloads, Pagination & Errors)\n- **Verified Route Map:**\n  1. `GET /health` -> `{\"status\": \"healthy\", \"service\": \"DPM-101 Helpdesk Chatbot\"}` (HTTP 200).\n  2. `POST /api/v1/conversations` -> Empty body. Response: HTTP 201 Created: `{\"id\": \"uuid\", \"created_at\": \"ISO\", \"updated_at\": \"ISO\", \"status\": \"active\"}`.\n  3. `GET /api/v1/conversations` -> Query params: `limit` (default 50, max 200), `offset` (default 0). Response: HTTP 200: `{\"conversations\": [...]}`.\n  4. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}` -> Response: HTTP 200: `{\"id\": ..., \"created_at\": ..., \"updated_at\": ..., \"status\": ...}`. Error: HTTP 404 `{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}`.\n  5. `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}` -> Response: HTTP 200: `{\"success\": true, \"message\": \"...\", \"conversation_id\": ...}`. Error: HTTP 404 `{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}`.\n  6. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` -> Query params: `limit` (default 100, max 500), `offset` (default 0). Response: HTTP 200: `{\"conversation_id\": ..., \"messages\": [{\"id\": ..., \"role\": \"user\"|\"assistant\", \"content\": ..., \"created_at\": ..., \"sources\": [...]}, ...]}`. Error: HTTP 404 `{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}`.\n  7. `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` -> Body: `{\"message\": str, \"request_id\": \"optional-uuid\"}`. Header: `X-Request-ID: optional-uuid` (must match body if both provided).\n     - Response: HTTP 200: `{\"conversation_id\": ..., \"message_id\": ..., \"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": ..., \"sources\": [...], \"created_at\": ..., \"is_in_scope\": bool, \"is_supported\": bool, \"is_duplicate\": bool}`.\n     - Header on duplicate: `X-Duplicate-Request: true`.\n     - Errors: HTTP 400 (bad JSON, empty/oversized message, mismatched request_id), HTTP 404 (conversation not found), HTTP 409 (conversation busy / idempotency conflict), HTTP 429 (rate limited with `retry_after` integer and `Retry-After: N` header), HTTP 500 (internal error).\n  8. `GET /api/stats` -> Response: HTTP 200: `{\"total_requests\": int, \"cache_hits\": int, \"gemini_calls\": int, \"errors\": int, \"uptime_seconds\": int, \"worker_note\": \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"}`. Error: HTTP 405 on non-GET, HTTP 503 on service failure.\n\n### 4. Frontend Security & Safe Rendering\n- **Strict XSS Defense:**\n  - Never use `element.innerHTML` on untrusted model or user content.\n  - Use `element.textContent` or safe DOM node builders (`document.createElement`, `document.createTextNode`).\n  - Pre-validate conversation IDs against UUID v4 regex pattern before interpolating into URL strings.\n  - Zero Gemini API key exposure in browser.\n\n### 5. Request Management & Idempotency\n- **UUID Generation:**\n  - Primary: `crypto.randomUUID()`.\n  - Fallback: RFC 4122 v4 math random fallback if `crypto.randomUUID` is unavailable in older/insecure contexts.\n- **Idempotency Matching:**\n  - Body `request_id` and header `X-Request-ID` must be identical.\n  - A user retry of the same failed request reuses the original `request_id`.\n  - A genuinely new user turn generates a fresh UUID.\n  - If backend returns `is_duplicate: true`, UI checks if message is already rendered to avoid duplicate bubble rendering.\n  - HTTP 429 parses integer `retry_after` from response body or `Retry-After` header to drive a live countdown timer.\n\n### 6. Live Statistics Non-Interference\n- `GET /api/stats` runs independently in a slide-out modal/drawer.\n- Polling (30s) occurs strictly while the modal is open and tab is visible.\n- If stats endpoint fails (e.g. 503 or network error), the modal displays an inline error without disrupting chat or throwing uncaught exceptions.\n\n---\n\n## 4. This prevents hallucination and keeps answers grounded in course content.\\n- **TF-IDF similarity** (via scikit-learn) instead of heavyweight embedding models â€” keeps the app deployable on Render's free/starter tier without GPU or large memory requirements.\\n\\n### ðŸ—„ï¸ Database (SQLite â€” 4 tables)\\n| Table | Purpose |\\n|---|---|\\n| `sessions` | Track each student session by UUID |\\n| `messages` | Full conversation history per session |\\n| `query_cache` | Exact + near-duplicate cache with TF-IDF vectors |\\n| `doc_chunks` | Pre-processed PDF text chunks with priority levels |\\n\\n### ðŸ”’ Security\\n- Gemini API key lives **only** in `.env` (local) and Render environment variables (production) â€” never in frontend code\\n- Forum content is architecturally excluded from the document corpus\\n- Prompt injection mitigation via system prompt constraints + input length limits\\n- Rate limiting: 10 requests/minute per session\\n\\n### ðŸ“„ Document Priority System\\nDocuments are ranked 1â€“4. WAL mode improves concurrency in multi-request environments (ignore error for in-memory DB)\n67:     try:\n68:         conn.execute(\"PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\")\n69:     except sqlite3.OperationalError:\n70:         pass\n71:     return conn\n72: \n73: \n74: def init_db(db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n75:     \"\"\"\n76:     Initialize SQLite schema for conversations and messages if not already present.\n77:     \"\"\"\n78:     conn = get_db_connection(db_path)\n79:     try:\n80:         with immediate_transaction(conn):\n81:             conn.execute(\"\"\"\n82:                 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n83:                     id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n84:                     created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n85:                     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n86:                     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n87:                 );\n88:             \"\"\")\n89: \n90:             conn.execute(\"\"\"\n91:                 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (\n92:                     id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n93:                     conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n94:                     role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'assistant')),\n95:                     content TEXT NOT NULL,\n96:                     created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n97:                     sources TEXT,\n98:                     FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n99:                 );\n100:             \"\"\")"}

Passing criteria & Exam minimum\n512:         if any(w in q_lower for w in (\"pass\", \"passing\", \"percentage\", \"criteria\", \"score to pass\")) or \"passing score\" in a_lower:\n513:             # Check for incorrect percentages or missing dual requirement (supporting % and percent)\n514:             has_valid_dual = (\"60%\" in answer or \"60 percent\" in a_lower) and (\"40%\" in answer or \"40 percent\" in a_lower)\n515:             has_erroneous_pct = bool(re.search(r\"\\b(30|45|50|55|70)\\s*(%|percent)\\b\", a_lower))\n516:             if has_erroneous_pct or not has_valid_dual:\n517:                 logger.warning(\"Invalid or incomplete passing criteria detected in answer. Overriding with Doc03 policy.\")\n518:                 return (\n519:                     \"To pass the course and earn the Verified Certificate, you must achieve an overall \"\n520:                     \"weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in \""}

Executive Summary & Assignment Traceability\n12: \n13: Module 10 introduces the user-facing **Frontend Chat Interface** for the IIMBx Digital Product Management (DPM-101) Course Helpdesk. The objective is to build a modern, polished, responsive, accessible, and fully functional chat application utilizing vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that seamlessly integrates with the existing Flask backend APIs.\n14: \n15: ### Traceability to Original Specification\n16: Every frontend component directly supports the architectural commitments established in Modules 1â€“9:\n17: \n18: | Architecture Reference | Original Specification & Expected Behavior | Planned Frontend Implementation | Verification Method |\n19: |---|---|---|---|\n20: | **Roadmap Â§15 (Module 10)** | `index.html`, `main.css`, `chat.css`, `chat.js`, `ui.js`. Loading states, source citations, follow-up indicator, error display. | Modular HTML/CSS/JS frontend served directly by Flask from `frontend/`. | Browser functional testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile. |\n21: | **Security Â§11.3 (XSS Defense)** | Safe text rendering via `textContent` or safe DOM text nodes; no `innerHTML` insertion of model output. | Custom plain-text / safe Markdown formatter that constructs DOM elements and text nodes without `innerHTML`. | Security inspection & automated XSS payload test. |\n22: | **API Integration (Â§Â§6, 9)** | Integrates `/api/v1/conversations`, `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`, and `/api/stats`. | Dedicated API client module (`api.js`) encapsulating fetch requests with error parsing. | Network inspection and mock backend integration tests. |\n23: | **Source Attribution (Â§1.1)** | Prominently display authoritative sources (Doc 01, Doc 03, Doc 04) and flag unsupported claims. | Distinct source attribution badges/cards below each assistant response with document metadata. | Visual inspection against 12 acceptance test questions. |\n24: | **Duplicate Prevention (Â§8)** | Client sends `X-Request-ID` and disables send button during in-flight processing. | Client generates `crypto.randomUUID()`, disables UI during requests, and renders `[Cached / Replayed]` tag. | Rapid double-click verification in browser. |\n25: | **Rate Limit Handling (Â§8)** | Gracefully handle HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header. | Dynamic warning banner with active second-by-second countdown timer. | Visual rate-limit trigger test. |\n26: | **Live Stats Display (Module 9)** | Read-only integration of `GET /api/stats` without disrupting chat. | Collapsible modal/drawer displaying the 6 official operational counters and worker disclaimer. | Modal trigger and live refresh verification. |\n27: \n28: ---\n29: \n30: ## 2. Existing Frontend & Backend Architecture Analysis\n31: \n32: ### 2.1 Existing Frontend Files\n33: - **Current State:** `frontend/index.html` contains an 13-line placeholder created during Module 2 setup. No CSS or JavaScript files currently exist in `frontend/`.\n34: - **Serving Architecture:** In `app.py`, Flask is already configured with:\n35:   ```python\n36:   app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"frontend\"), static_url_path=\"\")\n37:   \n38:   @app.route(\"/\")\n39:   def index():\n40:       return app.send_static_file(\"index.html\")\n41:   ```\n42:   Flask natively serves `frontend/index.html` at the root URL `/`, and all static assets inside `frontend/css/` and `frontend/js/` are automatically accessible via relative paths (`/css/...`, `/js/...`).\n43: - **No Build Tools Required:** No Webpack, Vite, Node.js, or frontend compilers are needed. The application runs purely on modern ES6+ vanilla JavaScript and native CSS.\n44: \n45: ### 2.2 Existing Backend API Endpoints to Integrate\n46: The frontend will communicate strictly with the established REST API:\n47: \n48: 1. `GET /health`: Server liveness and system health check.\n49: 2. `POST /api/v1/conversations`: Creates a new active conversation.\n50: 3. `GET /api/v1/conversations?limit=50&offset=0`: Retrieves list of previous conversations sorted by `updated_at DESC`.\n51: 4. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}`: Retrieves metadata for a specific conversation.\n52: 5. `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}`: Deletes a conversation and purges its messages.\n53: 6. `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages?limit=100`: Retrieves chronological message history.\n54: 7. `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`: Submits student question, returning policy-grounded assistant reply.\n55: 8. `GET /api/stats`: Fetches operational statistics (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`).\n56: \n57: ---\n58: \n59: ## 3. UI/UX Design System & Layout Architecture\n60: \n61: ### 3.1 Design Aesthetic: IIMBx Academic Professional\n62: The visual design reflects an authoritative, academic, student-first helpdesk:\n63: - **Primary Colors:**\n64:   - Deep Academic Navy (`--color-primary: #0B2545`): Header, primary brand elements, user message bubbles.\n65:   - Slate Blue (`--color-primary-light: #134074`): Hover states, secondary buttons, borders.\n66:   - Accent Gold / Amber (`--color-accent: #C59B27`): IIMBx certificate badge accents, subtle highlight tags.\n67:   - Background Neutral (`--color-bg: #F4F7FB`): Calm, neutral canvas reducing eye strain.\n68:   - Card & Surface White (`--color-surface: #FFFFFF`): Message bubbles, modals, conversation list cards.\n69:   - Assistant Surface (`--color-assistant-bg: #F0F4F9`): Soft cool gray-blue for assistant responses.\n70:   - Text Primary (`--color-text-main: #1D2A44`): High contrast readability ($> 10:1$ ratio).\n71:   - Text Muted (`--color-text-muted: #5A6B82`): Timestamps, source captions, metadata.\n72:   - Status Colors:\n73:     - Success Green (`#1E7E34`): Live connected status.\n74:     - Warning Amber (`#D97706`): Rate limit countdown, ambiguous question alert.\n75:     - Error Red (`#DC2626`): Network errors, server failures.\n76: -
