Component Structure and File Organization\n122: \n123: ```\n124: dpm101-chatbot/\n125: â””â”€â”€ frontend/\n126:     â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA landmarks, modal dialogs\n127:     â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n128:     â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # CSS variables, typography, reset, grid layout, buttons\n129:     â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Chat bubbles, sidebar, composer, animations, stats modal\n130:     â””â”€â”€ js/\n131:         â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # REST client wrapper for all backend routes\n132:         â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage manager (active conversation, cached IDs)\n133:         â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM rendering, auto-scroll, toasts, modal controllers\n134:         â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Main coordinator, event bindings, life-cycle manager\n135: ```\n136: \n137: ### 4.1 Responsibilities by Module\n138: 1. **`index.html`**:\n139:    - Declares semantic regions: `<aside class=\"sidebar\">`, `<main class=\"chat-main\">`, `<header>`, `<section class=\"message-feed\">`, `<form class=\"composer\">`.\n140:    - Embeds accessibility attributes: `role=\"log\"`, `aria-live=\"polite\"`, `aria-label`, visible focus landmarks.\n141:    - Embeds the Live Stats modal dialog (`<dialog id=\"stats-dialog\">`) with fallback drawer.\n142: 2. **`css/main.css`**:\n143:    - Design tokens: colors, spacing, borders, shadows, transitions.\n144:    - Modern layout: CSS Grid / Flexbox desktop split-view, mobile collapsible drawer.\n145:    - Accessibility styles: High-contrast focus rings (`:focus-visible`), reduced motion queries (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion)`).\n146: 3. **`css/chat.css`**:\n147:    - Message bubble styling: distinct user vs. assistant alignment, rounded borders, avatar icons.\n148:    - Source pill badges: visually distinctive badges displaying document authorities.\n149:    - Loading indicator: pulsing three-dot wave animation.\n150:    - Status badges & toast notification styling.\n151: 4. **`js/api.js`**:\n152:    - Fetch API wrapper with automatic JSON serialization, error normalization, request timeouts, and `X-Request-ID` injection.\n153:    - Explicit methods: `fetchHealth()`, `listConversations()`, `createConversation()`, `deleteConversation()`, `getMessages()`, `sendMessage()`, `fetchStats()`.\n154: 5. **`js/storage.js`**:\n155:    - Manages `localStorage` key `dpm101_active_conv_id`.\n156:    - Handles graceful fallback if localStorage is disabled or restricted in private browsing.\n157: 6. **`js/ui.js`**:\n158:    - **XSS-Safe Content Renderer**: Converts model output to safe HTML text nodes, converting line breaks to `<p>` and formatting bullet lists without using `innerHTML` on untrusted strings.\n159:    - Auto-scroll to bottom with user-scroll detection (does not hijack scroll if student is reading older history).\n160:    - Character counter update logic.\n161:    - Banner and Toast notification manager (e.g. Rate-limit countdown timer).\n162: 7. **`js/app.js`**:\n163:    - Application startup: checks backend health, restores or creates active conversation, renders message history.\n164:    - Event listeners: Form submission, `Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline, mobile sidebar toggle, stats modal toggle.\n165:    - Prevents duplicate clicks by toggling composer disabled state.\n166: \n167: ---\n168: \n169: ## 5. Detailed API Integration Mapping\n170: \n171: | User Action | Backend Endpoint | HTTP Method | Request Body & Headers | Success Handling | Error & Degraded Handling |\n172: |---|---|---|---|---|---|\n173: | **App Startup** | `GET /health` | `GET` | Headers: standard | Header displays \"â— Helpdesk Active\" | Header displays \"â— Server Connecting...\", retry on 5s backoff |\n174: | **Load Sidebar** | `GET /api/v1/conversations` | `GET` | Params: `limit=50&offset=0` | Renders conversation list in sidebar; selects active ID | Shows empty state \"No past chats\" or inline retry button |\n175: | **Click \"+ New Chat\"** | `POST /api/v1/conversations` | `POST` | Headers: `Content-Type: application/json` | Appends new conversation to sidebar; switches view to clean welcome screen | Toast notification: \"Failed to create conversation. Please try again.\" |\n176: | **Select Chat** | `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | `GET` | Params: `limit=100` | Clears chat window, renders past messages in order, scrolls to bottom | Shows \"Failed to load messages\" banner with retry option |\n177: | **Delete Chat** | `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}` | `DELETE` | Headers: standard | Removes item from sidebar; if current chat deleted, opens clean New Chat | Toast: \"Unable to delete conversation.\" |\n178: | **Send Message** | `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` | `POST` | Body: `{\"message\": str, \"request_id\": uuid}`<br>Header: `X-Request-ID: uuid` | Renders user message immediately; renders assistant message with source badges; updates conversation `updated_at` | **400:** Input validation alert.<br>**404:** Re-creates conversation.<br>**409:** Busy notification.<br>**429:** Starts countdown timer.<br>**500/503:** In-line error message. |\n179: | **Open Stats** | `GET /api/stats` | `GET` | Headers: standard | Populates modal with 6 metrics (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`) | Displays \"Statistics temporarily unavailable\" inside modal without disrupting chat |\n180: \n181: ---\n182: \n183: ## 6. Source Attribution & Citation Presentation\n184: \n185: Official document citations are vital for student confidence. Assistant responses will feature a dedicated source badge component:\n186: \n187: 1. **Source Pills**:\n188:    - If `sources` contains items (e.g. `[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]`):\n189:      - Renders a styled badge below the answer:\n190:        `ðŸ“„ Official Source: Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)`\n191:      - Clear visual separation from the main text with a subtle divider.\n192: 2. **Topic Precedence Clarifications**:\n193:    - For Doc 04 responses: clearly states `Source: Final Exam Rules (Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2)`.\n194:    - For Doc 01 responses: states `Source: Course Overview & Structure (Doc 01)`.\n195: 3. **Unsupported / Out-of-Scope Badges**:\n196:    - If `is_supported: false` (e.g. refund questions or Kubernetes trivia):\n197:      - Renders a neutral notice: `â„¹ï¸ Not Specified in Official Documents`.\n198: 4. **Duplicate / Replay Badges**:\n199:    - If response contains `is_duplicate: true` or `X-Duplicate-Request` header:\n200:      - Displays subtle metadata: `âš¡ Cached Response (Replayed)`.\n201: \n202: ---\n203: \n204: ## 7. Error Handling & Resilience Mechanics\n205: \n206: The UI handles all edge cases gracefully without exposing technical stack traces or crashing:\n207: \n208: 1. **Rate Limiting (HTTP 429)**:\n209:    - When the backend returns 429, it provides `retry_after` (in seconds).\n210:    - The frontend disables the send button and renders an alert banner:  \n211:      `â³ Rate limit reached. You can send another message in 12s.`\n212:    - A live JavaScript `setInterval` counts down each second (`11s... 10s... 1s`). When it hits 0, the input and button automatically re-enable.\n213: 2. **Concurrent Request Conflict (HTTP 409)**:\n214:    - If a student triggers an in-flight conflict:\n215:      `âš ï¸ A message is already being processed for this conversation. Please wait a moment.`\n216: 3. **Stale / Deleted Conversation (HTTP 404)**:\n217:    - If a conversation was deleted or wiped by a server restart:\n218:      `Conversation expired or reset. Starting a fresh conversation...`\n219:    - The UI automatically calls `createConversation()` and sends the message into the new conversation.\n220: 4. **Network Drop / Server Down**:\n221:    - If `fetch()` throws `TypeError: Failed to fetch`:\n222:      `ðŸ“¡ Connection lost. The server is unreachable. Please verify your internet or try again shortly.`\n223: 5. **Accidental Rapid Double-Click**:\n224:    - The send button is disabled immediately upon click, and re-enabled only after the response completes or errors out.\n225: \n226: ---\n227: \n228: ## 8. Gemini-generated responses are rendered using textContent or safe DOM escaping. innerHTML insertion of model-generated content is not used\"):\n232: \n233: - The frontend will implement a safe tokenizer function:\n234:   ```javascript\n235:   function renderSafeContent(container, rawText) {\n236:       container.replaceChildren(); // Clear existing content\n237:       const paragraphs = rawText.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/);\n238:       paragraphs.forEach(paraText => {\n239:           const p = document.createElement('p');\n240:           // Handle line breaks within paragraphs\n241:           const lines = paraText.split('\\n');\n242:           lines.forEach((line, idx) => {\n243:               if (idx > 0) p.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));\n244:               // Format simple bold (**text**) safely using DOM nodes\n245:               formatInlineSafe(p, line);\n246:           });\n247:           container.appendChild(p);\n248:       });\n249:   }\n250:   ```\n251: - **Zero Raw HTML Injection**: Model responses containing `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `onload=`, or malicious HTML entities are treated as plain text strings via `document.createTextNode()`, eliminating XSS vulnerabilities.\n252: \n253: ### 8.2 Client-Side Idempotency\n254: - Before sending `POST /messages`, `api.js` calls `crypto.randomUUID()` to generate an RFC 4122 v4 UUID.\n255: - Injected both as `X-Request-ID` header and `request_id` in the request body.\n256: \n257: ---\n258: \n259: ## 9. Live Statistics Drawer / Modal Integration\n260: \n261: To integrate the Module 9 `GET /api/stats` endpoint seamlessly:\n262: \n263: 1. **Trigger & Presentation**:\n264:    - A clean button in the top navigation bar: `ðŸ“Š Live Stats` with a status dot.\n265:    - Clicking opens a non-modal drawer or accessible `<dialog>` card.\n266: 2. **Displayed Metrics**:\n267:    - **Total Requests Received**: Numerical counter.\n268:    - **Cache Hits**: Number of queries served instantly from SQLite cache.\n269:    - **Gemini AI Invocations**: Number of actual LLM generation calls.\n270:    - **Errors Encountered**: Server error count.\n271:    - **Server Uptime**: Formatted as `X days, Y hrs, Z mins`.\n272:    - **Worker Note Disclaimer**: Displays the verbatim disclaimer:  \n273:      `\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"`\n274: 3. **Polling Strategy**:\n275:    - Fetched on initial drawer open.\n276:    - Refreshes automatically every 30 seconds **only** while the drawer/modal is open.\n277:    - Polling stops immediately when closed or when the browser tab is hidden (`document.visibilityState === 'hidden'`).\n278: 4. **Graceful Fallback**:\n279:    - If `/api/stats` returns 503 or fails, the drawer displays `\"Statistics currently unavailable\"` without affecting ongoing chat conversations.\n280: \n281: ---\n282: \n283: ## 10. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance)\n284: \n285: 1. **Semantic Structure**: Proper heading hierarchy (`<h1>` for app title, `<h2>` for chat landmarks).\n286: 2. **Keyboard Navigation**:\n287:    - Full navigation without a mouse using `Tab`, `Shift+Tab`, `Enter`, and `Escape`.\n288:    - `Escape` closes any open drawer, modal, or confirmation dialog.\n289:    - `Enter` in composer sends message; `Shift+Enter` inserts newline.\n290: 3. **Screen Reader Live Regions**:\n291:    - Message container has `role=\"log\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"`.\n292:    - Incoming assistant messages are announced automatically to assistive technology.\n293:    - Status updates (e.g. \"Assistant is typing...\") use `role=\"status\"` with `aria-atomic=\"true\"`.\n294: 4. **Color Contrast & Focus**:\n295:    - Contrast ratio for all text elements exceeds $4.5:1$ against backgrounds.\n296:    - Distinct 2px high-visibility outline on `:focus-visible` for keyboard users.\n297: \n298: ---\n299: \n300: ## 11. verify all 6 fields render accurately with the worker note.\n313: - [ ] **XSS Injection Test**: Send `<script>alert('xss')</script>` and `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>`; verify text renders as literal plain text without execution.\n314: - [ ] **Responsive Breakpoints**: Test on mobile ($375\\text{px}$), tablet ($768\\text{px}$), and desktop ($1280\\text{px}$); Implementation Task Checklist (Phase 2 Preview)\n326: \n327: | Task ID | Task Description | Target File |\n328: |---|---|---|\n329: | **T10.1** | Create semantic HTML structure with ARIA roles, landmarks, sidebar, message feed, and stats dialog. | `frontend/index.html` |\n330: | **T10.2** | Build modern, accessible CSS design system: variables, reset, layout grid, typography, focus styles. | `frontend/css/main.css` |\n331: | **T10.3** | Build chat-specific CSS: message bubbles, source pills, typing animation, drawer, toast alerts. | `frontend/css/chat.css` |\n332: | **T10.4** | Implement REST API client module wrapping all backend endpoints with error normalization. | `frontend/js/api.js` |\n333: | **T10.5** | Implement LocalStorage state persistence for active conversation ID and user preferences. | `frontend/js/storage.js` |\n334: | **T10.6** | Implement safe DOM rendering engine (safe text formatting, no innerHTML, auto-scroll, modals). | `frontend/js/ui.js` |\n335: | **T10.7** | Implement main controller: event handlers, lifecycle management, keyboard bindings, stats polling. | `frontend/js/app.js` |\n336: | **T10.8** | Create frontend static serving and integration test suite. | `tests/test_frontend_integration.py` |\n337: | **T10.9** | Execute complete regression suite across Modules 1â€“10 (target: 313 + new frontend tests passing). | Full Test Run |\n338: | **T10.10**| Update `README.md` with frontend usage instructions, responsive layout guide, and screenshots. | `README.md` |\n339: \n340: ---\n341: \n342: ## 13. Acceptance Criteria\n343: \n344: 1. **Design Quality**: Clean, modern, responsive interface branded for IIMBx DPM-101.\n345: 2. **Functional Completeness**: Students can create, switch, and delete conversations, send messages, and review history.\n346: 3. **Source Transparency**: Clear attribution badges for Doc 01, Doc 03, and Doc 04 on every grounded answer.\n347: 4. **Resilience**: Polite, informative error messages for 400, 404, 409, 429 (with countdown), and 500 errors.\n348: 5. **Security**: Zero `innerHTML` insertion of untrusted data; zero Gemini API key exposure in browser.\n349: 6. **Live Stats**: Seamless display of `GET /api/stats` metrics with worker note.\n350: 7. **Zero Backend Regressions**: All 313 existing backend tests pass without modification."}

Loading states, source citations, follow-up indicator, error display. | Modular HTML/CSS/JS architecture served directly by Flask from `frontend/`. | Browser functional testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile. |\n| **Security Â§11.3 (XSS Defense)** | Safe text rendering via `textContent` or safe DOM text nodes; strictly **no `innerHTML`** insertion of model-generated output. | Safe DOM tree builder that formats paragraphs, bullet lists, and bold text using `document.createElement` and `document.createTextNode`. | Security inspection & automated XSS payload test suite. |\n| **Chat Management (Module 6)** | Full lifecycle: conversation creation, switching, history retrieval, deletion, and context-aware follow-ups. | Complete sidebar conversation list, active conversation switching, chronological message feed, and explicit delete action. | E2E functional test of conversation flows. |\n| **Request Management (Module 8)** | Idempotency keys (`X-Request-ID`), duplicate detection, duplicate replay, and per-IP / per-conversation rate limiting. | `crypto.randomUUID()` with fallback, matching header and body `request_id`, duplicate replay handling, and live 429 countdown timer. | Rapid double-click and simulated duplicate/rate-limit verification. |\n| **Statistics & Counters (Module 9)** | Read-only integration of `GET /api/stats` without disrupting chat. | Accessible modal/drawer fetching all 6 operational fields every 30s only while open, with non-interfering graceful degradation. | Stats modal inspection and network traffic analysis. |\n| **Policy Accuracy (Module 5)** | Attribution to official documents (Doc 01, Doc 03, Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2) and clear unsupported topic rejection. | Dynamic source pills rendered only when returned by backend; multi-source support; distinct styling for unsupported answers. | Visual and schema inspection across official question set. |\n\n---\n\n## 2. `app.py`.\n\n### 2.1 Route Map & Endpoint 2.2 Deep Endpoint Specifications\n\n#### 1. System Health Check\n- **Route:** `GET /health`\n- **Headers:** None\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"status\": \"healthy\",\n    \"service\": \"DPM-101 Helpdesk Chatbot\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Behavior:** Server down or reverse proxy error (502/503/504).\n- **Frontend Use:** Verifies backend connectivity on initial page load; displays subtle status dot (`â— Online` / `â—‹ Offline`).\n\n#### 2. Create Conversation\n- **Route:** `POST /api/v1/conversations`\n- **Request Body:** None (or `{}`)\n- **Success Response (HTTP 201 Created):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n    \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n    \"status\": \"active\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response:** HTTP 500 `{\"error\": \"Internal server error\"}`.\n- **Frontend Use:** Called when user clicks \"+ New Chat\", or on initial visit if no active conversation exists in `localStorage`.\n\n#### 3. List Conversations\n- **Route:** `GET /api/v1/conversations?limit={limit}&offset={offset}`\n- **Query Parameters:**\n  - `limit`: Integer, default `50`, clamped between `1` and `200`.\n  - `offset`: Integer, default `0`, clamped $\\ge 0$.\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversations\": [\n      {\n        \"id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n        \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:20:10.654321+00:00\",\n        \"status\": \"active\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n  ```\n- **Ordering:** Sorted chronologically descending by `updated_at DESC`.\n- **Frontend Use:** Populates the sidebar conversation history list.\n\n#### 4. Get Conversation Details\n- **Route:** `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}`\n- **Path Parameter:** `conversation_id` (pre-validated UUID v4 string).\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n    \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:20:10.654321+00:00\",\n    \"status\": \"active\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 404 Not Found):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Conversation not found\"\n  }\n  ```\n\n#### 5. Delete Conversation\n- **Route:** `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}`\n- **Path Parameter:** `conversation_id` (pre-validated UUID v4 string).\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"success\": true,\n    \"message\": \"Conversation deleted successfully\",\n    \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 404 Not Found):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Conversation not found\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Frontend Use:** Triggered by the delete button on sidebar chat items; removes conversation from UI and purges its stored messages in SQLite.\n\n#### 6. Get Message History\n- **Route:** `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages?limit={limit}&offset={offset}`\n- **Query Parameters:**\n  - `limit`: Integer, default `100`, clamped between `1` and `500`.\n  - `offset`: Integer, default `0`, clamped $\\ge 0$.\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"messages\": [\n      {\n        \"id\": \"msg-001\",\n        \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n        \"role\": \"user\",\n        \"content\": \"What is the passing score?\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:35.000000+00:00\",\n        \"sources\": null\n      },\n      {\n        \"id\": \"msg-002\",\n        \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n        \"role\": \"assistant\",\n        \"content\": \"To pass the course, you must achieve an overall weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in the proctored final exam.\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:37.000000+00:00\",\n        \"sources\": [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 404 Not Found):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Conversation not found\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Key Schema Details:**\n  - Messages are returned in deterministic chronological order (`created_at ASC, rowid ASC`).\n  - User messages have `sources: null`.\n  - Assistant messages have `sources: list[str]` (or `null` if no sources were recorded).\n\n#### 7. Send Message & Receive Response\n- **Route:** `POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages`\n- **Request Headers:**\n  - `Content-Type: application/json`\n  - `X-Request-ID: <uuid-v4>` (optional, but generated by client)\n- **Request Body:**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"message\": \"What is the penalty for late submission?\",\n    \"request_id\": \"<uuid-v4>\"\n  }\n  ```\n  *(Rule: If both `X-Request-ID` header and body `request_id` are provided, they must be strictly identical.)*\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK â€” Normal Processing):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"message_id\": \"msg-004\",\n    \"role\": \"assistant\",\n    \"content\": \"Late submissions are no longer accepted for weekly quizzes or the capstone case...\",\n    \"sources\": [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"],\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:16:10.000000+00:00\",\n    \"is_in_scope\": true,\n    \"is_supported\": true,\n    \"is_duplicate\": false\n  }\n  ```\n- **Duplicate Replay Response (HTTP 200 OK â€” Idempotent Duplicate Replay):**\n  - Response Header: `X-Duplicate-Request: true`\n  - Response Body: Same structure as above, with `\"is_duplicate\": true`.\n- **Error Responses:**\n  - **HTTP 400 Bad Request:**\n    - Non-JSON body: `{\"error\": \"Request body must be valid JSON\"}`\n    - Missing message: `{\"error\": \"Field 'message' is required\"}`\n    - Empty message: `{\"error\": \"Message cannot be empty or whitespace only\"}`\n    - Message > 4000 characters: `{\"error\": \"Message exceeds maximum allowed length of 4000 characters\"}`\n    - Invalid UUID format: `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"INVALID_REQUEST_ID\"}`\n    - Header/body mismatch: `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"MISMATCHED_REQUEST_ID\"}`\n  - **HTTP 404 Not Found:**\n    - `{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}` (or deleted)\n  - **HTTP 409 Conflict:**\n    - In-flight lock: `{\"error\": \"A message is already being processed for this conversation. Please wait.\", \"code\": \"CONVERSATION_BUSY\"}`\n    - Idempotency conflict: `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT\"}` (same request ID used with different query)\n  - **HTTP 429 Too Many Requests (Rate Limited):**\n    - Response Header: `Retry-After: <integer-seconds>` (e.g. `15`)\n    - Response Body:\n      ```json\n      {\n        \"error\": \"Rate limit exceeded. Please wait before sending another message.\",\n        \"code\": \"RATE_LIMITED\",\n        \"retry_after\": 15\n      }\n      ```\n  - **HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout:**\n    - `{\"error\": \"Timed out waiting for in-flight request\", \"code\": \"IN_FLIGHT_TIMEOUT\"}`\n  - **HTTP 500 Internal Server Error:**\n    - `{\"error\": \"Internal server error processing message\"}`\n\n#### 8. Operational Statistics\n- **Route:** `GET /api/stats`\n- **Method Restriction:** Strictly `GET` (non-GET returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed).\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"total_requests\": 142,\n    \"cache_hits\": 58,\n    \"gemini_calls\": 84,\n    \"errors\": 1,\n    \"uptime_seconds\": 18450,\n    \"worker_note\": \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 503 Service Unavailable):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Failed to retrieve statistics\",\n    \"code\": \"STATS_UNAVAILABLE\"\n  }\n  ```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Refined Conversation Recovery (Correction 1)\n\n### 3.1 Strict Prohibition of Silent Auto-Resending\nThe v1 proposal to automatically create a new conversation and resend the user's message upon HTTP 404 is **completely removed**.\n- **Reason:** Silent resubmission creates unexpected conversations, risks duplicate billing/processing, and masks server resets or state loss from the student.\n\n### 3.2 Corrected Recovery Flow\nWhen a message submission or message history load returns **HTTP 404**:\n\n```\nStudent Sends Message\n         â”‚\n         â–¼\nPOST /conversations/{id}/messages\n         â”‚\n   HTTP 404 Received\n         â”‚\n         â”œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\n         â–¼                                                                        â–¼\n1. Preserve User Text                                                  2. Display Prominent Banner\n   - Keep message intact in input composer                               - Clear, honest alert message:\n   - Ensure student does NOT lose their typing                             \"This conversation is no longer available\n                                                                            on the server. It may have expired or been\n                                                                            reset.\"\n                                                                         - Offer explicit action:\n                                                                           [Start New Chat] button\n         â”‚\n         â–¼\n3. Student Clicks [Start New Chat]\n   - Frontend calls POST /api/v1/conversations\n   - Saves new conversation ID to state and localStorage\n   - Composer retains the student's text, ready for user review and manual send\n   - Never implies deleted conversation history can be recovered\n```\n\n### 3.3 UI Implementation Details\n1. **Preserved Input State:** If `POST /messages` fails with 404:\n   - The textarea content is **not** cleared.\n   - The composer is re-enabled so the student can edit or keep the text.\n2. **Error Banner:**\n   ```html\n   <div class=\"alert-banner alert-warning\" role=\"alert\">\n     <span class=\"alert-icon\">âš ï¸</span>\n     <div class=\"alert-content\">\n       <strong>Conversation Unavailable</strong>\n       <p>This conversation is no longer active on the server. Your message has been preserved below.</p>\n     </div>\n     <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-secondary btn-sm\" id=\"btn-recover-new-chat\">Start New Chat</button>\n   </div>\n   ```\n3. **No Silent Network Calls:** No background `createConversation` or automatic message re-dispatch is executed. The user retains full control.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Grounded Source Attribution (Correction 2)\n\n### 4.1 Schema Inspection from Backend\nFrom `backend/services/policy_service.py` (`PolicyAnswer`) and `backend/services/chat_service.py` (`save_assistant_message`):\n- `sources` is a Python `list[str]` containing unique document titles extracted from evidence chunks via `_get_unique_sources()`.\n- Example authoritative sources:\n  - `\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"` (Doc 03)\n  - `\"Course Handbook & Overview\"` (Doc 01)\n  - `\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\"` (Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2)\n- Unsupported answers (e.g. questions regarding refund policies, faculty offices, or out-of-scope subjects):\n  - `sources` is `[]` (empty list)\n  - `is_supported` is `false`\n  - `is_in_scope` is `true` or `false`\n\n### 4.2 Rendering Rules\n\n```\n                       Assistant Response Received\n                                   â”‚\n                                   â–¼\n                       Check `sources` property\n                                   â”‚\n         â”Œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”´â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\n         â–¼                                                   â–¼\n`sources` has 1 or more items                    `sources` is empty / null\n         â”‚                                                   â”‚\n         â–¼                                                   â–¼\nRender Source Badges Container                 Check `is_supported` flag\nFor each source in `sources`:                                â”‚\n  - Create `<span class=\"source-badge\">`        â”Œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”´â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\n  - Text: `ðŸ“„ Official Source: ${source}`      â–¼                         â–¼\n                                       is_supported === false    is_supported === true\n                                                â”‚                         â”‚\n                                                â–¼                         â–¼\n                                       Render Notice:            No badge rendered\n                                       \"Information not          (graceful omission)\n                                       specified in official\n                                       course documents.\"\n```\n\n### 4.3 Strict Formatting Standards\n1. **Multi-Source Support:** If the backend references multiple documents (e.g. Doc 01 and Doc 03 for a combined question), each source gets its own badge.\n2. **No Hardcoded Badges:** The UI never injects a default or fallback source badge if `sources` is empty.\n3. **Never Fabricate Citations:** If a document title is not explicitly present in the `sources` array, the frontend will never invent or guess a citation.\n4. **Unsupported Notice:** If `is_supported === false`, display a distinct status pill:\n   ```html\n   <div class=\"response-unsupported-note\" role=\"note\">\n     <span class=\"note-icon\">â„¹ï¸</span>\n     <span>Information not specified in official course documents.</span>\n   </div>\n   ```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Frontend Security & Safe Rendering (Correction 4)\n\n### 5.1 Strict XSS Defense (Zero `innerHTML`)\nTo satisfy Architecture Specification Â§11.3 without exception:\n- **Rule:** The frontend will **never** assign untrusted backend content (assistant responses, user messages, conversation titles, source titles, or error strings) to `element.innerHTML`.\n- **Implementation:** All text is inserted via `document.createTextNode` or `element.textContent`.\n- **Formatting Engine (`ui.js`):**\n  ```javascript\n  /**\n   * Safely renders structured text into a container DOM element using\n   * native DOM nodes only. Eliminates XSS risks completely.\n   */\n  function renderSafeContent(container, rawText) {\n      container.replaceChildren(); // Safe DOM clear\n      if (!rawText) return;\n\n      // Split into paragraphs by blank lines\n      const paragraphs = rawText.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/);\n      for (const para of paragraphs) {\n          const trimmed = para.trim();\n          if (!trimmed) continue;\n\n          // Check if paragraph is a bullet list\n          const lines = trimmed.split('\\n');\n          const isList = lines.every(l => /^\\s*[-*â€¢]\\s+/.test(l));\n\n          if (isList) {\n              const ul = document.createElement('ul');\n              ul.className = 'content-list';\n              for (const line of lines) {\n                  const li = document.createElement('li');\n                  const itemText = line.replace(/^\\s*[-*â€¢]\\s+/, '');\n                  renderInlineFormatting(li, itemText);\n                  ul.appendChild(li);\n              }\n              container.appendChild(ul);\n          } else {\n              const p = document.createElement('p');\n              p.className = 'content-para';\n              lines.forEach((line, idx) => {\n                  if (idx > 0) p.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));\n                  renderInlineFormatting(p, line);\n              });\n              container.appendChild(p);\n          }\n      }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Safe inline tokenizer for bold (**text**) without innerHTML.\n   */\n  function renderInlineFormatting(parent, text) {\n      const parts = text.split(/(\\*\\*[^*]+\\*\\*)/g);\n      for (const part of parts) {\n          if (part.startsWith('**') && part.endsWith('**') && part.length > 4) {\n              const strong = document.createElement('strong');\n              strong.textContent = part.slice(2, -2);\n              parent.appendChild(strong);\n          } else if (part) {\n              parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(part));\n          }\n      }\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 5.2 Zero API Key Exposure\n- No Gemini API key, secret token, or bearer credential is ever sent to or stored in the browser.\n- All requests communicate with local Flask endpoints (`/api/...`).\n- Environment variables remain server-side only.\n\n### 5.3 URL Parameter Validation\n- Before interpolating a `conversation_id` into a fetch path (e.g. `/api/v1/conversations/${id}/messages`), `api.js` verifies the ID against the standard UUID v4 format:\n  ```javascript\n  const UUID_V4_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;\n\n  function isValidUUID(id) {\n      return typeof id === 'string' && UUID_V4_REGEX.test(id);\n  }\n  ```\n  If invalid, the call is rejected immediately on the client side with a client validation error, preventing path traversal or injection.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Request Management, Idempotency & Rate Limiting (Correction 5)\n\n### 6.1 UUID Generation with Robust Fallback\nTo ensure compatibility across modern browsers, legacy devices, and non-secure HTTP testing contexts:\n```javascript\n/**\n * Generate RFC 4122 v4 UUID with crypto fallback.\n */\nfunction generateUUID() {\n    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {\n        try {\n            return crypto.randomUUID();\n        } catch (_) {\n            // Fall through if restricted\n        }\n    }\n    // RFC 4122 v4 compliant math fallback\n    return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {\n        const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;\n        const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;\n        return v.toString(16);\n    });\n}\n```\n\n### 6.2 Idempotency Key Consistency\n- **Rule:** For every `POST /messages` request, the generated UUID is passed **identically** in:\n  1. Header: `X-Request-ID: <uuid>`\n  2. Request body: `{\"request_id\": \"<uuid>\"}`\n- **Retry Logic:**\n  - If a message request fails due to network drop or timeout and the user clicks **Retry**, the client re-submits the **exact same `request_id`**. This allows the backend `RequestManager` to safely match in-flight requests or replay cached results without creating duplicate turns.\n  - When the user sends a **new** message, a brand-new UUID is generated.\n\n### 6.3 Duplicate Replay Deduplication\n- When the backend returns a duplicate response:\n  - Header: `X-Duplicate-Request: true`\n  - Body: `is_duplicate: true`\n- The frontend inspects `message_id`:\n  - If a message bubble with this `message_id` already exists in the DOM, the UI does **not** append a second bubble.\n  - If it is not yet rendered (e.g. page refreshed during in-flight processing), it renders the message with a subtle pill: `âš¡ Replayed Response`.\n\n### 6.4 HTTP 429 Rate-Limit Handling (Countdown Timer)\n- When the backend responds with HTTP 429:\n  - The client parses `retry_after` from the JSON response body (`data.retry_after`) or falls back to parsing the `Retry-After` header as an integer.\n  - The UI locks the input composer and starts an active second-by-second countdown timer:\n    ```\n    â³ Rate limit active. Please wait 15 seconds before sending another message.\n    ```\n  - When the countdown reaches `0`, the timer automatically clears, the warning banner disappears, and the composer is re-enabled.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Live Statistics Integration (Correction 6)\n\n### 7.1 Verified Operational Fields\nThe live statistics modal fetches `GET /api/stats` and presents the exact 6 fields defined in the approved Module 9 contract:\n\n| Key | Type | Label in UI | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `total_requests` | `int` | Total Queries | Total valid chat message requests processed. |\n| `cache_hits` | `int` | Cache Hits | Queries resolved instantly from SQLite cache. |\n| `gemini_calls` | `int` | AI Invocations | Real Gemini model generation calls made. |\n| `errors` | `int` | System Errors | Server or model error count. |\n| `uptime_seconds` | `int` | Server Uptime | Formatted as `Xh Ym Zs` or `Xd Xh`. |\n| `worker_note` | `str` | Operational Note | Displayed verbatim: *\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"* |\n\n### 7.2 Non-Interference Architecture\n1. **Isolated Execution:** Stats fetching executes independently via `api.fetchStats()`. It never shares state with the chat message pipeline or conversation store.\n2. **Open-Only Polling:**\n   - Stats are fetched only when the user opens the stats modal/drawer.\n   - An interval polls every 30 seconds **only** while the modal is visible.\n   - If the modal is closed or the document becomes hidden (`document.visibilityState !== 'visible'`), the interval is immediately cleared via `clearInterval()`.\n3. **Graceful Degradation:**\n   - If `/api/stats` returns HTTP 503 or network fails, an inline message is shown inside the modal:  \n     `\"Statistics temporarily unavailable\"`.\n   - The error is isolated to the modal; it never triggers alerts or affects chat functionality.\n\n---\n\n## 8. 2.2 Deep Endpoint Specifications\n\n#### 1. System Health Check\n- **Route:** `GET /health`\n- **Headers:** None\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"status\": \"healthy\",\n    \"service\": \"DPM-101 Helpdesk Chatbot\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Behavior:** Server down or reverse proxy error (502/503/504).\n- **Frontend Use:** Verifies backend connectivity on initial page load; displays subtle status dot (`â— Online` / `â—‹ Offline`).\n\n#### 2. Create Conversation\n- **Route:** `POST /api/v1/conversations`\n- **Request Body:** None (or `{}`)\n- **Success Response (HTTP 201 Created):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n    \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n    \"status\": \"active\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response:** HTTP 500 `{\"error\": \"Internal server error\"}`.\n- **Frontend Use:** Called when user clicks \"+ New Chat\", or on initial visit if no active conversation exists in `localStorage`.\n\n#### 3. List Conversations\n- **Route:** `GET /api/v1/conversations?limit={limit}&offset={offset}`\n- **Query Parameters:**\n  - `limit`: Integer, default `50`, clamped between `1` and `200`.\n  - `offset`: Integer, default `0`, clamped $\\ge 0$.\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversations\": [\n      {\n        \"id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n        \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:20:10.654321+00:00\",\n        \"status\": \"active\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n  ```\n- **Ordering:** Sorted chronologically descending by `updated_at DESC`.\n- **Frontend Use:** Populates the sidebar conversation history list.\n\n#### 4. Get Conversation Details\n- **Route:** `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}`\n- **Path Parameter:** `conversation_id` (pre-validated UUID v4 string).\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:30.123456+00:00\",\n    \"updated_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:20:10.654321+00:00\",\n    \"status\": \"active\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 404 Not Found):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Conversation not found\"\n  }\n  ```\n\n#### 5. Delete Conversation\n- **Route:** `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}`\n- **Path Parameter:** `conversation_id` (pre-validated UUID v4 string).\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"success\": true,\n    \"message\": \"Conversation deleted successfully\",\n    \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 404 Not Found):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Conversation not found\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Frontend Use:** Triggered by the delete button on sidebar chat items; removes conversation from UI and purges its stored messages in SQLite.\n\n#### 6. Get Message History\n- **Route:** `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages?limit={limit}&offset={offset}`\n- **Query Parameters:**\n  - `limit`: Integer, default `100`, clamped between `1` and `500`.\n  - `offset`: Integer, default `0`, clamped $\\ge 0$.\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"messages\": [\n      {\n        \"id\": \"msg-001\",\n        \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n        \"role\": \"user\",\n        \"content\": \"What is the passing score?\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:35.000000+00:00\",\n        \"sources\": null\n      },\n      {\n        \"id\": \"msg-002\",\n        \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n        \"role\": \"assistant\",\n        \"content\": \"To pass the course, you must achieve an overall weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in the proctored final exam.\",\n        \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:15:37.000000+00:00\",\n        \"sources\": [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 404 Not Found):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Conversation not found\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Key Schema Details:**\n  - Messages are returned in deterministic chronological order (`created_at ASC, rowid ASC`).\n  - User messages have `sources: null`.\n  - Assistant messages have `sources: list[str]` (or `null` if no sources were recorded).\n\n#### 7. Send Message & Receive Response\n- **Route:** `POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages`\n- **Request Headers:**\n  - `Content-Type: application/json`\n  - `X-Request-ID: <uuid-v4>` (optional, but generated by client)\n- **Request Body:**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"message\": \"What is the penalty for late submission?\",\n    \"request_id\": \"<uuid-v4>\"\n  }\n  ```\n  *(Rule: If both `X-Request-ID` header and body `request_id` are provided, they must be strictly identical.)*\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK â€” Normal Processing):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n    \"message_id\": \"msg-004\",\n    \"role\": \"assistant\",\n    \"content\": \"Late submissions are no longer accepted for weekly quizzes or the capstone case...\",\n    \"sources\": [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"],\n    \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:16:10.000000+00:00\",\n    \"is_in_scope\": true,\n    \"is_supported\": true,\n    \"is_duplicate\": false\n  }\n  ```\n- **Duplicate Replay Response (HTTP 200 OK â€” Idempotent Duplicate Replay):**\n  - Response Header: `X-Duplicate-Request: true`\n  - Response Body: Same structure as above, with `\"is_duplicate\": true`.\n- **Error Responses:**\n  - **HTTP 400 Bad Request:**\n    - Non-JSON body: `{\"error\": \"Request body must be valid JSON\"}`\n    - Missing message: `{\"error\": \"Field 'message' is required\"}`\n    - Empty message: `{\"error\": \"Message cannot be empty or whitespace only\"}`\n    - Message > 4000 characters: `{\"error\": \"Message exceeds maximum allowed length of 4000 characters\"}`\n    - Invalid UUID format: `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"INVALID_REQUEST_ID\"}`\n    - Header/body mismatch: `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"MISMATCHED_REQUEST_ID\"}`\n  - **HTTP 404 Not Found:**\n    - `{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}` (or deleted)\n  - **HTTP 409 Conflict:**\n    - In-flight lock: `{\"error\": \"A message is already being processed for this conversation. Please wait.\", \"code\": \"CONVERSATION_BUSY\"}`\n    - Idempotency conflict: `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT\"}` (same request ID used with different query)\n  - **HTTP 429 Too Many Requests (Rate Limited):**\n    - Response Header: `Retry-After: <integer-seconds>` (e.g. `15`)\n    - Response Body:\n      ```json\n      {\n        \"error\": \"Rate limit exceeded. Please wait before sending another message.\",\n        \"code\": \"RATE_LIMITED\",\n        \"retry_after\": 15\n      }\n      ```\n  - **HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout:**\n    - `{\"error\": \"Timed out waiting for in-flight request\", \"code\": \"IN_FLIGHT_TIMEOUT\"}`\n  - **HTTP 500 Internal Server Error:**\n    - `{\"error\": \"Internal server error processing message\"}`\n\n#### 8. Operational Statistics\n- **Route:** `GET /api/stats`\n- **Method Restriction:** Strictly `GET` (non-GET returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed).\n- **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"total_requests\": 142,\n    \"cache_hits\": 58,\n    \"gemini_calls\": 84,\n    \"errors\": 1,\n    \"uptime_seconds\": 18450,\n    \"worker_note\": \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"\n  }\n  ```\n- **Error Response (HTTP 503 Service Unavailable):**\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"error\": \"Failed to retrieve statistics\",\n    \"code\": \"STATS_UNAVAILABLE\"\n  }\n  ```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Refined Conversation Recovery (Correction 1)\n\n### 3.1 Strict Prohibition of Silent Auto-Resending\nThe v1 proposal to automatically create a new conversation and resend the user's message upon HTTP 404 is **completely removed**.\n- **Reason:** Silent resubmission creates unexpected conversations, risks duplicate billing/processing, and masks server resets or state loss from the student.\n\n### 3.2 Corrected Recovery Flow\nWhen a message submission or message history load returns **HTTP 404**:\n\n```\nStudent Sends Message\n         â”‚\n         â–¼\nPOST /conversations/{id}/messages\n         â”‚\n   HTTP 404 Received\n         â”‚\n         â”œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\n         â–¼                                                                        â–¼\n1. Preserve User Text                                                  2. Display Prominent Banner\n   - Keep message intact in input composer                               - Clear, honest alert message:\n   - Ensure student does NOT lose their typing                             \"This conversation is no longer available\n                                                                            on the server. It may have expired or been\n                                                                            reset.\"\n                                                                         - Offer explicit action:\n                                                                           [Start New Chat] button\n         â”‚\n         â–¼\n3. Student Clicks [Start New Chat]\n   - Frontend calls POST /api/v1/conversations\n   - Saves new conversation ID to state and localStorage\n   - Composer retains the student's text, ready for user review and manual send\n   - Never implies deleted conversation history can be recovered\n```\n\n### 3.3 UI Implementation Details\n1. **Preserved Input State:** If `POST /messages` fails with 404:\n   - The textarea content is **not** cleared.\n   - The composer is re-enabled so the student can edit or keep the text.\n2. **Error Banner:**\n   ```html\n   <div class=\"alert-banner alert-warning\" role=\"alert\">\n     <span class=\"alert-icon\">âš ï¸</span>\n     <div class=\"alert-content\">\n       <strong>Conversation Unavailable</strong>\n       <p>This conversation is no longer active on the server. Your message has been preserved below.</p>\n     </div>\n     <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-secondary btn-sm\" id=\"btn-recover-new-chat\">Start New Chat</button>\n   </div>\n   ```\n3. **No Silent Network Calls:** No background `createConversation` or automatic message re-dispatch is executed. The user retains full control.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Grounded Source Attribution (Correction 2)\n\n### 4.1 Schema Inspection from Backend\nFrom `backend/services/policy_service.py` (`PolicyAnswer`) and `backend/services/chat_service.py` (`save_assistant_message`):\n- `sources` is a Python `list[str]` containing unique document titles extracted from evidence chunks via `_get_unique_sources()`.\n- Example authoritative sources:\n  - `\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"` (Doc 03)\n  - `\"Course Handbook & Overview\"` (Doc 01)\n  - `\"Final Exam Rules & Student Forum Excerpts\"` (Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2)\n- Unsupported answers (e.g. questions regarding refund policies, faculty offices, or out-of-scope subjects):\n  - `sources` is `[]` (empty list)\n  - `is_supported` is `false`\n  - `is_in_scope` is `true` or `false`\n\n### 4.2 Rendering Rules\n\n```\n                       Assistant Response Received\n                                   â”‚\n                                   â–¼\n                       Check `sources` property\n                                   â”‚\n         â”Œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”´â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\n         â–¼                                                   â–¼\n`sources` has 1 or more items                    `sources` is empty / null\n         â”‚                                                   â”‚\n         â–¼                                                   â–¼\nRender Source Badges Container                 Check `is_supported` flag\nFor each source in `sources`:                                â”‚\n  - Create `<span class=\"source-badge\">`        â”Œâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”´â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”\n  - Text: `ðŸ“„ Official Source: ${source}`      â–¼                         â–¼\n                                       is_supported === false    is_supported === true\n                                                â”‚                         â”‚\n                                                â–¼                         â–¼\n                                       Render Notice:            No badge rendered\n                                       \"Information not          (graceful omission)\n                                       specified in official\n                                       course documents.\"\n```\n\n### 4.3 Strict Formatting Standards\n1. **Multi-Source Support:** If the backend references multiple documents (e.g. Doc 01 and Doc 03 for a combined question), each source gets its own badge.\n2. **No Hardcoded Badges:** The UI never injects a default or fallback source badge if `sources` is empty.\n3. **Never Fabricate Citations:** If a document title is not explicitly present in the `sources` array, the frontend will never invent or guess a citation.\n4. **Unsupported Notice:** If `is_supported === false`, display a distinct status pill:\n   ```html\n   <div class=\"response-unsupported-note\" role=\"note\">\n     <span class=\"note-icon\">â„¹ï¸</span>\n     <span>Information not specified in official course documents.</span>\n   </div>\n   ```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Frontend Security & Safe Rendering (Correction 4)\n\n### 5.1 Strict XSS Defense (Zero `innerHTML`)\nTo satisfy Architecture Specification Â§11.3 without exception:\n- **Rule:** The frontend will **never** assign untrusted backend content (assistant responses, user messages, conversation titles, source titles, or error strings) to `element.innerHTML`.\n- **Implementation:** All text is inserted via `document.createTextNode` or `element.textContent`.\n- **Formatting Engine (`ui.js`):**\n  ```javascript\n  /**\n   * Safely renders structured text into a container DOM element using\n   * native DOM nodes only. Eliminates XSS risks completely.\n   */\n  function renderSafeContent(container, rawText) {\n      container.replaceChildren(); // Safe DOM clear\n      if (!rawText) return;\n\n      // Split into paragraphs by blank lines\n      const paragraphs = rawText.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/);\n      for (const para of paragraphs) {\n          const trimmed = para.trim();\n          if (!trimmed) continue;\n\n          // Check if paragraph is a bullet list\n          const lines = trimmed.split('\\n');\n          const isList = lines.every(l => /^\\s*[-*â€¢]\\s+/.test(l));\n\n          if (isList) {\n              const ul = document.createElement('ul');\n              ul.className = 'content-list';\n              for (const line of lines) {\n                  const li = document.createElement('li');\n                  const itemText = line.replace(/^\\s*[-*â€¢]\\s+/, '');\n                  renderInlineFormatting(li, itemText);\n                  ul.appendChild(li);\n              }\n              container.appendChild(ul);\n          } else {\n              const p = document.createElement('p');\n              p.className = 'content-para';\n              lines.forEach((line, idx) => {\n                  if (idx > 0) p.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));\n                  renderInlineFormatting(p, line);\n              });\n              container.appendChild(p);\n          }\n      }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Safe inline tokenizer for bold (**text**) without innerHTML.\n   */\n  function renderInlineFormatting(parent, text) {\n      const parts = text.split(/(\\*\\*[^*]+\\*\\*)/g);\n      for (const part of parts) {\n          if (part.startsWith('**') && part.endsWith('**') && part.length > 4) {\n              const strong = document.createElement('strong');\n              strong.textContent = part.slice(2, -2);\n              parent.appendChild(strong);\n          } else if (part) {\n              parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(part));\n          }\n      }\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 5.2 Zero API Key Exposure\n- No Gemini API key, secret token, or bearer credential is ever sent to or stored in the browser.\n- All requests communicate with local Flask endpoints (`/api/...`).\n- Environment variables remain server-side only.\n\n### 5.3 URL Parameter Validation\n- Before interpolating a `conversation_id` into a fetch path (e.g. `/api/v1/conversations/${id}/messages`), `api.js` verifies the ID against the standard UUID v4 format:\n  ```javascript\n  const UUID_V4_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;\n\n  function isValidUUID(id) {\n      return typeof id === 'string' && UUID_V4_REGEX.test(id);\n  }\n  ```\n  If invalid, the call is rejected immediately on the client side with a client validation error, preventing path traversal or injection.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Request Management, Idempotency & Rate Limiting (Correction 5)\n\n### 6.1 UUID Generation with Robust Fallback\nTo ensure compatibility across modern browsers, legacy devices, and non-secure HTTP testing contexts:\n```javascript\n/**\n * Generate RFC 4122 v4 UUID with crypto fallback.\n */\nfunction generateUUID() {\n    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {\n        try {\n            return crypto.randomUUID();\n        } catch (_) {\n            // Fall through if restricted\n        }\n    }\n    // RFC 4122 v4 compliant math fallback\n    return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {\n        const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;\n        const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;\n        return v.toString(16);\n    });\n}\n```\n\n### 6.2 Idempotency Key Consistency\n- **Rule:** For every `POST /messages` request, the generated UUID is passed **identically** in:\n  1. Header: `X-Request-ID: <uuid>`\n  2. Request body: `{\"request_id\": \"<uuid>\"}`\n- **Retry Logic:**\n  - If a message request fails due to network drop or timeout and the user clicks **Retry**, the client re-submits the **exact same `request_id`**. This allows the backend `RequestManager` to safely match in-flight requests or replay cached results without creating duplicate turns.\n  - When the user sends a **new** message, a brand-new UUID is generated.\n\n### 6.3 Duplicate Replay Deduplication\n- When the backend returns a duplicate response:\n  - Header: `X-Duplicate-Request: true`\n  - Body: `is_duplicate: true`\n- The frontend inspects `message_id`:\n  - If a message bubble with this `message_id` already exists in the DOM, the UI does **not** append a second bubble.\n  - If it is not yet rendered (e.g. page refreshed during in-flight processing), it renders the message with a subtle pill: `âš¡ Replayed Response`.\n\n### 6.4 HTTP 429 Rate-Limit Handling (Countdown Timer)\n- When the backend responds with HTTP 429:\n  - The client parses `retry_after` from the JSON response body (`data.retry_after`) or falls back to parsing the `Retry-After` header as an integer.\n  - The UI locks the input composer and starts an active second-by-second countdown timer:\n    ```\n    â³ Rate limit active. Please wait 15 seconds before sending another message.\n    ```\n  - When the countdown reaches `0`, the timer automatically clears, the warning banner disappears, and the composer is re-enabled.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Live Statistics Integration (Correction 6)\n\n### 7.1 Verified Operational Fields\nThe live statistics modal fetches `GET /api/stats` and presents the exact 6 fields defined in the approved Module 9 contract:\n\n| Key | Type | Label in UI | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `total_requests` | `int` | Total Queries | Total valid chat message requests processed. |\n| `cache_hits` | `int` | Cache Hits | Queries resolved instantly from SQLite cache. |\n| `gemini_calls` | `int` | AI Invocations | Real Gemini model generation calls made. |\n| `errors` | `int` | System Errors | Server or model error count. |\n| `uptime_seconds` | `int` | Server Uptime | Formatted as `Xh Ym Zs` or `Xd Xh`. |\n| `worker_note` | `str` | Operational Note | Displayed verbatim: *\"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"* |\n\n### 7.2 Non-Interference Architecture\n1. **Isolated Execution:** Stats fetching executes independently via `api.fetchStats()`. It never shares state with the chat message pipeline or conversation store.\n2. **Open-Only Polling:**\n   - Stats are fetched only when the user opens the stats modal/drawer.\n   - An interval polls every 30 seconds **only** while the modal is visible.\n   - If the modal is closed or the document becomes hidden (`document.visibilityState !== 'visible'`), the interval is immediately cleared via `clearInterval()`.\n3. **Graceful Degradation:**\n   - If `/api/stats` returns HTTP 503 or network fails, an inline message is shown inside the modal:  \n     `\"Statistics temporarily unavailable\"`.\n   - The error is isolated to the modal; it never triggers alerts or affects chat functionality.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Frontend Component & File Architecture\n\n```\ndpm101-chatbot/\nâ””â”€â”€ frontend/\n    â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA landmarks, dialogs\n    â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # Base styles, color variables, typography, responsive grid\n    â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Message feed, bubbles, sources, composer, stats modal\n    â””â”€â”€ js/\n        â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # Verified REST client (handles all 8 endpoints + UUIDs)\n        â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage manager (active conversation + preferences)\n        â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM renderer (zero innerHTML), auto-scroll, modals\n        â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Application controller, event orchestration, keyboard bindings\n```\n\n### 8.1 Detailed File Responsibilities\n\n1. **`frontend/index.html`**:\n   - Header with course title, health status indicator, `[Live Stats]` button, and `[+ New Chat]` button.\n   - Collapsible sidebar with list of conversations and delete buttons.\n   - Main message feed with `role=\"log\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"`.\n   - Composer form with expanding `<textarea>`, character counter (`0 / 4000`), and `[Send]` button.\n   - Accessible `<dialog id=\"stats-modal\">` for operational statistics.\n2. **`frontend/css/main.css`**:\n   - IIMBx academic color system (`#0B2545` deep navy, `#C59B27` gold accent, `#F4F7FB` background).\n   - Responsive layout rules (desktop 2-column grid, tablet collapsible sidebar, mobile overlay drawer).\n   - High-contrast focus rings (`:focus-visible`) and reduced motion rules (`prefers-reduced-motion`).\n3. **`frontend/css/chat.css`**:\n   - Distinct styling for user bubbles (navy, right-aligned) and assistant bubbles (soft blue-gray, left-aligned).\n   - Source badge cards, unsupported topic notes, and duplicate replay badges.\n   - Three-dot pulsing typing indicator animation.\n   - Countdown rate-limit warning banner and error toast alerts.\n4. **`frontend/js/api.js`**:\n   - Encapsulates `fetch` calls to `/health`, `/api/v1/conversations`, `/api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages`, and `/api/stats`.\n   - Generates RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs for `X-Request-ID` and body `request_id`.\n   - Normalizes errors and extracts `retry_after` from 429 responses.\n   - Validates UUID format before interpolating into URLs.\n5. **`frontend/js/storage.js`**:\n   - Stores and retrieves `dpm101_active_conv_id` from `localStorage`.\n   - Provides safe in-memory fallback if `localStorage` throws `SecurityError` (e.g. restricted private browsing).\n6. **`frontend/js/ui.js`**:\n   - Implements `renderSafeContent()` with strict DOM text node construction.\n   - Manages auto-scroll behavior (maintains position if user has scrolled up to read earlier messages).\n   - Controls dialog open/close states and live countdown timers.\n7. **`frontend/js/app.js`**:\n   - Initializes application on `DOMContentLoaded`.\n   - Checks backend health.\n   - Restores active conversation or shows welcome screen with suggested questions.\n   - Binds `Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline.\n   - Implements explicit conversation recovery on 404 without silent resending.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Implementation Checklist (Phase 2 Preview)\n\n| Task ID | Task Description | Target File | Verification Method |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **T10.1** | Create semantic HTML structure with ARIA roles, landmarks, sidebar, message feed, and stats dialog. | `frontend/index.html` | W3C validator & accessibility audit |\n| **T10.2** | Build modern, accessible CSS design system: variables, reset, layout grid, typography, focus styles. | `frontend/css/main.css` | Multi-resolution layout inspection |\n| **T10.3** | Build chat-specific CSS: message bubbles, source pills, typing animation, drawer, toast alerts. | `frontend/css/chat.css` | Visual component inspection |\n| **T10.4** | Implement REST API client module wrapping all backend endpoints with error normalization & UUIDs. | `frontend/js/api.js` | Endpoint integration tests |\n| **T10.5** | Implement LocalStorage state persistence for active conversation ID with private browsing fallback. | `frontend/js/storage.js` | Storage unit tests |\n| **T10.6** | Implement safe DOM rendering engine (safe text formatting, no `innerHTML`, auto-scroll, modals). | `frontend/js/ui.js` | Automated XSS payload test suite |\n| **T10.7** | Implement main controller: event handlers, lifecycle management, keyboard bindings, 404 recovery. | `frontend/js/app.js` | End-to-end conversation flow test |\n| **T10.8** | Create frontend static serving and integration test suite. | `tests/test_frontend_integration.py` | Pytest execution (`pytest tests/test_frontend_integration.py`) |\n| **T10.9** | Execute complete regression suite across Modules 1â€“10 (target: 313 + new frontend tests passing). | Full Test Run | Pytest execution (`pytest -v`) |\n| **T10.10**| Update `README.md` with frontend usage instructions, responsive layout guide, and screenshots. | `README.md` | Documentation review |\n\n---\n\n## 10. Acceptance Criteria Matrix\n\n| Criterion | Requirement Description | Verification Method | Pass Condition |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **AC10.1** | Interface is cleanly branded for IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk and responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop. | Chrome DevTools device mode (375px, 768px, 1280px) | Layout adapts cleanly with zero horizontal scroll overflow. |\n| **AC10.2** | Conversation management: user can create, list, switch, and delete conversations. | Manual browser testing & automated test | All conversation actions succeed and update the DOM accurately. |\n| **AC10.3** | Safe Text Rendering: No model-generated or user content is rendered via `innerHTML`. | Automated XSS injection test (`<script>`, `onerror`, `<iframe>`) | Malicious payloads render as harmless plain text. |\n| **AC10.4** | Grounded Source Attribution: Badges render only when returned by backend; supports multi-sources; flags unsupported topics. | Test queries against Doc 01, Doc 03, Doc 04, and unsupported topics | Source badges match backend `sources` array exactly; no fabricated badges. |\n| **AC10.5** | Conversation Recovery: On HTTP 404, user message is preserved in composer, explicit notice is shown, and explicit New Chat button is offered (no silent resending). | Simulated 404 response | User message remains intact; student is not stranded. |\n| **AC10.6** | Idempotency & Rate Limiting: UUID v4 generated; header & body match; HTTP 429 triggers live countdown timer. | Rapid send clicks and simulated 429 response | Single turn sent; live countdown decrements and re-enables composer at 0. |\n| **AC10.7** | Live Statistics: Modal presents exact 6 fields from `/api/stats` without disrupting ongoing chats; polls only while open. | Open modal, inspect network tab, verify 6 fields | 6 fields match schema; polling stops when modal is closed. |\n| **AC10.8** | Regression Baseline: All 313 existing backend tests continue to pass without modification. | `pytest -v` | 313 / 313 tests pass. |\n\n---\n\n## 11. Confirmation of Planning Integrity\n\n- **NO application source code files have been created or modified.**\n- **NO backend routes, services, or models have been altered.**\n- **NO dependencies or packages have been installed.**\n- **The existing backend test suite remains 100% passing at 313 / 313 tests.**\n- **This phase is strictly limited to architectural planning and specification refinement.**\n\n---\n\n**STOPPING HERE. Exact API Contract Verification\n\nEvery endpoint has been audited directly against `backend/routes/chat_routes.py`, `backend/routes/stats_routes.py`, and `app.py`:\n\n| Endpoint | Method | Request Payload & Headers | Success Response | Error Codes & Schemas |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| **`/health`** | `GET` | None | `HTTP 200`<br>`{\"status\": \"healthy\", \"service\": \"DPM-101 Helpdesk Chatbot\"}` | Unreachable (502/503/504) |\n| **`/api/v1/conversations`** | `POST` | None or `{}` | `HTTP 201 Created`<br>`{\"id\": \"<uuid>\", \"created_at\": \"<iso>\", \"updated_at\": \"<iso>\", \"status\": \"active\"}` | `500` |\n| **`/api/v1/conversations`** | `GET` | Query: `limit` (def 50, max 200), `offset` (def 0) | `HTTP 200 OK`<br>`{\"conversations\": [{\"id\": \"...\", \"created_at\": \"...\", \"updated_at\": \"...\", \"status\": \"active\"}]}` | `500` |\n| **`/api/v1/conversations/<id>`** | `GET` | Path: `id` (UUID v4) | `HTTP 200 OK`<br>`{\"id\": \"...\", \"created_at\": \"...\", \"updated_at\": \"...\", \"status\": \"active\"}` | `HTTP 404`<br>`{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}` |\n| **`/api/v1/conversations/<id>`** | `DELETE` | Path: `id` (UUID v4) | `HTTP 200 OK`<br>`{\"success\": true, \"message\": \"Conversation deleted successfully\", \"conversation_id\": \"...\"}` | `HTTP 404`<br>`{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}` |\n| **`/api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`** | `GET` | Query: `limit` (def 100, max 500), `offset` (def 0) | `HTTP 200 OK`<br>`{\"conversation_id\": \"...\", \"messages\": [{\"id\": \"...\", \"conversation_id\": \"...\", \"role\": \"user\"\\|\"assistant\", \"content\": \"...\", \"created_at\": \"...\", \"sources\": [\"...\"] \\| null}]}` | `HTTP 404`<br>`{\"error\": \"Conversation not found\"}` |\n| **`/api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`** | `POST` | Header: `X-Request-ID: <uuid>`<br>Body: `{\"message\": str, \"request_id\": \"<uuid>\"}`<br>*(Length: 1â€“4000 chars; headers & body ID must match)* | `HTTP 200 OK`<br>`{\"conversation_id\": \"...\", \"message_id\": \"...\", \"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": \"...\", \"sources\": [\"...\"], \"created_at\": \"...\", \"is_in_scope\": bool, \"is_supported\": bool, \"is_duplicate\": false}`<br><br>**Duplicate Replay:** Header `X-Duplicate-Request: true`, body has `is_duplicate: true` | `HTTP 400` (invalid JSON, empty text, >4000 chars, bad UUID, mismatched IDs)<br>`HTTP 404` (conversation not found)<br>`HTTP 409` (`CONVERSATION_BUSY` or `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`)<br>`HTTP 429` (header `Retry-After: N`, body `{\"error\": \"...\", \"code\": \"RATE_LIMITED\", \"retry_after\": N}`)<br>`HTTP 504` (`IN_FLIGHT_TIMEOUT`)<br>`HTTP 500` |\n| **`/api/stats`** | `GET` | None *(strictly GET; non-GET returns 405)* | `HTTP 200 OK`<br>`{\"total_requests\": int, \"cache_hits\": int, \"gemini_calls\": int, \"errors\": int, \"uptime_seconds\": int, \"worker_note\": \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"}` | `HTTP 405` Method Not Allowed<br>`HTTP 503` `{\"error\": \"Failed to retrieve statistics\", \"code\": \"STATS_UNAVAILABLE\"}` |\n\n---\n\n### 2. Corrected Conversation Recovery (No Silent Resending)\n\nThe previous proposal to silently auto-create a conversation and resend messages on HTTP 404 has been **completely removed**.\n- **User Notification:** When `POST /messages` returns HTTP 404 (e.g., after an ephemeral container restart or deletion), the UI displays a clear, honest warning banner:  \n  *â€œThis conversation is no longer active on the server. Your message has been preserved below.â€*\n- **Preserved Typing:** The student's unsent message is preserved directly inside the input composer and is not cleared.\n- **Explicit Action:** An explicit button `[Start New Chat]` is presented. The student retains full control to click New Chat, review their preserved draft, and submit when ready.\n- **No False History Claims:** The UI never implies deleted or lost history can be restored.\n\n---\n\n### 3. Grounded Source Attribution Details\n\nAudited against `PolicyService.ask()` and `ChatService.save_assistant_message()`:\n- **Backend Schema:** `sources` is a `list[str]` containing unique authoritative document titles (e.g. `[\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"]`).\n- **Dynamic Multi-Source Rendering:** The UI dynamically iterates over `sources`. If multiple sources exist, each receives its own badge; if only one exists, one badge is rendered.\n- **Zero Fabrication / No Hardcoded Badges:** When `sources` is empty (`[]`) or `null`, no source badges are rendered.\n- **Unsupported Answers:** When `is_supported === false` (e.g. refund requests, instructor office queries, or out-of-scope questions), the UI displays a distinct status note:  \n  *â€œâ„¹ï¸ Information not specified in official course documents.â€*\n\n---\n\n### 4. Security & Request Idempotency Strategy\n\n- **Strict XSS Defense (Zero `innerHTML`):** All user and model content is rendered via safe DOM construction (`document.createElement`, `document.createTextNode`, `replaceChildren`). Simple bold markdown (`**text**`) is parsed into `<strong>` text nodes without HTML string evaluation.\n- **UUID Generation & Fallback:** `api.js` uses `crypto.randomUUID()` when available, with a standards-compliant RFC 4122 v4 math fallback for older browsers or non-secure contexts.\n- **Idempotency Consistency:** The client guarantees that `X-Request-ID` in the request header exactly matches `request_id` in the JSON body. Retrying a failed request reuses the original ID; typing a new message generates a fresh ID.\n- **Duplicate Response Handling:** On responses with `is_duplicate: true` or `X-Duplicate-Request: true`, the frontend verifies `message_id` against rendered DOM bubbles to prevent duplicate bubble insertion.\n- **HTTP 429 Live Countdown:** The client parses the integer `retry_after` from the response body (or `Retry-After` header), disables the composer, and displays a live second-by-second countdown timer (`15s... 14s... 0s`), automatically re-enabling the composer at `0`.\n- **URL Parameter Validation:** UUID format is validated via regex before interpolation into API URL paths.\n- **Live Stats Non-Interference:** `/api/stats` is polled every 30 seconds strictly while the stats modal is open, and is halted immediately upon modal close or page hide. Stats errors never impact ongoing chat turns.\n\n---\n\n### 5. Updated Acceptance Criteria Matrix\n\n| Criterion | Requirement Description | Verification Method |\n|---|---|---|\n| **AC10.1** | Clean academic IIMBx branding, responsive layout across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px). | DevTools multi-device inspection |\n| **AC10.2** | Full conversation lifecycle (create, list, switch, delete, review history). | End-to-end conversation flow test |\n| **AC10.3** | Strict XSS prevention: all dynamic content rendered via DOM text nodes; zero `innerHTML`. | Automated XSS payload test suite |\n| **AC10.4** | Source attribution reflects exact backend `sources` array; multi-source support; distinct unsupported indicator. | Test queries across Docs 01, 03, 04, and unsupported topics |\n| **AC10.5** | Safe 404 recovery: preserves typed message, displays honest alert, provides explicit New Chat button. | Simulated 404 response test |\n| **AC10.6** | Idempotency key matching; duplicate bubble deduplication; 429 live countdown timer. | Rapid double-click & 429 mock test |\n| **AC10.7** | Live stats modal displays exact 6 fields without disrupting chat; open-only 30s polling. | Network inspection & modal audit |\n| **AC10.8** | Full regression baseline preserved (313 / 313 passing tests). | `pytest -v` |\n\n---\n\n### 6. Confirmation of Planning Integrity\n\n- **Zero application source files were created or modified.**\n- **Zero backend services, routes, or database schemas were touched.**\n- **Zero dependencies were installed.**\n- **Regression test suite verified:** **313 / 313 passing tests** (`pytest -q` completed in 26.53s).\n\n---\n\n**STOPPING HERE.** The Phase 1B implementation plan refinement is complete. Send Message & Receive Response\n183: - **Route:** `POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages`\n184: - **Request Headers:**\n185:   - `Content-Type: application/json`\n186:   - `X-Request-ID: <uuid-v4>` (optional, but generated by client)\n187: - **Success Response (HTTP 200 OK â€” Normal Processing):**\n196:   ```json\n197:   {\n198:     \"conversation_id\": \"c1f7a8b2-3e4d-4a1b-9f2c-5d8e7b6a9c0d\",\n199:     \"message_id\": \"msg-004\",\n200:     \"role\": \"assistant\",\n201:     \"content\": \"Late submissions are no longer accepted for weekly quizzes or the capstone case...\",\n202:     \"sources\": [\"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2 (Current)\"],\n203:     \"created_at\": \"2026-11-11T09:16:10.000000+00:00\",\n204:     \"is_in_scope\": true,\n205:     \"is_supported\": true,\n206:     \"is_duplicate\": false\n207:   }\n208:   ```\n209: - **Duplicate Replay Response (HTTP 200 OK â€” Idempotent Duplicate Replay):**\n210:   - Response Header: `X-Duplicate-Request: true`\n211:   - Response Body: Same structure as above, with `\"is_duplicate\": true`.\n212: - **Error Responses:**\n213:   - **HTTP 400 Bad Request:**\n214:     - Non-JSON body: `{\"error\": \"Request body must be valid JSON\"}`\n215:     - Missing message: `{\"error\": \"Field 'message' is required\"}`\n216:     -
