{"step_index":2439,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T04:44:02Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T10:14:02+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T10:14:02+05:30\nShowing lines 380-489 of 489\n380: #### Security & Access\n381: - **Read-Only**: Non-GET methods (`POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH`) return `HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed`.\n382: - **Zero Information Leakage**: Exposes only the 6 required numerical counters and the worker disclaimer. Contains no IP addresses, user identifiers, session IDs, request IDs, prompts, or secrets.\n383: - **No Public Reset Controls**: Does not expose reset endpoints, preventing unauthorized metric manipulation.\n384: \n385: ### 3. Deployment & Lifecycle Disclosures\n386: \n387: - **Single-Worker Scope**: Counters reside in the memory of the single Gunicorn worker process (`--workers 1 --threads 2`). They accurately reflect process-wide metrics without cross-process inconsistency.\n388: - **Ephemeral Container Restart Loss**: On free-tier cloud platforms like Render, container restarts and redeployments wipe in-memory state. All counters reset to zero upon worker process boot.\n389: \n390: ---\n391: \n392: ## Module 10: Frontend Chat Interface\n393: \n394: Module 10 introduces the complete student-facing web interface for the IIMBx Digital Product Management (DPM-101) Course Helpdesk. Built entirely with vanilla HTML5, modern CSS3, and ES6+ JavaScript, it natively integrates with the Flask backend without requiring external frontend build steps or heavy JavaScript frameworks.\n395: \n396: ### 1. Architecture & Component Structure\n397: \n398: The frontend is served directly by the Flask backend from `frontend/`:\n399: \n400: ```\n401: frontend/\n402: â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA accessibility landmarks, dialogs\n403: â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n404: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # Academic design tokens, typography, CSS grid layout, buttons, modals\n405: â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Message feed, user & assistant bubbles, source pills, composer, stats grid\n406: â””â”€â”€ js/\n407:     â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage state persistence with private browsing fallback\n408:     â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # REST client wrapping all 8 backend endpoints, UUID v4 generator\n409:     â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM renderer (zero innerHTML), auto-scroll, modals, countdowns\n410:     â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Main coordinator, keyboard navigation, 404 recovery, stats polling\n411: ```\n412: \n413: ### 2. How to Start and Access the Application\n414: \n415: 1. **Activate the virtual environment**:\n416:    ```powershell\n417:    # Windows\n418:    .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n419:    ```\n420: 2. **Start the Flask server**:\n421:    ```bash\n422:    python app.py\n423:    ```\n424: 3. **Open the Chatbot in your browser**:\n425:    Navigate to `http://localhost:5000` (or `http://127.0.0.1:5000`).\n426: \n427: ### 3. Key Features\n428: \n429: - **Academic IIMBx Identity**: Branded with deep academic navy (`#0B2545`), gold accents (`#C59B27`), and high-contrast typography satisfying WCAG 2.1 AA standards.\n430: - **Responsive Layout**:\n431:   - **Desktop (>900px)**: 2-column view with permanent conversation sidebar and spacious chat workspace.\n432:   - **Tablet (601pxâ€“900px)**: Collapsible sidebar drawer with mobile hamburger toggle and tap-outside backdrop.\n433:   - **Mobile (â‰¤600px)**: Compact header, full-screen touch-friendly feed, and auto-expanding input composer.\n434: - **Conversation Management**:\n435:   - Create new conversations with one click.\n436:   - Switch between past conversations with instantaneous history loading.\n437:   - Delete conversations with confirmation prompt.\n438:   - Welcome state with 4 clickable FAQ prompt chips for rapid student onboarding.\n439: - **Strict Safe Text Rendering (Zero `innerHTML`)**:\n440:   - Model responses, user messages, conversation titles, and source citations are rendered strictly using native DOM text nodes (`document.createElement`, `document.createTextNode`, `replaceChildren`).\n441:   - Custom safe tokenizer renders bold text (`**text**`), bullet lists, and paragraphs without HTML string injection, eliminating XSS vulnerabilities.\n442: - **Grounded Source Attribution**:\n443:   - Dynamically renders source badges based on the backend's `sources` list.\n444:   - Supports multiple authoritative sources per response.\n445:   - Displays distinct `â„¹ï¸ Information not specified in official course documents` banner for unsupported queries (`is_supported: false`).\n446:   - Never hardcodes or fabricates document citations.\n447: - **Request Management & Duplicate Prevention**:\n448:   - Generates RFC 4122 v4 UUID request IDs satisfying `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]{1,128}$`.\n449:   - Sends matching request IDs in both `X-Request-ID` header and JSON body `request_id`.\n450:   - Reuses request ID when retrying a failed turn; generates a fresh ID for every new turn.\n451:   - Deduplicates replayed responses (`is_duplicate: true` / `X-Duplicate-Request: true`) to prevent duplicate bubbles in the DOM.\n452: - **HTTP 429 Rate-Limit Countdown**:\n453:   - Catches HTTP 429 and parses `retry_after` from response body and header.\n454:   - Disables composer and displays an active second-by-second countdown banner (`15s... 14s... 0s`).\n455:   - Automatically re-enables composer when the cooldown expires.\n456: - **404 Conversation Recovery (No Silent Resending)**:\n457:   - If a conversation is no longer active on the server, the student's typed message is preserved in the composer.\n458:   - Displays an honest alert: *\"This conversation is no longer active on the server.\"*\n459:   - Provides an explicit `[Start New Chat]` action button for the student.\n460: - **Live Operational Statistics Modal**:\n461:   - Access via `[ðŸ“Š Live Stats]` button in header.\n462:   - Displays the 6 exact counters from `GET /api/stats`: Total Requests, Cache Hits, Gemini Calls, Errors, Process Uptime, and Worker Note.\n463:   - Polls automatically every 30 seconds strictly while the dialog is open.\n464:   - Pauses polling immediately when closed or when the browser tab is hidden.\n465: \n466: ### 4. Testing Instructions\n467: \n468: Run frontend integration tests:\n469: ```bash\n470: pytest tests/test_frontend_integration.py -v\n471: ```\n472: \n473: Run the complete test suite across all 10 modules:\n474: ```bash\n475: pytest -v\n476: ```\n477: *(Total: 335 / 335 tests passing with zero regressions).*\n478: \n479: ### 5. Remaining Limitations\n480: \n481: - **Ephemeral Storage**: Conversation history and in-process statistics are stored locally in SQLite and memory; they reset when the server container restarts or redeploys.\n482: - **No User Authentication**: Conversations are tracked via anonymous client-side UUIDs without authenticated user accounts.\n483: - **Cloud Deployment**: Production deployment on Render with Gunicorn will be completed in Module 12.\n484: \n485: ---\n486: \n487: ## Next Steps\n488: \n489: Module 11 will implement End-to-End Integration, Comprehensive Testing & Error Handling."}

Overview & Objective\n\nModule 11 unifies, validates, and stress-tests all previously developed and approved modules (Modules 1 through 10) into an end-to-end integrated application. \n\nThe primary objective of Module 11 is to prove that the entire helpdesk chatbot system operates reliably across all architectural tiers:\n1. **Frontend-to-Backend Communication**: HTTP static serving, RESTful JSON contracts, request ID header/body parity, and safe DOM rendering.\n2. **Conversation Lifecycle**: Persistent multi-turn conversations, chronological ordering, and cascade deletions in SQLite.\n3. **Knowledge Retrieval & Policy Accuracy**: Strict grounding in official DPM-101 course documents, enforcement of topic-level document authority, complete suppression of outdated Doc 02 grading chunks, and complete exclusion of Doc 04 Â§3+ forum comments.\n4. **Resilience & Fault Tolerance**: Deterministic fallback behavior when Gemini is unconfigured or unavailable, SQLite transaction rollbacks, rate limiting, and thundering-herd deduplication.\n5. **Observability & Operational Integrity**: Live counters tracking requests, cache hits, Gemini calls, errors, and process uptime without metric drift or race conditions.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Requirements & Acceptance Criteria\n\n### A. Mandatory Assignment Requirements\n\n| ID | Requirement Category | Acceptance Criteria |\n|---|---|---|\n| **REQ-11-01** | **All 8 API Endpoints Verified** | Every route (`GET /health`, `GET /`, `POST /api/v1/conversations`, `GET /api/v1/conversations`, `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>`, `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/<id>`, `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`, `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`, `GET /api/stats`, `GET /api/v1/cache/stats`, `POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup`) returns exact schema, correct status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 405, 409, 429, 500, 503), and proper headers. |\n| **REQ-11-02** | **12 Acceptance-Test Questions (Section 17)** | All 12 sample questions from Section 17 of `implementation_plan.md` produce the exact specified behavior: authoritative source citation, correct policy logic, context resolution for follow-ups, and polite refusal for out-of-scope or unverified topics. |\n| **REQ-11-03** | **Policy Authority & Precedence** | Doc 03 is the sole authority for grading and assignment/quiz deadlines. Doc 02 grading content is never cited or retrieved. Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 is the sole authority for final exam rules and date (Nov 20, 2026). Doc 04 Â§3+ student forum comments are never cited or retrieved. Doc 01 is the authority for general course details and the â‚¹1,500 certificate fee. |\n| **REQ-11-04** | **Multi-Turn Context Resolution** | Pronoun-bearing queries (e.g. *\"What if I miss it by just one day?\"*) correctly resolve prior conversational context, pass history to the synthesis pipeline, and bypass caching. |\n| **REQ-11-05** | **Cache Operation & Invalidation** | Exact-match composite keys hit on repeated queries. Follow-up queries bypass cache. Document modification triggers automatic cache invalidation on file hash change. |\n| **REQ-11-06** | **Request Deduplication & Idempotency** | Simultaneous identical requests (thundering herd) execute primary synthesis once while waiters receive the result via condition variable. Replayed requests return cached payload with `is_duplicate: true`. |\n| **REQ-11-07** | **Rate Limiting & Cooldown** | Exceeding 20 requests/60s per IP or 15 requests/60s per conversation returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`. Replayed duplicate requests do not consume rate limit tokens. |\n| **REQ-11-08** | **SQLite Transactions & Resilience** | All conversation and message operations use `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transactions. SQLite locks or operational failures degrade gracefully without corrupting database state. |\n| **REQ-11-09** | **Gemini Fallback & Key Security** | Missing credentials, network outages, or API rate limits trigger the Extractive Fallback without crashing Flask. API keys are never exposed in responses or logs. |\n| **REQ-11-10** | **XSS & Safe DOM Rendering** | Model and user outputs containing malicious HTML/scripts (`<script>`, `onerror`, `javascript:`) are rendered safely via text nodes without execution. |\n| **REQ-11-11** | **Operational Statistics Accuracy** | In-process statistics accurately record `total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, and `uptime_seconds`. Health checks and static requests do not increment stats. |\n| **REQ-11-12** | **Health Check Decoupling** | `GET /health` returns HTTP 200 `{\"status\": \"healthy\"}` without invoking Gemini or consuming quota. |\n| **REQ-11-13** | **Regression Baseline Preservation** | All 335 existing tests across Modules 1â€“10 pass cleanly without modifications, deletions, or weakened assertions. |\n\n---\n\n## 3. End-to-End Integration Test Scenarios\n\nThe Module 11 test suite will be implemented in `tests/test_module11_e2e_integration.py` divided into 7 core test classes:\n\n### Suite 1: Full Conversation Lifecycle & Multi-Turn Integration\n- **Test 1.1**: Create conversation $\\rightarrow$ Verify UUID generation and initial empty message list.\n- **Test 1.2**: Post first question (*\"What are the passing criteria?\"*) $\\rightarrow$ Verify user and assistant messages persisted in SQLite with UTC timestamps.\n- **Test 1.3**: Post follow-up question (*\"What if I get less than 40% in the final exam?\"*) $\\rightarrow$ Verify context disambiguation and context-dependent flag.\n- **Test 1.4**: Retrieve message history via `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages` $\\rightarrow$ Verify chronological ordering, role tags, and source metadata.\n- **Test 1.5**: Hard delete conversation via `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/<id>` $\\rightarrow$ Verify cascading deletion of messages in SQLite.\n- **Test 1.6**: Query deleted conversation $\\rightarrow$ Returns HTTP 404.\n\n### Suite 2: The 12 Acceptance-Test Questions (Section 17 Mapping)\n- **Q1**: *\"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Sourced from Doc 03 (50% overall + 40% final exam; 70% distinction). Doc 02 absent.\n- **Q2**: *\"When is the capstone project deadline?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Sourced from Doc 03.\n- **Q3**: *\"When is the final exam and what are the rules?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Sourced from Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 (Nov 20, 2026, 90 mins, AI proctoring, webcam required). Forum comments absent. Doc 03 absent.\n- **Q4**: *\"What is the certificate fee?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Sourced from Doc 01 (â‚¹1,500). Forum fee (â‚¹4,999) rejected.\n- **Q5**: *\"What is the refund policy?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Not in official documents $\\rightarrow$ Polite refusal with `is_supported: false`.\n- **Q6**: *\"How does the best-five-of-six quiz rule work?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Sourced from Doc 03.\n- **Q7**: *\"Can you help me with SQL joins / Kubernetes setup?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Out-of-scope query $\\rightarrow$ Polite refusal with `is_in_scope: false`.\n- **Q8**: *\"Who won the cricket World Cup?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Unrelated general query $\\rightarrow$ Polite refusal with `is_in_scope: false`.\n- **Q9**: *\"What is the late submission penalty?\"* followed by *\"What if I miss it by just one day?\"* $\\rightarrow$ First cached as standalone; second bypasses cache and uses multi-turn context.\n- **Q10**: Exact repeat of Q9 $\\rightarrow$ Cache hit (`is_duplicate: false`, cache counter increments, Gemini call count unchanged).\n- **Q11**: Rephrased near-duplicate $\\rightarrow$ Cache semantic evaluation (hit if threshold met, miss otherwise).\n- **Q12**: Repeat Q9 after document mtime update $\\rightarrow$ Cache miss and fresh evaluation.\n\n### Suite 3: Cache Operation, Invalidation & Capacity\n- **Test 3.1**: Cold cache miss followed by exact match cache hit.\n- **Test 3.2**: Follow-up query cache bypass (neither reads nor writes cache).\n- **Test 3.3**: Unsupported topic query (`is_supported: false`) excluded from cache storage.\n- **Test 3.4**: Cache capacity enforcement (LRU eviction when entries exceed limit).\n- **Test 3.5**: Cache maintenance endpoints (`GET /api/v1/cache/stats` and `POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup`).\n- **Test 3.6**: Fault tolerance: Database locked or table dropped degrades to live evaluation without failing request.\n\n### Suite 4: Request Management, Thundering Herd & Concurrency\n- **Test 4.1**: Concurrent identical requests (Thundering Herd) $\\rightarrow$ Primary thread computes, secondary threads wait on condition variable, both return identical response.\n- **Test 4.2**: Primary request failure wakes all waiting threads deterministically $\\rightarrow$ All threads receive HTTP 500 without hangs.\n- **Test 4.3**: Rapid double-submit Project Inspection & System Health Baseline\n\n### A. Current Regression Suite Status\n- **Test Baseline**: **335 / 335 tests passing** (100% pass rate in 19.35s).\n- **Module Distribution**:\n  - Module 2 (`test_health.py`): 7 tests\n  - Module 3 (`test_document_service.py`): 87 tests\n  - Module 4 (`test_gemini_service.py`): 22 tests\n  - Module 5 (`test_policy_service.py`): 71 tests\n  - Module 6 (`test_chat_service.py`): 42 tests\n  - Module 7 (`test_cache_service.py`): 36 tests\n  - Module 8 (`test_request_management.py`): 28 tests\n  - Module 9 (`test_stats_service.py`): 20 tests\n  - Module 10 (`test_frontend_integration.py`): 22 tests\n\n### B. Architectural Inventory & Endpoints\nThe backend currently exposes all 8 required endpoints across three Blueprint / application scopes:\n1. `GET /health` â€” Liveness probe, 100% decoupled from Gemini.\n2. `GET /` â€” Serves static `frontend/index.html` with cache headers.\n3. `POST /api/v1/conversations` â€” UUID v4 conversation creation.\n4. `GET /api/v1/conversations` â€” Conversation list sorted by `updated_at DESC`.\n5. `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>` â€” Conversation details.\n6. `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/<id>` â€” Hard deletion with SQLite cascade to messages.\n7. `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages` â€” Chronological message history.\n8. `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages` â€” Core chat processing pipeline (idempotency, lock, context resolution, retrieval, policy accuracy, Gemini/extractive fallback, stats instrumentation).\n9. `GET /api/stats` â€” Public operational statistics (6 fields, thread-safe snapshot).\n10. `GET /api/v1/cache/stats` & `POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup` â€” SQLite cache monitoring and stale pruning.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Requirements Analysis & Scope Separation\n\n### A. Mandatory Assignment Requirements\n1. **End-to-End Multi-Turn Integration**: Persistent conversations across repeated turns, pronoun resolution (e.g. *\"What if I miss it by just one day?\"*), and chronological message retrieval.\n2. **Acceptance-Test Question Verification**: Verification of all 12 sample questions from Section 17 of `implementation_plan.md`, enforcing:\n   - Doc 03 sole authority on grading and assignment/quiz deadlines (Doc 02 suppressed).\n   - Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 sole authority on final exam rules & date (Nov 20, 2026); Doc 04 Â§3+ forum comments excluded.\n   - Doc 01 authority on certificate fee (â‚¹1,500); rejection of hallucinated â‚¹4,999 forum fee.\n   - Honest refusal for out-of-scope (Kubernetes, SQL joins) and unverified (refund policy) questions.\n3. **Cache Operation & Invalidation**: Composite SHA-256 keys, follow-up bypass, and automatic invalidation upon document hash modification.\n4. **Idempotency & Concurrency**: Thundering-herd in-flight duplicate waiting, per-conversation lock timeout (`CONVERSATION_BUSY`), and duplicate replay (`is_duplicate: true`).\n5. **Rate Limiting**: Sliding-window quotas (20 req/60s per IP, 15 req/60s per conversation) with HTTP 429 and `Retry-After`.\n6. **Gemini Resilience & Key Security**: Seamless activation of extractive fallback on missing credentials or quota exhaustion without exposing API keys or crashing Flask.\n7. **Security & XSS Prevention**: Zero dynamic `innerHTML`; safe text node construction.\n8. **Statistics Consistency**: Atomic updates to `total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, and `uptime_seconds`.\n9. **Zero Baseline Regressions**: All 335 existing tests must continue to pass without modifications.\n\n### B. Optional / Future Non-Functional Enhancements (Out of Scope for Module 11)\n- WebSocket / SSE streaming (not part of original HTTP REST assignment specification).\n- Cross-region multi-worker synchronization (single Gunicorn worker architecture is an approved design decision for Render free tier).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Planned Integration Test Scenarios (`tests/test_module11_e2e_integration.py`)\n\nThe planned test suite will introduce **25â€“30 comprehensive end-to-end integration tests** organized into 7 distinct suites:\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph S1 [\"Suite 1: Lifecycle & Multi-Turn\"]\n        T1[\"Create Conv -> Turn 1 -> Turn 2 (Follow-up) -> History Check -> Delete Conv -> 404 Verification\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph S2 [\"Suite 2: Section 17 Sample Questions\"]\n        T2[\"Verify all 12 Acceptance Questions with Document Authority, Fallback & Exclusions\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph S3 [\"Suite 3: Cache Invalidation & Bounds\"]\n        T3[\"Cold Miss -> Hit -> Follow-up Bypass -> File Hash Invalidation -> Cleanup\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph S4 [\"Suite 4: Concurrency & Deduplication\"]\n        T4[\"Thundering Herd Waiters -> Double Click Replay -> Lock Timeout (409) -> Parallel Convs\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph S5 [\"Suite 5: Rate Limiting & Cooldown\"]\n        T5[\"Burst 20 req -> HTTP 429 with Retry-After -> Duplicate Exemption -> Multi-IP Isolation\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph S6 [\"Suite 6: Fault Tolerance & Error Injection\"]\n        T6[\"Missing API Key -> Extractive Fallback -> DB Error Degradation -> Malformed Payloads (400)\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph S7 [\"Suite 7: Frontend Contract & Security\"]\n        T7[\"Static Asset MIME Types -> XSS Escaping -> Request-ID Parity -> Stats Accuracy\"]\n    end\n\n    S1 --> S2 --> S3 --> S4 --> S5 --> S6 --> S7\n```\n\n1. **Suite 1: Conversation Lifecycle & Multi-Turn Integration**\n   - End-to-end multi-turn conversation creating persistent SQLite records, resolving pronouns across turns, and cascading hard-deletes.\n2. **Suite 2: All 12 Acceptance-Test Questions (Section 17)**\n   - Systematic verification of Q1 through Q12 against live policy routing, proving exact document precedence.\n3. **Suite 3: Cache Lifecycle, Invalidation & Cold-Start Warmup**\n   - Proves cold-miss, warm-hit, follow-up bypass, and automatic invalidation upon PDF timestamp/hash modification.\n4. **Suite 4: Concurrency, In-Flight Synchronization & Idempotency**\n   - Validates Thundering Herd condition waiting, duplicate replay, lock contention (HTTP 409), and multi-conversation parallelism.\n5. **Suite 5: Sliding-Window Rate Limiting**\n   - Validates per-IP and per-conversation quotas, HTTP 429 response structure, `Retry-After` headers, and duplicate exemptions.\n6. **Suite 6: Fault Tolerance, Error Injection & Fallback**\n   - Verifies Extractive Fallback under unconfigured credentials, network outages, SQLite lock degradation, and HTTP 400 validation.\n7. **Suite 7: Full Stack Contract, Security & Statistics**\n   - Verifies XSS safety, static asset headers, header/body request ID matching, and counter precision on `GET /api/stats`.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Overview & Objective\n\nModule 11 unifies, validates, and stress-tests all previously developed and approved modules (Modules 1 through 10) into an end-to-end integrated application.\n\nThe primary objective of Module 11 is to prove that the entire helpdesk chatbot system operates reliably across all architectural tiers without regressions:\n1. **Full-Stack HTTP Integration**: End-to-end traversal from client request through rate limiting, idempotency coordination, conversation history, policy retrieval, caching, Gemini synthesis / extractive fallback, to database persistence and operational statistics.\n2. **Acceptance-Test Verification**: Systematic verification of the 12 canonical student queries from Section 17 of the architecture specification, proving topic-level authority routing, document supersession, and honest refusal behavior.\n3. **Resilience & Fault Tolerance**: Deterministic fallback behavior when Gemini is unconfigured or unavailable, SQLite transaction rollbacks, rate limiting, and thundering-herd deduplication.\n4. **Offline Determinism**: Automated regression testing that is 100% decoupled from external network access, API keys, or live cloud dependencies.\n5. **Regression Safety**: Preserving all 335 existing passing tests without modifications, deletions, or weakened assertions.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Endpoint Reconciliation & Classification\n\nTo ensure architectural clarity, all application endpoints are strictly classified into their appropriate functional tiers:\n\n### A. Mandatory Assignment-Required Endpoints\nThese endpoints directly fulfill the core functional specification of the student helpdesk chatbot:\n- `POST /api/v1/conversations`: Create a new conversation session, generating a validated UUID identifier (HTTP 201).\n- `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`: Retrieve the chronological message history for an active conversation (HTTP 200).\n- `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`: Submit a student question, executing the full processing pipeline (rate limit, idempotency lock, context resolution, document retrieval, policy enforcement, Gemini synthesis / extractive fallback, persistence, stats counter) and returning an authoritative grounded answer (HTTP 200).\n- `GET /api/stats`: Retrieve public operational counters (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`) from in-process memory without consuming AI quota (HTTP 200).\n\n### B. Supporting & Lifecycle Endpoints\nThese endpoints were implemented in Modules 6, 7, and 10 to support complete browser UI capabilities and maintenance hygiene:\n- `GET /api/v1/conversations`: List existing conversations sorted by `updated_at DESC` for the frontend conversation sidebar.\n- `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>`: Retrieve conversation metadata.\n- `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/<id>`: Hard-delete a conversation with SQLite cascading deletion of associated messages.\n- `GET /api/v1/cache/stats`: Operational inspection of cache entries, size, and hit rates.\n- `POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup`: Maintenance endpoint to prune expired cache entries.\n\n### C. Root Page & Health Endpoints\n- `GET /`: Serves the static HTML5 single-page application (`index.html`) from the `frontend/` directory with public cache headers.\n- `GET /health`: Liveness probe returning HTTP 200 `{\"status\": \"healthy\"}`, strictly decoupled from the Gemini API and external dependencies.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Course Documents & Cache Fingerprinting Architecture\n\n### A. Official Documents Format\nThe official course knowledge base consists exclusively of four plain-text files located in `data/documents/`:\n1. `01_course_handbook.txt` (**Doc 01**): Course overview, weekly syllabus schedule, learning objectives, faculty contacts, and certificate fee (â‚¹1,500).\n2. `02_grading_policy_v1.txt` (**Doc 02**): Historical grading policy (superseded by Doc 03 for grading and submission rules; excluded from retrieval).\n3. `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` (**Doc 03**): Updated grading criteria, assessment weighting, 50% passing threshold, 70% distinction threshold, assignment/quiz submission deadlines, and late-submission penalties.\n4. `04_exam_rules_and_faq.txt` (**Doc 04**): Â§1 & Â§2 are authoritative for final exam rules (Nov 20, 2026, 90 mins, AI-proctored, laptop/desktop only); Â§3+ contains unmoderated student forum excerpts (strictly excluded from retrieval).\n\n### B. Document Fingerprint Implementation\nIn [`backend/services/cache_service.py`](file:///C:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%26H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L184-L225), `CacheService.compute_documents_fingerprint()` computes a composite SHA-256 hash across all registered text files:\n1. It inspects each document file's nanosecond modification timestamp (`st_mtime_ns`) and byte size (`st_size`).\n2. When cached mtimes match the filesystem, it returns the cached fingerprint instantly (microsecond latency).\n3. When any file's content or mtime changes, it reads the file bytes, computes `hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()`, and combines all document hashes into a master document fingerprint.\n4. The composite cache key is generated via:\n   $$\\text{SHA-256}(\\text{normalized\\_query} \\parallel \\text{doc\\_fingerprint} \\parallel \\text{policy\\_version} \\parallel \\text{model\\_version})$$\n5. **Test Design**: Integration tests for cache invalidation will directly modify the test environment's text file content and mtime, verifying that `CacheService` detects the fingerprint change and invalidates previous cache entries without requiring server restarts.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Non-Redundant Integration Scope & Test Strategy\n\nTo prevent unnecessary duplication with the 335 existing unit and frontend tests, Module 11 focuses exclusively on **multi-tier integration seams and cross-service coordination**:\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart LR\n    ClientReq[\"HTTP Client Request\"] --> Route[\"chat_routes.py\"]\n    Route --> RL[\"rate_limiter.py\"]\n    RL --> RM[\"request_service.py (Idempotency & Locks)\"]\n    RM --> CS[\"chat_service.py (SQLite DB)\"]\n    CS --> PS[\"policy_service.py\"]\n    PS --> Cache[\"cache_service.py (SQLite Cache)\"]\n    PS --> Doc[\"document_service.py (TXT Registry)\"]\n    PS --> Gen[\"gemini_service.py / Extractive Fallback\"]\n    PS --> Val[\"Policy Enforcement (Fee & Pass Guards)\"]\n    Route --> Stats[\"stats_service.py (Counters)\"]\n    Route --> ClientResp[\"HTTP JSON Response\"]\n```\n\n### Gap Analysis: What Existing Tests Cover vs. What Module 11 Adds\n\n| Component Seam | Covered in Existing Tests (Modules 1â€“10) | Module 11 Cross-Tier Integration Gap Addressed |\n|---|---|---|\n| **API Endpoints** | Unit tests mock backend services; frontend tests check static HTML/CSS/JS. | **True full-stack execution**: HTTP request passing through actual Flask client into real SQLite database, rate limiter, request manager, and policy pipeline simultaneously. |\n| **Section 17 Questions** | Policy service tested with direct python method calls (`policy_service.ask()`). | **End-to-end HTTP validation**: Submitting Section 17 questions through `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages` and asserting JSON response structures, HTTP headers, DB persistence, and cache transitions. |\n| **Multi-Turn Context** | Chat service context resolution tested in isolation. | **Sequential HTTP turns**: Sending Turn 1 via HTTP $\\rightarrow$ persisting to SQLite $\\rightarrow$ sending Turn 2 follow-up via HTTP $\\rightarrow$ verifying prompt context reconstruction and cache bypass. |\n| **Cache Invalidation** | Cache key generation tested with mock hashes. | **Filesystem-driven invalidation**: Modifying an actual course `.txt` file on disk $\\rightarrow$ querying via HTTP $\\rightarrow$ verifying cache miss and updated fingerprint evaluation. |\n| **Fault Recovery** | Mocked exception tests for isolated components. | **End-to-end degradation**: Simulating Gemini network failure during an active HTTP request and confirming the client receives an HTTP 200 grounded extractive fallback with source attribution, while operational error counters increment accurately. |\n\n### Deterministic Test Execution Principles\n1. **100% Offline by Default**: The automated test suite uses controlled mocks for `GeminiService` and the built-in deterministic Extractive Fallback engine. It never makes live network calls to Google Gemini, avoiding flaky tests, rate-limit blocks, or credential dependencies.\n2. **Optional Live Gemini Probe**: Delineated into a separate optional verification script (e.g. `tests/probe_live_gemini.py`) that executes only when `GEMINI_API_KEY` is explicitly configured in the shell environment.\n3. **No Arbitrary Test Count Targets**: Focus on high-value, comprehensive scenarios rather than padding test counts. Supporting & Lifecycle Endpoints\nThese endpoints were implemented in Modules 6, 7, and 10 to support complete browser UI capabilities and maintenance hygiene:\n- `GET /api/v1/conversations`: List existing conversations sorted by `updated_at DESC` for the frontend conversation sidebar.\n- `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>`: Retrieve conversation metadata.\n- `DELETE /api/v1/conversations/<id>`: Hard-delete a conversation with SQLite cascading deletion of associated messages.\n- `GET /api/v1/cache/stats`: Operational inspection of cache entries, size, and hit rates.\n- `POST /api/v1/cache/cleanup`: Maintenance endpoint to prune expired cache entries.\n\n### C. Root Page & Health Endpoints\n- `GET /`: Serves the static HTML5 single-page application (`index.html`) from the `frontend/` directory with public cache headers.\n- `GET /health`: Liveness probe returning HTTP 200 `{\"status\": \"healthy\"}`, strictly decoupled from the Gemini API and external dependencies.\n\n---\n\n## 3. It inspects each document file's nanosecond modification timestamp (`st_mtime_ns`) and byte size (`st_size`).\n2. When cached mtimes match the filesystem, it returns the cached fingerprint instantly (microsecond latency).\n3. When any file's content or mtime changes, it reads the file bytes, computes `hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()`, and combines all document hashes into a master document fingerprint.\n4. The composite cache key is generated via:\n   $$\\text{SHA-256}(\\text{normalized\\_query} \\parallel \\text{doc\\_fingerprint} \\parallel \\text{policy\\_version} \\parallel \\text{model\\_version})$$\n5. **Test Design**: Integration tests for cache invalidation will directly modify the test environment's text file content and mtime, verifying that `CacheService` detects the fingerprint change and invalidates previous cache entries without requiring server restarts.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Section 17 questions submitted through the actual `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages` HTTP route.\n3. Multi-turn sequential HTTP context resolution across turns in SQLite.\n4. Filesystem-driven cache invalidation via actual `.txt` file updates.\n5. Mandatory Assignment-Required Endpoints\nThese endpoints directly fulfill the core functional specification of the student helpdesk chatbot:\n- `POST /api/v1/conversations`: Create a new conversation session, generating a validated UUID identifier (HTTP 201).\n- `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`: Retrieve the chronological message history for an active conversation (HTTP 200).\n- `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages`: Submit a student question, executing the full processing pipeline (rate limit, idempotency lock, context resolution, document retrieval, policy enforcement, Gemini synthesis / extractive fallback, persistence, stats counter) and returning an authoritative grounded answer (HTTP 200).\n- `GET /api/stats`: Retrieve public operational counters (`total_requests`, `cache_hits`, `gemini_calls`, `errors`, `uptime_seconds`, `worker_note`) from in-process memory without consuming AI quota (HTTP 200).\n\n### B. Official Documents Format\n44: The official course knowledge base consists exclusively of four plain-text files located in `data/documents/`:\n45: 1. `01_course_handbook.txt` (**Doc 01**): Course overview, weekly syllabus schedule, learning objectives, faculty contacts, and certificate fee (â‚¹1,500).\n46: 2. `02_grading_policy_v1.txt` (**Doc 02**): Historical grading policy (superseded by Doc 03 for grading and submission rules; excluded from retrieval).\n47: 3. `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` (**Doc 03**): Updated grading criteria, assessment weighting, 50% passing threshold, 70% distinction threshold, assignment/quiz submission deadlines, and late-submission penalties.\n48: 4. `04_exam_rules_and_faq.txt` (**Doc 04**): Â§1 & Â§2 are authoritative for final exam rules (Nov 20, 2026, 90 mins, AI-proctored, laptop/desktop only); Â§3+ contains unmoderated student forum excerpts (strictly excluded from retrieval).\n49: \n50: ### B. Document Fingerprint Implementation & Q12 Procedure\n51: In [`backend/services/cache_service.py`](file:///C:/Users/ACHYUTHA/OneDrive/Desktop/API%20M%26H%20Dashboard/dpm101-chatbot/backend/services/cache_service.py#L184-L225), `CacheService.compute_documents_fingerprint()` computes a composite SHA-256 hash across all registered text files:\n52: 1. It inspects each document file's nanosecond modification timestamp (`st_mtime_ns`) and byte size (`st_size`).\n53: 2. When cached mtimes match the filesystem, it returns the cached fingerprint instantly (microsecond latency).\n54: 3. When any document file's content or mtime changes, it reads the file bytes, computes `hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()`, and combines all document hashes into a master document fingerprint.\n55: 4. The composite cache key is generated via:\n56:    $$\\text{SHA-256}(\\text{normalized\\_query} \\parallel \\text{doc\\_fingerprint} \\parallel \\text{policy\\_version} \\parallel \\text{model\\_version})$$\n57: 5. **Exact Q12 Test Procedure**:\n58:    - In an isolated test environment with temporary document files, query Q9 (*\"What is the late submission penalty?\"*) is asked and cached under composite key $K_1$ containing document fingerprint $FP_1$.\n59:    - A subsequent repeat of Q9 verifies a Cache HIT on $K_1$.\n60:    - The test modifies the content of `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` in the isolated temporary documents directory.\n61:    - Calling `compute_documents_fingerprint()` recalculates fingerprint $FP_2 \\ne FP_1$.\n62:    - Querying Q9 again generates composite key $K_2 \\ne K_1$.\n63:    - The cache lookup for $K_2$ produces a **Cache MISS**, verifying that the old cached answer $K_1$ is not reused and fresh evaluation is executed against the updated text.\n64: \n65: ---\n66: \n67: ## 4. **E2E-01**: Complete conversation round-trip: `POST /api/v1/conversations` creates session $\\rightarrow$ `POST .../messages` persists user & assistant turns in SQLite $\\rightarrow$ `GET .../messages` returns sorted history with citations $\\rightarrow$ `DELETE` cascades deletion $\\rightarrow$ Subsequent access yields HTTP 404.\n130: - **E2E-02**: Multi-turn contextual follow-up: Turn 1 sets context (*\"What is the late submission penalty?\"*) $\\rightarrow$ Turn 2 resolves implicit reference (*\"What if I miss it by just one day?\"*) $\\rightarrow$ verifies prior turn injected into prompt and cache lookup is bypassed.\n131: \n132: ### Suite 2: Section 17 Canonical Questions End-to-End (`TestE2ESection17Acceptance`)\n133: - **E2E-03**: Questions 1, 2, 6 (Grading, Capstone, Quizzes) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies Doc 03 is cited, Doc 02 is absent, and 50% passing threshold is enforced.\n134: - **E2E-04**: Question 3 (Final Exam logistics) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 is cited, exam date is Nov 20, 2026, and forum comments are excluded.\n135: - **E2E-05**: Question 4 (Certificate fee) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies Doc 01 is cited and fee is â‚¹1,500 (adversarial â‚¹4,999 forum claim rejected).\n136: - **E2E-06**: Questions 5, 7, 8 (Refund, Kubernetes, Cricket World Cup) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies polite decline responses with `is_supported: false` or `is_in_scope: false` and confirms **they are never stored in cache**.\n137: - **E2E-07**: Question 11 (Rephrased question) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies different wording generates a different composite key, producing an expected **Cache MISS** and fresh evaluation without semantic matching.\n138: \n139: ### Suite 3: End-to-End Cache Lifecycle & TXT Fingerprint Invalidation (`TestE2ECacheAndFingerprinting`)\n140: - **E2E-08**: Cold-start cache miss $\\rightarrow$ stores validated answer $\\rightarrow$ Question 10 exact repeat yields cache HIT (`cache_hits` counter increments; Gemini call count unchanged).\n141: - **E2E-09**: Question 12 document update invalidation: Modifying `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` content and recalculating `compute_documents_fingerprint()` produces a new fingerprint $\\rightarrow$ repeated question causes cache MISS and evaluates fresh content. Old cache entry under previous fingerprint is not reused.\n142: - **E2E-10**: Unsupported answers (refund decline), out-of-scope answers, and error responses are verified absent from cache table.\n143: \n144: ### Suite 4: Cross-Tier Concurrency, Idempotency & Rate Limiting (`TestE2EConcurrencyAndLimits`)\n145: - **E2E-11**: Thundering herd duplicate resolution: 3 concurrent identical POST requests $\\rightarrow$ Primary executes synthesis, duplicate threads wait on condition variable $\\rightarrow$ all 3 receive identical HTTP 200 payload without duplicate DB inserts or multiple Gemini calls.\n146: - **E2E-12**: Sliding window rate limiting: Burst of 20 requests succeeds $\\rightarrow$ 21st request receives HTTP 429 with valid `Retry-After` header $\\rightarrow$ replaying an existing completed request during rate-limited cooldown succeeds without consuming quota.\n147: - **E2E-13**: Same-conversation lock contention: Concurrent differing queries to the same conversation return HTTP 409 `CONVERSATION_BUSY` when lock times out.\n148: \n149: ### Suite 5: Error Injection, Extractive Fallback & Metrics Integrity (`TestE2EFaultToleranceAndStats`)\n150: - **E2E-14**: Extractive fallback on provider outage: Simulating Gemini network/auth failure during message POST $\\rightarrow$ server does not crash or return 500; returns HTTP 200 with policy-grounded fallback extracted from course text files, citing official sources."}

**E2E-01**: Complete conversation round-trip: `POST /api/v1/conversations` creates session $\\rightarrow$ `POST .../messages` persists user & assistant turns in SQLite $\\rightarrow$ `GET .../messages` returns sorted history with citations $\\rightarrow$ `DELETE` cascades deletion $\\rightarrow$ Subsequent access yields HTTP 404.\n130: - **E2E-02**: Multi-turn contextual follow-up: Turn 1 sets context (*\"What is the late submission penalty?\"*) $\\rightarrow$ Turn 2 resolves implicit reference (*\"What if I miss it by just one day?\"*) $\\rightarrow$ verifies prior turn injected into prompt and cache lookup is bypassed.\n131: \n132: ### Suite 2: Section 17 Canonical Questions End-to-End (`TestE2ESection17Acceptance`)\n133: - **E2E-03**: Questions 1, 2, 6 (Grading, Capstone, Quizzes) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies Doc 03 is cited, Doc 02 is absent, 60% overall passing threshold and 40% final exam minimum are enforced, and distinction requires 85% or above.\n134: - **E2E-04**: Question 3 (Final Exam logistics) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2 is cited, exam date is Nov 20, 2026, and forum comments are excluded.\n135: - **E2E-05**: Question 4 (Certificate fee) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies Doc 01 is cited and fee is â‚¹1,500 (adversarial â‚¹4,999 forum claim rejected).\n136: - **E2E-06**: Questions 5, 7, 8 (Refund, Kubernetes, Cricket World Cup) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies polite decline responses with `is_supported: false` or `is_in_scope: false` and confirms **they are never stored in cache**.\n137: - **E2E-07**: Question 11 (Rephrased question) $\\rightarrow$ Verifies different wording generates a different composite key, producing an expected **Cache MISS** and fresh evaluation without semantic matching.\n138: \n139: ### Suite 3: End-to-End Cache Lifecycle & TXT Fingerprint Invalidation (`TestE2ECacheAndFingerprinting`)\n140: - **E2E-08**: Cold-start cache miss $\\rightarrow$ stores validated answer $\\rightarrow$ Question 10 exact repeat yields cache HIT (`cache_hits` counter increments; Gemini call count unchanged).\n141: - **E2E-09**: Question 12 document update invalidation: Modifying `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` content and recalculating `compute_documents_fingerprint()` produces a new fingerprint $\\rightarrow$ repeated question causes cache MISS and evaluates fresh content. Old cache entry under previous fingerprint is not reused.\n142: - **E2E-10**: Unsupported answers (refund decline), out-of-scope answers, and error responses are verified absent from cache table.\n143: \n144: ### Suite 4: Cross-Tier Concurrency, Idempotency & Rate Limiting (`TestE2EConcurrencyAndLimits`)\n145: - **E2E-11**: Thundering herd duplicate resolution: 3 concurrent identical POST requests $\\rightarrow$ Primary executes synthesis, duplicate threads wait on condition variable $\\rightarrow$ all 3 receive identical HTTP 200 payload without duplicate DB inserts or multiple Gemini calls.\n146: - **E2E-12**: Sliding window rate limiting: Burst of 20 requests succeeds $\\rightarrow$ 21st request receives HTTP 429 with valid `Retry-After` header $\\rightarrow$ replaying an existing completed request during rate-limited cooldown succeeds without consuming quota.\n147: - **E2E-13**: Same-conversation lock contention: Concurrent differing queries to the same conversation return HTTP 409 `CONVERSATION_BUSY` when lock times out.\n148: \n149: ### Suite 5: Error Injection, Extractive Fallback & Metrics Integrity (`TestE2EFaultToleranceAndStats`)\n150: - **E2E-14**: Extractive fallback on provider outage: Simulating Gemini network/auth failure during message POST $\\rightarrow$ server does not crash or return 500; returns HTTP 200 with policy-grounded fallback extracted from course text files, citing official sources.\n151: - **E2E-15**: Statistics accuracy across the pipeline: Verifies that valid requests, cache hits, fallback errors, and Gemini calls accurately increment the 6 fields on `GET /api/stats` without double-counting.\n152: - **E2E-16**: Health check decoupling: Repeated calls to `GET /health` return HTTP 200 without altering `gemini_calls` or operational stats.\n153: \n154: ---\n155: \n156: ## 7. Verify conversation exists and is active.\n601:           2. Save user message.\n602:           3. Retrieve recent conversation history (last N messages).\n603:           4. Update conversation activity timestamp.\n607:           8. Return structured assistant payload.\n608:         \"\"\"\n609:         # 1. Verification\n610:         is_active, err_msg = self.verify_conversation_active(conversation_id)\n611:         if not is_active:\n612:             raise ValueError(err_msg)\n613: \n614:         clean_text = user_text.strip()\n615: \n616:         # 2. Save User Message\n617:         user_msg = self.save_user_message(conversation_id, clean_text)\n618: \n619:         # 3. Context Resolution\n627:         resolved_q, is_ambiguous, clarification = self.resolve_context(\n628:             clean_text, history_before\n629:         )\n630: \n631:         if is_ambiguous and clarification:\n632:             # Re-check active status before saving clarification\n633:             is_active_amb, err_amb = self.verify_conversation_active(conversation_id)\n634:             if not is_active_amb:\n635:                 raise ValueError(err_amb or \"Conversation was deleted during processing\")\n636: \n637:             assistant_msg = self.save_assistant_message(\n638:                 conversation_id, clarification, sources=[]\n639:             )\n640:             return {\n641:                 \"conversation_id\": conversation_id,\n642:                 \"message_id\": assistant_msg[\"id\"],\n643:                 \"role\": \"assistant\",\n644:                 \"content\": clarification,\n645:                 \"sources\": [],\n646:                 \"created_at\": assistant_msg[\"created_at\"],\n647:                 \"is_in_scope\": True,\n648:                 \"is_supported\": True,\n649:                 \"is_duplicate\": False,\n650:             }\n651: \n652:         # 5. Determine context dependency for safe caching (Module 7)\n653:         is_context_dependent = (resolved_q.strip().lower() != clean_text.strip().lower()) or bool(\n654:             history_before and any(re.search(pat, clean_text.lower()) for pat in FOLLOW_UP_PRONOUNS)\n655:         )\n656: \n657:         # 6. Reset on restart.\"\n28: \n29: \n30: class StatsService:\n31:     \"\"\"\n32:     Thread-safe in-process counter service for operational monitoring.\n33:     \"\"\"\n34: \n35:     def __init__(self, start_time: Optional[float] = None) -> None:\n36:         self._lock = threading.Lock()\n37:         self._start_time = start_time if start_time is not None else time.time()\n38:         self._total_requests = 0\n39:         self._cache_hits = 0\n40:         self._gemini_calls = 0\n41:         self._errors = 0\n42: \n43:     @property\n44:     def start_time(self) -> float:\n45:         \"\"\"Process start timestamp.\"\"\"\n46:         return self._start_time\n47: \n48:     def increment_requests(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n49:         \"\"\"Increment total_requests atomically.\"\"\"\n50:         with self._lock:\n51:             self._total_requests += count\n52: \n53:     def increment_cache_hits(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n54:         \"\"\"Increment cache_hits atomically.\"\"\"\n55:         with self._lock:\n56:             self._cache_hits += count\n57: \n58:     def increment_gemini_calls(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n59:         \"\"\"Increment gemini_calls atomically.\"\"\"\n60:         with self._lock:\n61:             self._gemini_calls += count\n62: \n63:     def increment_errors(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n64:         \"\"\"Increment errors atomically.\"\"\"\n65:         with self._lock:\n66:             self._errors += count\n67: \n68:     def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n69:         \"\"\"\n70:         Retrieve a thread-safe snapshot of public operational statistics.\n71:         Returns exactly the 6 fields specified in Architecture Specification Â§9:\n72:           - total_requests: int\n73:           - cache_hits: int\n74:           - gemini_calls: int\n75:           - errors: int\n76:           - uptime_seconds: int\n77:           - worker_note: str\n78:         \"\"\"\n79:         with self._lock:\n80:             uptime = int(time.time() - self._start_time)"}

      client, services = integration_env\n\n        # 1. Create a new conversation\n        create_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        assert create_resp.status_code == 201\n        conv_data = create_resp.get_json()\n        assert \"id\" in conv_data\n        conv_id = conv_data[\"id\"]\n        assert conv_data[\"status\"] == \"active\"\n\n        # 2. Get conversation metadata\n        meta_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}\")\n        assert meta_resp.status_code == 200\n        assert meta_resp.get_json()[\"id\"] == conv_id\n\n        # 3. Turn 2: Contextual follow-up query containing pronoun \"it\"\n        turn2_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What if I miss it by just one day?\"},\n        )\n        assert turn2_resp.status_code == 200\n        turn2_data = turn2_resp.get_json()\n        # Verify assistant answers contextually based on the capstone/quiz late submission rules\n        assert \"discontinued\" in turn2_data[\"content\"] or \"penalty\" in turn2_data[\"content\"]\n        assert turn2_data[\"is_duplicate\"] is False\n\n        # Verify that both turns (4 total messages) are present in history in correct order\n        messages_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\")\n        msgs = messages_resp.get_json()[\"messages\"]\n        assert len(msgs) == 4\n        assert msgs[0][\"content\"] == \"What is the late submission penalty?\"\n        assert msgs[2][\"content\"] == \"What if I miss it by just one day?\"\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 2: Section 17 Canonical Questions End-to-End\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2ESection17Acceptance:\n    \"\"\"Verifies all Section 17 canonical questions, document authorities, and rephrased queries.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_03_canonical_q1_grading_passing_distinction_precedence(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-03: Q1 passing requirements: verifies 60% overall + 40% exam minimum; 85% distinction; Doc 03 authority.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n\n        # Strict grading assertions per 03_grading_policy_v2.txt\n        assert \"60%\" in data[\"content\"] or \"60 percent\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert \"40%\" in data[\"content\"] or \"40 percent\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert \"85%\" in data[\"content\"] or \"distinction\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n\n        # Authority assertion: Doc 03 is cited; outdated Doc 02 is excluded\n        sources_str = \" \".join(data.get(\"sources\", []))\n        assert \"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2\" in sources_str or \"Grading Policy V2\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"Policy V1\" not in sources_str\n        assert \"02_grading_policy_v1\" not in sources_str\n\n    def test_e2e_04_canonical_q2_and_q6_capstone_deadline_and_quiz_rule(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-04: Q2 capstone deadline (15 Nov 2026) and Q6 best 5 of 6 quizzes rule.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Q2: Capstone deadline\n        resp_q2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the capstone project deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q2.status_code == 200\n        data_q2 = resp_q2.get_json()\n        assert \"15 November 2026\" in data_q2[\"content\"]\n        assert \"11:59 PM\" in data_q2[\"content\"]\n\n        # Q6: Quiz rule\n        resp_q6 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"How does the best-five-of-six quiz rule work?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q6.status_code == 200\n        data_q6 = resp_q6.get_json()\n        assert \"best 5\" in data_q6[\"content\"].lower() or \"5 out of 6\" in data_q6[\"content\"]\n\n    def test_e2e_05_canonical_q3_final_exam_rules_and_forum_exclusion(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-05: Q3 exam logistics: date 20 Nov 2026, closed-book, laptop/desktop only, forum exclusion.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the final exam and what are the rules?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n\n        assert \"20 November 2026\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"closed-book\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        # Verify prohibited items/devices mentioned\n        assert \"tablet\" in data[\"content\"].lower() or \"mobile\" in data[\"content\"].lower() or \"phone\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        # Doc 04 is cited; forum section is completely excluded\n        sources_str = \" \".join(data.get(\"sources\", []))\n        assert \"Exam Rules\" in sources_str\n        assert \"Forum\" not in sources_str\n\n    def test_e2e_06_canonical_q4_certificate_fee_adversarial_rejection(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-06: Q4 certificate fee is Rs. 1,500; rejects adversarial Rs. 4,999 forum rumor.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert \"1,500\" in data[\"content\"] or \"1500\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4,999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert any(\"Handbook\" in s for s in data[\"sources\"])\n\n    def test_e2e_07_canonical_q5_q7_q8_unsupported_out_of_scope_rejection(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-07: Questions 5, 7, 8: polite decline responses; verifies they are NEVER cached.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Q5: Refund policy (unsupported topic in course context)\n        resp_q5 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the refund policy?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q5.status_code == 200\n        data_q5 = resp_q5.get_json()\n        assert \"do not specify a refund policy\" in data_q5[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert data_q5[\"is_supported\"] is False\n\n        # Q7: Technical question out of scope\n        resp_q7 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Can you help me with SQL joins and Kubernetes setup?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q7.status_code == 200\n        data_q7 = resp_q7.get_json()\n        assert \"do not specify whether\" in data_q7[\"content\"].lower() or \"only answer questions related to the dpm-101 course\" in data_q7[\"content\"].lower()\n\n        # Q8: Completely unrelated question\n        resp_q8 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Who won the cricket World Cup?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q8.status_code == 200\n        data_q8 = resp_q8.get_json()\n        assert \"i can only answer questions related to the dpm-101 course\" in data_q8[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert data_q8[\"is_in_scope\"] is False\n\n        # Verify NONE of these 3 responses are stored in the SQLite cache table\n        cache_svc: CacheService = services[\"cache_service\"]\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"What is the refund policy?\") is None\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"Can you help me with SQL joins and Kubernetes setup?\") is None\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"Who won the cricket World Cup?\") is None\n\n    def test_e2e_08_canonical_q11_rephrased_query_cache_miss(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-08: Q11 rephrased question produces a Cache MISS and fresh evaluation (no semantic caching).\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Turn 1: Ask Q9 (\"What is the late submission penalty?\")\n        resp_q9 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the late submission penalty?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q9.status_code == 200\n        hits_before = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"]\n\n        # Turn 2: Ask rephrased Q11 in a new session (\"What happens if I submit my assignment late?\")\n        conv2_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        resp_q11 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv2_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What happens if I submit my assignment late?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q11.status_code == 200\n        hits_after = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"]\n\n        # Verified: hits_after == hits_before (Q11 produced a Cache MISS because the wording differs)\n        assert hits_after == hits_before\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 3: End-to-End Cache Lifecycle & TXT Fingerprint Invalidation\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2ECacheAndFingerprinting:\n    \"\"\"Verifies cold-start caching, exact-key hits, and document fingerprint cache invalidation.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_09_cold_start_miss_and_q10_exact_repeat_hit(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-09: Cold-start miss stores answer; Q10 exact repeat yields cache HIT without calling Gemini.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        stats_svc: StatsService = services[\"stats_service\"]\n        initial_stats = stats_svc.get_stats()\n        assert initial_stats[\"cache_hits\"] == 0\n\n        # Request 1: Cold start miss -> calls Gemini and writes cache\n        resp1 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the capstone project deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp1.status_code == 200\n        stats1 = stats_svc.get_stats()\n        assert stats1[\"gemini_calls\"] == 1\n        assert stats1[\"cache_hits\"] == 0\n\n        # Request 2: Q10 exact repeat in a fresh conversation -> Cache HIT\n        conv2_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        resp2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv2_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the capstone project deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp2.status_code == 200\n        stats2 = stats_svc.get_stats()\n        # Gemini call count remains 1, cache_hits increments to 1\n        assert stats2[\"gemini_calls\"] == 1\n        assert stats2[\"cache_hits\"] == 1\n        assert resp2.get_json()[\"content\"] == resp1.get_json()[\"content\"]\n\n    def test_e2e_10_canonical_q12_txt_fingerprint_invalidation(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"E2E-10: Modifying 03_grading_policy_v2.txt updates document fingerprint, causing a Cache MISS.\"\"\"\n        # Setup an isolated documents directory\n        temp_docs_dir = tmp_path / \"temp_documents\"\n        temp_docs_dir.mkdir()\n        for doc_id, doc_meta in DOC_REGISTRY.items():\n            src_file = Path(config.DOCUMENTS_DIR) / doc_meta[\"filename\"]\n            if src_file.exists():\n                shutil.copy(src_file, temp_docs_dir / doc_meta[\"filename\"])\n\n        db_file = str(tmp_path / \"cache_invalidation.db\")\n        stats_svc = StatsService()\n        set_stats_service(stats_svc)\n\n        mock_gemini_client = make_mock_gemini_client()\n        gemini_svc = GeminiService(client=mock_gemini_client)\n\n        cache_svc = CacheService(db_path=db_file, documents_dir=str(temp_docs_dir))\n        doc_proc = DocumentProcessor(DOC_REGISTRY, str(temp_docs_dir))\n        policy_svc = PolicyService(\n            gemini_service=gemini_svc,\n            doc_processor=doc_proc,\n            cache_service=cache_svc,\n        )\n        chat_svc = ChatService(\n            db_path=db_file,\n            policy_service=policy_svc,\n            cache_service=cache_svc,\n        )\n\n        app_instance = create_app({\n            \"TESTING\": True,\n            \"DB_PATH\": db_file,\n            \"chat_service\": chat_svc,\n            \"stats_service\": stats_svc,\n        })\n\n        with app_instance.test_client() as client:\n            conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n            query = \"What is the late submission penalty?\"\n\n            # 1. First execution: Cold-start miss\n            resp1 = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": query},\n            )\n            assert resp1.status_code == 200\n            fp1 = cache_svc.compute_documents_fingerprint()\n\n            # 2. Second execution: Cache HIT\n            conv2_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n            resp2 = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv2_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": query},\n            )\n            assert resp2.status_code == 200\n            assert stats_svc.get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"] == 1\n\n            # 3. Simulate Course Coordinator modifying Doc 03\n            doc3_path = temp_docs_dir / \"03_grading_policy_v2.txt\"\n            time.sleep(0.05)  # Ensure nanosecond mtime differential\n            with open(doc3_path, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                f.write(\"\\n\\n4. AMENDMENT: One-time special extension granted.\\n\")\n\n            # 4. Invalidation: Document fingerprint changes automatically\n            fp2 = cache_svc.compute_documents_fingerprint(force_recompute=True)\n            assert fp1 != fp2, \"Document fingerprint must change when course text is modified\"\n\n            # 5. Querying again produces a Cache MISS because the composite key incorporates the new fingerprint\n            conv3_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n            resp3 = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv3_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": query},\n            )\n            assert resp3.status_code == 200\n            # Cache hits must NOT increment on cache miss\n            assert stats_svc.get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"] == 1\n\n        set_stats_service(None)\n\n    def test_e2e_11_unsupported_and_error_answers_never_cached(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-11: Unsupported answers, out-of-scope answers, and provider errors are never stored in cache table.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        cache_svc: CacheService = services[\"cache_service\"]\n\n        # Verify cache table is initialized and empty initially\n        stats = cache_svc.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] == 0\n\n        # Ask unsupported query\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the refund policy?\"},\n        )\n\n        # Ask out-of-scope query\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Tell me a joke about robots\"},\n        )\n\n        # Directly inspect the SQLite cache table\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(services[\"db_path\"])\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cache;\")\n            count = cursor.fetchone()[0]\n            assert count == 0, f\"Cache table should have 0 entries, found {count}\"\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 4: Cross-Tier Concurrency, Idempotency & Rate Limiting\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2EConcurrencyAndLimits:\n    \"\"\"Verifies Thundering Herd duplicate resolution, sliding-window rate limiting, and conversation locks.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_12_thundering_herd_duplicate_resolution(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-12: 3 concurrent identical requests: exactly 1 Gemini call; duplicate threads wait and receive 200.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        results = []\n        errors = []\n        barrier = threading.Barrier(3)\n        req_id = \"req-e2e-thundering-herd-1\"\n\n        # Make the mock Gemini call delay briefly so duplicate threads register as in-flight waiters\n        original_side_effect = services[\"mock_gemini_client\"].models.generate_content.side_effect\n\n        def slow_generate(*args, **kwargs):\n            time.sleep(0.15)\n            return original_side_effect(*args, **kwargs)\n\n        services[\"mock_gemini_client\"].models.generate_content.side_effect = slow_generate\n\n        def worker():\n            try:\n                barrier.wait(timeout=5.0)\n                resp = client.post(\n                    f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                    json={\n                        \"message\": \"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\",\n                        \"request_id\": req_id,\n                    },\n                    headers={\"X-Request-ID\": req_id},\n                )\n                results.append(resp)\n            except Exception as e:\n                errors.append(e)\n\n        threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(3)]\n        for t in threads:\n            t.start()\n        for t in threads:\n            t.join(timeout=10.0)\n\n        assert not errors, f\"Threads encountered exceptions: {errors}\"\n        assert len(results) == 3\n\n        # All 3 requests receive HTTP 200 with identical grounded answers\n        for r in results:\n            assert r.status_code == 200\n            data = r.get_json()\n            assert \"60%\" in data[\"content\"]\n            assert \"40%\" in data[\"content\"]\n\n        # Exactly 1 primary turn (is_duplicate: False) and 2 duplicate replays (is_duplicate: True)\n        duplicate_flags = [r.get_json().get(\"is_duplicate\") for r in results]\n        assert duplicate_flags.count(False) == 1\n        assert duplicate_flags.count(True) == 2\n\n        # Exactly 2 responses have header X-Duplicate-Request: true\n        dup_headers = [r.headers.get(\"X-Duplicate-Request\") for r in results]\n        assert dup_headers.count(\"true\") == 2\n\n        # Database contains exactly one user message and one assistant message\n        messages = services[\"chat_service\"].get_conversation_messages(conv_id)\n        assert len(messages) == 2\n        assert messages[0][\"role\"] == \"user\"\n        assert messages[1][\"role\"] == \"assistant\"\n\n        # Gemini was called exactly once across all 3 concurrent requests\n        stats = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"gemini_calls\"] == 1\n\n    def test_e2e_13_sliding_window_rate_limiting_and_replay_exemption(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-13: Sliding window limits bursts to limit (HTTP 429), while duplicate replays are exempt from rate limit.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        test_limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(default_ip_limit=5, default_ip_window=60)\n        services[\"app\"].extensions[\"rate_limiter\"] = test_limiter\n\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        completed_req_id = \"req-e2e-rate-limit-1\"\n\n        # Request 1: succeeds and establishes idempotency record\n        resp1 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\", \"request_id\": completed_req_id},\n            headers={\"X-Request-ID\": completed_req_id},\n        )\n        assert resp1.status_code == 200\n\n        # Requests 2 to 5: consume the remainder of the 5-request quota\n        for i in range(2, 6):\n            r_id = f\"req-e2e-rate-limit-{i}\"\n            r = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": f\"Inquiry number {i} regarding DPM course\", \"request_id\": r_id},\n                headers={\"X-Request-ID\": r_id},\n            )\n            assert r.status_code == 200\n\n        # Request 6: Exceeds rate limit -> returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header\n        resp_blocked = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Exceeding request when rate limited\", \"request_id\": \"req-blocked\"},\n            headers={\"X-Request-ID\": \"req-blocked\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_blocked.status_code == 429\n        assert resp_blocked.get_json().get(\"code\") == \"RATE_LIMITED\"\n        assert \"Retry-After\" in resp_blocked.headers\n\n        # Replaying the earlier completed request must succeed (HTTP 200) without being blocked by rate limiting\n        resp_replay = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\", \"request_id\": completed_req_id},\n            headers={\"X-Request-ID\": completed_req_id},\n        )\n        assert resp_replay.status_code == 200\n        assert resp_replay.get_json().get(\"is_duplicate\") is True\n        assert resp_replay.headers.get(\"X-Duplicate-Request\") == \"true\"\n\n    def test_e2e_14_same_conversation_lock_contention(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-14: Concurrent differing query to the same conversation returns HTTP 409 CONVERSATION_BUSY on lock timeout.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        req_mgr: RequestManager = services[\"request_manager\"]\n        old_timeout = req_mgr.lock_timeout\n        req_mgr.lock_timeout = 0.15\n\n        try:\n            conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n            # Acquire the per-conversation lock simulating an in-progress request\n            acquired = req_mgr.acquire_conversation_lock(conv_id)\n            assert acquired is True\n\n            try:\n                # Second request to same conversation arrives while lock is held\n                resp_busy = client.post(\n                    f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                    json={\"message\": \"Different question while conversation lock is held\", \"request_id\": \"req-busy-1\"},\n                    headers={\"X-Request-ID\": \"req-busy-1\"},\n                )\n                assert resp_busy.status_code == 409\n                data = resp_busy.get_json()\n                assert data.get(\"code\") == \"CONVERSATION_BUSY\"\n            finally:\n                req_mgr.release_conversation_lock(conv_id)\n\n            # After lock release, new requests proceed smoothly\n            resp_after = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": \"Question after lock is released\", \"request_id\": \"req-after-lock\"},\n                headers={\"X-Request-ID\": \"req-after-lock\"},\n            )\n            assert resp_after.status_code == 200\n        finally:\n            req_mgr.lock_timeout = old_timeout\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 5: Error Injection, Extractive Fallback & Metrics Integrity\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2EFaultToleranceAndStats:\n    \"\"\"Verifies extractive fallback on Gemini outage, stats counter accuracy, and health check decoupling.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_15_extractive_fallback_on_provider_outage(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-15: Gemini network/auth failure triggers extractive fallback without HTTP 500 crash.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        services[\"mock_gemini_client\"].models.generate_content.side_effect = RuntimeError(\n            \"Connection refused: Gemini API endpoint unreachable\"\n        )\n\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\"},\n        )\n        # Server must gracefully return HTTP 200 with extractive fallback\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert \"60%\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"40%\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"Grading Policy V2\" in data[\"content\"] or any(\"Grading\" in s for s in data.get(\"sources\", []))\n\n        # Stats error counter should increment exactly once\n        stats = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"errors\"] == 1\n        assert stats[\"gemini_calls\"] >= 1\n\n        # Fallback response must NOT be stored in the SQLite cache\n        cache_svc: CacheService = services[\"cache_service\"]\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\") is None\n\n    def test_e2e_16_stats_pipeline_integrity_and_health_decoupling(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-16: /health calls do not consume quota or alter stats; schema matches exact 6 fields.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n\n        # Verify initial stats schema\n        stats_resp = client.get(\"/api/stats\")\n        assert stats_resp.status_code == 200\n        stats_data = stats_resp.get_json()\n        assert len(stats_data) == 6\n        assert set(stats_data.keys()) == {\n            \"total_requests\",\n            \"cache_hits\",\n            \"gemini_calls\",\n            \"errors\",\n            \"uptime_seconds\",\n            \"worker_note\",\n        }\n        assert stats_data[\"total_requests\"] == 0\n        assert stats_data[\"gemini_calls\"] == 0\n        assert stats_data[\"worker_note\"] == WORKER_NOTE\n\n        # 5 calls to /health must NOT alter any counters\n        for _ in range(5):\n            h_resp = client.get(\"/health\")\n            assert h_resp.status_code == 200\n            assert h_resp.get_json()[\"status\"] == \"healthy\"\n\n        stats_after_health = client.get(\"/api/stats\").get_json()\n        assert stats_after_health[\"total_requests\"] == 0\n        assert stats_after_health[\"gemini_calls\"] == 0\n\n        # Root static GET / must NOT alter counters\n        root_resp = client.get(\"/\")\n        assert root_resp.status_code == 200\n        assert \"<title>IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk</title>\" in root_resp.data.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n        # Invalid requests (404 conversation, 400 bad JSON) must NOT increment total_requests\n        client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/messages\", json={\"message\": \"hello\"})\n        client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\", data=\"not json\", content_type=\"text/plain\")\n\n        stats_after_errors = client.get(\"/api/stats\").get_json()\n        assert stats_after_errors[\"total_requests\"] == 0\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"C:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_module11_e2e_integration.py"}}]}
