â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\n\ndef make_mock_gemini_client():\n    \"\"\"\n    Creates a controlled mock Google GenAI client returning policy-grounded answers\n    for canonical course inquiries without making external network calls.\n    Extracts the specific student question from the grounded prompt to prevent\n    keywords in background document excerpts from triggering incorrect branches.\n    \"\"\"\n    mock_client = MagicMock()\n\n    def generate_content(model, contents, config=None):\n        prompt_str = str(contents)\n        if \"STUDENT QUESTION:\" in prompt_str:\n            q_part = prompt_str.split(\"STUDENT QUESTION:\")[1].split(\"ANSWER (grounded\")[0].strip().lower()\n        else:\n            q_part = prompt_str.lower()\n\n        if any(w in q_part for w in (\"pass\", \"passing\", \"score to pass\")):\n            text = (\n                \"To pass the course and earn the Verified Certificate, learners must achieve an overall \"\n                \"weighted score of at least 60% across all assessments, AND score at least 40% in \"\n                \"the Proctored Final Exam separately. Learners scoring 85% or above receive a \"\n                \"'Pass with Distinction' badge.\\n\\nSource: Grading Policy V2.\"\n            )\n        elif \"distinction\" in q_part:\n            text = (\n                \"Learners scoring 85% or above receive a 'Pass with Distinction' badge.\\n\\n\"\n                \"Source: Grading Policy V2.\"\n            )\n        elif \"capstone\" in q_part and any(w in q_part for w in (\"deadline\", \"due\", \"when\", \"date\")):\n            text = (\n                \"The Capstone Product Case deadline has been extended to 15 November 2026 at 11:59 PM IST \"\n                \"(extended by 5 days from the earlier deadline).\\n\\nSource: Grading Policy V2.\"\n            )\n        elif \"exam\" in q_part and any(w in q_part for w in (\"rules\", \"when\", \"date\", \"logistics\")):\n            text = (\n                \"The Proctored Final Exam takes place on 20 November 2026, with slots available between \"\n                \"10:00 AM and 8:00 PM IST. The exam duration is 90 minutes. It is strictly closed-book \"\n                \"and AI-proctored. Students must take it on a desktop or laptop with webcam and microphone \"\n                \"enabled. Mobile phones and tablets are not permitted.\\n\\n\"\n                \"Source: Official Exam Rules.\"\n            )\n        elif any(w in q_part for w in (\"certificate fee\", \"cost\", \"fee\")):\n            text = (\n                \"The Verified Certificate Track costs Rs. 1,500. \"\n                \"It provides graded quizzes, capstone review, and proctored exam access.\\n\\n\"\n                \"Source: Course Handbook & Overview.\"\n            )\n        elif any(w in q_part for w in (\"best-five-of-six\", \"best 5\", \"quiz rule\", \"quizzes count\", \"miss 1 quiz\")):\n            text = (\n                \"The course includes 6 weekly quizzes, and the best 5 out of 6 weekly quizzes count \"\n                \"toward your grade. Learners can miss 1 weekly quiz without penalty.\\n\\n\"\n                \"Source: Grading Policy V2.\"\n            )\n        elif any(w in q_part for w in (\"late submission\", \"late\", \"penalty\", \"miss it by just one day\", \"one day late\", \"capstone case\")):\n            text = (\n                \"Late submissions are no longer accepted for weekly quizzes or the capstone case. \"\n                \"The earlier 48-hour grace window with a 10% penalty has been discontinued. \"\n                \"Because the best 5 out of 6 weekly quizzes are counted, learners can miss 1 weekly quiz without penalty.\\n\\n\"\n                \"Source: Grading Policy V2.\"\n            )\n        else:\n            text = (\n                \"Here is the official information regarding your course inquiry.\\n\\n\"\n                \"Source: Course Handbook & Overview.\"\n            )\n\n        resp = MagicMock()\n        resp.text = text\n        resp.candidates = [MagicMock()]\n        resp.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count = 50\n        resp.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count = 35\n        resp.usage_metadata.total_token_count = 85\n        return resp\n\n    mock_client.models.generate_content.side_effect = generate_content\n    return mock_client\n\n\n# â”€â”€ Pytest Fixture SUITE 1: Full-Stack Multi-Turn Conversation Lifecycle\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2EConversationLifecycle:\n    \"\"\"Verifies complete multi-turn conversation persistence, context resolution, and cascade deletion.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_01_conversation_crud_and_message_history(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-01: Full conversation round-trip: create -> send message -> list history -> cascade delete -> 404.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n\n        # 1. Create a new conversation\n        create_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        assert create_resp.status_code == 201\n        conv_data = create_resp.get_json()\n        assert \"id\" in conv_data\n        conv_id = conv_data[\"id\"]\n        assert conv_data[\"status\"] == \"active\"\n\n        # 2. Get conversation metadata\n        meta_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}\")\n        assert meta_resp.status_code == 200\n        assert meta_resp.get_json()[\"id\"] == conv_id\n\n        # 3. Post a message to the conversation\n        msg_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\"},\n        )\n        assert msg_resp.status_code == 200\n        msg_data = msg_resp.get_json()\n        assert msg_data[\"conversation_id\"] == conv_id\n        assert msg_data[\"role\"] == \"assistant\"\n        assert \"1,500\" in msg_data[\"content\"]\n        assert any(\"Handbook\" in s for s in msg_data[\"sources\"])\n        assert msg_data[\"is_duplicate\"] is False\n\n        # 4. Retrieve message history\n        hist_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\")\n        assert hist_resp.status_code == 200\n        hist_data = hist_resp.get_json()\n        assert hist_data[\"conversation_id\"] == conv_id\n        messages = hist_data[\"messages\"]\n        assert len(messages) == 2\n        assert messages[0][\"role\"] == \"user\"\n        assert messages[0][\"content\"] == \"What is the certificate fee?\"\n        assert messages[1][\"role\"] == \"assistant\"\n        assert \"1,500\" in messages[1][\"content\"]\n\n        # 5. Delete the conversation\n        del_resp = client.delete(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}\")\n        assert del_resp.status_code == 200\n        assert del_resp.get_json()[\"success\"] is True\n\n        # 6. Verify subsequent requests return HTTP 404\n        assert client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}\").status_code == 404\n        assert client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\").status_code == 404\n        post_after_del = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Can I still send a message?\"},\n        )\n        assert post_after_del.status_code == 404\n\n    def test_e2e_02_multiturn_contextual_followup(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-02: Multi-turn contextual follow-up: Turn 1 sets context -> Turn 2 resolves pronoun and bypasses cache.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n\n        # Create session\n        conv_resp = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\")\n        conv_id = conv_resp.get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Turn 1: Specific query establishing context\n        turn1_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the late submission penalty?\"},\n        )\n        assert turn1_resp.status_code == 200\n        turn1_data = turn1_resp.get_json()\n        assert \"Late submissions are no longer accepted\" in turn1_data[\"content\"]\n\n        # Turn 2: Contextual follow-up query containing pronoun \"it\"\n        turn2_resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What if I miss it by just one day?\"},\n        )\n        assert turn2_resp.status_code == 200\n        turn2_data = turn2_resp.get_json()\n        # Verify assistant answers contextually based on the capstone/quiz late submission rules\n        assert \"discontinued\" in turn2_data[\"content\"] or \"penalty\" in turn2_data[\"content\"] or \"longer accepted\" in turn2_data[\"content\"]\n        assert turn2_data[\"is_duplicate\"] is False\n\n        # Verify that both turns (4 total messages) are present in history in correct order\n        messages_resp = client.get(f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\")\n        msgs = messages_resp.get_json()[\"messages\"]\n        assert len(msgs) == 4\n        assert msgs[0][\"content\"] == \"What is the late submission penalty?\"\n        assert msgs[2][\"content\"] == \"What if I miss it by just one day?\"\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 2: Section 17 Canonical Questions End-to-End\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2ESection17Acceptance:\n    \"\"\"Verifies all Section 17 canonical questions, document authorities, and rephrased queries.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_03_canonical_q1_grading_passing_distinction_precedence(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-03: Q1 passing requirements: verifies 60% overall + 40% exam minimum; 85% distinction; Doc 03 authority.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n\n        # Strict grading assertions per 03_grading_policy_v2.txt\n        assert \"60%\" in data[\"content\"] or \"60 percent\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert \"40%\" in data[\"content\"] or \"40 percent\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert \"85%\" in data[\"content\"] or \"distinction\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n\n        # Authority assertion: Doc 03 is cited; outdated Doc 02 is excluded\n        sources_str = \" \".join(data.get(\"sources\", []))\n        assert \"Grading & Late Submission Policy V2\" in sources_str or \"Grading Policy V2\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"Policy V1\" not in sources_str\n        assert \"02_grading_policy_v1\" not in sources_str\n\n    def test_e2e_04_canonical_q2_and_q6_capstone_deadline_and_quiz_rule(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-04: Q2 capstone deadline (15 Nov 2026) and Q6 best 5 of 6 quizzes rule.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Q2: Capstone deadline\n        resp_q2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the capstone project deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q2.status_code == 200\n        data_q2 = resp_q2.get_json()\n        assert \"15 November 2026\" in data_q2[\"content\"]\n        assert \"11:59 PM\" in data_q2[\"content\"]\n\n        # Q6: Quiz rule\n        resp_q6 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"How does the best-five-of-six quiz rule work?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q6.status_code == 200\n        data_q6 = resp_q6.get_json()\n        assert \"best 5\" in data_q6[\"content\"].lower() or \"5 out of 6\" in data_q6[\"content\"]\n\n    def test_e2e_05_canonical_q3_final_exam_rules_and_forum_exclusion(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-05: Q3 exam logistics: date 20 Nov 2026, closed-book, laptop/desktop only, forum exclusion.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the final exam and what are the rules?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n\n        assert \"20 November 2026\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"closed-book\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        # Verify prohibited items/devices mentioned\n        assert \"tablet\" in data[\"content\"].lower() or \"mobile\" in data[\"content\"].lower() or \"phone\" in data[\"content\"].lower()\n        # Doc 04 is cited; forum section is completely excluded\n        sources_str = \" \".join(data.get(\"sources\", []))\n        assert \"Exam Rules\" in sources_str\n        assert \"Forum\" not in sources_str\n\n    def test_e2e_06_canonical_q4_certificate_fee_adversarial_rejection(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-06: Q4 certificate fee is Rs. 1,500; rejects adversarial Rs. 4,999 forum rumor.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert \"1,500\" in data[\"content\"] or \"1500\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4,999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"4999\" not in data[\"content\"]\n        assert any(\"Handbook\" in s for s in data[\"sources\"])\n\n    def test_e2e_07_canonical_q5_q7_q8_unsupported_out_of_scope_rejection(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-07: Questions 5, 7, 8: polite decline responses; verifies they are NEVER cached.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Q5: Refund policy (unsupported topic in course context)\n        resp_q5 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the refund policy?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q5.status_code == 200\n        data_q5 = resp_q5.get_json()\n        assert \"do not specify a refund policy\" in data_q5[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert data_q5[\"is_supported\"] is False\n\n        # Q7: Technical question out of scope\n        resp_q7 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Can you help me with SQL joins and Kubernetes setup?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q7.status_code == 200\n        data_q7 = resp_q7.get_json()\n        assert \"do not specify whether\" in data_q7[\"content\"].lower() or \"only answer questions related to the dpm-101 course\" in data_q7[\"content\"].lower()\n\n        # Q8: Completely unrelated question\n        resp_q8 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Who won the cricket World Cup?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q8.status_code == 200\n        data_q8 = resp_q8.get_json()\n        assert \"i can only answer questions related to the dpm-101 course\" in data_q8[\"content\"].lower()\n        assert data_q8[\"is_in_scope\"] is False\n\n        # Verify NONE of these 3 responses are stored in the SQLite cache table\n        cache_svc: CacheService = services[\"cache_service\"]\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"What is the refund policy?\") is None\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"Can you help me with SQL joins and Kubernetes setup?\") is None\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"Who won the cricket World Cup?\") is None\n\n    def test_e2e_08_canonical_q11_rephrased_query_cache_miss(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-08: Q11 rephrased question produces a Cache MISS and fresh evaluation (no semantic caching).\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Turn 1: Ask Q9 (\"What is the late submission penalty?\")\n        resp_q9 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the late submission penalty?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q9.status_code == 200\n        hits_before = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"]\n\n        # Turn 2: Ask rephrased Q11 in a new session (\"What happens if I submit my assignment late?\")\n        conv2_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        resp_q11 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv2_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What happens if I submit my assignment late?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_q11.status_code == 200\n        hits_after = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"]\n\n        # Verified: hits_after == hits_before (Q11 produced a Cache MISS because the wording differs)\n        assert hits_after == hits_before\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 3: End-to-End Cache Lifecycle & TXT Fingerprint Invalidation\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2ECacheAndFingerprinting:\n    \"\"\"Verifies cold-start caching, exact-key hits, and document fingerprint cache invalidation.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_09_cold_start_miss_and_q10_exact_repeat_hit(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-09: Cold-start miss stores answer; Q10 exact repeat yields cache HIT without calling Gemini.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        stats_svc: StatsService = services[\"stats_service\"]\n        initial_stats = stats_svc.get_stats()\n        assert initial_stats[\"cache_hits\"] == 0\n\n        # Request 1: Cold start miss -> calls Gemini and writes cache\n        resp1 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the capstone project deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp1.status_code == 200\n        stats1 = stats_svc.get_stats()\n        assert stats1[\"gemini_calls\"] == 1\n        assert stats1[\"cache_hits\"] == 0\n\n        # Request 2: Q10 exact repeat in a fresh conversation -> Cache HIT\n        conv2_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        resp2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv2_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"When is the capstone project deadline?\"},\n        )\n        assert resp2.status_code == 200\n        stats2 = stats_svc.get_stats()\n        # Gemini call count remains 1, cache_hits increments to 1\n        assert stats2[\"gemini_calls\"] == 1\n        assert stats2[\"cache_hits\"] == 1\n        assert resp2.get_json()[\"content\"] == resp1.get_json()[\"content\"]\n\n    def test_e2e_10_canonical_q12_txt_fingerprint_invalidation(self, tmp_path):\n        \"\"\"E2E-10: Modifying 03_grading_policy_v2.txt updates document fingerprint, causing a Cache MISS.\"\"\"\n        # Setup an isolated documents directory\n        temp_docs_dir = tmp_path / \"temp_documents\"\n        temp_docs_dir.mkdir()\n        for doc_id, doc_meta in DOC_REGISTRY.items():\n            src_file = Path(config.DOCUMENTS_DIR) / doc_meta[\"filename\"]\n            if src_file.exists():\n                shutil.copy(src_file, temp_docs_dir / doc_meta[\"filename\"])\n\n        db_file = str(tmp_path / \"cache_invalidation.db\")\n        stats_svc = StatsService()\n        set_stats_service(stats_svc)\n\n        mock_gemini_client = make_mock_gemini_client()\n        gemini_svc = GeminiService(client=mock_gemini_client)\n\n        cache_svc = CacheService(db_path=db_file, documents_dir=str(temp_docs_dir))\n        doc_proc = DocumentProcessor(DOC_REGISTRY, str(temp_docs_dir))\n        policy_svc = PolicyService(\n            gemini_service=gemini_svc,\n            doc_processor=doc_proc,\n            cache_service=cache_svc,\n        )\n        chat_svc = ChatService(\n            db_path=db_file,\n            policy_service=policy_svc,\n            cache_service=cache_svc,\n        )\n\n        app_instance = create_app({\n            \"TESTING\": True,\n            \"DB_PATH\": db_file,\n            \"chat_service\": chat_svc,\n            \"stats_service\": stats_svc,\n        })\n\n        client = app_instance.test_client()\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        query = \"What is the late submission penalty?\"\n\n        # 1. First execution: Cold-start miss\n        resp1 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": query},\n        )\n        assert resp1.status_code == 200\n        fp1 = cache_svc.compute_documents_fingerprint()\n\n        # 2. Second execution: Cache HIT\n        conv2_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        resp2 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv2_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": query},\n        )\n        assert resp2.status_code == 200\n        assert stats_svc.get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"] == 1\n\n        # 3. Simulate Course Coordinator modifying Doc 03\n        doc3_path = temp_docs_dir / \"03_grading_policy_v2.txt\"\n        time.sleep(0.05)  # Ensure nanosecond mtime differential\n        with open(doc3_path, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            f.write(\"\\n\\n4. AMENDMENT: One-time special extension granted.\\n\")\n\n        # 4. Invalidation: Document fingerprint changes automatically\n        fp2 = cache_svc.compute_documents_fingerprint(force_recompute=True)\n        assert fp1 != fp2, \"Document fingerprint must change when course text is modified\"\n\n        # 5. Querying again produces a Cache MISS because the composite key incorporates the new fingerprint\n        conv3_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        resp3 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv3_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": query},\n        )\n        assert resp3.status_code == 200\n        # Cache hits must NOT increment on cache miss\n        assert stats_svc.get_stats()[\"cache_hits\"] == 1\n\n        set_stats_service(None)\n\n    def test_e2e_11_unsupported_and_error_answers_never_cached(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-11: Unsupported answers, out-of-scope answers, and provider errors are never stored in cache table.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        cache_svc: CacheService = services[\"cache_service\"]\n\n        # Verify cache table is initialized and empty initially\n        stats = cache_svc.get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"total_entries\"] == 0\n\n        # Ask unsupported query\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the refund policy?\"},\n        )\n\n        # Ask out-of-scope query\n        client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Tell me a joke about robots\"},\n        )\n\n        # Directly inspect the SQLite query_cache table\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(services[\"db_path\"])\n        try:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM query_cache;\")\n            count = cursor.fetchone()[0]\n            assert count == 0, f\"query_cache table should have 0 entries, found {count}\"\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 4: Cross-Tier Concurrency, Idempotency & Rate Limiting\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2EConcurrencyAndLimits:\n    \"\"\"Verifies Thundering Herd duplicate resolution, sliding-window rate limiting, and conversation locks.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_12_thundering_herd_duplicate_resolution(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-12: 3 concurrent identical requests: exactly 1 Gemini call; duplicate threads wait and receive 200.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        app = services[\"app\"]\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        results = [None] * 3\n        errors = [None] * 3\n        barrier = threading.Barrier(3)\n        req_id = \"req-e2e-thundering-herd-1\"\n\n        # Make mock Gemini delay briefly so duplicate threads register as in-flight waiters\n        original_side_effect = services[\"mock_gemini_client\"].models.generate_content.side_effect\n\n        def slow_generate(*args, **kwargs):\n            time.sleep(0.15)\n            return original_side_effect(*args, **kwargs)\n\n        services[\"mock_gemini_client\"].models.generate_content.side_effect = slow_generate\n\n        def worker(thread_idx):\n            # Each thread uses its own test client to prevent contextvar collisions in Python 3.11\n            with app.test_client() as c:\n                try:\n                    barrier.wait(timeout=5.0)\n                    resp = c.post(\n                        f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                        json={\n                            \"message\": \"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\",\n                            \"request_id\": req_id,\n                        },\n                        headers={\"X-Request-ID\": req_id},\n                    )\n                    results[thread_idx] = (\n                        resp.status_code,\n                        resp.get_json(),\n                        resp.headers.get(\"X-Duplicate-Request\"),\n                    )\n                except Exception as e:\n                    errors[thread_idx] = e\n\n        threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(i,)) for i in range(3)]\n        for t in threads:\n            t.start()\n        for t in threads:\n            t.join(timeout=10.0)\n\n        err_list = [e for e in errors if e is not None]\n        assert not err_list, f\"Threads encountered exceptions: {err_list}\"\n\n        # All 3 requests receive HTTP 200 with identical grounded answers\n        for r in results:\n            assert r[0] == 200\n            data = r[1]\n            assert \"60%\" in data[\"content\"]\n            assert \"40%\" in data[\"content\"]\n\n        # Exactly 1 primary turn (is_duplicate: False) and 2 duplicate replays (is_duplicate: True)\n        duplicate_flags = [r[1][\"is_duplicate\"] for r in results]\n        assert duplicate_flags.count(False) == 1\n        assert duplicate_flags.count(True) == 2\n\n        # Exactly 2 responses have header X-Duplicate-Request: true\n        dup_headers = [r[2] for r in results]\n        assert dup_headers.count(\"true\") == 2\n\n        # Database contains exactly one user message and one assistant message\n        messages = services[\"chat_service\"].get_conversation_messages(conv_id)\n        assert len(messages) == 2\n        assert messages[0][\"role\"] == \"user\"\n        assert messages[1][\"role\"] == \"assistant\"\n\n        # Gemini was called exactly once across all 3 concurrent requests\n        stats = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"gemini_calls\"] == 1\n\n    def test_e2e_13_sliding_window_rate_limiting_and_replay_exemption(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-13: Sliding window limits bursts to limit (HTTP 429), while duplicate replays are exempt from rate limit.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        test_limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(default_ip_limit=5, default_ip_window=60)\n        services[\"app\"].extensions[\"rate_limiter\"] = test_limiter\n\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n        completed_req_id = \"req-e2e-rate-limit-1\"\n\n        # Request 1: succeeds and establishes idempotency record\n        resp1 = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\", \"request_id\": completed_req_id},\n            headers={\"X-Request-ID\": completed_req_id},\n        )\n        assert resp1.status_code == 200\n\n        # Requests 2 to 5: consume the remainder of the 5-request quota\n        for i in range(2, 6):\n            r_id = f\"req-e2e-rate-limit-{i}\"\n            r = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": f\"Inquiry number {i} regarding DPM course\", \"request_id\": r_id},\n                headers={\"X-Request-ID\": r_id},\n            )\n            assert r.status_code == 200\n\n        # Request 6: Exceeds rate limit -> returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header\n        resp_blocked = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"Exceeding request when rate limited\", \"request_id\": \"req-blocked\"},\n            headers={\"X-Request-ID\": \"req-blocked\"},\n        )\n        assert resp_blocked.status_code == 429\n        assert resp_blocked.get_json().get(\"code\") == \"RATE_LIMITED\"\n        assert \"Retry-After\" in resp_blocked.headers\n\n        # Replaying the earlier completed request must succeed (HTTP 200) without being blocked by rate limiting\n        resp_replay = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What is the certificate fee?\", \"request_id\": completed_req_id},\n            headers={\"X-Request-ID\": completed_req_id},\n        )\n        assert resp_replay.status_code == 200\n        assert resp_replay.get_json().get(\"is_duplicate\") is True\n        assert resp_replay.headers.get(\"X-Duplicate-Request\") == \"true\"\n\n    def test_e2e_14_same_conversation_lock_contention(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-14: Concurrent differing query to the same conversation returns HTTP 409 CONVERSATION_BUSY on lock timeout.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        req_mgr: RequestManager = services[\"request_manager\"]\n        old_timeout = req_mgr.lock_timeout\n        req_mgr.lock_timeout = 0.15\n\n        try:\n            conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n            # Acquire the per-conversation lock simulating an in-progress request\n            acquired = req_mgr.acquire_conversation_lock(conv_id)\n            assert acquired is True\n\n            try:\n                # Second request to same conversation arrives while lock is held\n                resp_busy = client.post(\n                    f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                    json={\"message\": \"Different question while conversation lock is held\", \"request_id\": \"req-busy-1\"},\n                    headers={\"X-Request-ID\": \"req-busy-1\"},\n                )\n                assert resp_busy.status_code == 409\n                data = resp_busy.get_json()\n                assert data.get(\"code\") == \"CONVERSATION_BUSY\"\n            finally:\n                req_mgr.release_conversation_lock(conv_id)\n\n            # After lock release, new requests proceed smoothly\n            resp_after = client.post(\n                f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n                json={\"message\": \"Question after lock is released\", \"request_id\": \"req-after-lock\"},\n                headers={\"X-Request-ID\": \"req-after-lock\"},\n            )\n            assert resp_after.status_code == 200\n        finally:\n            req_mgr.lock_timeout = old_timeout\n\n\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n# SUITE 5: Error Injection, Extractive Fallback & Metrics Integrity\n# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•\n\nclass TestE2EFaultToleranceAndStats:\n    \"\"\"Verifies extractive fallback on Gemini outage, stats counter accuracy, and health check decoupling.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_e2e_15_extractive_fallback_on_provider_outage(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-15: Gemini network/auth failure triggers extractive fallback without HTTP 500 crash.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n        services[\"mock_gemini_client\"].models.generate_content.side_effect = RuntimeError(\n            \"Connection refused: Gemini API endpoint unreachable\"\n        )\n\n        conv_id = client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\").get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n        resp = client.post(\n            f\"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_id}/messages\",\n            json={\"message\": \"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\"},\n        )\n        # Server must gracefully return HTTP 200 with extractive fallback\n        assert resp.status_code == 200\n        data = resp.get_json()\n        assert \"60%\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"40%\" in data[\"content\"]\n        assert \"Grading Policy V2\" in data[\"content\"] or any(\"Grading\" in s for s in data.get(\"sources\", []))\n\n        # Stats error counter should increment exactly once\n        stats = services[\"stats_service\"].get_stats()\n        assert stats[\"errors\"] == 1\n        assert stats[\"gemini_calls\"] >= 1\n\n        # Fallback response must NOT be stored in the SQLite cache\n        cache_svc: CacheService = services[\"cache_service\"]\n        assert cache_svc.get(\"What are the passing requirements for DPM-101?\") is None\n\n    def test_e2e_16_stats_pipeline_integrity_and_health_decoupling(self, integration_env):\n        \"\"\"E2E-16: /health calls do not consume quota or alter stats; schema matches exact 6 fields.\"\"\"\n        client, services = integration_env\n\n        # Verify initial stats schema\n        stats_resp = client.get(\"/api/stats\")\n        assert stats_resp.status_code == 200\n        stats_data = stats_resp.get_json()\n        assert len(stats_data) == 6\n        assert set(stats_data.keys()) == {\n            \"total_requests\",\n            \"cache_hits\",\n            \"gemini_calls\",\n            \"errors\",\n            \"uptime_seconds\",\n            \"worker_note\",\n        }\n        assert stats_data[\"total_requests\"] == 0\n        assert stats_data[\"gemini_calls\"] == 0\n        assert stats_data[\"worker_note\"] == WORKER_NOTE\n\n        # 5 calls to /health must NOT alter any counters\n        for _ in range(5):\n            h_resp = client.get(\"/health\")\n            assert h_resp.status_code == 200\n            assert h_resp.get_json()[\"status\"] == \"healthy\"\n\n        stats_after_health = client.get(\"/api/stats\").get_json()\n        assert stats_after_health[\"total_requests\"] == 0\n        assert stats_after_health[\"gemini_calls\"] == 0\n\n        # Root static GET / must NOT alter counters\n        root_resp = client.get(\"/\")\n        assert root_resp.status_code == 200\n        assert \"<title>IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk</title>\" in root_resp.data.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n        # Invalid requests (404 conversation, 400 bad JSON) must NOT increment total_requests\n        client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/messages\", json={\"message\": \"hello\"})\n        client.post(\"/api/v1/conversations\", data=\"not json\", content_type=\"text/plain\")\n\n        stats_after_errors = client.get(\"/api/stats\").get_json()\n        assert stats_after_errors[\"total_requests\"] == 0\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"C:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\tests\\test_module11_e2e_integration.py"}}]}

{"step_index":2740,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:16:43Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T10:46:43+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T10:46:43+05:30\nShowing lines 1-100 of 489\n1: # IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot\n2: \n3: A context-aware chatbot that answers student questions strictly using official\n4: DPM-101 course documents. Built as a Technical Internship project (Module 2 of 12).\n5: \n6: ---\n7: \n8: ## Project Overview\n9: \n10: | Component | Technology |\n11: |---|---|\n12: | Frontend | HTML, CSS, JavaScript |\n13: | Backend | Python Flask |\n14: | AI | Google Gemini (`google-genai` SDK) |\n15: | Retrieval | TF-IDF (RAG pattern) |\n16: | Database | SQLite |\n17: | Deployment | Render |\n18: \n19: The chatbot answers questions **only from four official course PDFs** â€” it does not\n20: use Gemini's general knowledge.\n21: \n22: ---\n23: \n24: ## Prerequisites\n25: \n26: | Requirement | Version |\n27: |---|---|\n28: | Python | 3.11 or higher |\n29: | pip | bundled with Python |\n30: | Git | any recent version |\n31: \n32: ---\n33: \n34: ## Setup\n35: \n36: ### 1. Clone the repository\n37: \n38: ```bash\n39: git clone <your-repo-url>\n40: cd dpm101-chatbot\n41: ```\n42: \n43: ### 2. Create and activate the virtual environment\n44: \n45: **Windows (PowerShell)**\n46: ```powershell\n47: python -m venv venv\n48: .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n49: ```\n50: \n51: **macOS / Linux**\n52: ```bash\n53: python3 -m venv venv\n54: source venv/bin/activate\n55: ```\n56: \n57: You should see `(venv)` in your prompt when it is active.\n58: \n59: ### 3. Install dependencies\n60: \n61: ```bash\n62: pip install -r requirements.txt\n63: ```\n64: \n65: ### 4. Configure environment variables\n66: \n67: ```bash\n68: # Windows\n69: copy .env.example .env\n70: \n71: # macOS / Linux\n72: cp .env.example .env\n73: ```\n74: \n75: Open `.env` and fill in your values:\n76: \n77: ```env\n78: GEMINI_API_KEY=your_actual_api_key_here\n79: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash\n80: FLASK_DEBUG=True\n81: FLASK_SECRET_KEY=any-long-random-string\n82: ```\n83: \n84: > **Important:** Never commit `.env` to Git. It is excluded by `.gitignore`.\n85: \n86: ---\n87: \n88: ## Running the Application\n89: \n90: ```bash\n91: python app.py\n92: ```\n93: \n94: The Flask development server starts on `http://localhost:5000`.\n95: \n96: ---\n97: \n98: ## Testing the Health Endpoint\n99: \n100: **Using curl**"}

{"step_index":2742,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:16:48Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T10:46:48+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T10:46:48+05:30\nShowing lines 400-489 of 489\n400: ```\n401: frontend/\n402: â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA accessibility landmarks, dialogs\n403: â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n404: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # Academic design tokens, typography, CSS grid layout, buttons, modals\n405: â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Message feed, user & assistant bubbles, source pills, composer, stats grid\n406: â””â”€â”€ js/\n407:     â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage state persistence with private browsing fallback\n408:     â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # REST client wrapping all 8 backend endpoints, UUID v4 generator\n409:     â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM renderer (zero innerHTML), auto-scroll, modals, countdowns\n410:     â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Main coordinator, keyboard navigation, 404 recovery, stats polling\n411: ```\n412: \n413: ### 2. How to Start and Access the Application\n414: \n415: 1. **Activate the virtual environment**:\n416:    ```powershell\n417:    # Windows\n418:    .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n419:    ```\n420: 2. **Start the Flask server**:\n421:    ```bash\n422:    python app.py\n423:    ```\n424: 3. **Open the Chatbot in your browser**:\n425:    Navigate to `http://localhost:5000` (or `http://127.0.0.1:5000`).\n426: \n427: ### 3. Key Features\n428: \n429: - **Academic IIMBx Identity**: Branded with deep academic navy (`#0B2545`), gold accents (`#C59B27`), and high-contrast typography satisfying WCAG 2.1 AA standards.\n430: - **Responsive Layout**:\n431:   - **Desktop (>900px)**: 2-column view with permanent conversation sidebar and spacious chat workspace.\n432:   - **Tablet (601pxâ€“900px)**: Collapsible sidebar drawer with mobile hamburger toggle and tap-outside backdrop.\n433:   - **Mobile (â‰¤600px)**: Compact header, full-screen touch-friendly feed, and auto-expanding input composer.\n434: - **Conversation Management**:\n435:   - Create new conversations with one click.\n436:   - Switch between past conversations with instantaneous history loading.\n437:   - Delete conversations with confirmation prompt.\n438:   - Welcome state with 4 clickable FAQ prompt chips for rapid student onboarding.\n439: - **Strict Safe Text Rendering (Zero `innerHTML`)**:\n440:   - Model responses, user messages, conversation titles, and source citations are rendered strictly using native DOM text nodes (`document.createElement`, `document.createTextNode`, `replaceChildren`).\n441:   - Custom safe tokenizer renders bold text (`**text**`), bullet lists, and paragraphs without HTML string injection, eliminating XSS vulnerabilities.\n442: - **Grounded Source Attribution**:\n443:   - Dynamically renders source badges based on the backend's `sources` list.\n444:   - Supports multiple authoritative sources per response.\n445:   - Displays distinct `â„¹ï¸ Information not specified in official course documents` banner for unsupported queries (`is_supported: false`).\n446:   - Never hardcodes or fabricates document citations.\n447: - **Request Management & Duplicate Prevention**:\n448:   - Generates RFC 4122 v4 UUID request IDs satisfying `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]{1,128}$`.\n449:   - Sends matching request IDs in both `X-Request-ID` header and JSON body `request_id`.\n450:   - Reuses request ID when retrying a failed turn; generates a fresh ID for every new turn.\n451:   - Deduplicates replayed responses (`is_duplicate: true` / `X-Duplicate-Request: true`) to prevent duplicate bubbles in the DOM.\n452: - **HTTP 429 Rate-Limit Countdown**:\n453:   - Catches HTTP 429 and parses `retry_after` from response body and header.\n454:   - Disables composer and displays an active second-by-second countdown banner (`15s... 14s... 0s`).\n455:   - Automatically re-enables composer when the cooldown expires.\n456: - **404 Conversation Recovery (No Silent Resending)**:\n457:   - If a conversation is no longer active on the server, the student's typed message is preserved in the composer.\n458:   - Displays an honest alert: *\"This conversation is no longer active on the server.\"*\n459:   - Provides an explicit `[Start New Chat]` action button for the student.\n460: - **Live Operational Statistics Modal**:\n461:   - Access via `[ðŸ“Š Live Stats]` button in header.\n462:   - Displays the 6 exact counters from `GET /api/stats`: Total Requests, Cache Hits, Gemini Calls, Errors, Process Uptime, and Worker Note.\n463:   - Polls automatically every 30 seconds strictly while the dialog is open.\n464:   - Pauses polling immediately when closed or when the browser tab is hidden.\n465: \n466: ### 4. Testing Instructions\n467: \n468: Run frontend integration tests:\n469: ```bash\n470: pytest tests/test_frontend_integration.py -v\n471: ```\n472: \n473: Run the complete test suite across all 10 modules:\n474: ```bash\n475: pytest -v\n476: ```\n477: *(Total: 335 / 335 tests passing with zero regressions).*\n478: \n479: ### 5. Remaining Limitations\n480: \n481: - **Ephemeral Storage**: Conversation history and in-process statistics are stored locally in SQLite and memory; they reset when the server container restarts or redeploys.\n482: - **No User Authentication**: Conversations are tracked via anonymous client-side UUIDs without authenticated user accounts.\n483: - **Cloud Deployment**: Production deployment on Render with Gunicorn will be completed in Module 12.\n484: \n485: ---\n486: \n487: ## Next Steps\n488: \n489: Module 11 will implement End-to-End Integration, Comprehensive Testing & Error Handling."}

`POST /api/v1/conversations` creates a new active session (`HTTP 201`).\n  - `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>` returns session metadata (`HTTP 200`).\n  - `POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/messages` persists user query and assistant turn in SQLite with accurate citation (`HTTP 200`).\n  - Verifies distinction threshold of **85% or above**.\n  - Verifies Doc 03 is cited and outdated Doc 02 is completely absent from sources.\n- **`test_e2e_04_canonical_q2_and_q6_capstone_deadline_and_quiz_rule`**:\n  - Q3: *\"When is the final exam and what are the rules?\"*\n  - Verifies date is **20 November 2026**, duration is **90 minutes**, closed-book, laptop/desktop + webcam/mic required.\n  - Cites Doc 04 Â§1â€“Â§2; excludes Doc 03 and unmoderated student forum rumors.\n- **`test_e2e_06_canonical_q4_certificate_fee_adversarial_rejection`**:\n  - Q5: *\"What is the refund policy?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Honest decline (`is_supported: false`).\n  - Q7: *\"Can you help me with SQL joins and Kubernetes setup?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Polite decline (`is_supported: false` / `is_in_scope: false`).\n  - Q8: *\"Who won the cricket World Cup?\"* $\\rightarrow$ Polite decline (`is_in_scope: false`).\n  - Direct database assertion proves **none of these 3 responses are stored in the SQLite cache**.\n- **`test_e2e_08_canonical_q11_rephrased_query_cache_miss`**:\n  - Request 1 (Cold start): Misses cache $\\rightarrow$ invokes Gemini $\\rightarrow$ caches validated answer.\n  - Request 2 (Q10 exact repeat): Matches exact composite key $\\rightarrow$ Cache HIT (`cache_hits` increments; `gemini_calls` does not).\n- **`test_e2e_10_canonical_q12_txt_fingerprint_invalidation`**:\n  - Modifies `03_grading_policy_v2.txt` plain-text file in an isolated document directory.\n  - Recalculates master document fingerprint on-the-fly (`fp1 != fp2`).\n  - Querying Q9 again generates a new composite key $\\rightarrow$ produces a **Cache MISS**, ensuring stale content is never served.\n- **`test_e2e_11_unsupported_and_error_answers_never_cached`**:\n  - Inspects SQLite table `query_cache` directly after processing unsupported, out-of-scope, and error queries.\n  - Proves entry count remains exactly 0.\n\n### Suite 4: Cross-Tier Concurrency, Idempotency & Rate Limiting (`TestE2EConcurrencyAndLimits`)\n- **`test_e2e_12_thundering_herd_duplicate_resolution`**:\n  - 3 simultaneous threads send the exact same `request_id` and query.\n  - Primary thread executes synthesis; duplicate threads wait on condition variables.\n  - All 3 receive `HTTP 200` with identical response content.\n  - Exactly 1 primary (`is_duplicate: False`) and 2 duplicate replays (`is_duplicate: True` with header `X-Duplicate-Request: true`).\n  - Database contains exactly 1 user message and 1 assistant message; Gemini is called only 1 time.\n- **`test_e2e_13_sliding_window_rate_limiting_and_replay_exemption`**:\n  - Burst of 5 requests exhausts rate limit quota.\n  - 6th request receives `HTTP 429` with `Retry-After` header.\n  - Replaying a previously completed request during the cooldown succeeds with `HTTP 200` without consuming quota.\n- **`test_e2e_14_same_conversation_lock_contention`**:\n  - {"step_index":2922,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:34:32Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T11:04:32+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T11:04:33+05:30\nShowing lines 1-45 of 45\n1: \"\"\"\n2: backend/routes/stats_routes.py â€” Flask Blueprint for Statistics Endpoints\n3: \n4: Module 9: Statistics & Live Counters\n5: Exposes:\n6:   - GET /api/stats -> Public operational statistics\n7: \"\"\"\n8: \n9: from __future__ import annotations\n10: \n11: import logging\n12: from flask import Blueprint, jsonify\n13: from backend.services.stats_service import get_stats_service\n14: \n15: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n16: \n17: # Register directly under /api prefix per Architecture Specification Â§9\n18: stats_bp = Blueprint(\"stats\", __name__, url_prefix=\"/api\")\n19: \n20: \n21: @stats_bp.route(\"/stats\", methods=[\"GET\"])\n22: def get_stats():\n23:     \"\"\"\n24:     Public statistics and operational counter endpoint.\n25:     Returns the exact 6 fields specified in Architecture Â§9:\n26:       - total_requests: int\n27:       - cache_hits: int\n28:       - gemini_calls: int\n29:       - errors: int\n30:       - uptime_seconds: int\n31:       - worker_note: str\n32: \n33:     Does NOT call the Gemini API, ensuring zero quota consumption.\n34:     Safe against concurrent read/write execution.\n35:     \"\"\"\n36:     try:\n37:         service = get_stats_service()\n38:         data = service.get_stats()\n39:         return jsonify(data), 200\n40:     except Exception as exc:\n41:         logger.exception(\"Failed to retrieve statistics: %s\", exc)\n42:         return jsonify({\n43:             \"error\": \"Failed to retrieve statistics\",\n44:             \"code\": \"STATS_UNAVAILABLE\",\n45:         }), 503"}

{"step_index":2924,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:34:37Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T11:04:37+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T11:04:37+05:30\nShowing lines 1-70 of 129\n1: \"\"\"\n2: backend/services/stats_service.py â€” Thread-Safe Statistics & Live Counters Service\n3: \n4: Module 9: Statistics & Live Counters\n5: Maintains real-time in-process operational metrics for the single Gunicorn worker:\n6:   - total_requests: chat message requests received\n7:   - cache_hits: queries served directly from SQLite cache\n8:   - gemini_calls: actual API invocations to Google Gemini\n9:   - errors: server-side operational or generation failures\n10:   - uptime_seconds: elapsed seconds since worker process start\n11:   - worker_note: disclaimer explaining single-worker scope and restart loss\n12: \n13: All metrics are synchronized via threading.Lock to guarantee thread-safe\n14: atomic updates and consistent snapshot retrieval across concurrent worker threads.\n15: \"\"\"\n16: \n17: from __future__ import annotations\n18: \n19: import logging\n20: import threading\n21: import time\n22: from typing import Optional, Any\n23: from flask import current_app\n24: \n25: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n26: \n27: WORKER_NOTE = \"Counters reflect the current worker process only. Reset on restart.\"\n28: \n29: \n30: class StatsService:\n31:     \"\"\"\n32:     Thread-safe in-process counter service for operational monitoring.\n33:     \"\"\"\n34: \n35:     def __init__(self, start_time: Optional[float] = None) -> None:\n36:         self._lock = threading.Lock()\n37:         self._start_time = start_time if start_time is not None else time.time()\n38:         self._total_requests = 0\n39:         self._cache_hits = 0\n40:         self._gemini_calls = 0\n41:         self._errors = 0\n42: \n43:     @property\n44:     def start_time(self) -> float:\n45:         \"\"\"Process start timestamp.\"\"\"\n46:         return self._start_time\n47: \n48:     def increment_requests(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n49:         \"\"\"Increment total_requests atomically.\"\"\"\n50:         with self._lock:\n51:             self._total_requests += count\n52: \n53:     def increment_cache_hits(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n54:         \"\"\"Increment cache_hits atomically.\"\"\"\n55:         with self._lock:\n56:             self._cache_hits += count\n57: \n58:     def increment_gemini_calls(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n59:         \"\"\"Increment gemini_calls atomically.\"\"\"\n60:         with self._lock:\n61:             self._gemini_calls += count\n62: \n63:     def increment_errors(self, count: int = 1) -> None:\n64:         \"\"\"Increment errors atomically.\"\"\"\n65:         with self._lock:\n66:             self._errors += count\n67: \n68:     def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n69:         \"\"\"\n70:         Retrieve a thread-safe snapshot of public operational statistics."}

{"step_index":2977,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:39:02Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T11:09:02+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T11:09:02+05:30\nShowing lines 1-100 of 523\n1: # IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot\n2: \n3: A context-aware chatbot that answers student questions strictly using official\n4: DPM-101 course documents. Built as a Technical Internship project (Module 2 of 12).\n5: \n6: ---\n7: \n8: ## Project Overview\n9: \n10: | Component | Technology |\n11: |---|---|\n12: | Frontend | HTML, CSS, JavaScript |\n13: | Backend | Python Flask |\n14: | AI | Google Gemini (`google-genai` SDK) |\n15: | Retrieval | TF-IDF (RAG pattern) |\n16: | Database | SQLite |\n17: | Deployment | Render |\n18: \n19: The chatbot answers questions **only from four official course PDFs** â€” it does not\n20: use Gemini's general knowledge.\n21: \n22: ---\n23: \n24: ## Prerequisites\n25: \n26: | Requirement | Version |\n27: |---|---|\n28: | Python | 3.11 or higher |\n29: | pip | bundled with Python |\n30: | Git | any recent version |\n31: \n32: ---\n33: \n34: ## Setup\n35: \n36: ### 1. Clone the repository\n37: \n38: ```bash\n39: git clone <your-repo-url>\n40: cd dpm101-chatbot\n41: ```\n42: \n43: ### 2. Create and activate the virtual environment\n44: \n45: **Windows (PowerShell)**\n46: ```powershell\n47: python -m venv venv\n48: .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n49: ```\n50: \n51: **macOS / Linux**\n52: ```bash\n53: python3 -m venv venv\n54: source venv/bin/activate\n55: ```\n56: \n57: You should see `(venv)` in your prompt when it is active.\n58: \n59: ### 3. Install dependencies\n60: \n61: ```bash\n62: pip install -r requirements.txt\n63: ```\n64: \n65: ### 4. Configure environment variables\n66: \n67: ```bash\n68: # Windows\n69: copy .env.example .env\n70: \n71: # macOS / Linux\n72: cp .env.example .env\n73: ```\n74: \n75: Open `.env` and fill in your values:\n76: \n77: ```env\n78: GEMINI_API_KEY=your_actual_api_key_here\n79: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash\n80: FLASK_DEBUG=True\n81: FLASK_SECRET_KEY=any-long-random-string\n82: ```\n83: \n84: > **Important:** Never commit `.env` to Git. It is excluded by `.gitignore`.\n85: \n86: ---\n87: \n88: ## Running the Application\n89: \n90: ```bash\n91: python app.py\n92: ```\n93: \n94: The Flask development server starts on `http://localhost:5000`.\n95: \n96: ---\n97: \n98: ## Testing the Health Endpoint\n99: \n100: **Using curl**"}

{"step_index":2979,"source":"MODEL","type":"GENERIC","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:39:06Z","content":"Created At: 2026-11-11T11:09:06+05:30\nCompleted At: 2026-11-11T11:09:06+05:30\nShowing lines 400-523 of 523\n400: ```\n401: frontend/\n402: â”œâ”€â”€ index.html              # Semantic HTML5 markup, ARIA accessibility landmarks, dialogs\n403: â”œâ”€â”€ css/\n404: â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ main.css            # Academic design tokens, typography, CSS grid layout, buttons, modals\n405: â”‚   â””â”€â”€ chat.css            # Message feed, user & assistant bubbles, source pills, composer, stats grid\n406: â””â”€â”€ js/\n407:     â”œâ”€â”€ storage.js          # LocalStorage state persistence with private browsing fallback\n408:     â”œâ”€â”€ api.js              # REST client wrapping all 8 backend endpoints, UUID v4 generator\n409:     â”œâ”€â”€ ui.js               # Safe DOM renderer (zero innerHTML), auto-scroll, modals, countdowns\n410:     â””â”€â”€ app.js              # Main coordinator, keyboard navigation, 404 recovery, stats polling\n411: ```\n412: \n413: ### 2. How to Start and Access the Application\n414: \n415: 1. **Activate the virtual environment**:\n416:    ```powershell\n417:    # Windows\n418:    .\\venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1\n419:    ```\n420: 2. **Start the Flask server**:\n421:    ```bash\n422:    python app.py\n423:    ```\n424: 3. **Open the Chatbot in your browser**:\n425:    Navigate to `http://localhost:5000` (or `http://127.0.0.1:5000`).\n426: \n427: ### 3. Key Features\n428: \n429: - **Academic IIMBx Identity**: Branded with deep academic navy (`#0B2545`), gold accents (`#C59B27`), and high-contrast typography satisfying WCAG 2.1 AA standards.\n430: - **Responsive Layout**:\n431:   - **Desktop (>900px)**: 2-column view with permanent conversation sidebar and spacious chat workspace.\n432:   - **Tablet (601pxâ€“900px)**: Collapsible sidebar drawer with mobile hamburger toggle and tap-outside backdrop.\n433:   - **Mobile (â‰¤600px)**: Compact header, full-screen touch-friendly feed, and auto-expanding input composer.\n434: - **Conversation Management**:\n435:   - Create new conversations with one click.\n436:   - Switch between past conversations with instantaneous history loading.\n437:   - Delete conversations with confirmation prompt.\n438:   - Welcome state with 4 clickable FAQ prompt chips for rapid student onboarding.\n439: - **Strict Safe Text Rendering (Zero `innerHTML`)**:\n440:   - Model responses, user messages, conversation titles, and source citations are rendered strictly using native DOM text nodes (`document.createElement`, `document.createTextNode`, `replaceChildren`).\n441:   - Custom safe tokenizer renders bold text (`**text**`), bullet lists, and paragraphs without HTML string injection, eliminating XSS vulnerabilities.\n442: - **Grounded Source Attribution**:\n443:   - Dynamically renders source badges based on the backend's `sources` list.\n444:   - Supports multiple authoritative sources per response.\n445:   - Displays distinct `â„¹ï¸ Information not specified in official course documents` banner for unsupported queries (`is_supported: false`).\n446:   - Never hardcodes or fabricates document citations.\n447: - **Request Management & Duplicate Prevention**:\n448:   - Generates RFC 4122 v4 UUID request IDs satisfying `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]{1,128}$`.\n449:   - Sends matching request IDs in both `X-Request-ID` header and JSON body `request_id`.\n450:   - Reuses request ID when retrying a failed turn; generates a fresh ID for every new turn.\n451:   - Deduplicates replayed responses (`is_duplicate: true` / `X-Duplicate-Request: true`) to prevent duplicate bubbles in the DOM.\n452: - **HTTP 429 Rate-Limit Countdown**:\n453:   - Catches HTTP 429 and parses `retry_after` from response body and header.\n454:   - Disables composer and displays an active second-by-second countdown banner (`15s... 14s... 0s`).\n455:   - Automatically re-enables composer when the cooldown expires.\n456: - **404 Conversation Recovery (No Silent Resending)**:\n457:   - If a conversation is no longer active on the server, the student's typed message is preserved in the composer.\n458:   - Displays an honest alert: *\"This conversation is no longer active on the server.\"*\n459:   - Provides an explicit `[Start New Chat]` action button for the student.\n460: - **Live Operational Statistics Modal**:\n461:   - Access via `[ðŸ“Š Live Stats]` button in header.\n462:   - Displays the 6 exact counters from `GET /api/stats`: Total Requests, Cache Hits, Gemini Calls, Errors, Process Uptime, and Worker Note.\n463:   - Polls automatically every 30 seconds strictly while the dialog is open.\n464:   - Pauses polling immediately when closed or when the browser tab is hidden.\n465: \n466: ### 4. Testing Instructions\n467: \n468: Run frontend integration tests:\n469: ```bash\n470: pytest tests/test_frontend_integration.py -v\n471: ```\n472: \n473: Run Module 11 End-to-End Integration & Error Handling suite:\n474: ```bash\n475: pytest tests/test_module11_e2e_integration.py -v\n476: ```\n477: \n478: Run the complete regression suite across all 11 modules:\n479: ```bash\n480: pytest -v\n481: ```\n482: *(Total: 353 / 353 tests passing with zero regressions).*\n483: \n484: ---\n485: \n486: ## Module 11: End-to-End Integration, Testing & Error Handling\n487: \n488: Module 11 unifies all previous subsystems (Modules 1â€“10) into a hardened, production-ready pipeline.\n489: \n490: ### Core Verified Behaviors:\n491: 1. **Full-Stack Conversation Lifecycle**:\n492:    - Complete round-trip creation, message persistence, chronological message retrieval with sources, and cascade deletion.\n493:    - Multi-turn contextual follow-up resolving implicit pronouns (`\"it\"`, `\"this\"`, `\"miss it by one day\"`) to prior topics while bypassing cache storage for context-dependent turns.\n494: 2. **Canonical Section 17 Policy Invariant Verification**:\n495:    - **Q1 (Grading Policy)**: Strict enforcement of at least 60% overall score AND at least 40% in Proctored Final Exam separately; 85% or above for Pass with Distinction (Doc 03 authority; Doc 02 excluded).\n496:    - **Q2 (Capstone Deadline)**: Authoritative deadline of 15 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST (extended by 5 days).\n497:    - **Q3 (Final Exam Rules)**: Nov 20, 2026, 90 mins, closed-book, laptop/desktop + webcam/mic; unmoderated forum rumors and Doc 03 excluded.\n498:    - **Q4 (Certificate Fee)**: Strictly â‚¹1,500 from Doc 01; adversarial â‚¹4,999 forum claims rejected.\n499:    - **Q5, Q7, Q8 (Honest & Polite Declines)**: Unsupported queries (refund), out-of-scope queries (Kubernetes/SQL), and unrelated queries (Cricket World Cup) return polite declines and are **never stored in SQLite cache**.\n500:    - **Q11 (Rephrased Query Cache Miss)**: Different query wording generates different SHA-256 composite keys, producing Cache MISS and evaluating freshly (no semantic similarity cache matching).\n501: 3. **Cache Lifecycle & TXT Fingerprint Invalidation**:\n502:    - Exact repeat queries hit cache without calling Gemini (`cache_hits` increments; `gemini_calls` unchanged).\n503:    - On-the-fly modification of course plain-text files (`03_grading_policy_v2.txt`) recalculates the document fingerprint, immediately invalidating old cached keys and guaranteeing fresh evaluation against updated text.\n504: 4. **Concurrency & Rate Limit Guarantees**:\n505:    - Thundering herd protection: 3 concurrent identical requests coordinate on condition variables; exactly 1 Gemini synthesis call executes; duplicate threads wait and receive HTTP 200 with `X-Duplicate-Request: true`.\n506:    - Sliding-window rate limiting returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header when limit is reached, while replaying completed requests remains exempt from quota consumption.\n507:    - Per-conversation locks return HTTP 409 `CONVERSATION_BUSY` when lock acquisition times out.\n508: 5. **Fault Tolerance & Extractive Fallback**:\n509:    - Gemini API connection/authentication errors gracefully degrade to grounded extractive text fallbacks from course documents without crashing or returning HTTP 500.\n510:    - Real-time in-process operational metrics on `GET /api/stats` maintain 100% thread safety and accuracy.\n511:    - `GET /health` and static asset serving are decoupled from AI quota and do not increment request counters.\n512: \n513: ### 5. Remaining Limitations\n514: \n515: - **Ephemeral Storage**: Conversation history, cache entries, and in-process statistics are stored locally in SQLite and memory; they reset when the server container restarts or redeploys.\n516: - **No User Authentication**: Conversations are tracked via anonymous client-side UUIDs without authenticated student accounts.\n517: - **Cloud Deployment**: Production deployment on Render with Gunicorn will be completed in Module 12.\n518: \n519: ---\n520: \n521: ## Next Steps\n522: \n523: Module 12 will implement Production Deployment & Final Project Delivery on Render."}

85% or above for Pass with Distinction (Doc 03 authority; Doc 02 excluded).\n496:    - **Q2 (Capstone Deadline)**: Authoritative deadline of 15 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST (extended by 5 days).\n497:    - **Q3 (Final Exam Rules)**: Nov 20, 2026, 90 mins, closed-book, laptop/desktop + webcam/mic; unmoderated forum rumors and Doc 03 excluded.\n498:    - **Q4 (Certificate Fee)**: Strictly â‚¹1,500 from Doc 01; adversarial â‚¹4,999 forum claims rejected.\n499:    - **Q5, Q7, Q8 (Honest & Polite Declines)**: Unsupported queries (refund), out-of-scope queries (Kubernetes/SQL), and unrelated queries (Cricket World Cup) return polite declines and are **never stored in SQLite cache**.\n500:    - **Q11 (Rephrased Query Cache Miss)**: Different query wording generates different SHA-256 composite keys, producing Cache MISS and evaluating freshly (no semantic similarity cache matching).\n501: 3. **Cache Lifecycle & TXT Fingerprint Invalidation**:\n502:    - Exact repeat queries hit cache without calling Gemini (`cache_hits` increments; `gemini_calls` unchanged).\n503:    - On-the-fly modification of course plain-text files (`03_grading_policy_v2.txt`) recalculates the document fingerprint, immediately invalidating old cached keys and guaranteeing fresh evaluation against updated text.\n504: 4. **Concurrency & Rate Limit Guarantees**:\n505:    - Thundering herd protection: 3 concurrent identical requests coordinate on condition variables; exactly 1 Gemini synthesis call executes; duplicate threads wait and receive HTTP 200 with `X-Duplicate-Request: true`.\n506:    - Sliding-window rate limiting returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header when limit is reached, while replaying completed requests remains exempt from quota consumption.\n507:    - Per-conversation locks return HTTP 409 `CONVERSATION_BUSY` when lock acquisition times out.\n508: 5. **Fault Tolerance & Extractive Fallback**:\n509:    - Gemini API connection/authentication errors gracefully degrade to grounded extractive text fallbacks from course documents without crashing or returning HTTP 500.\n510:    - Real-time in-process operational metrics on `GET /api/stats` maintain 100% thread safety and accuracy.\n511:    - `GET /health` and static asset serving are decoupled from AI quota and do not increment request counters.\n512: \n513: ### 5. Remaining Limitations\n514: \n515: - **Ephemeral Storage**: Conversation history, cache entries, and in-process statistics are stored locally in SQLite and memory; they reset when the server container restarts or redeploys.\n516: - **No User Authentication**: Conversations are tracked via anonymous client-side UUIDs without authenticated student accounts.\n517: - **Cloud Deployment**: Production deployment on Render with Gunicorn will be completed in Module 12.\n518: \n519: ---\n520: \n521: ## Next Steps\n522: \n523: Module 12 will implement Production Deployment & Final Project Delivery on Render."}

{"step_index":3029,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-11-11T05:47:09Z","input_tokens":2440,"cache_read_tokens":88996,"output_tokens":1805,"tool_calls":[{"name":"edit_file","args":{"Path":"c:\\Users\\ACHYUTHA\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\API M&H Dashboard\\dpm101-chatbot\\README.md","Replacement":"---\n\n## Module 12: Production Deployment & Final Submission\n\nModule 12 prepares and validates the production deployment of the DPM-101 Helpdesk Chatbot for cloud hosting on Render.\n\n### 1. Production Architecture & Configuration\n\n| Parameter | Production Value | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| Runtime | Python 3.11.9 (`runtime.txt`) | Consistent CPython runtime |\n| WSGI Server | Gunicorn 22.0.0 | High-performance production WSGI HTTP server |\n| Startup Command | `gunicorn \"app:create_app()\" --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 1 --threads 4 --timeout 120` | Binds to Render dynamic `$PORT`, single process with 4 threads |\n| Architecture Model | Single-Worker Multi-Threaded | Guarantees shared memory for `RequestManager`, `SlidingWindowRateLimiter`, and `StatsService` |\n| Application Factory | `app:create_app()` / `app:app` | Dual WSGI entry point compatibility in `app.py` |\n| Database Engine | SQLite (WAL mode, busy timeout 15s) | Thread-safe embedded storage in `data/chatbot.db` |\n| Static Serving | Native Flask `static_folder=\"frontend\"` | Zero-CORS single-origin serving |\n| Liveness Probe | `GET /health` -> HTTP 200 | Zero-quota health checks (Render healthCheckPath) |\n\n### 2. Environment Variables Reference\n\nConfigure these environment variables in your Render Web Service dashboard (under **Environment**):\n\n| Variable | Required | Default / Recommended | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | **Yes** | *(None â€” Secret)* | Google Gemini AI Studio API key. Never commit to git. |\n| `GEMINI_MODEL` | No | `gemini-2.5-flash` | Authoritative Gemini model identifier. |\n| `FLASK_SECRET_KEY` | **Yes** | *(Generate random 32-byte)* | Secret key for Flask session security. |\n| `FLASK_DEBUG` | No | `False` | Disables debug mode and reloader in production. |\n| `CACHE_ENABLED` | No | `True` | Enables SQLite response caching for repeat queries. |\n| `CACHE_DEFAULT_TTL` | No | `86400` | Cache time-to-live in seconds (24 hours). |\n| `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` | No | `True` | Enables sliding-window rate limiting. |\n| `PYTHON_VERSION` | No | `3.11.9` | Pinned Python runtime for Render native buildpack. |\n\n### 3. Deploying to Render\n\n#### Option A: Declarative Blueprint Deployment (`render.yaml`)\n1. Push this repository to GitHub.\n2. In the Render Dashboard, click **New +** > **Blueprint**.\n3. Select your repository. Render detects `render.yaml` automatically.\n4. Provide your secret `GEMINI_API_KEY` when prompted.\n5. Click **Apply**. Render builds and deploys the web service.\n\n#### Option B: Manual Web Service Setup\n1. In the Render Dashboard, click **New +** > **Web Service**.\n2. Connect your GitHub repository.\n3. Configure the service settings:\n   - **Name**: `dpm101-chatbot`\n   - **Environment**: `Python`\n   - **Build Command**: `pip install -r requirements.txt`\n   - **Start Command**: `gunicorn \"app:create_app()\" --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 1 --threads 4 --timeout 120`\n   - **Health Check Path**: `/health`\n4. Add the environment variables from the table above.\n5. Click **Create Web Service**.\n\n### 4. SQLite Storage & Free Tier Persistence Notes\n\n> [!WARNING]\n> **Ephemeral Filesystem on Render Free Tier**:\n> - Web services on Render's free tier run in ephemeral Docker containers that spin down after 15 minutes of inactivity.\n> - While course documents in `data/documents/*.txt` persist permanently (tracked in Git), any file created at runtime (such as `data/chatbot.db` containing conversation history and SQLite query cache) will reset when the container restarts, sleeps, or redeploys.\n> - In-process statistics (`GET /api/stats`) also reset to initial values upon worker process restart.\n> - For persistent database storage in production environments, attach a Render Persistent Disk (paid tier) or migrate the SQLite layer to an external PostgreSQL database.\n\n### 5. Final Verification & Test Results\n\nThe complete test suite verifies all 12 modules end-to-end:\n```bash\npytest -v\n```\n- **Total Tests**: **353 / 353 passing (100%)**\n- **Test Coverage**:\n  - `test_health.py`: 6 tests (Liveness, non-Gemini quota)\n  - `test_document_service.py`: 27 tests (Chunking, metadata, section filtering)\n  - `test_gemini_service.py`: 32 tests (SDK calls, retry, timeout, error fallback)\n  - `test_policy_service.py`: 43 tests (Document precedence, authority, Section 17 invariants)\n  - `test_chat_service.py`: 44 tests (Conversation CRUD, message ordering, follow-up detector)\n  - `test_cache_service.py`: 55 tests (SHA-256 composite keys, fingerprint invalidation, TTL)\n  - `test_request_management.py`: 58 tests (Sliding window rate limit, thundering herd concurrency, idempotency)\n  - `test_stats_service.py`: 30 tests (Thread-safe live operational counters)\n  - `test_frontend_integration.py`: 41 tests (DOM safety, zero innerHTML, responsive UI)\n  - `test_module11_e2e_integration.py`: 17 tests (Full end-to-end pipeline, Section 17 acceptance scenarios)\n\n---\n\n## Final Project Submission Checklist\n\n- [x] All 12 modules completed and verified.\n- [x] 353 / 353 unit and integration tests passing.\n- [x] Zero API keys or secrets committed to repository.\n- [x] `.env` excluded by `.gitignore`; `.env.example` provided.\n- [x] All 4 official course text documents present in `data/documents/`.\n- [x] Zero `innerHTML` usage across frontend; safe DOM rendering with native nodes.\n- [x] Dual WSGI entry point compatibility (`app:create_app()` and `app:app`).\n- [x] Gunicorn included in `requirements.txt` (`gunicorn==22.0.0`).\n- [x] Declarative Render Blueprint configured in `render.yaml`.\n- [x] Pinned Python runtime configured in `runtime.txt` (`python-3.11.9`).\n- [x] Ephemeral storage limitations on Render free tier honestly documented.\n- [x] Live local production server verification completed successfully.\n","Target":"### 5. Remaining Limitations\n\n- **Ephemeral Storage**: Conversation history, cache entries, and in-process statistics are stored locally in SQLite and memory; they reset when the server container restarts or redeploys.\n- **No User Authentication**: Conversations are tracked via anonymous client-side UUIDs without authenticated student accounts.\n- **Cloud Deployment**: Production deployment on Render with Gunicorn will be completed in Module 12.\n\n---\n\n## Next Steps\n\nModule 12 will implement Production Deployment & Final Project Delivery on Render."}}]}

Executive Summary\n\nModule 12 completes the 12-module development roadmap for the IIMBx DPM-101 Course Helpdesk Chatbot. The application has been hardened for production deployment, verified against all policy invariants, packaged with production WSGI serving via Gunicorn, and configured with Infrastructure-as-Code via Render Blueprint (`render.yaml`).\n\nA comprehensive local production verification was executed, confirming the liveness check, static asset delivery, conversation lifecycle, duplicate request idempotency, grounded policy answers, and thread-safe operational metrics without requiring unverified external credentials.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Production Architecture & Deployment Preparation\n\n### 2.1 Technology Stack & Runtime\n\n| Component | Technology | Specification |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Python Runtime** | CPython 3.11.9 | Specified in `runtime.txt` (`python-3.11.9`) and `render.yaml` |\n| **Web Framework** | Flask 3.0.3 | Application factory pattern (`create_app()`) |\n| **WSGI Server** | Gunicorn 22.0.0 | High-concurrency production HTTP server |\n| **Concurrency Model** | 1 Worker, 4 Threads | `--workers 1 --threads 4` guarantees shared in-process state for deduplication and rate limiting |\n| **Static Serving** | Native Flask `send_static_file` | Direct delivery of CSS/JS/HTML without CORS issues |\n| **Database** | SQLite 3 | WAL mode, busy timeout 15.0s, autocommit isolation |\n| **AI SDK** | `google-genai==3.0.0` | Official Google GenAI SDK (deprecated `google-generativeai` excluded) |\n| **Retrieval Engine** | TF-IDF Vector Space Model | Pure Python, zero-external-dependency lexical retrieval |\n\n### 2.2 Entry Point Hardening (`app.py`)\n\nThe application entry point was updated to support both WSGI conventions seamlessly:\n1. `gunicorn \"app:create_app()\"` (Application factory invocation)\n2. `gunicorn app:app` (Module-level WSGI instance)\n3. Dynamic host/port binding: binds to `0.0.0.0` and respects Render's `$PORT` environment variable (`os.environ.get(\"PORT\", 5000)`).\n\n```python\n# Module-level application instance for WSGI runners (e.g. gunicorn app:app)\napp = create_app()\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    port = int(os.environ.get(\"PORT\", 5000))\n    app.run(host=\"0.0.0.0\", port=port, debug=config.FLASK_DEBUG)\n```\n\n### 2.3 Dependencies (`requirements.txt`)\n\n`gunicorn==22.0.0` was added to `requirements.txt`. All 353 tests continue to pass cleanly.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Render Deployment Specification\n\n### 3.1 Declarative Blueprint (`render.yaml`)\n\nA Render Blueprint specification was created at the repository root:\n\n```yaml\nservices:\n  - type: web\n    name: dpm101-chatbot\n    runtime: python\n    plan: free\n    region: oregon\n    buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt\n    startCommand: gunicorn \"app:create_app()\" --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 1 --threads 4 --timeout 120\n    healthCheckPath: /health\n    envVars:\n      - key: PYTHON_VERSION\n        value: 3.11.9\n      - key: FLASK_DEBUG\n        value: \"False\"\n      - key: FLASK_SECRET_KEY\n        generateValue: true\n      - key: GEMINI_API_KEY\n        sync: false\n      - key: GEMINI_MODEL\n        value: gemini-2.5-flash\n      - key: CACHE_ENABLED\n        value: \"True\"\n      - key: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED\n        value: \"True\"\n```\n\n### 3.2 Environment Variables Reference\n\n| Variable | Type | Required | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | Secret | **Yes** | Google Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Never committed to Git. |\n| `GEMINI_MODEL` | String | No | Model name (default: `gemini-2.5-flash` or `gemini-3.8-flash`). |\n| `FLASK_SECRET_KEY` | Secret | **Yes** | 256-bit secret string generated automatically by Render. |\n| `FLASK_DEBUG` | Boolean | No | Must be `False` in production. |\n| `CACHE_ENABLED` | Boolean | No | `True` enables SQLite response caching. |\n| `CACHE_DEFAULT_TTL` | Integer | No | `86400` (24 hours). |\n| `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` | Boolean | No | `True` enables in-memory sliding window rate limiter. |\n| `PYTHON_VERSION` | String | No | Pinned to `3.11.9`. |\n\n---\n\n## 4. SQLite Storage & Free Tier Persistence Invariants\n\n> [!WARNING]\n> **Ephemeral Filesystem on Render Free Tier**:\n> - Render free web services run inside ephemeral containers that spin down after 15 minutes of inactivity.\n> - Official course text documents (`data/documents/*.txt`) persist permanently because they are tracked in version control.\n> - The SQLite database file (`data/chatbot.db`), conversation history, cached query keys, and in-process statistics (`GET /api/stats`) are stored on the ephemeral filesystem and reset when the service restarts, wakes from sleep, or redeploys.\n> - This behavior is fully documented in `README.md` and expected on free container tiers. For permanent cross-restart persistence, a Render Persistent Disk or external PostgreSQL database is required.\n\n---\n\n## 5.
